units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 20|name|3051|0
units.english: Explore <system> again
units.italian: Esplora di nuovo <system>

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 20|description|3052|0
units.english: Bring a group of Remnant scientists to the <destination>, together with the Petrel you have been given, exactly on <date>.
units.italian: Porta un gruppo di scienziati Remnant sul <destination>, insieme al Petrel che ti è stato dato, esattamente il <date>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 20|After asking for directions to a few locals, you meet up with Dusk again. In the background, you see a half-open Petrel suspended by some wires a few meters above the ground. "<first>, were you able to prepare the jump-capable carrier I mentioned last time?" Dusk asks. "And is it nearby?"|3062|0
units.english: After asking for directions to a few locals, you meet up with Dusk again. In the background, you see a half-open Petrel suspended by some wires a few meters above the ground. "<first>, were you able to prepare the jump-capable carrier I mentioned last time?" Dusk asks. "And is it nearby?"
units.italian: Dopo aver chiesto indicazioni a qualche locale, ti incontri di nuovo con Dusk. Sullo sfondo vedi un Petrel semiaperto, sospeso con dei cavi a qualche metro da terra. "<first>, sei riuscito a preparare il vettore capace di salto di cui ti avevo parlato l'ultima volta?" chiede Dusk. "Ed è qui vicino?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 20|	"Yes, it is."|3064|0
units.english: "Yes, it is."
units.italian: "Sì, lo è."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 20|	"Sorry, but I do not own one."|3066|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I do not own one."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non ne possiedo uno."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 20|	"No, it's in another system."|3068|0
units.english: "No, it's in another system."
units.italian: "No, è in un altro sistema."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 20|	"It is best to bring it here then," he asserts. "I will be here when you are ready."|3069|0
units.english: "It is best to bring it here then," he asserts. "I will be here when you are ready."
units.italian: "Meglio portarlo qui, allora," afferma. "Sarò qui quando sarai pronto."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 20|	"It is imperative we use one, <first>," he signs, disappointed. "I can request for us to be assigned one, but taking Jump Drive-equipped vehicles is not a quick process for someone at my level. Certainly more time intensive than if you were able to give one to us," he concludes with a low tone.|3072|0
units.english: "It is imperative we use one, <first>," he signs, disappointed. "I can request for us to be assigned one, but taking Jump Drive-equipped vehicles is not a quick process for someone at my level. Certainly more time intensive than if you were able to give one to us," he concludes with a low tone.
units.italian: "È indispensabile che ne usiamo uno, <first>," accenna deluso. "Posso chiedere che ce ne venga assegnato uno, ma prendere veicoli dotati di motore di salto non è un processo rapido per qualcuno al mio livello. Di certo richiede più tempo di quanto ne servirebbe se potessi darcene uno tu," conclude con voce bassa.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 20|	"Very well then!" he signs excitedly, and you follow him in the direction of the Petrel. Once you come closer, you recognize that the technicians are completing outfit installations of all sorts, from additional bunks to a Korath reactor of the smaller kind. "This is going to be the cargo you need to carry to our destination: a lifeboat to escape from our laboratory around Patir, if there will ever be a need.|3075|0
units.english: "Very well then!" he signs excitedly, and you follow him in the direction of the Petrel. Once you come closer, you recognize that the technicians are completing outfit installations of all sorts, from additional bunks to a Korath reactor of the smaller kind. "This is going to be the cargo you need to carry to our destination: a lifeboat to escape from our laboratory around Patir, if there will ever be a need.
units.italian: "Benissimo allora!" accenna eccitato, e lo segui in direzione del Petrel. Quando ti avvicini, riconosci che i tecnici stanno completando installazioni di equipaggiamento di ogni tipo, da cuccette aggiuntive a un reattore Korath del tipo più piccolo. "Questo sarà il carico che devi portare alla nostra destinazione: una scialuppa per fuggire dal nostro laboratorio attorno a Patir, se mai ce ne fosse bisogno.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 20|	"As you might know, the Smew is our typical lifeboat, but this time the requirements are fairly different. Giving a Jump Drive to a fighter is often impractical, especially for an expedition like this; rather, our strategy will be to use it to hide deep beneath the gas giant in Patir for as long as is necessary for a rescue ship to arrive. Thankfully, only a few outfit changes turned out to be necessary to use the Calm Sea Afire for such a job."|3076|0
units.english: "As you might know, the Smew is our typical lifeboat, but this time the requirements are fairly different. Giving a Jump Drive to a fighter is often impractical, especially for an expedition like this; rather, our strategy will be to use it to hide deep beneath the gas giant in Patir for as long as is necessary for a rescue ship to arrive. Thankfully, only a few outfit changes turned out to be necessary to use the Calm Sea Afire for such a job."
units.italian: "Come forse saprai, lo Smew è la nostra scialuppa tipica, ma questa volta i requisiti sono piuttosto diversi. Dare un motore di salto a un caccia è spesso poco pratico, soprattutto per una spedizione come questa; la nostra strategia sarà invece usarlo per nasconderci in profondità sotto il gigante gassoso di Patir per tutto il tempo necessario all'arrivo di una nave di soccorso. Per fortuna sono bastati pochi cambi di equipaggiamento per adattare la Calm Sea Afire a un compito del genere."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 20|	"That still sounds fairly dangerous."|3078|0
units.english: "That still sounds fairly dangerous."
units.italian: "Sembra comunque piuttosto pericoloso."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 20|	"What is the interest of the Remnant in Patir to justify such an effort?"|3080|0
units.english: "What is the interest of the Remnant in Patir to justify such an effort?"
units.italian: "Qual è l'interesse dei Remnant per Patir da giustificare uno sforzo del genere?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 20|	"Are we ready to go?"|3081|0
units.english: "Are we ready to go?"
units.italian: "Siamo pronti a partire?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 20|	"Well, if you ask ten people, you will probably hear ten different answers. For some, it is simply a potential source of new and exciting technology, military or otherwise; for others, it is the potential gateway into a new galaxy, with its own dangers and opportunities." He sits down, acquiring a more pensive look. "But there at least a couple broader philosophies that come in play beyond simple exploration.|3083|0
units.english: "Well, if you ask ten people, you will probably hear ten different answers. For some, it is simply a potential source of new and exciting technology, military or otherwise; for others, it is the potential gateway into a new galaxy, with its own dangers and opportunities." He sits down, acquiring a more pensive look. "But there at least a couple broader philosophies that come in play beyond simple exploration.
units.italian: "Beh, se chiedi a dieci persone, probabilmente otterrai dieci risposte diverse. Per alcuni è semplicemente una potenziale fonte di tecnologia nuova ed eccitante, militare o meno; per altri è la possibile porta verso una nuova galassia, con i suoi pericoli e le sue opportunità." Si siede, assumendo un'aria più pensierosa. "Ma ci sono almeno un paio di filosofie più ampie che entrano in gioco oltre la semplice esplorazione.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 20|	"One is related to the control that these creatures seem to impose over the Ka'sei. The Graveyard as a whole right now is a sleeping giant, after all: if some Ka'het was able to escape its bounds, as we know they have in the past, it would open a second front on top of the Korath threat."|3084|0
units.english: "One is related to the control that these creatures seem to impose over the Ka'sei. The Graveyard as a whole right now is a sleeping giant, after all: if some Ka'het was able to escape its bounds, as we know they have in the past, it would open a second front on top of the Korath threat."
units.italian: "Una riguarda il controllo che queste creature sembrano imporre sui Ka'sei. Il Cimitero nel suo insieme, in fondo, è ora un gigante dormiente: se qualche Ka'het riuscisse a uscire dai suoi confini, come sappiamo che è accaduto in passato, aprirebbe un secondo fronte oltre alla minaccia Korath."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 20|	"What are the other philosophies?"|3086|0
units.english: "What are the other philosophies?"
units.italian: "Quali sono le altre filosofie?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 20|	"Is that a serious risk?"|3088|0
units.english: "Is that a serious risk?"
units.italian: "È un rischio serio?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 20|	"I am stronger than the Ka'het."|3090|0
units.english: "I am stronger than the Ka'het."
units.italian: "Sono più forte dei Ka'het."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 20|	"I hope you are," he signs after a brief pause. He seems unenthused by your remark.|3091|0
units.english: "I hope you are," he signs after a brief pause. He seems unenthused by your remark.
units.italian: "Lo spero," accenna dopo una breve pausa. Sembra poco entusiasta della tua battuta.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 20|	"See, <first>, the extinction of an interstellar species is a relatively rare occurrence in the galaxy. Empires will shrink and grow, sometimes even ceasing to be spacefaring; but it takes incredible circumstances to completely erase such a civilization. It is only natural for other civilizations to want to find out what was able to make the unthinkable happen.|3094|0
units.english: "See, <first>, the extinction of an interstellar species is a relatively rare occurrence in the galaxy. Empires will shrink and grow, sometimes even ceasing to be spacefaring; but it takes incredible circumstances to completely erase such a civilization. It is only natural for other civilizations to want to find out what was able to make the unthinkable happen.
units.italian: "Vedi, <first>, l'estinzione di una specie interstellare è un evento relativamente raro nella galassia. Gli imperi si restringono e si espandono, a volte smettono persino di essere spaziali; ma servono circostanze incredibili per cancellare del tutto una civiltà del genere. È naturale che altre civiltà vogliano scoprire che cosa è riuscito a far accadere l'impensabile.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 20|	"The mistakes done by the Builders, for example, seem trivial from our perspective. This could mean that they made profoundly stupid decisions, or that we have not understood enough of the situation to put all the pieces together and actually comprehend their mistakes. And now we have indications of another, much older extinct species in the space that lies beyond Patir."|3095|0
units.english: "The mistakes done by the Builders, for example, seem trivial from our perspective. This could mean that they made profoundly stupid decisions, or that we have not understood enough of the situation to put all the pieces together and actually comprehend their mistakes. And now we have indications of another, much older extinct species in the space that lies beyond Patir."
units.italian: "Gli errori dei Costruttori, per esempio, ci sembrano banali dalla nostra prospettiva. Questo potrebbe significare che presero decisioni profondamente stupide, o che non abbiamo capito abbastanza della situazione per mettere insieme tutti i pezzi e comprenderne davvero gli errori. E ora abbiamo indizi di un'altra specie estinta, molto più antica, nello spazio oltre Patir."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 20|	He seems dubious. "Answering this question is... more complicated than it looks. We are not certain of how the Ka'het gained keystones the first time, nor how many of them were able to do so. We know that it is a possibility, that the Ka'het as a whole are likely stronger than our fleets, and that no Ka'het has moved past the Graveyard since the Exodus. The truth, <first>, is that risk posturing is a very complex subject; for that matter, the same can be said with our mission.|3098|0
units.english: He seems dubious. "Answering this question is... more complicated than it looks. We are not certain of how the Ka'het gained keystones the first time, nor how many of them were able to do so. We know that it is a possibility, that the Ka'het as a whole are likely stronger than our fleets, and that no Ka'het has moved past the Graveyard since the Exodus. The truth, <first>, is that risk posturing is a very complex subject; for that matter, the same can be said with our mission.
units.italian: Sembra dubbioso. "Rispondere a questa domanda è... più complicato di quanto sembri. Non sappiamo con certezza come i Ka'het abbiano ottenuto le pietre-chiave la prima volta, né quanti di loro ci siano riusciti. Sappiamo che è una possibilità, che i Ka'het nel loro insieme sono probabilmente più forti delle nostre flotte, e che nessun Ka'het ha superato il Cimitero dall'Esodo. La verità, <first>, è che fare supposizioni sul rischio è una faccenda molto complessa; lo stesso si può dire della nostra missione.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 20|	He thoughtfully passes his hand over the hull of Calm Sea Afire. "Only time will tell, but I stand by the decisions we have made. A standard Smew is simple to repair and to keep in storage, but not too useful outside of the Ember Waste. A large, jump-capable starship is complicated to keep in flight-status for months at a time, not to mention the maintenance needs of a cloaking system. And worse of all, it might not even be of much use if Patir was not in the Milky Way when the emergency happens!"|3100|0
units.english: He thoughtfully passes his hand over the hull of Calm Sea Afire. "Only time will tell, but I stand by the decisions we have made. A standard Smew is simple to repair and to keep in storage, but not too useful outside of the Ember Waste. A large, jump-capable starship is complicated to keep in flight-status for months at a time, not to mention the maintenance needs of a cloaking system. And worse of all, it might not even be of much use if Patir was not in the Milky Way when the emergency happens!"
units.italian: Passa pensieroso la mano sullo scafo della Calm Sea Afire. "Solo il tempo lo dirà, ma resto convinto delle decisioni che abbiamo preso. Uno Smew standard è semplice da riparare e da tenere in deposito, ma non molto utile fuori dalla Distesa di Braci. Una grande nave stellare capace di salto è complicata da mantenere in stato di volo per mesi, per non parlare delle necessità di manutenzione di un sistema di occultamento. E, cosa peggiore, potrebbe non servire a nulla se Patir non fosse nella Via Lattea nel momento dell'emergenza!"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 20|	The buzz of Dusk's commlink draws his attention. He smiles, and his tone changes almost instantly. "Ssil Vida is ready to cut the signal. Once they do so, it will take six days for this to reach Patir; at that point, it will instantly disappear, possibly to move into the same cluster we visited the last time. You, I, and four of our researchers must be there when this happens." He rights up and clears his throat. "Captain," he sings, "shall I give the order?"|3102|0
units.english: The buzz of Dusk's commlink draws his attention. He smiles, and his tone changes almost instantly. "Ssil Vida is ready to cut the signal. Once they do so, it will take six days for this to reach Patir; at that point, it will instantly disappear, possibly to move into the same cluster we visited the last time. You, I, and four of our researchers must be there when this happens." He rights up and clears his throat. "Captain," he sings, "shall I give the order?"
units.italian: Il ronzio del communicatore di Dusk attira la sua attenzione. Sorride, e il suo tono cambia quasi all'istante. "Ssil Vida è pronto a interrompere il segnale. Una volta fatto, ci vorranno sei giorni perché arrivi a Patir; a quel punto sparirà all'istante, forse per spostarsi nello stesso ammasso che abbiamo visitato l'ultima volta. Tu, io e quattro dei nostri ricercatori dobbiamo essere lì quando accadrà." Si raddrizza e si schiarisce la voce. "Capitano," canta, "do l'ordine?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 20|	"Do it."|3104|0
units.english: "Do it."
units.italian: "Fallo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 20|	He types on his commlink, and a minute passes. When the commlink buzzes again, Dusk makes an uncharacteristic cheer and quickly bids farewell to the people in the hangar. While he gathers a group of people, presumably the researchers that will follow you in the expedition, one of the spaceport workers takes a small crystal out of the now-assembled Petrel and hands it to you. "The Calm Sea Afire is in your hands, Captain," she signs. "Treat her well."|3105|0
units.english: He types on his commlink, and a minute passes. When the commlink buzzes again, Dusk makes an uncharacteristic cheer and quickly bids farewell to the people in the hangar. While he gathers a group of people, presumably the researchers that will follow you in the expedition, one of the spaceport workers takes a small crystal out of the now-assembled Petrel and hands it to you. "The Calm Sea Afire is in your hands, Captain," she signs. "Treat her well."
units.italian: Digita sul communicatore, e passa un minuto. Quando il communicatore ronza di nuovo, Dusk lancia un evviva insolitamente e saluta in fretta le persone nell'hangar. Mentre raduna un gruppo, presumibilmente i ricercatori che ti seguiranno nella spedizione, uno degli operai dello spazioporto estrae un piccolo cristallo dal Petrel ormai assemblato e te lo consegna. "La Calm Sea Afire è nelle tue mani, capitano," accenna. "Trattala bene."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 20|dialog|3113|0
units.english: You've arrived at <planet>, but either your passengers or the Calm Sea Afire are not with you!
units.italian: Sei arrivato su <planet>, ma i tuoi passeggeri o la Calm Sea Afire non sono con te!

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 21|name|3141|0
units.english: Lifeboat on the run
units.italian: Scialuppa in fuga

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 21|description|3142|0
units.english: Follow the Petrel lifeboat to <destination>, a gas giant in the same system.
units.italian: Segui la scialuppa Petrel fino a <destination>, un gigante gassoso nello stesso sistema.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 21|The thrilled atmosphere in the bridge, after gradually increasing during the entire trip, comes to a stop a few minutes away from the outpost. One by one, the stars in front of you dim and disappear, until the sky is black once again. And in a few seconds more, the first lights begin their strange dance, soon followed by more and more of them.|3151|0
units.english: The thrilled atmosphere in the bridge, after gradually increasing during the entire trip, comes to a stop a few minutes away from the outpost. One by one, the stars in front of you dim and disappear, until the sky is black once again. And in a few seconds more, the first lights begin their strange dance, soon followed by more and more of them.
units.italian: L'atmosfera di eccitazione nella plancia, cresciuta gradualmente durante tutto il viaggio, si ferma a qualche minuto dall'avamposto. Una per una, le stelle davanti a te si attenuano e spariscono, finché il cielo è di nuovo nero. E in pochi secondi ancora, le prime luci cominciano la loro strana danza, seguite presto da sempre più numerose.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 21|	(Prepare for landing.)|3153|0
units.english: (Prepare for landing.)
units.italian: (Preparati all'atterraggio.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 21|	(Set the autopilot to loiter, so as to take a better look.)|3155|0
units.english: (Set the autopilot to loiter, so as to take a better look.)
units.italian: (Imposta il pilota automatico in attesa, per guardare meglio.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 21|	The Remnant have scattered their own machines all around your ship while you were busy piloting. Every one of your windows has at least one contraption mounted in front of it, often with some tape keeping it in place, all of which are now buzzing cheerfully and scanning the spectacle happening around them. You stop next to one of the Remnant of the crew, who is busy looking into a three-barrel telescope. You don't recognize him as someone who was in either of your past expeditions, however.|3156|0
units.english: The Remnant have scattered their own machines all around your ship while you were busy piloting. Every one of your windows has at least one contraption mounted in front of it, often with some tape keeping it in place, all of which are now buzzing cheerfully and scanning the spectacle happening around them. You stop next to one of the Remnant of the crew, who is busy looking into a three-barrel telescope. You don't recognize him as someone who was in either of your past expeditions, however.
units.italian: I Remnant hanno sparso le loro macchine attorno alla nave mentre tu eri impegnato a pilotare. Ogni tuo finestrino ha almeno un congegno montato davanti, spesso tenuto fermo con del nastro adesivo, e tutti ora ronzano allegramente e scansionano lo spettacolo attorno a loro. Ti fermi accanto a uno dei Remnant dell'equipaggio, impegnato a guardare dentro un cannocchiale a tre canne. Non lo riconosci come qualcuno che era in una delle tue spedizioni passate.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 21|	When you get close to the outpost, one of the Remnant takes a seat next to you. At her suggestion, you keep your ship at a consistent altitude for a minute more to give them a better view of the ongoing spectacle. You don't recognize her as someone who was in either of your past expeditions, however.|3159|0
units.english: When you get close to the outpost, one of the Remnant takes a seat next to you. At her suggestion, you keep your ship at a consistent altitude for a minute more to give them a better view of the ongoing spectacle. You don't recognize her as someone who was in either of your past expeditions, however.
units.italian: Quando ti avvicini all'avamposto, uno dei Remnant si siede accanto a te. Su suo suggerimento, mantieni la nave a quota costante per un altro minuto per dar loro una vista migliore dello spettacolo in corso. Non la riconosci come qualcuno che era in una delle tue spedizioni passate.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 21|	The show soon comes to an end, and you bring the ship down into the makeshift pad next to the Remnant laboratory. It takes a couple hours to deploy the dozens of experiments you have carried here onto the surface; you help the Remnant connect them to some of their radioisotope cells, much smaller than the generators you are used to.|3161|0
units.english: The show soon comes to an end, and you bring the ship down into the makeshift pad next to the Remnant laboratory. It takes a couple hours to deploy the dozens of experiments you have carried here onto the surface; you help the Remnant connect them to some of their radioisotope cells, much smaller than the generators you are used to.
units.italian: Lo spettacolo finisce presto, e porti la nave giù sulla piazzola improvvisata accanto al laboratorio dei Remnant. Ci vogliono un paio d'ore per schierare sulla superficie le dozzine di esperimenti che hai portato fin qui; aiuti i Remnant a collegarli ad alcune delle loro celle a radioisotopi, molto più piccole dei generatori a cui sei abituato.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 21|	"Our stay in this galaxy will not last more than a few hours," signs one of the Remnant once back inside the habitat. The six of you, sitting around the main table, are sharing a quick meal after the effort. "We should get going if we want to complete the whole schedule."|3162|0
units.english: "Our stay in this galaxy will not last more than a few hours," signs one of the Remnant once back inside the habitat. The six of you, sitting around the main table, are sharing a quick meal after the effort. "We should get going if we want to complete the whole schedule."
units.italian: "La nostra permanenza in questa galassia non durerà più di qualche ora," accenna uno dei Remnant una volta rientrati nell'habitat. Voi sei, seduti attorno al tavolo principale, condividete un pasto veloce dopo lo sforzo. "Dovremmo andare se vogliamo completare tutto il programma."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 21|	"Which is?"|3164|0
units.english: "Which is?"
units.italian: "Che sarebbe?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 21|	"Why not stay for longer?"|3166|0
units.english: "Why not stay for longer?"
units.italian: "Perché non restare più a lungo?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 21|	"That was the verdict made in Ssil Vida," she replies.|3167|0
units.english: "That was the verdict made in Ssil Vida," she replies.
units.italian: "È stato il verdetto di Ssil Vida," risponde.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 21|	"It was decided that the first intentional mission should be as short as reasonably possible," Dusk intervenes in a slightly sour tone. "Much like the first trips into space, we will be able to do little beyond staying here and observing our surroundings." He pauses, glancing at the Petrel connected with the laboratory by a short tunnel.|3169|0
units.english: "It was decided that the first intentional mission should be as short as reasonably possible," Dusk intervenes in a slightly sour tone. "Much like the first trips into space, we will be able to do little beyond staying here and observing our surroundings." He pauses, glancing at the Petrel connected with the laboratory by a short tunnel.
units.italian: "Si è deciso che la prima missione intenzionale debba essere il più breve possibile, ragionevolmente," interviene Dusk con tono un po' acido. "Proprio come i primi viaggi nello spazio, potremo fare poco più che restare qui e osservare ciò che ci circonda." Si ferma, dando un'occhiata al Petrel collegato al laboratorio da un breve tunnel.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 21|	"We should put our lifeboat under some stress testing," declares Dusk. "Most of our experiments are up and running, and you two are the only ones with instruments that require human intervention. If we move our remaining tasks here to your schedules, the rest of us can take the Calm Sea Afire on a test run," he concludes, indicating the two members of the crew opposite to him. They give each other an ambiguous glance, then nod in response.|3170|0
units.english: "We should put our lifeboat under some stress testing," declares Dusk. "Most of our experiments are up and running, and you two are the only ones with instruments that require human intervention. If we move our remaining tasks here to your schedules, the rest of us can take the Calm Sea Afire on a test run," he concludes, indicating the two members of the crew opposite to him. They give each other an ambiguous glance, then nod in response.
units.italian: "Dovremmo sottoporre la nostra scialuppa a qualche prova di stress," dichiara Dusk. "La maggior parte dei nostri esperimenti è avviata, e voi due siete gli unici con strumenti che richiedono intervento umano. Se spostiamo qui i nostri compiti rimanenti sulle vostre tabelle, il resto di noi può portare la Calm Sea Afire a fare un giro di prova," conclude, indicando i due membri dell'equipaggio di fronte a lui. Si scambiano uno sguardo ambiguo, poi annuiscono in risposta.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 21|	"The three of us will get aboard the Petrel and simulate an emergency and a mission abort, abandoning this place at high Gs to seek the safety of the nearby gas giant. You, <first>, will instead act as the danger: your objective will be to hit us with one of your weapons before we can get to safety, if you can. Nothing high caliber, of course, it is just a simulation; still, I bet it will be more difficult than you think."|3171|0
units.english: "The three of us will get aboard the Petrel and simulate an emergency and a mission abort, abandoning this place at high Gs to seek the safety of the nearby gas giant. You, <first>, will instead act as the danger: your objective will be to hit us with one of your weapons before we can get to safety, if you can. Nothing high caliber, of course, it is just a simulation; still, I bet it will be more difficult than you think."
units.italian: "Noi tre saliremo sul Petrel e simuleremo un'emergenza e un aborto della missione, abbandonando questo posto a G elevati per cercare la sicurezza del gigante gassoso vicino. Tu, <first>, farai invece la parte del pericolo: il tuo obiettivo sarà colpirci con una delle tue armi prima che possiamo metterci al sicuro, se ci riesci. Niente di grosso calibro, naturalmente, è solo una simulazione; eppure scommetto che sarà più difficile di quanto pensi."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 21|	"I bet it will not be."|3173|0
units.english: "I bet it will not be."
units.italian: "Scommetto di no."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 21|	"I will try."|3175|0
units.english: "I will try."
units.italian: "Ci proverò."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 21|	"That does not seem very appropriate."|3177|0
units.english: "That does not seem very appropriate."
units.italian: "Non mi sembra molto appropriato."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 21|	He shrugs. "You are the one with the 'fire' button here, after all. You can follow us without shooting, if you prefer so."|3178|0
units.english: He shrugs. "You are the one with the 'fire' button here, after all. You can follow us without shooting, if you prefer so."
units.italian: Scrolla le spalle. "Dopo tutto sei tu quello con il pulsante 'fuoco' qui. Puoi seguirci senza sparare, se preferisci."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 21|	He smiles. "We will see soon! She is more fast and nimble than she might appear on the ground, or we would have not chosen her as our lifeboat."|3181|0
units.english: He smiles. "We will see soon! She is more fast and nimble than she might appear on the ground, or we would have not chosen her as our lifeboat."
units.italian: Sorride. "Lo vedremo presto! È più veloce e agile di quanto sembri a terra, o non l'avremmo scelta come scialuppa."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 21|	"Oh, to be clear," he recalls, climbing aboard the Petrel, "once we are at the gas giant, Pacili, you will not need to go more than a few kilometers deep. You can stay up, near the very edge of the atmosphere, while we delve deep below to test our craft further; you should not need a gaslining ship for such a task." He bows, and closes the hatches separating the outpost and the lifeboat.|3183|0
units.english: "Oh, to be clear," he recalls, climbing aboard the Petrel, "once we are at the gas giant, Pacili, you will not need to go more than a few kilometers deep. You can stay up, near the very edge of the atmosphere, while we delve deep below to test our craft further; you should not need a gaslining ship for such a task." He bows, and closes the hatches separating the outpost and the lifeboat.
units.italian: "Oh, per chiarire," ricorda, salendo sul Petrel, "una volta al gigante gassoso, Pacili, non dovrai scendere più di qualche chilometro in profondità. Puoi restare in alto, vicino al bordo dell'atmosfera, mentre noi scendiamo in profondità per mettere alla prova la nostra nave; per un compito del genere non dovresti aver bisogno di una nave adatta all'atmosfera." Si inchina, e chiude i portelli che separano l'avamposto dalla scialuppa.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 21|	You don your suit right as the emergency alarm signals the start of the simulation. The Petrel zooms up in the sky at an incredible speed, disappearing into the night, and you hurry up to prepare your ship to follow it.|3184|0
units.english: You don your suit right as the emergency alarm signals the start of the simulation. The Petrel zooms up in the sky at an incredible speed, disappearing into the night, and you hurry up to prepare your ship to follow it.
units.italian: Indossi la tuta proprio mentre l'allarme di emergenza segnala l'inizio della simulazione. Il Petrel schizza in cielo a una velocità incredibile, sparendo nella notte, e tu ti affretti a preparare la nave per seguirlo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 22|name|3202|0
units.english: End of the tests
units.italian: Fine dei test

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 22|description|3203|0
units.english: Return to the <destination> with the Petrel "<npc>".
units.italian: Torna al <destination> con il Petrel "<npc>".

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 22|You meet up with the <npc> just above the uppermost cloud layer of Pacili. "<first>, what happened to your weapons? We did not record any of them hitting us on the way here," questions Dusk through the radio. The chanting tone makes you unsure of whether it was a taunt or a genuine inquiry about your weaponry.|3213|0
units.english: You meet up with the <npc> just above the uppermost cloud layer of Pacili. "<first>, what happened to your weapons? We did not record any of them hitting us on the way here," questions Dusk through the radio. The chanting tone makes you unsure of whether it was a taunt or a genuine inquiry about your weaponry.
units.italian: Ti incontri con il <npc> appena sopra lo strato di nuvole più alto di Pacili. "<first>, che fine hanno fatto le tue armi? Non abbiamo registrato nessun colpo durante il tragitto," chiede Dusk alla radio. Il tono cantilenante ti lascia incerto se fosse una presa in giro o una domanda sincera sul tuo armamento.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 22|	"I was not prepared well."|3215|0
units.english: "I was not prepared well."
units.italian: "Non ero ben preparato."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 22|	"I chose not to shoot, so as not to put you all in danger."|3217|0
units.english: "I chose not to shoot, so as not to put you all in danger."
units.italian: "Ho scelto di non sparare, per non mettervi tutti in pericolo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 22|	"You might not be as lucky next time."|3219|0
units.english: "You might not be as lucky next time."
units.italian: "La prossima volta potresti non essere così fortunato."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 22|You meet up with the <npc> just above the uppermost cloud layer of <planet>. You call them on the radio to inform them of the shots you landed. "You did well," replies Dusk with an undecided tone. "We will review the results on the way back in a few days to get a better idea."|3222|0
units.english: You meet up with the <npc> just above the uppermost cloud layer of <planet>. You call them on the radio to inform them of the shots you landed. "You did well," replies Dusk with an undecided tone. "We will review the results on the way back in a few days to get a better idea."
units.italian: Ti incontri con il <npc> appena sopra lo strato di nuvole più alto di <planet>. Li chiami alla radio per informarli dei colpi che hai messo a segno. "Hai fatto bene," risponde Dusk con tono indeciso. "Esamineremo i risultati sulla via del ritorno tra qualche giorno per farci un'idea migliore."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 22|	"The escape plan certainly needs improvements."|3224|0
units.english: "The escape plan certainly needs improvements."
units.italian: "Il piano di fuga ha di certo bisogno di miglioramenti."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 22|	"It was quite fun."|3226|0
units.english: "It was quite fun."
units.italian: "È stato piuttosto divertente."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 22|	"Most of it was luck on my part."|3228|0
units.english: "Most of it was luck on my part."
units.italian: "Per la maggior parte è stata fortuna da parte mia."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 22|	"Embers help those who help themselves," he chants in a somber tone. "Still, I will take note of the feedback for posterity. We are almost ready for our descent now. We should be back in about an hour, but feel free to fly around here in the meantime."|3230|0
units.english: "Embers help those who help themselves," he chants in a somber tone. "Still, I will take note of the feedback for posterity. We are almost ready for our descent now. We should be back in about an hour, but feel free to fly around here in the meantime."
units.italian: "Le Braci aiutano chi si aiuta," canta con tono cupo. "Tuttavia prenderò nota del riscontro per i posteri. Ora siamo quasi pronti a scendere. Dovremmo essere di ritorno tra circa un'ora, ma nel frattempo sentiti libero di volare qui intorno."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 22|	"Don't be too hard on yourself," he reassures you. "We would not have chosen her if we didn't think she could escape such an attack!" The radio stays silent for a few seconds, then he returns. "Captain, we are almost ready for our descent now. We should be back in about an hour, but feel free to fly around here in the meantime."|3233|0
units.english: "Don't be too hard on yourself," he reassures you. "We would not have chosen her if we didn't think she could escape such an attack!" The radio stays silent for a few seconds, then he returns. "Captain, we are almost ready for our descent now. We should be back in about an hour, but feel free to fly around here in the meantime."
units.italian: "Non essere troppo duro con te stesso," ti rassicura. "Non l'avremmo scelta se non avessimo pensato che potesse sfuggire a un attacco del genere!" La radio resta muta per qualche secondo, poi torna. "Capitano, ora siamo quasi pronti a scendere. Dovremmo essere di ritorno tra circa un'ora, ma nel frattempo sentiti libero di volare qui intorno."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 22|	"Oh," comes the somber response. "I will take note. At least the rest of the simulation went well," he decides at last. "We are almost ready for our descent now. We should be back in about an hour."|3236|0
units.english: "Oh," comes the somber response. "I will take note. At least the rest of the simulation went well," he decides at last. "We are almost ready for our descent now. We should be back in about an hour."
units.italian: "Oh," arriva la risposta cupa. "Ne prenderò nota. Almeno il resto della simulazione è andato bene," decide infine. "Ora siamo quasi pronti a scendere. Dovremmo essere di ritorno tra circa un'ora."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 22|	"There's a reason for these simulations," he reasons through the communicator, "and there are certainly some quirks to iron out. Our descent now will be the last part that we need to demonstrate. We should be back in about an hour, but feel free to fly around here in the meantime."|3239|0
units.english: "There's a reason for these simulations," he reasons through the communicator, "and there are certainly some quirks to iron out. Our descent now will be the last part that we need to demonstrate. We should be back in about an hour, but feel free to fly around here in the meantime."
units.italian: "C'è un motivo per queste simulazioni," ragiona al communicatore, "e di certo ci sono ancora delle stranezze da correggere. La nostra discesa ora sarà l'ultima parte da dimostrare. Dovremmo essere di ritorno tra circa un'ora, ma nel frattempo sentiti libero di volare qui intorno."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 22|	"It would not have been as fun if the attack was not simulated," he replies. It takes a minute for the next transmission to come. "We are almost ready for our descent now. We should be back in about an hour."|3242|0
units.english: "It would not have been as fun if the attack was not simulated," he replies. It takes a minute for the next transmission to come. "We are almost ready for our descent now. We should be back in about an hour."
units.italian: "Non sarebbe stato divertente se l'attacco non fosse stato simulato," risponde. Ci vuole un minuto perché arrivi la trasmissione successiva. "Ora siamo quasi pronti a scendere. Dovremmo essere di ritorno tra circa un'ora."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 22|	The Petrel leaves your wing and falls like a stone through the cloud layer. Irregular updates from the crew reassure you that their test is continuing, and that their ship is holding up well. You follow their trip on your radar screen until they move beyond the range of your instruments.|3244|0
units.english: The Petrel leaves your wing and falls like a stone through the cloud layer. Irregular updates from the crew reassure you that their test is continuing, and that their ship is holding up well. You follow their trip on your radar screen until they move beyond the range of your instruments.
units.italian: Il Petrel lascia la tua ala e cade come una pietra attraverso lo strato di nuvole. Aggiornamenti irregolari dell'equipaggio ti rassicurano che il test continua e che la loro nave regge bene. Segui il loro tragitto sullo schermo radar finché non escono dalla portata dei tuoi strumenti.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 22|	The stars above you are barely visible through the atmosphere of <origin>, which at first seems normal. It is not until they begin flickering more that you realize Patir is in the process of moving again! There is no way that the Remnant can see it from deep below, and those who remained at the Builder settlement are probably too busy with their experiments to notice it. Chances are that, this time, you are the only person who can stop and take a look at the spectacle. You recline your seat to watch through your cockpit the faint dance above the planet, for once all by yourself.|3245|0
units.english: The stars above you are barely visible through the atmosphere of <origin>, which at first seems normal. It is not until they begin flickering more that you realize Patir is in the process of moving again! There is no way that the Remnant can see it from deep below, and those who remained at the Builder settlement are probably too busy with their experiments to notice it. Chances are that, this time, you are the only person who can stop and take a look at the spectacle. You recline your seat to watch through your cockpit the faint dance above the planet, for once all by yourself.
units.italian: Le stelle sopra di te sono a malapena visibili attraverso l'atmosfera di <origin>, il che all'inizio sembra normale. È solo quando cominciano a tremolare più forte che capisci che Patir si sta spostando di nuovo! Non c'è modo che i Remnant possano vederlo dal profondo, e quelli rimasti all'insediamento dei Costruttori sono probabilmente troppo occupati con i loro esperimenti per accorgersene. Probabilmente, questa volta, sei l'unica persona che può fermarsi a guardare lo spettacolo. Reclini il sedile per osservare dal cockpit la debole danza sopra il pianeta, per una volta tutto da solo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 22|	The sequence you have now seen twice repeats in reverse: the number of stars now grows continuously, spinning or moving erratically left and right. In the last few seconds, most condense into a mass of light that shrinks until it appears as simply another star. Still, you can confidently say that you can see far more stars around you than before Patir started moving.|3246|0
units.english: The sequence you have now seen twice repeats in reverse: the number of stars now grows continuously, spinning or moving erratically left and right. In the last few seconds, most condense into a mass of light that shrinks until it appears as simply another star. Still, you can confidently say that you can see far more stars around you than before Patir started moving.
units.italian: La sequenza che hai ormai visto due volte si ripete al contrario: il numero di stelle ora cresce continuamente, girando o muovendosi in modo irregolare a destra e a sinistra. Negli ultimi secondi, la maggior parte si condensa in una massa di luce che si restringe finché appare semplicemente come un'altra stella. Tuttavia puoi dire con certezza di vedere molte più stelle attorno a te di quante ce ne fossero prima che Patir iniziasse a spostarsi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 22|	Soon enough, the fruitful return of their lifeboat puts an end to your thoughts. Now that you are back in the Milky Way, it's time to pack things up in the Remnant laboratory and make the trip back to the Ember Waste.|3247|0
units.english: Soon enough, the fruitful return of their lifeboat puts an end to your thoughts. Now that you are back in the Milky Way, it's time to pack things up in the Remnant laboratory and make the trip back to the Ember Waste.
units.italian: Presto il ritorno proficuo della loro scialuppa mette fine ai tuoi pensieri. Ora che sei di nuovo nella Via Lattea, è il momento di fare i bagagli nel laboratorio dei Remnant e di intraprendere il viaggio di ritorno alla Distesa di Braci.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 22|You precede the Petrel to the outpost and stand next to your ship, watching it make a fairly decent landing right next to the facility. Despite the imprecision, a tunnel grows out of the habitat and toward the ship's hatch, locking the two of them together. When you enter the laboratory, the three Remnant are giving a rundown of their results to the other two, and vice versa. Both groups seem satisfied, though you feel the pair who stayed in the lab are more so than the other three.|3255|0
units.english: You precede the Petrel to the outpost and stand next to your ship, watching it make a fairly decent landing right next to the facility. Despite the imprecision, a tunnel grows out of the habitat and toward the ship's hatch, locking the two of them together. When you enter the laboratory, the three Remnant are giving a rundown of their results to the other two, and vice versa. Both groups seem satisfied, though you feel the pair who stayed in the lab are more so than the other three.
units.italian: Precedi il Petrel verso l'avamposto e resti accanto alla nave, guardandolo atterrare in modo piuttosto decente proprio accanto alla struttura. Nonostante l'imprecisione, un tunnel si estende dall'habitat verso il portello della nave, collegando i due. Quando entri nel laboratorio, i tre Remnant stanno illustrando i loro risultati agli altri due, e viceversa. Entrambi i gruppi sembrano soddisfatti, anche se senti che la coppia rimasta nel laboratorio lo è più dei tre.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 22|	"We will be ready to leave soon," announces Dusk at last. "After a few hours of sleep, and a couple more to finish setting up the lab. I suggest you take the chance to sleep a bit as well, <first>." He hands you a small crystal, enclosed in a metallic container.|3256|0
units.english: "We will be ready to leave soon," announces Dusk at last. "After a few hours of sleep, and a couple more to finish setting up the lab. I suggest you take the chance to sleep a bit as well, <first>." He hands you a small crystal, enclosed in a metallic container.
units.italian: "Saremo pronti a partire presto," annuncia infine Dusk. "Dopo qualche ora di sonno, e un paio d'ore per finire di allestire il laboratorio. Ti suggerisco di cogliere l'occasione per dormire un po' anche tu, <first>." Ti porge un piccolo cristallo, chiuso in un contenitore metallico.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 22|	"But first, make sure to transmit back to Ssil Vida the contents of this chip. You can think of it as a passphrase - in the event Patir moves without us and we become stranded in the other galaxy, they will move Patir again as soon as possible if they don't receive the passphrase." You nod, and leave them to their rest in the outpost.|3257|0
units.english: "But first, make sure to transmit back to Ssil Vida the contents of this chip. You can think of it as a passphrase - in the event Patir moves without us and we become stranded in the other galaxy, they will move Patir again as soon as possible if they don't receive the passphrase." You nod, and leave them to their rest in the outpost.
units.italian: "Ma prima, assicurati di trasmettere a Ssil Vida il contenuto di questo chip. Puoi considerarlo una frase d'ordine: nel caso Patir si sposti senza di noi e restiamo bloccati nell'altra galassia, sposteranno di nuovo Patir il prima possibile se non ricevono la frase d'ordine." Annuisci, e li lasci riposare nell'avamposto.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 23|name|3268|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Torna su <planet>

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 23|description|3269|0
units.english: Bring the Remnant researchers back to <destination> to evaluate the results of the test.
units.italian: Riporta i ricercatori Remnant sul <destination> per valutare i risultati del test.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 23|You enter the outpost once again, only to discover that no one is inside. A glance out of the small windows does not reveal any activity, and the Calm Sea Afire, still docked to the side of the laboratory, appears to be just as empty as the rest of the outpost. It does not take you long to decide that if the Remnant are not here and you did not see them outside, they must have entered into the Builder settlement.|3280|0
units.english: You enter the outpost once again, only to discover that no one is inside. A glance out of the small windows does not reveal any activity, and the Calm Sea Afire, still docked to the side of the laboratory, appears to be just as empty as the rest of the outpost. It does not take you long to decide that if the Remnant are not here and you did not see them outside, they must have entered into the Builder settlement.
units.italian: Entri di nuovo nell'avamposto, solo per scoprire che non c'è nessuno dentro. Un'occhiata dai piccoli finestrini non rivela alcuna attività, e la Calm Sea Afire, ancora attraccata al fianco del laboratorio, sembra vuota quanto il resto dell'avamposto. Non ci vuole molto per decidere che, se i Remnant non sono qui e non li hai visti fuori, devono essere entrati nell'insediamento dei Costruttori.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 23|	(Follow them inside.)|3282|0
units.english: (Follow them inside.)
units.italian: (Seguili dentro.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 23|	(Wait for them here.)|3284|0
units.english: (Wait for them here.)
units.italian: (Aspettali qui.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 23|	(Get back to your ship and wait for them there.)|3286|0
units.english: (Get back to your ship and wait for them there.)
units.italian: (Torna alla nave e aspettali lì.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 23|	Over half an hour passes before the Remnant show up outside of the outpost. You watch them from the cockpit as they tow and then load unidentifiable cargo into your payload bay; eventually, they all climb into the pressurized section of your ship, signaling to you that they are ready to go back to <destination>.|3287|0
units.english: Over half an hour passes before the Remnant show up outside of the outpost. You watch them from the cockpit as they tow and then load unidentifiable cargo into your payload bay; eventually, they all climb into the pressurized section of your ship, signaling to you that they are ready to go back to <destination>.
units.italian: Passa più di mezz'ora prima che i Remnant compaiano fuori dall'avamposto. Li guardi dalla cabina mentre trainano e poi caricano nella stiva un carico non identificabile; alla fine salgono tutti nella sezione pressurizzata della nave, facendoti segno che sono pronti a tornare su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 23|	Half an hour passes before the airlock opens and the first Remnant comes in. They are carrying with them dozens of heavy-looking containers, certainly containing artifacts found inside the facility. To make their life easier, and to expedite the process, you go back outside and fly your ship closer to the entrance. After helping them some more, and with their thanks, you move back to the bridge at last and prepare for your flight back to <destination>.|3290|0
units.english: Half an hour passes before the airlock opens and the first Remnant comes in. They are carrying with them dozens of heavy-looking containers, certainly containing artifacts found inside the facility. To make their life easier, and to expedite the process, you go back outside and fly your ship closer to the entrance. After helping them some more, and with their thanks, you move back to the bridge at last and prepare for your flight back to <destination>.
units.italian: Passa mezz'ora prima che la camera di equilibrio si apra e arrivi il primo Remnant. Portano con sé dozzine di contenitori dall'aria pesante, che di certo contengono manufatti trovati nella struttura. Per facilitare il loro lavoro e accelerare la procedura, torni fuori e avvicini la nave all'ingresso. Dopo averli aiutati ancora un po', e con i loro ringraziamenti, torni infine in plancia e ti prepari al volo di ritorno su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 23|	The space inside the settlement has changed remarkably since your first encounter with the Ka'sei. Much like around the outpost, an army of small, autonomous scientific stations have been scattered all over the floor, each with its own generator and control system. Near them, you find that a section of the floor has been opened, and a makeshift tent has been erected over it.|3293|0
units.english: The space inside the settlement has changed remarkably since your first encounter with the Ka'sei. Much like around the outpost, an army of small, autonomous scientific stations have been scattered all over the floor, each with its own generator and control system. Near them, you find that a section of the floor has been opened, and a makeshift tent has been erected over it.
units.italian: Lo spazio dentro l'insediamento è cambiato notevolmente dal tuo primo incontro con i Ka'sei. Come attorno all'avamposto, un esercito di piccole stazioni scientifiche autonome è stato sparso su tutto il pavimento, ognuna con il proprio generatore e sistema di controllo. Vicino a esse, scopri che una sezione del pavimento è stata aperta e che sopra vi è stata eretta una tenda improvvisata.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 23|	You try to contact the Remnant with your commlink, and soon enough one of the researchers replies with indications on how to reach their position. A lift of clear Remnant design takes you down a couple floors, and in front of a second map. A stroke of luck: some translations have been taped next to the original Builder writing!|3294|0
units.english: You try to contact the Remnant with your commlink, and soon enough one of the researchers replies with indications on how to reach their position. A lift of clear Remnant design takes you down a couple floors, and in front of a second map. A stroke of luck: some translations have been taped next to the original Builder writing!
units.italian: Cerchi di contattare i Remnant con il communicatore, e presto uno dei ricercatori risponde con indicazioni su come raggiungerli. Un ascensore di chiara fattura Remnant ti porta giù di un paio di piani, davanti a una seconda mappa. Un colpo di fortuna: alcune traduzioni sono state attaccate accanto alle scritte originali dei Costruttori!

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 23|	'Branch of Leaf,' 'Water Moon (?)', 'Exit Lane (?)', and 'Blue To Orange (??)' appear prominently on the map. A thick line labeled 'Safe Hull' surrounds the floor: it appears that despite its appearance, the complex is well protected. You compare the message of the Remnant with the rooms shown in front of you. Based on the indications, it appears that your destination is the 'Exit Lane'. It takes you a few minutes to reach it - the spaces here are far larger than before, including the higher and much wider doors connecting them.|3295|0
units.english: 'Branch of Leaf,' 'Water Moon (?)', 'Exit Lane (?)', and 'Blue To Orange (??)' appear prominently on the map. A thick line labeled 'Safe Hull' surrounds the floor: it appears that despite its appearance, the complex is well protected. You compare the message of the Remnant with the rooms shown in front of you. Based on the indications, it appears that your destination is the 'Exit Lane'. It takes you a few minutes to reach it - the spaces here are far larger than before, including the higher and much wider doors connecting them.
units.italian: 'Ramo di Foglia', 'Luna d'Acqua (?)', 'Corsia d'Uscita (?)' e 'Dal Blu all'Arancione (??)' appaiono in evidenza sulla mappa. Una linea spessa etichettata 'Scafo Sicuro' circonda il piano: sembra che, nonostante l'aspetto, il complesso sia ben protetto. Confronti il messaggio dei Remnant con le stanze che hai davanti. In base alle indicazioni, sembra che la tua destinazione sia la 'Corsia d'Uscita'. Ti servono qualche minuto per raggiungerla: gli spazi qui sono molto più grandi di prima, comprese porte più alte e molto più larghe che li collegano.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 23|	"Captain!" comes the voice of one of the Remnant, "come help us!" You join them in towing a pile of metallic containers, held together inside something best described as an incredibly thin fishing net. Despite the low gravity, the effort exhausts you before you have even passed the gate of the 'Exit Lane'; the load certainly weighs multiple tons. The Remnant explain you that it contains the many archeological artifacts gathered here during your past trip beyond Patir, which were left behind in the hurry after the return to the Milky Way. "Amusingly enough," concludes one of them, "most of this mass is not in the samples themselves - it is in the padding to keep them safe."|3296|0
units.english: "Captain!" comes the voice of one of the Remnant, "come help us!" You join them in towing a pile of metallic containers, held together inside something best described as an incredibly thin fishing net. Despite the low gravity, the effort exhausts you before you have even passed the gate of the 'Exit Lane'; the load certainly weighs multiple tons. The Remnant explain you that it contains the many archeological artifacts gathered here during your past trip beyond Patir, which were left behind in the hurry after the return to the Milky Way. "Amusingly enough," concludes one of them, "most of this mass is not in the samples themselves - it is in the padding to keep them safe."
units.italian: "Capitano!" arriva la voce di uno dei Remnant, "vieni ad aiutarci!" Ti unisci a loro per trainare un mucchio di contenitori metallici, tenuti insieme da qualcosa che si può descrivere solo come una rete da pesca incredibilmente sottile. Nonostante la bassa gravità, lo sforzo ti sfinisce prima ancora che abbiate superato il cancello della 'Corsia d'Uscita'; il carico pesa di certo diverse tonnellate. I Remnant ti spiegano che contiene i molti manufatti archeologici raccolti qui durante il tuo viaggio oltre Patir, lasciati indietro nella fretta dopo il ritorno nella Via Lattea. "Divertente, no?" conclude uno di loro, "la maggior parte di questa massa non sono i campioni stessi: è l'imbottitura che li tiene al sicuro."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 23|	"What is this room?"|3298|0
units.english: "What is this room?"
units.italian: "Che stanza è questa?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 23|	"It does not sound that amusing right now."|3300|0
units.english: "It does not sound that amusing right now."
units.italian: "Al momento non mi sembra così divertente."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 23|	(Put all your efforts in bringing them to the lift.)|3301|0
units.english: (Put all your efforts in bringing them to the lift.)
units.italian: (Metti tutto il tuo impegno per portarli all'ascensore.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 23|	Your reply makes him grin briefly. "We really ought to bring some trailers with us the next time. Perhaps even a camel, or three..."|3303|0
units.english: Your reply makes him grin briefly. "We really ought to bring some trailers with us the next time. Perhaps even a camel, or three..."
units.italian: La tua risposta lo fa sorridere brevemente. "Dovremmo davvero portare qualche rimorchio con noi la prossima volta. Magari persino un cammello, o tre..."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 23|	"Just a telecommunication center," replies Dusk. "Pristine, much like the rest of the settlement, and for us mainly of interest for its electronics - as well as for being an open, spacious room where we could amass our equipment." You look around the room in search of any identifiable feature. Besides pavement-mounted screens and sets of clearly recognizable speakers, both on top and at the bottom of the room's walls - each at least twice as tall as the ones in the first floor. Other than that, you cannot see anything that could give information on the Builders' appearance.|3306|0
units.english: "Just a telecommunication center," replies Dusk. "Pristine, much like the rest of the settlement, and for us mainly of interest for its electronics - as well as for being an open, spacious room where we could amass our equipment." You look around the room in search of any identifiable feature. Besides pavement-mounted screens and sets of clearly recognizable speakers, both on top and at the bottom of the room's walls - each at least twice as tall as the ones in the first floor. Other than that, you cannot see anything that could give information on the Builders' appearance.
units.italian: "Solo un centro di telecomunicazioni," risponde Dusk. "Intatto, come il resto dell'insediamento, e per noi interessante soprattutto per l'elettronica, oltre che per essere una stanza aperta e spaziosa dove poter ammassare la nostra attrezzatura." Ti guardi intorno in cerca di qualche elemento identificabile. Oltre a schermi montati sul pavimento e a serie di altoparlanti chiaramente riconoscibili, sia in alto sia in basso sulle pareti della stanza, ognuno almeno due volte più alti di quelli del primo piano. A parte questo, non vedi nulla che possa dare informazioni sull'aspetto dei Costruttori.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 23|	After much hard work and a short break, the mass of containers sits atop the lift. Four Remnant climb with the equipment back to the surface in order to unload it. Dusk instead waits with you at the bottom of the lift, ready to intervene if it were to malfunction while carrying such a heavy mass.|3308|0
units.english: After much hard work and a short break, the mass of containers sits atop the lift. Four Remnant climb with the equipment back to the surface in order to unload it. Dusk instead waits with you at the bottom of the lift, ready to intervene if it were to malfunction while carrying such a heavy mass.
units.italian: Dopo molto lavoro e una breve pausa, la massa di contenitori si trova sopra l'ascensore. Quattro Remnant salgono con l'attrezzatura fino alla superficie per scaricarla. Dusk invece aspetta con te in fondo all'ascensore, pronto a intervenire se dovesse guastarsi mentre trasporta un peso così grande.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 23|	Dusk, after glancing at his data pad for some time, breaks the silence. "<first>, has anybody taught you the Builder written language?" You shake your head, and he shows you a picture on his pad. It shows a room with a series of circular mattresses, with a curtain separating each other. You recognize the sign above them: it was the one marked as Water Moon in the map. "In the context here, what do you believe the sign is about?"|3309|0
units.english: Dusk, after glancing at his data pad for some time, breaks the silence. "<first>, has anybody taught you the Builder written language?" You shake your head, and he shows you a picture on his pad. It shows a room with a series of circular mattresses, with a curtain separating each other. You recognize the sign above them: it was the one marked as Water Moon in the map. "In the context here, what do you believe the sign is about?"
units.italian: Dusk, dopo aver dato un'occhiata al suo tablet per qualche tempo, rompe il silenzio. "<first>, qualcuno ti ha insegnato la lingua scritta dei Costruttori?" Scuoti la testa, e lui ti mostra una foto sul tablet. Mostra una stanza con una serie di materassi circolari, separati l'uno dall'altro da una tenda. Riconosci il segno sopra di essi: era quello indicato come Luna d'Acqua sulla mappa. "Nel contesto di qui, secondo te di cosa parla il segno?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 23|	"I believe it says 'Water Moon.'"|3311|0
units.english: "I believe it says 'Water Moon.'"
units.italian: "Credo che dica 'Luna d'Acqua'."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 23|	"Something about bunks?"|3313|0
units.english: "Something about bunks?"
units.italian: "Qualcosa sulle cuccette?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 23|	"What is this about?"|3315|0
units.english: "What is this about?"
units.italian: "Di che si tratta?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 23|	"Oh, it is nothing of particular importance," he replies slightly flustered. "Just some bits of information that I find interesting, but they really do not help much compose the bigger picture."|3316|0
units.english: "Oh, it is nothing of particular importance," he replies slightly flustered. "Just some bits of information that I find interesting, but they really do not help much compose the bigger picture."
units.italian: "Oh, non è di particolare importanza," risponde un po' confuso. "Solo qualche informazione che trovo interessante, ma che in realtà non aiuta molto a comporre il quadro generale."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 23|	He smiles broadly. "I see that you have stopped to read the map on the way here. Yes, literally that is the correct translation. But what does Water Moon have to do with what is clearly a bunk room - and, in fact, the only one we have encountered in the complex? Neither this, nor most other signs around this floor, seem to make any sense based on our understanding of Builder. It is far from the first time this happens, especially with texts longer than a phrase or two. Some rules or characteristics of their language are still far beyond our understanding, it seems."|3319|0
units.english: He smiles broadly. "I see that you have stopped to read the map on the way here. Yes, literally that is the correct translation. But what does Water Moon have to do with what is clearly a bunk room - and, in fact, the only one we have encountered in the complex? Neither this, nor most other signs around this floor, seem to make any sense based on our understanding of Builder. It is far from the first time this happens, especially with texts longer than a phrase or two. Some rules or characteristics of their language are still far beyond our understanding, it seems."
units.italian: Sorride ampiamente. "Vedo che ti sei fermato a leggere la mappa lungo la strada. Sì, letteralmente quella è la traduzione corretta. Ma che cosa c'entra Luna d'Acqua con quella che è chiaramente una stanza con le cuccette, e per giunta l'unica che abbiamo incontrato nel complesso? Né questa né la maggior parte degli altri segni di questo piano sembrano avere senso in base alla nostra comprensione della lingua dei Costruttori. Non è affatto la prima volta che accade, soprattutto con testi più lunghi di una frase o due. Alcune regole o caratteristiche della loro lingua restano ancora ben oltre la nostra comprensione, a quanto pare."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 23|	"Logical, and yet the literal translation of these signs would be 'Water Moon', or 'Water Sky'. And the same disconnect between the text in the signs and the actual content of the room repeats more or less in this entire zone, unlike the floors above us. Truthfully, Patir is not the first place where we saw this happen, even if it usually happens in longer phrases than signs. Some rules or characteristics of their language are still far beyond our understanding, it seems."|3322|0
units.english: "Logical, and yet the literal translation of these signs would be 'Water Moon', or 'Water Sky'. And the same disconnect between the text in the signs and the actual content of the room repeats more or less in this entire zone, unlike the floors above us. Truthfully, Patir is not the first place where we saw this happen, even if it usually happens in longer phrases than signs. Some rules or characteristics of their language are still far beyond our understanding, it seems."
units.italian: "Logico, eppure la traduzione letterale di questi segni sarebbe 'Luna d'Acqua', o 'Cielo d'Acqua'. E lo stesso disallineamento tra il testo dei segni e il contenuto reale della stanza si ripete più o meno in tutta questa zona, a differenza dei piani sopra di noi. A dire il vero, Patir non è il primo posto dove lo abbiamo visto, anche se di solito accade con frasi più lunghe dei segni. Alcune regole o caratteristiche della loro lingua restano ancora ben oltre la nostra comprensione, a quanto pare."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 23|	The lift returns to pick you two back up, and you follow Dusk inside the bucket. "It is customary that anyone who intends to work near Korath or Builder worlds learn the basics of the respective languages, but I used to spend some of my free time learning of more specific jargon. I had to give up some of my responsibilities at Ssil Vida recently to have some of my spare time back; perhaps I will be able to use some of it to help with the recent xenolinguistic developments."|3324|0
units.english: The lift returns to pick you two back up, and you follow Dusk inside the bucket. "It is customary that anyone who intends to work near Korath or Builder worlds learn the basics of the respective languages, but I used to spend some of my free time learning of more specific jargon. I had to give up some of my responsibilities at Ssil Vida recently to have some of my spare time back; perhaps I will be able to use some of it to help with the recent xenolinguistic developments."
units.italian: L'ascensore torna a prendervi, e segui Dusk dentro la cabina. "È consuetudine che chiunque intenda lavorare vicino a mondi Korath o dei Costruttori impari le basi delle rispettive lingue, ma io passavo parte del tempo libero a studiare gerghi più specifici. Di recente ho dovuto rinunciare ad alcune responsabilità a Ssil Vida per riavere un po' di tempo libero; forse riuscirò a usarne una parte per aiutare con i recenti sviluppi della xenolinguistica."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 23|	The discussion continues while moving the containers bit by bit, first into the outpost, and then into your ship. Much of the cargo has been loaded by the time they let you leave for some rest and to prepare your ship for liftoff, an offer which you graciously accept.|3325|0
units.english: The discussion continues while moving the containers bit by bit, first into the outpost, and then into your ship. Much of the cargo has been loaded by the time they let you leave for some rest and to prepare your ship for liftoff, an offer which you graciously accept.
units.italian: La discussione continua mentre spostate i contenitori pezzo per pezzo, prima nell'avamposto e poi nella tua nave. Gran parte del carico è già stata caricata quando ti lasciano andare a riposare e a preparare la nave al decollo, un'offerta che accetti volentieri.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 23|The Remnant leave the ship in a joyful mood, despite the effort and the complications along the way. While a carriage leaves with the cargo you brought back from Patir, Dusk informs you that the next step will depend on the review of this test flight directly by the Prefects. "If all goes well, you will find us at a table of the nearby cafeteria as soon as we have taken some rest," he concludes with a hopeful bow.|3331|0
units.english: The Remnant leave the ship in a joyful mood, despite the effort and the complications along the way. While a carriage leaves with the cargo you brought back from Patir, Dusk informs you that the next step will depend on the review of this test flight directly by the Prefects. "If all goes well, you will find us at a table of the nearby cafeteria as soon as we have taken some rest," he concludes with a hopeful bow.
units.italian: I Remnant lasciano la nave di buon umore, nonostante lo sforzo e le complicazioni lungo il percorso. Mentre una carrozza parte con il carico che hai riportato da Patir, Dusk ti informa che il passo successivo dipenderà dalla revisione di questo volo di prova direttamente da parte dei prefetti. "Se tutto va bene, ci troverai a un tavolo della caffetteria vicina appena ci saremo riposati un po'," conclude con un inchino speranzoso.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 24|name|3334|0
units.english: Beyond <system> again
units.italian: Di nuovo oltre <system>

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 24|description|3335|0
units.english: Return to <system> again with the same research team, this time with the intention of exploring the systems that lie beyond it. Be there exactly on <date>.
units.italian: Torna di nuovo su <system> con la stessa squadra di ricerca, questa volta con l'intenzione di esplorare i sistemi che si trovano oltre. Sii lì esattamente il <date>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 24|blocked|3337|0
units.english: The cargo for the next expedition to Patir is ready, but you do not have enough free space. Come back when you have <tons> free.
units.italian: Il carico per la prossima spedizione a Patir è pronto, ma non hai abbastanza spazio libero. Torna quando avrai <tons> libere.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 24|The spaceport cafeteria is brimming with excitement. You take a seat at the table of the Remnant who were in your expedition, who seem to be almost done with their meal. "The first expedition into a new land is always something that deserves celebration," signs one of them, offering you a bowl with a mix of their food. "Granted, only after going there already by accident. Still, this is going to be the first proper exploration, bringing scientific equipment to determine what it is actually like."|3346|0
units.english: The spaceport cafeteria is brimming with excitement. You take a seat at the table of the Remnant who were in your expedition, who seem to be almost done with their meal. "The first expedition into a new land is always something that deserves celebration," signs one of them, offering you a bowl with a mix of their food. "Granted, only after going there already by accident. Still, this is going to be the first proper exploration, bringing scientific equipment to determine what it is actually like."
units.italian: La caffetteria dello spazioporto è piena di eccitazione. Ti siedi al tavolo dei Remnant che erano nella tua spedizione, che sembrano quasi aver finito il pasto. "La prima spedizione in una nuova terra merita sempre una celebrazione," accenna uno di loro, offrendoti una ciotola con un misto del loro cibo. "Certo, solo dopo esserci già andati per caso. Tuttavia questa sarà la prima vera esplorazione, con strumenti scientifici per determinare com'è davvero."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 24|	"What kind of equipment?"|3348|0
units.english: "What kind of equipment?"
units.italian: "Che tipo di strumenti?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 24|	"Sorry, but I already ate."|3349|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I already ate."
units.italian: "Scusa, ho già mangiato."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 24|	"The ones I am trained for are the UV photo-polarimeter and the imaging telescope. And the broad-band X-ray telescope, but that requires little intervention," she replies. "But the full complement is much more than this, such as a millimeter-wave sounder and a trace molecule spectroscope to use near those creatures. What we have tried to assemble is a true research center, far more capable than the standard 6-ton laboratories."|3351|0
units.english: "The ones I am trained for are the UV photo-polarimeter and the imaging telescope. And the broad-band X-ray telescope, but that requires little intervention," she replies. "But the full complement is much more than this, such as a millimeter-wave sounder and a trace molecule spectroscope to use near those creatures. What we have tried to assemble is a true research center, far more capable than the standard 6-ton laboratories."
units.italian: "Quelli per cui sono addestrata sono il fotopolarimetro UV e il telescopio per immagini. E il telescopio a raggi X a banda larga, ma quello richiede poco intervento," risponde. "Ma il corredo completo è molto più di questo, per esempio un sondatore a onde millimetriche e uno spettroscopio per molecole in tracce da usare vicino a quelle creature. Quello che abbiamo cercato di assemblare è un vero centro di ricerca, molto più capace dei laboratori standard da 6 tonnellate."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 24|	She slowly retracts the bowl, putting some of the food on her tray.|3354|0
units.english: She slowly retracts the bowl, putting some of the food on her tray.
units.italian: Ritrae lentamente la ciotola, mettendo un po' del cibo sul vassoio.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 24|	"This time, the payload is going to be very large," Dusk intervenes. "Even larger than the outpost set up in Patir, though it will not be removed from your ship this time. We will stay in your payload bay for our research as you fly toward our destination, trying to make the best use of our time."|3356|0
units.english: "This time, the payload is going to be very large," Dusk intervenes. "Even larger than the outpost set up in Patir, though it will not be removed from your ship this time. We will stay in your payload bay for our research as you fly toward our destination, trying to make the best use of our time."
units.italian: "Questa volta il carico sarà molto grande," interviene Dusk. "Persino più grande dell'avamposto allestito a Patir, anche se questa volta non verrà rimosso dalla tua nave. Resteremo nella tua stiva per la nostra ricerca mentre voli verso la destinazione, cercando di sfruttare al meglio il tempo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 24|	"What destination?" you ask while he takes the last bite off of his plate.|3357|0
units.english: "What destination?" you ask while he takes the last bite off of his plate.
units.italian: "Quale destinazione?" chiedi mentre prende l'ultimo boccone dal piatto.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 24|	"Our first target, after landing in Patir to wait for the system to move, will be the station in Chanai. This will be what we defined as a Medium Endurance trip - a week-long stay in the space beyond Patir, enough to reach the lower cluster but not to make a full tour of it before Ssil Vida's signal reaches Patir again and brings it back. The Long Endurance trips will be what allows us to reach Lathia again, hopefully a couple months from now.|3358|0
units.english: "Our first target, after landing in Patir to wait for the system to move, will be the station in Chanai.
