This will be what we defined as a Medium Endurance trip - a week-long stay in the space beyond Patir, enough to reach the lower cluster but not to make a full tour of it before Ssil Vida's signal reaches Patir again and brings it back. The Long Endurance trips will be what allows us to reach Lathia again, hopefully a couple months from now.
units.italian: "Il nostro primo obiettivo, dopo essere atterrati a Patir per aspettare che il sistema si sposti, sarà la stazione di Chanai. Sarà quello che abbiamo definito un viaggio a resistenza media: un soggiorno di una settimana nello spazio oltre Patir, abbastanza per raggiungere l'ammasso inferiore ma non per fargli un giro completo prima che il segnale di Ssil Vida arrivi di nuovo a Patir e lo riporti indietro. I viaggi a resistenza lunga saranno quelli che ci permetteranno di raggiungere di nuovo Lathia, speriamo tra un paio di mesi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 24|	"I need you to carry a 135 ton payload to Patir stationed on this very planet. If you can, I will call Postverta to send the signal and begin the countdown shortly; if you cannot, we can wait for a couple days for you to obtain the space before we begin the mission. As you have seen, we do not have the time to stop anywhere if we want to be in Patir when it moves away. If you have any escorts, see that they make the jump with you - Patir won't wait for them."|3359|0
units.english: "I need you to carry a 135 ton payload to Patir stationed on this very planet. If you can, I will call Postverta to send the signal and begin the countdown shortly; if you cannot, we can wait for a couple days for you to obtain the space before we begin the mission. As you have seen, we do not have the time to stop anywhere if we want to be in Patir when it moves away. If you have any escorts, see that they make the jump with you - Patir won't wait for them."
units.italian: "Ho bisogno che tu porti un carico di 135 tonnellate a Patir, in servizio proprio su questo pianeta. Se puoi, chiamerò Postverta per inviare il segnale e iniziare il conto alla rovescia tra poco; se non puoi, possiamo aspettare un paio di giorni che tu trovi lo spazio prima di cominciare la missione. Come hai visto, non abbiamo il tempo di fermarci da nessuna parte se vogliamo essere a Patir quando si allontana. Se hai delle scorte, fa' in modo che saltino con te: Patir non le aspetterà."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 25|name|3370|0
units.english: <planet> exploration
units.italian: Esplorazione di <planet>

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 25|description|3371|0
units.english: Bring the Remnant to explore the <destination>, making sure you are there exactly on <date> so that you do not miss the return trip.
units.italian: Porta i Remnant a esplorare il <destination>, assicurandoti di essere lì esattamente il <date> per non perdere il viaggio di ritorno.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 25|For once, your ship's bridge is unusually quiet. The same cannot be said about the laboratory in the back of your ship - the Remnant have all moved there already, in order to activate the equipment for the mission. Each of them stands at their console setting up small computers and strange pieces of machinery, like a well-oiled machine where everyone knows exactly what to do.|3381|0
units.english: For once, your ship's bridge is unusually quiet. The same cannot be said about the laboratory in the back of your ship - the Remnant have all moved there already, in order to activate the equipment for the mission. Each of them stands at their console setting up small computers and strange pieces of machinery, like a well-oiled machine where everyone knows exactly what to do.
units.italian: Per una volta la plancia della nave è insolitamente silenziosa. Non si può dire lo stesso del laboratorio nella parte posteriore: i Remnant si sono già spostati lì per attivare l'attrezzatura della missione. Ognuno è alla propria console, ad allestire piccoli computer e strani pezzi di macchinari, come una macchina ben oliata in cui tutti sanno esattamente cosa fare.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 25|	By the time you reach the Builder settlement, the light show has come to an end. After briefly consulting with the crew, you decide to save some time by launching back to orbit straight away while they finish their preparations. After all, a new countdown has begun: in seven days, Patir will move back to the Milky Way, with or without you.|3382|0
units.english: By the time you reach the Builder settlement, the light show has come to an end. After briefly consulting with the crew, you decide to save some time by launching back to orbit straight away while they finish their preparations. After all, a new countdown has begun: in seven days, Patir will move back to the Milky Way, with or without you.
units.italian: Quando raggiungete l'insediamento dei Costruttori, lo spettacolo di luci è finito. Dopo una breve consultazione con l'equipaggio, decidi di risparmiare tempo tornando subito in orbita mentre loro finiscono i preparativi. Dopo tutto è iniziato un nuovo conto alla rovescia: tra sette giorni Patir tornerà nella Via Lattea, con o senza di te.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 25|dialog|3387|0
units.english: An airlock warning lights up on your control board: the Remnant reassure you that it's because a small satellite is being released from of the back of your payload bay, as it will in every system you pass through.
units.italian: Sul pannello di controllo si accende un avviso della camera di equilibrio: i Remnant ti rassicurano che è perché un piccolo satellite viene rilasciato dal fondo della tua stiva, come accadrà in ogni sistema che attraverserai.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|name|3391|0
units.english: Return the samples to <system>
units.italian: Riporta i campioni su <system>

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|description|3392|0
units.english: Bring the Remnant and the samples they gathered in Chanai back to <system> for examination. Be there exactly on <date>.
units.italian: Riporta i Remnant e i campioni raccolti a Chanai su <system> per l'esame. Sii lì esattamente il <date>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|"Watch your step, everyone," advises Dusk as you step into the station. In front of you, a wide, dark and roughly cylindrical room houses sets of lifts, pumps and various tools all over the walls. The analysis the Remnant have done of your scans must have paid off: this time, you are entering the station from a hangar rather than the fuel tanks. You follow the Remnant to the aft end, where a circular half-open hatch seems to be waiting for your arrival; however, as you all come together to try pulling it open, it does not move.|3403|0
units.english: "Watch your step, everyone," advises Dusk as you step into the station. In front of you, a wide, dark and roughly cylindrical room houses sets of lifts, pumps and various tools all over the walls. The analysis the Remnant have done of your scans must have paid off: this time, you are entering the station from a hangar rather than the fuel tanks. You follow the Remnant to the aft end, where a circular half-open hatch seems to be waiting for your arrival; however, as you all come together to try pulling it open, it does not move.
units.italian: "Attenzione a dove mettete i piedi, tutti," avverte Dusk mentre entrate nella stazione. Davanti a voi, una stanza ampia, buia e grosso modo cilindrica ospita serie di ascensori, pompe e attrezzi vari su tutte le pareti. L'analisi che i Remnant hanno fatto delle tue scansioni deve aver dato frutti: questa volta entri nella stazione da un hangar invece che dai serbatoi di carburante. Segui i Remnant verso l'estremità posteriore, dove un portello circolare semiaperto sembra attendere il vostro arrivo; ma quando vi riunite tutti per provare a tirarlo, non si muove.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"There is something very strange with the mechanism," notes one of the researchers, passing his hands over the side of the door. You come closer to take a look. Despite your best efforts, you can't find the hinges of the hatch: rather, it seems to be attached to the wall by three pieces of solid metal. In the meanwhile, however, some Remnant have taken four drones out of their backpacks. Each is roughly as small as a rugby ball and similarly shaped, except for a white belly, a small wing and a set of mechanical eyes in front of it. One by one, they fly into the small gap, disappearing into the darkness at an unexpected speed.|3404|0
units.english: "There is something very strange with the mechanism," notes one of the researchers, passing his hands over the side of the door. You come closer to take a look. Despite your best efforts, you can't find the hinges of the hatch: rather, it seems to be attached to the wall by three pieces of solid metal. In the meanwhile, however, some Remnant have taken four drones out of their backpacks. Each is roughly as small as a rugby ball and similarly shaped, except for a white belly, a small wing and a set of mechanical eyes in front of it. One by one, they fly into the small gap, disappearing into the darkness at an unexpected speed.
units.italian: "C'è qualcosa di molto strano nel meccanismo," nota uno dei ricercatori, passando le mani sul lato della porta. Ti avvicini per dare un'occhiata. Nonostante i tuoi sforzi non riesci a trovare i cardini del portello: sembra piuttosto fissato alla parete da tre pezzi di metallo solido. Nel frattempo, però, alcuni Remnant hanno tirato fuori quattro droni dagli zaini. Ognuno è grosso modo piccolo come un pallone da rugby e di forma simile, tranne per una pancia bianca, una piccola ala e una serie di occhi meccanici davanti. Uno alla volta volano nella piccola fessura, sparendo nel buio a una velocità inattesa.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"We call them Snipes. They are only suitable for zero gravity, and they have a frustrating tendency of getting stuck in a loop, but I cannot complain about the quality of their work. If only we had them the first time..." Dusk informs you heartily. "The only way for us to get through as well is by melting the attachments of this hatch, which will take the better part of an hour even with our improved equipment."|3405|0
units.english: "We call them Snipes. They are only suitable for zero gravity, and they have a frustrating tendency of getting stuck in a loop, but I cannot complain about the quality of their work. If only we had them the first time..." Dusk informs you heartily. "The only way for us to get through as well is by melting the attachments of this hatch, which will take the better part of an hour even with our improved equipment."
units.italian: "Li chiamiamo Snipes. Vanno bene solo in assenza di gravità, e hanno la fastidiosa tendenza a bloccarsi in un ciclo, ma non posso lamentarmi della qualità del loro lavoro. Se solo li avessimo avuti la prima volta..." ti informa Dusk con calore. "L'unico modo per passare anche noi è fondere gli attacchi di questo portello, cosa che richiederà buona parte di un'ora anche con la nostra attrezzatura migliorata."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"I will try to help."|3407|0
units.english: "I will try to help."
units.italian: "Proverò ad aiutare."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"We could look into another hangar."|3409|0
units.english: "We could look into another hangar."
units.italian: "Potremmo cercare un altro hangar."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"I bet I could shoot it away from my ship much quicker."|3411|0
units.english: "I bet I could shoot it away from my ship much quicker."
units.italian: "Scommetto che potrei staccarlo dalla nave molto più in fretta."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"I think it would be easier to get back to the opening we left last time."|3413|0
units.english: "I think it would be easier to get back to the opening we left last time."
units.italian: "Credo che sarebbe più facile tornare all'apertura da cui siamo usciti l'ultima volta."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"Oh, that is a good idea. Perhaps you could fly by that spot with your ship to check it out while we begin cutting through the door, so that we cover both grounds at the same time."|3414|0
units.english: "Oh, that is a good idea. Perhaps you could fly by that spot with your ship to check it out while we begin cutting through the door, so that we cover both grounds at the same time."
units.italian: "Oh, è una buona idea. Forse potresti passare con la nave su quel punto per controllarlo mentre noi iniziamo a tagliare la porta, così copriamo entrambe le piste contemporaneamente."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	After a couple minutes of flying, you believe you have identified the tanks you went through last time. A closer look, however, reveals no holes of any kind in its hull. Confused, you bring up your navigation log from your previous expedition. There is no doubt that those are the very same tanks that you have cut through with the Remnant last time, and yet there is also no doubt that they are as pristine as they have ever been. At last, you are left no option but to give up and return to the Remnant to inform them of your findings.|3415|0
units.english: After a couple minutes of flying, you believe you have identified the tanks you went through last time. A closer look, however, reveals no holes of any kind in its hull. Confused, you bring up your navigation log from your previous expedition. There is no doubt that those are the very same tanks that you have cut through with the Remnant last time, and yet there is also no doubt that they are as pristine as they have ever been. At last, you are left no option but to give up and return to the Remnant to inform them of your findings.
units.italian: Dopo un paio di minuti di volo, credi di aver identificato i serbatoi da cui siete passati l'ultima volta. Un'occhiata più ravvicinata, però, non rivela alcun tipo di foro nello scafo. Confuso, richiami il registro di navigazione della spedizione precedente. Non c'è dubbio che quelli siano proprio i serbatoi che hai attraversato con i Remnant l'ultima volta, eppure non c'è dubbio nemmeno che siano intatti come non mai. Alla fine non ti resta che arrenderti e tornare dai Remnant per informarli delle tue scoperte.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"That is really not the way to go!" he replies alarmed. "It would be just as likely to be ineffective as it would to compromise the structure of the station." He gives you a questioning look. "If you want to help us, you can do it from here."|3418|0
units.english: "That is really not the way to go!" he replies alarmed. "It would be just as likely to be ineffective as it would to compromise the structure of the station." He gives you a questioning look. "If you want to help us, you can do it from here."
units.italian: "Non è certo il modo giusto di procedere!" risponde allarmato. "Sarebbe tanto probabile che non funzioni quanto che comprometta la struttura della stazione." Ti lancia uno sguardo interrogativo. "Se vuoi aiutarci, puoi farlo da qui."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"I thought of that too. You could take a look around with one of us while the rest begin cutting through the door, so that we cover both grounds at the same time." You follow the indications of the Remnant and look around the nearby hangars, in search of open hatches. By the time you get to the eighth, however, the lack of results convinces the two of you to give up and come back to the group.|3421|0
units.english: "I thought of that too. You could take a look around with one of us while the rest begin cutting through the door, so that we cover both grounds at the same time." You follow the indications of the Remnant and look around the nearby hangars, in search of open hatches. By the time you get to the eighth, however, the lack of results convinces the two of you to give up and come back to the group.
units.italian: "Ci ho pensato anch'io. Potresti dare un'occhiata in giro con uno di noi mentre gli altri iniziano a tagliare la porta, così copriamo entrambe le piste contemporaneamente." Segui le indicazioni dei Remnant e guardi gli hangar vicini in cerca di portelli aperti. Quando arrivi all'ottavo, però, la mancanza di risultati convince voi due ad arrendervi e a tornare al gruppo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	The flash of the blowtorches only becomes tolerable after you lower the sunshade of your helmet. Once the passage is clear, a holographic map comes out of one of their many instruments. "The Snipes have mapped some of the structure by now, including the sections we saw in our last visit. Our priority should be to find a navigation room, in the hope of understanding the function of this settlement or its connection with Patir; three of us should work on that. <first>, another of the items on our schedule is to see the plants you had found nearby. We could take care of that for now, and then join the rest for their search."|3423|0
units.english: The flash of the blowtorches only becomes tolerable after you lower the sunshade of your helmet. Once the passage is clear, a holographic map comes out of one of their many instruments. "The Snipes have mapped some of the structure by now, including the sections we saw in our last visit. Our priority should be to find a navigation room, in the hope of understanding the function of this settlement or its connection with Patir; three of us should work on that. <first>, another of the items on our schedule is to see the plants you had found nearby. We could take care of that for now, and then join the rest for their search."
units.italian: Il bagliore delle fiamme ossidriche diventa tollerabile solo dopo aver abbassato la visiera del casco. Una volta libero il passaggio, da uno dei loro molti strumenti esce una mappa olografica. "Gli Snipes hanno ormai mappato parte della struttura, comprese le sezioni che abbiamo visto nella nostra ultima visita. La nostra priorità dovrebbe essere trovare una sala di navigazione, nella speranza di capire la funzione di questo insediamento o il suo legame con Patir; tre di noi dovrebbero occuparsene. <first>, un altro punto del nostro programma è vedere le piante che avevi trovato qui vicino. Potremmo occuparcene per ora, e poi unirci agli altri per la loro ricerca."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	The walk to the plants ends up being shorter than you imagined, no doubt thanks to the routes found by the Snipes. Without wasting time, Dusk sticks the five tips of a scanner inside its crimson-colored trunk. "Iron oxide!" he exclaims enthusiastically once the results come in. "Just as we suspected!"|3424|0
units.english: The walk to the plants ends up being shorter than you imagined, no doubt thanks to the routes found by the Snipes. Without wasting time, Dusk sticks the five tips of a scanner inside its crimson-colored trunk. "Iron oxide!" he exclaims enthusiastically once the results come in. "Just as we suspected!"
units.italian: La camminata verso le piante si rivela più breve di quanto immaginassi, senza dubbio grazie ai percorsi trovati dagli Snipes. Senza perdere tempo, Dusk infila le cinque punte di uno scanner dentro il tronco color cremisi. "Ossido di ferro!" esclama entusiasta quando arrivano i risultati. "Proprio come sospettavamo!"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"What?"|3426|0
units.english: "What?"
units.italian: "Che cosa?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"How can a plant be made of iron oxide?"|3427|0
units.english: "How can a plant be made of iron oxide?"
units.italian: "Come può una pianta essere fatta di ossido di ferro?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"I am willing to bend our knowledge of plant workings, given everything else we have seen," he replies, half-serious. "It certainly does not seem to be alive now, however. And as far as I can tell," he glances inside the holes, "it does not have any of the stele necessary for such a plant to function."|3428|0
units.english: "I am willing to bend our knowledge of plant workings, given everything else we have seen," he replies, half-serious. "It certainly does not seem to be alive now, however. And as far as I can tell," he glances inside the holes, "it does not have any of the stele necessary for such a plant to function."
units.italian: "Sono disposto a piegare le nostre conoscenze sul funzionamento delle piante, viste tutte le altre cose che abbiamo visto," risponde mezzo serio. "Di certo però non sembra viva adesso. E per quanto posso dire," dà un'occhiata dentro i fori, "non ha nessuna delle stele necessarie perché una pianta del genere funzioni."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"It could be a fake plant," you suggest.|3429|0
units.english: "It could be a fake plant," you suggest.
units.italian: "Potrebbe essere una pianta finta," suggerisci.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"It might. But look at the top: it has overgrown for the size of this room, and its branches had to bend against the roof. A peculiar stylistic choice, if that is what it is."|3430|0
units.english: "It might. But look at the top: it has overgrown for the size of this room, and its branches had to bend against the roof. A peculiar stylistic choice, if that is what it is."
units.italian: "Potrebbe. Ma guarda la cima: è cresciuta oltre le dimensioni di questa stanza, e i suoi rami hanno dovuto piegarsi contro il soffitto. Una scelta stilistica peculiare, se è questo che è."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	His eyes light up, as if he just made a new connection. "There is another peculiarity we have discovered in our data back home. Do you remember the propellant sphere we passed around inside the tanks? The one that could not be deuterium, as hyperspace fuel is liquid in a vacuum?" You nod. "I wanted to wait before we had some sort of explanation, but based on our analysis, the only reading that comes anywhere close is none other than liquid deuterium." He grins. "In other words, a fake sphere of hyperspace fuel."|3431|0
units.english: His eyes light up, as if he just made a new connection. "There is another peculiarity we have discovered in our data back home. Do you remember the propellant sphere we passed around inside the tanks? The one that could not be deuterium, as hyperspace fuel is liquid in a vacuum?" You nod. "I wanted to wait before we had some sort of explanation, but based on our analysis, the only reading that comes anywhere close is none other than liquid deuterium." He grins. "In other words, a fake sphere of hyperspace fuel."
units.italian: I suoi occhi si illuminano, come se avesse appena fatto un nuovo collegamento. "C'è un'altra particolarità che abbiamo scoperto nei nostri dati a casa. Ricordi la sfera di propellente attorno a cui siamo passati dentro i serbatoi? Quella che non poteva essere deuterio, dato che il carburante per iperguida è liquido nel vuoto?" Annuisci. "Volevo aspettare di avere una qualche spiegazione, ma in base alla nostra analisi l'unica lettura che ci si avvicina è nientemeno che il deuterio liquido." Sorride. "In altre parole, una finta sfera di carburante per iperguida."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	You meet up with the rest of the group soon after, working inside the navigation room they have found. "We have found some engravings on the walls that gave us some clues. Nothing on Patir, as far as we could tell; however, the barrel in this station is clearly depicted as pointing toward the star in this system in all of the graphics."|3432|0
units.english: You meet up with the rest of the group soon after, working inside the navigation room they have found. "We have found some engravings on the walls that gave us some clues. Nothing on Patir, as far as we could tell; however, the barrel in this station is clearly depicted as pointing toward the star in this system in all of the graphics."
units.italian: Vi riunite al resto del gruppo poco dopo, al lavoro nella sala di navigazione che hanno trovato. "Abbiamo trovato alcune incisioni sulle pareti che ci hanno dato qualche indizio. Nulla su Patir, per quanto possiamo dire; tuttavia la canna in questa stazione è chiaramente raffigurata come puntata verso la stella di questo sistema in tutte le immagini."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"What would be the purpose of firing against a black hole?"|3434|0
units.english: "What would be the purpose of firing against a black hole?"
units.italian: "Quale sarebbe lo scopo di sparare contro un buco nero?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"What about its computers?"|3436|0
units.english: "What about its computers?"
units.italian: "E i suoi computer?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"We have found something we hypothesize to be large terminals, but they do not give signs of life. We are prying them open right now to get a better idea."|3437|0
units.english: "We have found something we hypothesize to be large terminals, but they do not give signs of life. We are prying them open right now to get a better idea."
units.italian: "Abbiamo trovato quello che ipotizziamo essere grandi terminali, ma non danno segni di vita. Li stiamo forzando proprio ora per farci un'idea migliore."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"I did not say black hole - I said star, and a black hole is not a star. All of these figures are very simplified, but they are very clearly representing a star there in the center of the system." He shows you and Dusk some of the graphics, and you cannot help but agree with the conclusion. "At some point in the past, the Chanai star became a supernova, which collapsed into the black hole we see today. How long ago it was is impossible to say: black holes have the unfortunate peculiarity that none of their features allow a direct estimation of their age, and we do not know nearly enough about this place to use external clues."|3440|0
units.english: "I did not say black hole - I said star, and a black hole is not a star. All of these figures are very simplified, but they are very clearly representing a star there in the center of the system." He shows you and Dusk some of the graphics, and you cannot help but agree with the conclusion. "At some point in the past, the Chanai star became a supernova, which collapsed into the black hole we see today. How long ago it was is impossible to say: black holes have the unfortunate peculiarity that none of their features allow a direct estimation of their age, and we do not know nearly enough about this place to use external clues."
units.italian: "Non ho detto buco nero, ho detto stella, e un buco nero non è una stella. Tutte queste figure sono molto semplificate, ma rappresentano chiaramente una stella al centro del sistema." Ti mostra, insieme a Dusk, alcune delle immagini, e non puoi fare a meno di concordare con la conclusione. "A un certo punto del passato la stella di Chanai è diventata una supernova, che è collassata nel buco nero che vediamo oggi. Quanto tempo fa sia accaduto è impossibile dirlo: i buchi neri hanno la sfortunata particolarità che nessuna delle loro caratteristiche permette una stima diretta dell'età, e non sappiamo quasi nulla di questo posto per usare indizi esterni."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"Still, the question of its purpose," intervenes Dusk. "Perhaps this laser was used to accelerate the reactions inside the star, making it burn brighter even at the cost of turning into a supernova - and then a black hole - sooner. It would not be the first species to attempt something so destructive. But surviving stellar events of this magnitude with no damage is almost inconceivable to me."|3441|0
units.english: "Still, the question of its purpose," intervenes Dusk. "Perhaps this laser was used to accelerate the reactions inside the star, making it burn brighter even at the cost of turning into a supernova - and then a black hole - sooner. It would not be the first species to attempt something so destructive. But surviving stellar events of this magnitude with no damage is almost inconceivable to me."
units.italian: "Resta però la questione del suo scopo," interviene Dusk. "Forse questo laser serviva ad accelerare le reazioni dentro la stella, facendola bruciare più luminosa anche al costo di trasformarsi prima in una supernova, e poi in un buco nero. Non sarebbe la prima specie a tentare qualcosa di così distruttivo. Ma sopravvivere a eventi stellari di questa portata senza danni è quasi inconcepibile per me."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	You help the Remnant lift a screen from the floor, allowing it to float away into the room. Below it, you find nothing of note: no cabling, no connectors, not even a single panel. You try again with the one next to it, and again you end up with the same result. "After this, I would say that we have explored this facility enough for today. Let's get back to <system> and gather our findings; we have more than enough to think about for the time being."|3443|0
units.english: You help the Remnant lift a screen from the floor, allowing it to float away into the room. Below it, you find nothing of note: no cabling, no connectors, not even a single panel. You try again with the one next to it, and again you end up with the same result. "After this, I would say that we have explored this facility enough for today. Let's get back to <system> and gather our findings; we have more than enough to think about for the time being."
units.italian: Aiuti i Remnant a sollevare uno schermo dal pavimento, lasciando che fluttui via nella stanza. Sotto non trovi nulla di rilevante: nessun cavo, nessun connettore, nemmeno un pannello. Provi di nuovo con quello accanto, e ancora una volta ottieni lo stesso risultato. "Dopo questo, direi che abbiamo esplorato questa struttura abbastanza per oggi. Torniamo su <system> e raccogliamo le nostre scoperte; abbiamo più che abbastanza su cui riflettere per ora."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|By the time your ship has been safed, the Remnant have unloaded many of the instruments they have used on this trip. "It would be a waste to take them back home after all the effort to get them here," they explain as you join them. "Once these are connected to our grid, they will use all of the available power and then some. We will have to take turns, at least until we bring some additional power stations." While they finish the setup, you take the chance to cover the machines with some regolith to help them conserve their heat in the night of the asteroid. You almost trip on one of their cables: with the recent trips, the exterior of the laboratory is quickly becoming as messy as its interior.|3450|0
units.english: By the time your ship has been safed, the Remnant have unloaded many of the instruments they have used on this trip. "It would be a waste to take them back home after all the effort to get them here," they explain as you join them. "Once these are connected to our grid, they will use all of the available power and then some. We will have to take turns, at least until we bring some additional power stations." While they finish the setup, you take the chance to cover the machines with some regolith to help them conserve their heat in the night of the asteroid. You almost trip on one of their cables: with the recent trips, the exterior of the laboratory is quickly becoming as messy as its interior.
units.italian: Quando la tua nave è stata messa in sicurezza, i Remnant hanno scaricato molti degli strumenti usati in questo viaggio. "Sarebbe uno spreco riportarli a casa dopo tutta la fatica per portarli qui," spiegano mentre ti unisci a loro. "Una volta collegati alla nostra rete, useranno tutta la potenza disponibile e anche di più. Dovremo alternarci, almeno finché non porteremo qualche stazione di energia in più." Mentre finiscono l'installazione, cogli l'occasione per coprire le macchine con un po' di regolite, per aiutarle a conservare il calore nella notte dell'asteroide. Quasi inciampi in uno dei loro cavi: con i viaggi recenti, l'esterno del laboratorio sta diventando in fretta disordinato quanto l'interno.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	Sitting around the table in the outpost, and sharing a hot drink, the discussions continue. "By our calculations, Patir should be moving back to the Milky Way within the next few hours. For our part, we will be ready to depart by next morning and conclude our expedition."|3452|0
units.english: Sitting around the table in the outpost, and sharing a hot drink, the discussions continue. "By our calculations, Patir should be moving back to the Milky Way within the next few hours. For our part, we will be ready to depart by next morning and conclude our expedition."
units.italian: Seduti attorno al tavolo dell'avamposto e condividendo una bevanda calda, le discussioni continuano. "Secondo i nostri calcoli, Patir dovrebbe tornare nella Via Lattea entro le prossime ore. Da parte nostra, saremo pronti a partire domani mattina e a concludere la spedizione."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"What did you discover about Chanai?"|3454|0
units.english: "What did you discover about Chanai?"
units.italian: "Che cosa avete scoperto su Chanai?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"What about our findings aboard the station?"|3455|0
units.english: "What about our findings aboard the station?"
units.italian: "E le nostre scoperte a bordo della stazione?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	They share a pensive look before replying. "Based on the various, contradictory, and - apparently - nonsensical things we have discovered, we have developed a theory. One that could be described it both as simple and as incredibly complex."|3456|0
units.english: They share a pensive look before replying. "Based on the various, contradictory, and - apparently - nonsensical things we have discovered, we have developed a theory. One that could be described it both as simple and as incredibly complex."
units.italian: Si scambiano uno sguardo pensieroso prima di rispondere. "In base alle cose varie, contraddittorie e, a quanto pare, senza senso che abbiamo scoperto, abbiamo sviluppato una teoria. Una che si potrebbe definire sia semplice sia incredibilmente complessa."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"Which is?"|3457|0
units.english: "Which is?"
units.italian: "Che sarebbe?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"That the station is an imperfect replica of something that was there long ago, before the Chanai star became a black hole - perhaps before any of the stars of this cluster became black holes, if that had not a natural cause. A duplicate which is presumably maintained in its pristine state to this day." He searches through some notes on his data pad. "It makes no sense that a hatch would be built half-open, held in that position by solid blocks of metal. But perhaps that hatch was half open when the creators of that duplicate saw it, and they did not create hinges because of the low fidelity of the replica - and perhaps, because they did not understand them."|3458|0
units.english: "That the station is an imperfect replica of something that was there long ago, before the Chanai star became a black hole - perhaps before any of the stars of this cluster became black holes, if that had not a natural cause. A duplicate which is presumably maintained in its pristine state to this day." He searches through some notes on his data pad. "It makes no sense that a hatch would be built half-open, held in that position by solid blocks of metal. But perhaps that hatch was half open when the creators of that duplicate saw it, and they did not create hinges because of the low fidelity of the replica - and perhaps, because they did not understand them."
units.italian: "Che la stazione è una replica imperfetta di qualcosa che era lì molto tempo fa, prima che la stella di Chanai diventasse un buco nero; forse prima che qualsiasi stella di questo ammasso diventasse un buco nero, se non è stata una causa naturale. Un duplicato che presumibilmente è mantenuto nel suo stato originale fino a oggi." Fruga tra alcune note sul tablet. "Non ha senso che un portello sia costruito semiaperto, tenuto in quella posizione da blocchi di metallo solido. Ma forse quel portello era semiaperto quando i creatori del duplicato lo videro, e non crearono cardini a causa della bassa fedeltà della replica, e forse perché non li capivano."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"I would take that low fidelity with an asterisk," adds one of the Remnant, "given the immense size of the construction. If you look at it from the full picture, a door's hinges would be such a minuscule detail to forgo!"|3459|0
units.english: "I would take that low fidelity with an asterisk," adds one of the Remnant, "given the immense size of the construction. If you look at it from the full picture, a door's hinges would be such a minuscule detail to forgo!"
units.italian: "Metterei un asterisco su quella bassa fedeltà," aggiunge uno dei Remnant, "data l'immensità della costruzione. Guardandola nel quadro complessivo, i cardini di una porta sarebbero un dettaglio minuscolo da trascurare!"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"Right. And a similar reasoning can be made for the propellant: such a bubble of deuterium must have been in the tanks of the station at the time, and whoever maintains the replica must perhaps be keeping it together to this day, in order to keep it identical to that moment."|3460|0
units.english: "Right. And a similar reasoning can be made for the propellant: such a bubble of deuterium must have been in the tanks of the station at the time, and whoever maintains the replica must perhaps be keeping it together to this day, in order to keep it identical to that moment."
units.italian: "Esatto. E un ragionamento simile si può fare per il propellente: una bolla di deuterio del genere doveva trovarsi nei serbatoi della stazione in quel momento, e chi mantiene la replica forse la tiene insieme ancora oggi, per mantenerla identica a quell'istante."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"A replica made by whom, and why?"|3462|0
units.english: "A replica made by whom, and why?"
units.italian: "Una replica fatta da chi, e perché?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"That sounds crazy."|3464|0
units.english: "That sounds crazy."
units.italian: "Sembra una follia."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"Are those asteroid creatures involved?"|3466|0
units.english: "Are those asteroid creatures involved?"
units.italian: "Ci sono di mezzo quelle creature degli asteroidi?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"Given the regolith we have found, we theorize that it was them who made it and kept it together to this day. Admittedly, it is not a very bold theory - they are the only species we have encountered here at this time. It is, on the other hand, essentially impossible to understand the reason behind it. A memory? A threat? A monument? A taunt, perhaps?"|3467|0
units.english: "Given the regolith we have found, we theorize that it was them who made it and kept it together to this day. Admittedly, it is not a very bold theory - they are the only species we have encountered here at this time. It is, on the other hand, essentially impossible to understand the reason behind it. A memory? A threat? A monument? A taunt, perhaps?"
units.italian: "Data la regolite che abbiamo trovato, ipotizziamo che siano stati loro a costruirla e a tenerla insieme fino a oggi. Va detto che non è una teoria molto ardita: sono l'unica specie che abbiamo incontrato qui in questo momento. D'altra parte è praticamente impossibile capire il motivo. Un ricordo? Una minaccia? Un monumento? Forse una beffa?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"Oh, there is no doubt about that. But right now, it is the only thing that makes sense for us.|3470|0
units.english: "Oh, there is no doubt about that. But right now, it is the only thing that makes sense for us.
units.italian: "Oh, su questo non c'è dubbio. Ma al momento è l'unica cosa che abbia senso per noi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	"Our theory is that, given the regolith we have found, the creatures in this region are the origin of this imitation. Admittedly, it is not a very bold theory - they are the only species we have encountered here at this time. It is, on the other hand, essentially impossible to understand the reason behind it. A memory? A threat? A monument? A taunt, perhaps?"|3472|0
units.english: "Our theory is that, given the regolith we have found, the creatures in this region are the origin of this imitation. Admittedly, it is not a very bold theory - they are the only species we have encountered here at this time. It is, on the other hand, essentially impossible to understand the reason behind it. A memory? A threat? A monument? A taunt, perhaps?"
units.italian: "La nostra teoria è che, data la regolite che abbiamo trovato, le creature di questa regione siano all'origine di questa imitazione. Va detto che non è una teoria molto ardita: sono l'unica specie che abbiamo incontrato qui in questo momento. D'altra parte è praticamente impossibile capire il motivo. Un ricordo? Una minaccia? Un monumento? Forse una beffa?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26A|	The discussion goes on and on, almost in a loop, and the black hole has almost set over the asteroid by the time you leave the outpost. Soon enough, the stellar dance begins once again. You reason that, in the time it will take you to walk to your ship, Patir will have jumped all the way back to the Milky Way.|3474|0
units.english: The discussion goes on and on, almost in a loop, and the black hole has almost set over the asteroid by the time you leave the outpost. Soon enough, the stellar dance begins once again. You reason that, in the time it will take you to walk to your ship, Patir will have jumped all the way back to the Milky Way.
units.italian: La discussione continua all'infinito, quasi in un ciclo, e il buco nero è quasi tramontato sull'asteroide quando lasci l'avamposto. Presto la danza stellare ricomincia. Ragioni che, nel tempo che ti servirà per camminare fino alla nave, Patir sarà già saltato del tutto nella Via Lattea.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|name|3478|0
units.english: Return the samples to <system>
units.italian: Riporta i campioni su <system>

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|description|3479|0
units.english: Bring the Remnant and the samples they gathered in Chanai back to <system> for examination. Be there exactly on <date>.
units.italian: Riporta i Remnant e i campioni raccolti a Chanai su <system> per l'esame. Sii lì esattamente il <date>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|The external coating of the structure appears pristine and untouched, much like a new spaceship. Orbiting far above a black hole, no asteroid moves in an orbit capable of posing a threat to it. Next to you, the Remnant are comparing the maps from your last expedition with the station in front of them; after a few minutes, they indicate a place from which the structure can be accessed.|3490|0
units.english: The external coating of the structure appears pristine and untouched, much like a new spaceship. Orbiting far above a black hole, no asteroid moves in an orbit capable of posing a threat to it. Next to you, the Remnant are comparing the maps from your last expedition with the station in front of them; after a few minutes, they indicate a place from which the structure can be accessed.
units.italian: Il rivestimento esterno della struttura appare intatto e immacolato, molto simile a quello di una nave nuova. In orbita molto sopra un buco nero, nessun asteroide si muove su un'orbita capace di rappresentare una minaccia. Accanto a te, i Remnant confrontano le mappe della tua ultima spedizione con la stazione davanti a loro; dopo qualche minuto, indicano un punto da cui è possibile accedere alla struttura.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	In front of you, a wide, dark and roughly cylindrical hangar houses sets of lifts, pumps and all sorts of tools all over the walls. You try to walk out of the cockpit, but Dusk stops you. "<first>, I believe your strengths would be better suited for scanning the station from aboard the <ship>. I have prepared a set of locations I would like you to fly over with our instruments running, while we study the station from inside, if you are able to." He passes you a datapad with a long set of instructions, with a hopeful look on his face.|3491|0
units.english: In front of you, a wide, dark and roughly cylindrical hangar houses sets of lifts, pumps and all sorts of tools all over the walls. You try to walk out of the cockpit, but Dusk stops you. "<first>, I believe your strengths would be better suited for scanning the station from aboard the <ship>. I have prepared a set of locations I would like you to fly over with our instruments running, while we study the station from inside, if you are able to." He passes you a datapad with a long set of instructions, with a hopeful look on his face.
units.italian: Davanti a te, un hangar ampio, buio e grosso modo cilindrico ospita serie di ascensori, pompe e ogni sorta di attrezzi su tutte le pareti. Provi a uscire dalla cabina, ma Dusk ti ferma. "<first>, credo che le tue capacità sarebbero più adatte a scansionare la stazione da bordo della <ship>. Ho preparato una serie di punti su cui vorrei che passassi con i nostri strumenti accesi, mentre noi studiamo la stazione dall'interno, se puoi." Ti porge un tablet con una lunga serie di istruzioni, con uno sguardo speranzoso.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	"Alright, I will try."|3493|0
units.english: "Alright, I will try."
units.italian: "Va bene, ci proverò."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	"Alone? What should I do if I have an issue?"|3495|0
units.english: "Alone? What should I do if I have an issue?"
units.italian: "Da solo? Che cosa devo fare se ho un problema?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	"What if you have an emergency and need to leave quickly?"|3497|0
units.english: "What if you have an emergency and need to leave quickly?"
units.italian: "E se aveste un'emergenza e doveste partire in fretta?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	He smiles. "I appreciate your concerns, <first>. You could wait until we have entered the station before going on with your work; I can assure you that after that, it will take longer for us to return here than it will for you. Well," he corrects himself, "I realize that does not sound very reassuring, but it was more to say that it matters little where your ship stays while we are deep inside the station."|3498|0
units.english: He smiles. "I appreciate your concerns, <first>. You could wait until we have entered the station before going on with your work; I can assure you that after that, it will take longer for us to return here than it will for you. Well," he corrects himself, "I realize that does not sound very reassuring, but it was more to say that it matters little where your ship stays while we are deep inside the station."
units.italian: Sorride. "Apprezzo le tue preoccupazioni, <first>. Potresti aspettare che siamo entrati nella stazione prima di proseguire con il tuo lavoro; posso assicurarti che dopo sarà più lungo per noi tornare qui di quanto lo sarà per te. Beh," si corregge, "mi rendo conto che non suona molto rassicurante, ma volevo dire che conta poco dove resti con la nave mentre noi siamo nel profondo della stazione."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	He smiles. "We will remain in radio contact for the entire time, if we can. Plus, we have seen first hand the experience you have gained lately. It would be foolish of us not to make use of your expertise when we can."|3501|0
units.english: He smiles. "We will remain in radio contact for the entire time, if we can. Plus, we have seen first hand the experience you have gained lately. It would be foolish of us not to make use of your expertise when we can."
units.italian: Sorride. "Resteremo in contatto radio per tutto il tempo, se possibile. Inoltre abbiamo visto di persona l'esperienza che hai accumulato di recente. Sarebbe sciocco da parte nostra non avvalerci della tua competenza quando possiamo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	You watch the Remnant move to the aft end of the station, where a circular half-open hatch seems to be waiting for their arrival; however, as they all come together to try pulling it open, it does not move. "There is something very strange with the mechanism," notes one of the researchers on the radio. "Somehow, it seems to be attached to the wall by three pieces of solid metal, rather than with hinges."|3503|0
units.english: You watch the Remnant move to the aft end of the station, where a circular half-open hatch seems to be waiting for their arrival; however, as they all come together to try pulling it open, it does not move. "There is something very strange with the mechanism," notes one of the researchers on the radio. "Somehow, it seems to be attached to the wall by three pieces of solid metal, rather than with hinges."
units.italian: Guardi i Remnant spostarsi verso l'estremità posteriore della stazione, dove un portello circolare semiaperto sembra attendere il loro arrivo; ma quando si riuniscono tutti per provare a tirarlo, non si muove. "C'è qualcosa di molto strano nel meccanismo," nota uno dei ricercatori alla radio. "In qualche modo sembra fissato alla parete da tre pezzi di metallo solido, invece che con cardini."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	"We will have to use a little more brute force here to move inside the complex," states Dusk calmly. "The only way for us to get through is by melting the attachments of this hatch. If you are ready, feel free to get going: it is going to take us the better part of an hour."|3504|0
units.english: "We will have to use a little more brute force here to move inside the complex," states Dusk calmly. "The only way for us to get through is by melting the attachments of this hatch. If you are ready, feel free to get going: it is going to take us the better part of an hour."
units.italian: "Dovremo usare un po' più di forza bruta qui per muoverci nel complesso," afferma Dusk con calma. "L'unico modo per passare è fondere gli attacchi di questo portello. Se sei pronto, puoi andare: ci vorrà buona parte di un'ora."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	"I prefer to wait until you are inside."|3506|0
units.english: "I prefer to wait until you are inside."
units.italian: "Preferisco aspettare che siate dentro."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	(Go on your own mission.)|3508|0
units.english: (Go on your own mission.)
units.italian: (Procedi con la tua missione.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	"I bet I could shoot it away from here much quicker."|3510|0
units.english: "I bet I could shoot it away from here much quicker."
units.italian: "Scommetto che potrei staccarlo da qui molto più in fretta."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	"That is really not the way to go!" he replies alarmed. "It would be just as likely to be ineffective as it would to compromise the structure of the station." Some seconds of silence pass. "The best way to help us, if that is your intention, is to focus on your own mission."|3513|0
units.english: "That is really not the way to go!" he replies alarmed. "It would be just as likely to be ineffective as it would to compromise the structure of the station." Some seconds of silence pass. "The best way to help us, if that is your intention, is to focus on your own mission."
units.italian: "Non è certo il modo giusto di procedere!" risponde allarmato. "Sarebbe tanto probabile che non funzioni quanto che comprometta la struttura della stazione." Passano alcuni secondi di silenzio. "Il modo migliore per aiutarci, se è questa la tua intenzione, è concentrarti sulla tua missione."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	The flash of their blowtorches is small from your distance, but you quickly discover that it becomes irritating over time. As Dusk promised, a little over half an hour after they arrived you see them tossing the hatch away from the door, and one by one they disappear in the darkness of the structure.|3516|0
units.english: The flash of their blowtorches is small from your distance, but you quickly discover that it becomes irritating over time. As Dusk promised, a little over half an hour after they arrived you see them tossing the hatch away from the door, and one by one they disappear in the darkness of the structure.
units.italian: Il bagliore delle loro fiamme ossidriche è piccolo dalla tua distanza, ma scopri presto che col tempo diventa fastidioso. Come aveva promesso Dusk, poco più di mezz'ora dopo il loro arrivo li vedi scagliare il portello via dalla porta, e uno alla volta spariscono nel buio della struttura.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	Soon enough, you set course to the first location - a nondescript, semi-cylindrical section of the station - and let your ship do its scans. As you are slowly floating above the station, you finish reading through the list you have been handed. One item interests you in particular: Dusk has left you a note to release some vehicles from the payload bay over a few areas.|3518|0
units.english: Soon enough, you set course to the first location - a nondescript, semi-cylindrical section of the station - and let your ship do its scans. As you are slowly floating above the station, you finish reading through the list you have been handed. One item interests you in particular: Dusk has left you a note to release some vehicles from the payload bay over a few areas.
units.italian: Presto imposti la rotta verso il primo punto, una sezione semicilindrica anonima della stazione, e lasci che la nave faccia le sue scansioni. Mentre fluttui lentamente sopra la stazione, finisci di leggere la lista che ti è stata consegnata. Un punto ti interessa in particolare: Dusk ti ha lasciato una nota per rilasciare alcuni veicoli dalla stiva sopra alcune aree.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	Searching through one of their boxes, it does not take you long to find what you are looking for: four drones, each roughly as small as a rugby ball and similarly shaped, except for a white belly, a small wing and a set of mechanical eyes on the front. Based on the labels on the container, they are called Snipes. You activate one and leave it in the airlock, from where it cheerfully departs at an impressive speed. You search over the structure for a few seconds and, at last, it plunges into a large entrance into the space station.|3519|0
units.english: Searching through one of their boxes, it does not take you long to find what you are looking for: four drones, each roughly as small as a rugby ball and similarly shaped, except for a white belly, a small wing and a set of mechanical eyes on the front. Based on the labels on the container, they are called Snipes. You activate one and leave it in the airlock, from where it cheerfully departs at an impressive speed. You search over the structure for a few seconds and, at last, it plunges into a large entrance into the space station.
units.italian: Frugando in una delle loro casse, non ci vuole molto per trovare quello che cerchi: quattro droni, ognuno grosso modo piccolo come un pallone da rugby e di forma simile, tranne per una pancia bianca, una piccola ala e una serie di occhi meccanici davanti. Secondo le etichette sul contenitore si chiamano Snipes. Ne attivi uno e lo lasci nella camera di equilibrio, da dove parte allegramente a una velocità impressionante. Cerchi sopra la struttura per qualche secondo e, alla fine, si tuffa in un grande ingresso della stazione spaziale.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	(Try to follow it with your ship to take a better look.)|3521|0
units.english: (Try to follow it with your ship to take a better look.)
units.italian: (Prova a seguirlo con la nave per guardare meglio.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	(Go on with the list while the Snipe is working.)|3522|0
units.english: (Go on with the list while the Snipe is working.)
units.italian: (Prosegui con la lista mentre lo Snipe lavora.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	It was hard to make estimates from afar, but as you come closer you quickly find the <ship> is far too large to pass through. Still, what you can see is quite unusual. Shining a light through the large, mostly open hatch shows you an intricate canvas, attached between various carvings, composed of a series of points in a line with every color of the rainbow. While the lines are near the bottom of the mural, above them all shines what looks like a red sun, sending rays of light down to each of the colorful dots and surrounding them all in a crimson halo.|3524|0
units.english: It was hard to make estimates from afar, but as you come closer you quickly find the <ship> is far too large to pass through. Still, what you can see is quite unusual. Shining a light through the large, mostly open hatch shows you an intricate canvas, attached between various carvings, composed of a series of points in a line with every color of the rainbow. While the lines are near the bottom of the mural, above them all shines what looks like a red sun, sending rays of light down to each of the colorful dots and surrounding them all in a crimson halo.
units.italian: Era difficile fare stime da lontano, ma avvicinandoti scopri subito che la <ship> è troppo grande per passare. Tuttavia quello che riesci a vedere è piuttosto insolito. Facendo passare una luce dal grande portello in gran parte aperto vedi una tela intricata, fissata tra varie incisioni, composta da una serie di punti in linea con ogni colore dell'arcobaleno. Mentre le linee sono vicine al fondo del murale, sopra di esse brilla quella che sembra una stella rossa, che manda raggi di luce su ciascuno dei punti colorati e li avvolge tutti in un alone cremisi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	A glance at your scanners reveals that each part of the canvas is made of a different metal, smoother and more refined than the walls around it. Curious, you take a photograph and send the data to the Remnant while you continue going through the assignments. After flying over an unusual variety of constructions with your instruments and some more Snipes, you finally reach the barrel that composes the core of this structure.|3525|0
units.english: A glance at your scanners reveals that each part of the canvas is made of a different metal, smoother and more refined than the walls around it. Curious, you take a photograph and send the data to the Remnant while you continue going through the assignments. After flying over an unusual variety of constructions with your instruments and some more Snipes, you finally reach the barrel that composes the core of this structure.
units.italian: Un'occhiata agli scanner rivela che ogni parte della tela è fatta di un metallo diverso, più liscio e raffinato delle pareti attorno. Curioso, scatti una fotografia e invii i dati ai Remnant mentre continui a seguire gli incarichi. Dopo aver sorvolato una varietà insolita di costruzioni con i tuoi strumenti e altri Snipes, raggiungi infine la canna che compone il nucleo di questa struttura.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	You take your ship over an unusual variety of constructions, scanning each as best as you can and releasing another pair of Snipes. When you have a break, however, you take a look through the feed from the first pair you released. Searching through its photographs shows you a series of carvings, most of which are unintelligible to you.|3529|0
units.english: You take your ship over an unusual variety of constructions, scanning each as best as you can and releasing another pair of Snipes. When you have a break, however, you take a look through the feed from the first pair you released. Searching through its photographs shows you a series of carvings, most of which are unintelligible to you.
units.italian: Porti la nave sopra una varietà insolita di costruzioni, scansionando ciascuna come meglio puoi e rilasciando un altro paio di Snipes. Quando hai una pausa, però, dai un'occhiata al flusso video della prima coppia che hai rilasciato. Frugando tra le sue fotografie trovi una serie di incisioni, la maggior parte incomprensibili per te.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	Eventually, however, you stumble upon an intricate canvas, composed of a series of points in a line with every color of the rainbow. While the lines are near the bottom of the mural, above them all shines what looks like a red sun, sending rays of light down to each of the colorful dots and surrounding them all in a crimson halo. A glance at the other feeds you have reveals that each part of the canvas is made of a different metal, smoother and more refined than the walls around it. Curious, you mark it for later attention just as you reach the barrel that composes the core of this structure.|3530|0
units.english: Eventually, however, you stumble upon an intricate canvas, composed of a series of points in a line with every color of the rainbow. While the lines are near the bottom of the mural, above them all shines what looks like a red sun, sending rays of light down to each of the colorful dots and surrounding them all in a crimson halo. A glance at the other feeds you have reveals that each part of the canvas is made of a different metal, smoother and more refined than the walls around it. Curious, you mark it for later attention just as you reach the barrel that composes the core of this structure.
units.italian: Alla fine, però, ti imbatti in una tela intricata, composta da una serie di punti in linea con ogni colore dell'arcobaleno. Mentre le linee sono vicine al fondo del murale, sopra di esse brilla quella che sembra una stella rossa, che manda raggi di luce su ciascuno dei punti colorati e li avvolge tutti in un alone cremisi. Un'occhiata agli altri flussi video che hai rivela che ogni parte della tela è fatta di un metallo diverso, più liscio e raffinato delle pareti attorno. Curioso, la segni per un'attenzione successiva proprio mentre raggiungi la canna che compone il nucleo di questa struttura.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	Looking through the empty spots in the structure, you notice some movement near the bottom - the Remnant are over there, waving as you fly upside down a hundred meters above them. Dusk contacts you shortly after. "Nice flying there, Captain, If you have gotten here already, I gather your tasks must be going fairly well!"|3532|0
units.english: Looking through the empty spots in the structure, you notice some movement near the bottom - the Remnant are over there, waving as you fly upside down a hundred meters above them. Dusk contacts you shortly after. "Nice flying there, Captain, If you have gotten here already, I gather your tasks must be going fairly well!"
units.italian: Guardando attraverso gli spazi vuoti della struttura, noti del movimento vicino al fondo: i Remnant sono laggiù, e ti salutano con la mano mentre voli capovolto cento metri sopra di loro. Dusk ti contatta poco dopo. "Bel volo, capitano. Se sei già arrivato fin qui, immagino che i tuoi compiti stiano andando piuttosto bene!"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	"I sent you my findings earlier. What about yours?"|3534|0
units.english: "I sent you my findings earlier. What about yours?"
units.italian: "Ti ho inviato prima le mie scoperte. E le vostre?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	"What is this place?"|3535|0
units.english: "What is this place?"
units.italian: "Che posto è questo?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	"I have not seen anything worth mentioning."|3537|0
units.english: "I have not seen anything worth mentioning."
units.italian: "Non ho visto nulla che meriti di essere menzionato."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	He takes note. "For our part, I have to say that most what we have seen was, for a lack of a better word... nonsensical. Doors that cannot be physically opened, screens not connected with anything, lights without any cabling or electronics. In some cases, one might even say they were fake. But this place, at least, seems truly special." Though from high up he does not look much bigger than an ant, you see him walking around the room, gesturing toward the barrel.|3538|0
units.english: He takes note. "For our part, I have to say that most what we have seen was, for a lack of a better word... nonsensical. Doors that cannot be physically opened, screens not connected with anything, lights without any cabling or electronics. In some cases, one might even say they were fake. But this place, at least, seems truly special." Though from high up he does not look much bigger than an ant, you see him walking around the room, gesturing toward the barrel.
units.italian: Prende nota. "Da parte nostra, devo dire che la maggior parte di ciò che abbiamo visto era, per mancanza di un termine migliore... senza senso. Porte che non si possono aprire fisicamente, schermi non collegati a nulla, luci senza cavi né elettronica. In alcuni casi si potrebbe persino dire che fossero finte. Ma questo posto, almeno, sembra davvero speciale." Anche se da lassù non sembra molto più grande di una formica, lo vedi camminare per la stanza, gesticolando verso la canna.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	"The room you see us in is, most likely, part of the exhaust chamber of this station's laser system. It is impossible to say for certain what its purpose was - hopefully, it was not purely a military system." Though from high up he does not look much bigger than an ant, you see him walking around the room, gesturing toward the barrel.|3541|0
units.english: "The room you see us in is, most likely, part of the exhaust chamber of this station's laser system. It is impossible to say for certain what its purpose was - hopefully, it was not purely a military system." Though from high up he does not look much bigger than an ant, you see him walking around the room, gesturing toward the barrel.
units.italian: "La stanza in cui ci vedi è, molto probabilmente, parte della camera di scarico del sistema laser di questa stazione. È impossibile dire con certezza quale fosse il suo scopo; speriamo che non fosse un sistema puramente militare." Anche se da lassù non sembra molto più grande di una formica, lo vedi camminare per la stanza, gesticolando verso la canna.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	The sheer size of the frame is rather impressive: as you walk toward it, you measure it to be over a kilometer and a half from one side to the opposite. At the very end, an enormous lens is attached to the last ring of the barrel; four holes near its center give it a slight resemblance to a cloth button.|3543|0
units.english: The sheer size of the frame is rather impressive: as you walk toward it, you measure it to be over a kilometer and a half from one side to the opposite. At the very end, an enormous lens is attached to the last ring of the barrel; four holes near its center give it a slight resemblance to a cloth button.
units.italian: Le dimensioni del telaio sono piuttosto impressionanti: mentre ti avvicini, misuri che è lungo oltre un chilometro e mezzo da un lato all'altro. All'estremità, un'enorme lente è fissata all'ultimo anello della canna; quattro fori vicino al centro le danno una vaga somiglianza con un bottone di stoffa.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	"You know, <first>," he explains in an excited rhythm, "we have found some engravings nearby that tell an interesting story. As far as we could tell, in all of them, this barrel is pointed right at the center of this system, toward what looks to be a star. Perhaps this laser was used to accelerate the reactions inside of it, making it burn brighter even at the cost of dying sooner; it would not be the first species to attempt something so destructive. But surviving a supernova with no damage is almost inconceivable to me."|3544|0
units.english: "You know, <first>," he explains in an excited rhythm, "we have found some engravings nearby that tell an interesting story. As far as we could tell, in all of them, this barrel is pointed right at the center of this system, toward what looks to be a star. Perhaps this laser was used to accelerate the reactions inside of it, making it burn brighter even at the cost of dying sooner; it would not be the first species to attempt something so destructive. But surviving a supernova with no damage is almost inconceivable to me."
units.italian: "Sai, <first>," spiega con un ritmo eccitato, "abbiamo trovato alcune incisioni qui vicino che raccontano una storia interessante. Per quanto possiamo dire, in tutte quante questa canna è puntata proprio verso il centro di questo sistema, verso quella che sembra una stella. Forse questo laser serviva ad accelerare le reazioni al suo interno, facendola bruciare più luminosa anche al costo di morire prima; non sarebbe la prima specie a tentare qualcosa di così distruttivo. Ma sopravvivere a una supernova senza danni è quasi inconcepibile per me."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	Soon enough, the Remnant start the trip back to the hangar, and you follow. At last, a rose light catches your eye, flying at high speed out of the hangar and disappearing behind the station. You are taken aback when you find that, somehow, the entrance hatch is back in place! As far as you can tell, there appears to be no sign of the cuts made by the Remnant to pass through, nor of any soldering to attach it back. A quick call to the Remnant reveals nothing else, except for how they seem to be as startled as you are.|3545|0
units.english: Soon enough, the Remnant start the trip back to the hangar, and you follow. At last, a rose light catches your eye, flying at high speed out of the hangar and disappearing behind the station. You are taken aback when you find that, somehow, the entrance hatch is back in place! As far as you can tell, there appears to be no sign of the cuts made by the Remnant to pass through, nor of any soldering to attach it back. A quick call to the Remnant reveals nothing else, except for how they seem to be as startled as you are.
units.italian: Presto i Remnant iniziano il viaggio di ritorno all'hangar, e tu li segui. Infine una luce rosa ti cattura l'occhio, che vola ad alta velocità fuori dall'hangar e sparisce dietro la stazione. Resti sorpreso quando scopri che, in qualche modo, il portello d'ingresso è tornato al suo posto! Per quanto puoi dire, non sembra esserci traccia dei tagli fatti dai Remnant per passare, né di saldature per rimetterlo a posto. Una rapida chiamata ai Remnant non rivela altro, se non che sembrano spaventati quanto te.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	(Wait for them to arrive.)|3547|0
units.english: (Wait for them to arrive.)
units.italian: (Aspetta che arrivino.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	(Try to follow the rose light.)|3549|0
units.english: (Try to follow the rose light.)
units.italian: (Prova a seguire la luce rosa.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	(Blow it up with your ship's weapons, so as to accelerate their exit.)|3551|0
units.english: (Blow it up with your ship's weapons, so as to accelerate their exit.)
units.italian: (Falla saltare con le armi della nave, per accelerare la loro uscita.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	A couple shots in quick succession are enough for the hatch to fly clear of the corridor, tumbling at random in the zero gravity of the station. The Remnant appear from behind the hatch right after: they must have already been at the exit when you fired. Despite this, all of them come out of the still-vibrating tunnel safely, taking leaps toward your ship. While they do not look too happy at your decision, none of them try to complain either.|3554|0
units.english: A couple shots in quick succession are enough for the hatch to fly clear of the corridor, tumbling at random in the zero gravity of the station. The Remnant appear from behind the hatch right after: they must have already been at the exit when you fired. Despite this, all of them come out of the still-vibrating tunnel safely, taking leaps toward your ship. While they do not look too happy at your decision, none of them try to complain either.
units.italian: Un paio di colpi in rapida successione bastano perché il portello voli via dal corridoio, ruzzolando a caso nella gravità zero della stazione. I Remnant compaiono subito dopo da dietro il portello: dovevano essere già all'uscita quando hai sparato. Nonostante questo, escono tutti sani e salvi dal tunnel ancora vibrante, saltando verso la tua nave. Anche se non sembrano troppo contenti della tua decisione, nessuno di loro cerca di lamentarsi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|label|3557|0
units.english: blown up
units.italian: blown up

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	A couple shots in quick succession are enough for the hatch to fly clear of the corridor, tumbling at random in the zero gravity of the station. The Remnant appear from behind the hatch right after: they must have already been at the exit when you fired. Despite this, all of them come out of the still-vibrating tunnel safely, taking leaps toward your ship. Once aboard, they make it very clear that you should not go against their orders next time.|3558|0
units.english: A couple shots in quick succession are enough for the hatch to fly clear of the corridor, tumbling at random in the zero gravity of the station. The Remnant appear from behind the hatch right after: they must have already been at the exit when you fired. Despite this, all of them come out of the still-vibrating tunnel safely, taking leaps toward your ship. Once aboard, they make it very clear that you should not go against their orders next time.
units.italian: Un paio di colpi in rapida successione bastano perché il portello voli via dal corridoio, ruzzolando a caso nella gravità zero della stazione. I Remnant compaiono subito dopo da dietro il portello: dovevano essere già all'uscita quando hai sparato. Nonostante questo, escono tutti sani e salvi dal tunnel ancora vibrante, saltando verso la tua nave. Una volta a bordo, ti fanno capire molto chiaramente che la prossima volta non dovresti andare contro i loro ordini.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	You push your throttle to the end, and your engines shout a loud roar as you leap toward your target. You follow it all around the station, almost to the point of catching up with it; however, it makes an impossible turn into a hole of the station, leaving you empty handed. Left with no option but to hope the Remnant can exit on their own, you come back to the hatch, where the flash of their blowtorches has now cut through a quarter of the door. It takes far longer than you would like, but eventually, the passage becomes clear, and the Remnant exit one by one.|3562|0
units.english: You push your throttle to the end, and your engines shout a loud roar as you leap toward your target. You follow it all around the station, almost to the point of catching up with it; however, it makes an impossible turn into a hole of the station, leaving you empty handed. Left with no option but to hope the Remnant can exit on their own, you come back to the hatch, where the flash of their blowtorches has now cut through a quarter of the door. It takes far longer than you would like, but eventually, the passage becomes clear, and the Remnant exit one by one.
units.italian: Spingi la manetta al massimo, e i motori ruggiscono forte mentre balzi verso il bersaglio. Lo segui per tutta la stazione, quasi al punto di raggiungerlo; tuttavia compie una virata impossibile dentro un foro della stazione, lasciandoti a mani vuote. Non ti resta che sperare che i Remnant riescano a uscire da soli; torni al portello, dove il bagliore delle loro fiamme ossidriche ha ormai tagliato un quarto della porta. Ci vuole molto più di quanto vorresti, ma alla fine il passaggio è libero, e i Remnant escono uno alla volta.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	Soon enough, you see their lights behind the opening of the door. "Stand back, <first>! We are about to use our blowtorches!" The flash of the blowtorches only becomes tolerable after you lower the sunshade of your helmet. You keep an eye around, but nothing of note happens: other than the unexplainable hatch, everything is as still as it ever was. It takes far longer than you wish for, but eventually, the passage becomes clear, and the Remnant exit one by one.|3565|0
units.english: Soon enough, you see their lights behind the opening of the door. "Stand back, <first>! We are about to use our blowtorches!" The flash of the blowtorches only becomes tolerable after you lower the sunshade of your helmet. You keep an eye around, but nothing of note happens: other than the unexplainable hatch, everything is as still as it ever was. It takes far longer than you wish for, but eventually, the passage becomes clear, and the Remnant exit one by one.
units.italian: Presto vedi le loro luci dietro l'apertura della porta. "Tirati indietro, <first>! Stiamo per usare le fiamme ossidriche!" Il bagliore diventa tollerabile solo dopo aver abbassato la visiera del casco. Ti guardi intorno, ma non succede nulla di rilevante: a parte il portello inspiegabile, tutto è immobile come non mai. Ci vuole molto più di quanto vorresti, ma alla fine il passaggio è libero, e i Remnant escono uno alla volta.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	"Very curious," Dusk comments, by now clearly more intrigued than scared. "If it was a malicious action, it was not a particularly effective one. Let us go back to <system>; we will reason on the whys and hows later."|3567|0
units.english: "Very curious," Dusk comments, by now clearly more intrigued than scared. "If it was a malicious action, it was not a particularly effective one. Let us go back to <system>; we will reason on the whys and hows later."
units.italian: "Molto curioso," commenta Dusk, ormai chiaramente più incuriosito che spaventato. "Se è stata un'azione malevola, non è stata particolarmente efficace. Torniamo su <system>; ragioneremo sui perché e sui come più tardi."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|By the time your ship has been safed, the Remnant have unloaded many of the instruments they have used on this trip. "It would be a waste to bring them back home after all the effort to launch them here," they explain as you join them. "Once these are connected to our grid, they will use all of the available power and then some. We will have to take turns, at least until we bring some additional power stations." While they finish the setup, you take the chance to cover the machines outside with some regolith to help them conserve their heat in the night of the asteroid. You almost trip on one of their cables: with the recent expeditions, the exterior of the laboratory is quickly becoming as messy as its interior.|3574|0
units.english: By the time your ship has been safed, the Remnant have unloaded many of the instruments they have used on this trip.
