"It would be a waste to bring them back home after all the effort to launch them here," they explain as you join them. "Once these are connected to our grid, they will use all of the available power and then some. We will have to take turns, at least until we bring some additional power stations." While they finish the setup, you take the chance to cover the machines outside with some regolith to help them conserve their heat in the night of the asteroid. You almost trip on one of their cables: with the recent expeditions, the exterior of the laboratory is quickly becoming as messy as its interior.
units.italian: Quando la tua nave è stata messa in sicurezza, i Remnant hanno scaricato molti degli strumenti usati in questo viaggio. "Sarebbe uno spreco riportarli a casa dopo tutta la fatica per lanciarli qui," spiegano mentre ti unisci a loro. "Una volta collegati alla nostra rete, useranno tutta la potenza disponibile e anche di più. Dovremo alternarci, almeno finché non porteremo qualche stazione di energia in più." Mentre finiscono l'installazione, cogli l'occasione per coprire le macchine all'esterno con un po' di regolite, per aiutarle a conservare il calore nella notte dell'asteroide. Quasi inciampi in uno dei loro cavi: con le spedizioni recenti, l'esterno del laboratorio sta diventando in fretta disordinato quanto l'interno.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	Sitting around the table inside the outpost, and sharing a hot drink, the discussions continue. "By our calculations, Patir should be moving back to the Milky Way within the next few hours. For our part, we will be ready to depart by next morning and conclude our expedition."|3576|0
units.english: Sitting around the table inside the outpost, and sharing a hot drink, the discussions continue. "By our calculations, Patir should be moving back to the Milky Way within the next few hours. For our part, we will be ready to depart by next morning and conclude our expedition."
units.italian: Seduti attorno al tavolo dentro l'avamposto e condividendo una bevanda calda, le discussioni continuano. "Secondo i nostri calcoli, Patir dovrebbe tornare nella Via Lattea entro le prossime ore. Da parte nostra, saremo pronti a partire domani mattina e a concludere la spedizione."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	"What did you discover about Chanai?"|3578|0
units.english: "What did you discover about Chanai?"
units.italian: "Che cosa avete scoperto su Chanai?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	"Was there anything important in your findings?"|3579|0
units.english: "Was there anything important in your findings?"
units.italian: "C'era qualcosa di importante nelle vostre scoperte?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	They share a pensive look before replying. "Based on the various, contradictory, and - apparently - nonsensical things we have discovered, we have developed a theory. Based on the point of view, one could describe it both as simple and as incredibly complex."|3580|0
units.english: They share a pensive look before replying. "Based on the various, contradictory, and - apparently - nonsensical things we have discovered, we have developed a theory. Based on the point of view, one could describe it both as simple and as incredibly complex."
units.italian: Si scambiano uno sguardo pensieroso prima di rispondere. "In base alle cose varie, contraddittorie e, a quanto pare, senza senso che abbiamo scoperto, abbiamo sviluppato una teoria. A seconda del punto di vista, la si potrebbe definire sia semplice sia incredibilmente complessa."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	"Which is?"|3581|0
units.english: "Which is?"
units.italian: "Che sarebbe?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	"That the station is an imperfect replica of something that was there long ago, before the Chanai star became a black hole - perhaps before all of the stars of this cluster became black holes, if it had not a natural cause. A duplicate which is presumably maintained in its pristine state to this day." He searches through some notes on his data pad. "It makes no sense that a hatch would be built half-open, held in that position by solid blocks of metal. But perhaps that hatch was half open when the creators of that duplicate saw it, and they did not create hinges because of the low fidelity of the replica - and perhaps, because they did not understand them."|3582|0
units.english: "That the station is an imperfect replica of something that was there long ago, before the Chanai star became a black hole - perhaps before all of the stars of this cluster became black holes, if it had not a natural cause. A duplicate which is presumably maintained in its pristine state to this day." He searches through some notes on his data pad. "It makes no sense that a hatch would be built half-open, held in that position by solid blocks of metal. But perhaps that hatch was half open when the creators of that duplicate saw it, and they did not create hinges because of the low fidelity of the replica - and perhaps, because they did not understand them."
units.italian: "Che la stazione è una replica imperfetta di qualcosa che era lì molto tempo fa, prima che la stella di Chanai diventasse un buco nero; forse prima che tutte le stelle di questo ammasso diventassero buchi neri, se non è stata una causa naturale. Un duplicato che presumibilmente è mantenuto nel suo stato originale fino a oggi." Fruga tra alcune note sul tablet. "Non ha senso che un portello sia costruito semiaperto, tenuto in quella posizione da blocchi di metallo solido. Ma forse quel portello era semiaperto quando i creatori del duplicato lo videro, e non crearono cardini a causa della bassa fedeltà della replica, e forse perché non li capivano."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	"I would take that low fidelity with an asterisk," adds one of the Remnant, "given the immense size of the construction. If you look at it from the full picture, a door's hinges would be such a minuscule detail to forgo!"|3583|0
units.english: "I would take that low fidelity with an asterisk," adds one of the Remnant, "given the immense size of the construction. If you look at it from the full picture, a door's hinges would be such a minuscule detail to forgo!"
units.italian: "Metterei un asterisco su quella bassa fedeltà," aggiunge uno dei Remnant, "data l'immensità della costruzione. Guardandola nel quadro complessivo, i cardini di una porta sarebbero un dettaglio minuscolo da trascurare!"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	"Right. And a similar reasoning can be made for how it came back in place: we have tampered with this duplicate, and its creators have understandably fixed the damage we had made. I would bet that the other holes we have made inside the structure have been fully repaired as well by now."|3584|0
units.english: "Right. And a similar reasoning can be made for how it came back in place: we have tampered with this duplicate, and its creators have understandably fixed the damage we had made. I would bet that the other holes we have made inside the structure have been fully repaired as well by now."
units.italian: "Esatto. E un ragionamento simile si può fare su come è tornato al suo posto: abbiamo manomesso questo duplicato, e i suoi creatori hanno comprensibilmente riparato i danni che avevamo fatto. Scommetto che anche gli altri fori che abbiamo aperto nella struttura sono già stati riparati del tutto."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	"A replica made by whom, and why?"|3586|0
units.english: "A replica made by whom, and why?"
units.italian: "Una replica fatta da chi, e perché?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	"That sounds crazy."|3588|0
units.english: "That sounds crazy."
units.italian: "Sembra una follia."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	"Are the asteroids here involved?"|3590|0
units.english: "Are the asteroids here involved?"
units.italian: "Ci sono di mezzo gli asteroidi qui?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	"Reviewing the footage, we have found traces of their dust all over the surface of the hatch. Given that they are the only species that we have encountered here at this time, it is only natural to speculate they were the creators of this replica. It is, on the other hand, essentially impossible to understand the reason behind it. A memory? A threat? A monument? A taunt, perhaps?"|3591|0
units.english: "Reviewing the footage, we have found traces of their dust all over the surface of the hatch. Given that they are the only species that we have encountered here at this time, it is only natural to speculate they were the creators of this replica. It is, on the other hand, essentially impossible to understand the reason behind it. A memory? A threat? A monument? A taunt, perhaps?"
units.italian: "Rivedendo le registrazioni, abbiamo trovato tracce della loro polvere su tutta la superficie del portello. Dato che sono l'unica specie che abbiamo incontrato qui in questo momento, è naturale supporre che siano stati loro i creatori di questa replica. D'altra parte è praticamente impossibile capire il motivo. Un ricordo? Una minaccia? Un monumento? Forse una beffa?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	"Oh, there is no doubt about that. But right now, it is the only thing that makes sense for us.|3594|0
units.english: "Oh, there is no doubt about that. But right now, it is the only thing that makes sense for us.
units.italian: "Oh, su questo non c'è dubbio. Ma al momento è l'unica cosa che abbia senso per noi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	"Reviewing the footage, we have found traces of dust all over the surface of the hatch, which quick analysis revealed to show the same exact readings as the creatures around this region. Given that they are the only species that we have encountered here at this time, it is only natural to speculate they were the creators of this replica. It is, on the other hand, essentially impossible to understand the reason behind it. A memory? A threat? A monument? A taunt, perhaps?|3596|0
units.english: "Reviewing the footage, we have found traces of dust all over the surface of the hatch, which quick analysis revealed to show the same exact readings as the creatures around this region. Given that they are the only species that we have encountered here at this time, it is only natural to speculate they were the creators of this replica. It is, on the other hand, essentially impossible to understand the reason behind it. A memory? A threat? A monument? A taunt, perhaps?
units.italian: "Rivedendo le registrazioni, abbiamo trovato tracce di polvere su tutta la superficie del portello, e una rapida analisi ha rivelato letture identiche a quelle delle creature di questa regione. Dato che sono l'unica specie che abbiamo incontrato qui in questo momento, è naturale supporre che siano stati loro i creatori di questa replica. D'altra parte è praticamente impossibile capire il motivo. Un ricordo? Una minaccia? Un monumento? Forse una beffa?

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 26B|	The discussion goes on and on, almost in a loop, and the sun has almost set over the asteroid by the time you leave the outpost. Soon enough, the stellar dance begins once again. You reason that, in the time it will take you to walk to your ship, Patir will have jumped all the way back to the Milky Way.|3598|0
units.english: The discussion goes on and on, almost in a loop, and the sun has almost set over the asteroid by the time you leave the outpost. Soon enough, the stellar dance begins once again. You reason that, in the time it will take you to walk to your ship, Patir will have jumped all the way back to the Milky Way.
units.italian: La discussione continua all'infinito, quasi in un ciclo, e il sole è quasi tramontato sull'asteroide quando lasci l'avamposto. Presto la danza stellare ricomincia. Ragioni che, nel tempo che ti servirà per camminare fino alla nave, Patir sarà già saltato del tutto nella Via Lattea.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 27|name|3611|0
units.english: Another asteroid
units.italian: Un altro asteroide

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 27|description|3612|0
units.english: Board the remains of the asteroid in <origin> before the Ka'sei get to it, then take what you find to <destination>.
units.italian: Abborda i resti dell'asteroide in <origin> prima che i Ka'sei ci arrivino, poi porta quello che trovi su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 27|The Remnant walk to your ship - late, as you are becoming accustomed to - with an excited stride. "One of those creatures was in the system when Patir moved back! We have recorded it as it turned inactive, floating around aimlessly. If you are quick enough, perhaps we can get to board it before the Ka'sei mine it. We can afford to make a stop before our return to <planet> - after all, Patir is not moving away any time soon."|3623|0
units.english: The Remnant walk to your ship - late, as you are becoming accustomed to - with an excited stride. "One of those creatures was in the system when Patir moved back! We have recorded it as it turned inactive, floating around aimlessly. If you are quick enough, perhaps we can get to board it before the Ka'sei mine it. We can afford to make a stop before our return to <planet> - after all, Patir is not moving away any time soon."
units.italian: I Remnant camminano verso la tua nave, in ritardo come ormai ti stai abituando, con passo eccitato. "Una di quelle creature era nel sistema quando Patir è tornato! L'abbiamo registrata mentre si disattivava, fluttuando senza meta. Se sei abbastanza veloce, forse riusciamo ad abbordarla prima che i Ka'sei la estraggano. Possiamo permetterci una sosta prima di tornare su <planet>: dopo tutto Patir non si allontanerà tanto presto."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 27|	He shows you a map of the system, marking the asteroid in a color blinking red and white. Two Fetri'sei are already on the way: you push the engines at the maximum power, hoping to make it in time...|3624|0
units.english: He shows you a map of the system, marking the asteroid in a color blinking red and white. Two Fetri'sei are already on the way: you push the engines at the maximum power, hoping to make it in time...
units.italian: Ti mostra una mappa del sistema, segnando l'asteroide con un colore che lampeggia rosso e bianco. Due Fetri'sei sono già in viaggio: spingi i motori alla massima potenza, sperando di arrivare in tempo...

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 27|dialog|3631|0
units.english: You stare at the enormous rock, still emitting a low glow all around it. Doing their best with the equipment on hand, the Remnant quickly mark a number of sections inside the asteroid for you to loot. Your computer tells you that they are respectively 20, 29 and 31 tons each.
units.italian: Fissi l'enorme roccia, che emette ancora un debole bagliore tutto intorno. Facendo del loro meglio con l'attrezzatura a disposizione, i Remnant segnano in fretta alcune sezioni dentro l'asteroide da saccheggiare. Il tuo computer ti dice che pesano rispettivamente 20, 29 e 31 tonnellate.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 27|dialog|3642|0
units.english: You've arrived at <planet>, but either your passengers, your cargo, or the outfits taken from the asteroid remains are not with you!
units.italian: Sei arrivato su <planet>, ma i tuoi passeggeri, il tuo carico o gli equipaggiamenti presi dai resti dell'asteroide non sono con te!

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 27|As you descend to the surface of <planet>, a communication from Chilia gives you new coordinates for your cargo. You pilot your ship to the new location in the middle of the desert - much like the one you had first met him in - and land your ship on the only landing pad you can see. As if trying to maintain great secrecy, groups of Remnant come marching out of the hangar, cover your cargo as best as they can with reflective, metallic-looking sheets, and silently take it away down an unmarked tunnel.|3648|0
units.english: As you descend to the surface of <planet>, a communication from Chilia gives you new coordinates for your cargo. You pilot your ship to the new location in the middle of the desert - much like the one you had first met him in - and land your ship on the only landing pad you can see. As if trying to maintain great secrecy, groups of Remnant come marching out of the hangar, cover your cargo as best as they can with reflective, metallic-looking sheets, and silently take it away down an unmarked tunnel.
units.italian: Mentre scendi verso la superficie di <planet>, una comunicazione di Chilia ti dà nuove coordinate per il tuo carico. Piloti la nave verso la nuova posizione in mezzo al deserto, molto simile a quella in cui lo avevi incontrato la prima volta, e atterri sull'unica piazzola che riesci a vedere. Come per mantenere grande segretezza, gruppi di Remnant escono marciando dall'hangar, coprono il tuo carico come meglio possono con teli riflettenti dall'aspetto metallico, e lo portano via in silenzio giù per un tunnel non segnalato.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 27|	As the sun sets over the mountain ranges in the distance, Dusk signs you to return to the main starport, so that they can unload their own equipment and get back to work. "As you might imagine, it is time for another project debriefing. Independently from how it goes, we will be in the closest cafeteria tomorrow morning; if you pass by, we will make sure to give you an update," he concludes ominously.|3649|0
units.english: As the sun sets over the mountain ranges in the distance, Dusk signs you to return to the main starport, so that they can unload their own equipment and get back to work. "As you might imagine, it is time for another project debriefing. Independently from how it goes, we will be in the closest cafeteria tomorrow morning; if you pass by, we will make sure to give you an update," he concludes ominously.
units.italian: Mentre il sole tramonta sulle catene montuose in lontananza, Dusk ti fa cenno di tornare allo spazioporto principale, così che possano scaricare la loro attrezzatura e rimettersi al lavoro. "Come puoi immaginare, è ora di un altro debriefing del progetto. Indipendentemente da come andrà, domani mattina saremo alla caffetteria più vicina; se passi, ci assicureremo di darti un aggiornamento," conclude in modo inquietante.

units.id: ship:Asteroid Young 2|display name|3652|0
mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|name|3659|0
units.english: Tanker fleet
units.italian: Flotta di rifornimento

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|description|3660|0
units.english: Escort the Swan fleet to <destination> for fit checks.
units.italian: Scorta la flotta degli Swan fino a <destination> per i controlli di adattamento.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|You find Dusk alone, sipping from a short, colorful glass, lost in his thoughts. "<first>, the review is going to take a while still. Given the wealth of data we have gathered, and that most of the crew by necessity do not have symbionts, we have agreed to split the analysis over a few days. A week, perhaps." He looks at his clock, then checks his communicator for any message. "Do not worry, though: I am not going to leave you without work during this wait."|3670|0
units.english: You find Dusk alone, sipping from a short, colorful glass, lost in his thoughts. "<first>, the review is going to take a while still. Given the wealth of data we have gathered, and that most of the crew by necessity do not have symbionts, we have agreed to split the analysis over a few days. A week, perhaps." He looks at his clock, then checks his communicator for any message. "Do not worry, though: I am not going to leave you without work during this wait."
units.italian: Trovi Dusk da solo, che sorseggia da un bicchiere corto e colorato, perso nei suoi pensieri. "<first>, la revisione richiederà ancora un po'. Vista la ricchezza dei dati raccolti, e visto che per necessità la maggior parte dell'equipaggio non ha simbionti, abbiamo concordato di dividere l'analisi su qualche giorno. Una settimana, forse." Guarda l'orologio, poi controlla il communicatore in cerca di messaggi. "Non preoccuparti, però: non ho intenzione di lasciarti senza lavoro durante l'attesa."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|	"What in particular would you like me to do?"|3672|0
units.english: "What in particular would you like me to do?"
units.italian: "Che cosa vorresti che facessi, in particolare?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|	"Are you waiting for someone?"|3674|0
units.english: "Are you waiting for someone?"
units.italian: "Stai aspettando qualcuno?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|	"Actually, I have other commitments right now."|3676|0
units.english: "Actually, I have other commitments right now."
units.italian: "In realtà, al momento ho altri impegni."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|	He looks surprised, though he tries to hide it. "Oh. Is there any chance you might delay them? We have a fairly important job here, and your help has been invaluable during our past expeditions." He makes some mental calculations. "Judging by on our plans, you might be free to go your own way in a little over a month."|3677|0
units.english: He looks surprised, though he tries to hide it. "Oh. Is there any chance you might delay them? We have a fairly important job here, and your help has been invaluable during our past expeditions." He makes some mental calculations. "Judging by on our plans, you might be free to go your own way in a little over a month."
units.italian: Sembra sorpreso, anche se cerca di nasconderlo. "Oh. C'è qualche possibilità che tu possa rimandarli? Qui abbiamo un lavoro piuttosto importante, e il tuo aiuto è stato inestimabile nelle nostre spedizioni passate." Fa qualche calcolo mentale. "A giudicare dai nostri piani, potresti essere libero di andare per la tua strada tra poco più di un mese."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|	"Alright, they can wait."|3679|0
units.english: "Alright, they can wait."
units.italian: "Va bene, possono aspettare."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|	"Sorry, but I cannot delay them any longer."|3681|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I cannot delay them any longer."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non posso rimandarli ancora."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|	"Alright then," he replies disappointed. "We will be here when you have time for us again, if you do not take too long."|3682|0
units.english: "Alright then," he replies disappointed. "We will be here when you have time for us again, if you do not take too long."
units.italian: "Va bene allora," risponde deluso. "Saremo qui quando avrai tempo per noi, se non ci metterai troppo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|	Your conversation is interrupted by Taely's arrival. She returns a gesture of greeting with one hand, carrying her communicator in the other. "Our fleet is almost ready. We need some time to move it to the launchpad, but as far as we are concerned there are no issues of any kind." She signs to follow her to the hangar, and you hurry up to keep pace with her and Dusk.|3685|0
units.english: Your conversation is interrupted by Taely's arrival. She returns a gesture of greeting with one hand, carrying her communicator in the other. "Our fleet is almost ready. We need some time to move it to the launchpad, but as far as we are concerned there are no issues of any kind." She signs to follow her to the hangar, and you hurry up to keep pace with her and Dusk.
units.italian: La tua conversazione viene interrotta dall'arrivo di Taely. Ricambia un gesto di saluto con una mano, tenendo il communicatore nell'altra. "La nostra flotta è quasi pronta. Ci serve un po' di tempo per portarla alla piazzola di lancio, ma per quanto ci riguarda non ci sono problemi di alcun tipo." Ti fa cenno di seguirla all'hangar, e ti affretti a tenere il passo con lei e Dusk.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|	"You might not know that, on top of the energy required, Ssil Vida uses significant amounts of hyperspace fuel in its operations," she explains. "It is able to ramscoop a limited amount of propellant from Postverta, but we have to supply more ourselves in order to keep up with our needs. I have helped coordinate the fueling fleets used for your recent expeditions, and I assure you that the logistics are becoming exceedingly difficult to maintain over time. At last, we have become convinced that we need a specialized vehicle for such a role."|3686|0
units.english: "You might not know that, on top of the energy required, Ssil Vida uses significant amounts of hyperspace fuel in its operations," she explains. "It is able to ramscoop a limited amount of propellant from Postverta, but we have to supply more ourselves in order to keep up with our needs. I have helped coordinate the fueling fleets used for your recent expeditions, and I assure you that the logistics are becoming exceedingly difficult to maintain over time. At last, we have become convinced that we need a specialized vehicle for such a role."
units.italian: "Forse non lo sai, ma oltre all'energia necessaria Ssil Vida consuma notevoli quantità di carburante per iperguida nelle sue operazioni," spiega. "È in grado di raccogliere con i ramscoop una quantità limitata di propellente da Postverta, ma dobbiamo fornirne altro noi per stare al passo con il fabbisogno. Ho contribuito a coordinare le flotte di rifornimento usate per le tue spedizioni recenti, e ti assicuro che la logistica sta diventando estremamente difficile da mantenere nel tempo. Alla fine ci siamo convinti che ci serve un veicolo specializzato per un ruolo del genere."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|	Three identical Remnant ships are queuing out of the local shipyard, each towed by two rows of camels and hovering barely a meter above the ground. Trying to pass through the crowds that have gathered to watch their passage, you notice that their wings are among the largest and thickest you have had a chance to see. The wingtips are sometimes just a few centimeters from buildings at the sides of the road, though the convoy is moving faster than you would expect with such tight gaps. Its structure reminds you of a large and heavy bird, with oversized wings and a thick neck.|3687|0
units.english: Three identical Remnant ships are queuing out of the local shipyard, each towed by two rows of camels and hovering barely a meter above the ground. Trying to pass through the crowds that have gathered to watch their passage, you notice that their wings are among the largest and thickest you have had a chance to see. The wingtips are sometimes just a few centimeters from buildings at the sides of the road, though the convoy is moving faster than you would expect with such tight gaps. Its structure reminds you of a large and heavy bird, with oversized wings and a thick neck.
units.italian: Tre navi Remnant identiche sono in fila all'uscita del cantiere locale, ognuna trainata da due file di cammelli e sospesa a malapena un metro da terra. Cercando di passare tra la folla radunata per vedere il loro passaggio, noti che le loro ali sono tra le più grandi e spesse che tu abbia avuto modo di vedere. Le punte delle ali sono a volte a pochi centimetri dagli edifici ai lati della strada, anche se il convoglio si muove più veloce di quanto ti aspetteresti con spazi così stretti. La sua struttura ti ricorda un grande e pesante uccello, con ali sovradimensionate e un collo grosso.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|	"What can I call them?"|3689|0
units.english: "What can I call them?"
units.italian: "Come posso chiamarle?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|	"How did you make them this quickly?"|3691|0
units.english: "How did you make them this quickly?"
units.italian: "Come avete fatto a costruirle così in fretta?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|	"They look beautiful."|3693|0
units.english: "They look beautiful."
units.italian: "Sono bellissime."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|	"I like them more for what they represent," she replies. "The history of the Swan is old, and fairly complicated. They were about ready to enter production several decades ago, however, the design exercise was not able to make a reasonable use case for them. They had to stay in limbo for all this time, watching newer and more innovative designs come out. Their style is considered fairly retro by now, and these first builds are heavier than we would like them to be. But to me, these equate an end of an era for our shipyards." She looks at them nostalgically. "Chances are that the Swan will be the last design we do not produce as a liveship. At least, not a complete one."|3694|0
units.english: "I like them more for what they represent," she replies. "The history of the Swan is old, and fairly complicated. They were about ready to enter production several decades ago, however, the design exercise was not able to make a reasonable use case for them. They had to stay in limbo for all this time, watching newer and more innovative designs come out. Their style is considered fairly retro by now, and these first builds are heavier than we would like them to be. But to me, these equate an end of an era for our shipyards." She looks at them nostalgically. "Chances are that the Swan will be the last design we do not produce as a liveship. At least, not a complete one."
units.italian: "Mi piacciono di più per quello che rappresentano," risponde. "La storia dello Swan è vecchia, e piuttosto complicata. Erano quasi pronti a entrare in produzione decenni fa, ma l'esercizio di progettazione non riuscì a trovare un caso d'uso ragionevole. Sono rimasti in sospeso per tutto questo tempo, guardando uscire progetti più nuovi e innovativi. Il loro stile è ormai considerato piuttosto retrò, e queste prime unità sono più pesanti di quanto vorremmo. Ma per me rappresentano la fine di un'era per i nostri cantieri." Li guarda con nostalgia. "Probabile che lo Swan sia l'ultimo progetto che non produziamo come nave viva. Almeno, non completo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|	"Their design predates liveships, though we have added some of their systems. In fact, chances are that the Swan will be the last design we produce not to be alive." She looks at them nostalgically. "The history of the Swan is old, and fairly complicated. They were about ready to enter production several decades ago, however, the design exercise was not able to make a reasonable use case for them. They had to stay in a limbo for all this time, watching newer and more innovative designs come out. Their style is considered fairly retro by now, and these first builds are heavier than we would like them to be. But to me, these equate an end of an era for our shipyards."|3697|0
units.english: "Their design predates liveships, though we have added some of their systems. In fact, chances are that the Swan will be the last design we produce not to be alive." She looks at them nostalgically. "The history of the Swan is old, and fairly complicated. They were about ready to enter production several decades ago, however, the design exercise was not able to make a reasonable use case for them. They had to stay in a limbo for all this time, watching newer and more innovative designs come out. Their style is considered fairly retro by now, and these first builds are heavier than we would like them to be. But to me, these equate an end of an era for our shipyards."
units.italian: "Il loro progetto è precedente alle navi vive, anche se abbiamo aggiunto alcuni dei loro sistemi. Anzi, probabile che lo Swan sia l'ultimo progetto che produciamo senza che sia vivo." Li guarda con nostalgia. "La storia dello Swan è vecchia, e piuttosto complicata. Erano quasi pronti a entrare in produzione decenni fa, ma l'esercizio di progettazione non riuscì a trovare un caso d'uso ragionevole. Sono rimasti in sospeso per tutto questo tempo, guardando uscire progetti più nuovi e innovativi. Il loro stile è ormai considerato piuttosto retrò, e queste prime unità sono più pesanti di quanto vorremmo. Ma per me rappresentano la fine di un'era per i nostri cantieri."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|	"We chose to call them Swans," she replies, "in what now feels like eons ago. They were about ready to enter production several decades ago, however, the design exercise was not able to make a reasonable use case for them. They had to stay in limbo for all this time, watching newer and more innovative designs come out. Their style is considered fairly retro by now, and these first builds are heavier than we would like them to be. But to me, these equate an end of an era for our shipyards." She looks at them nostalgically. "Chances are that the Swan will be the last design we do not produce as a liveship. At least, not a complete one."|3700|0
units.english: "We chose to call them Swans," she replies, "in what now feels like eons ago. They were about ready to enter production several decades ago, however, the design exercise was not able to make a reasonable use case for them. They had to stay in limbo for all this time, watching newer and more innovative designs come out. Their style is considered fairly retro by now, and these first builds are heavier than we would like them to be. But to me, these equate an end of an era for our shipyards." She looks at them nostalgically. "Chances are that the Swan will be the last design we do not produce as a liveship. At least, not a complete one."
units.italian: "Abbiamo scelto di chiamarli Swan," risponde, "in quello che ora sembra un'eternità fa. Erano quasi pronti a entrare in produzione decenni fa, ma l'esercizio di progettazione non riuscì a trovare un caso d'uso ragionevole. Sono rimasti in sospeso per tutto questo tempo, guardando uscire progetti più nuovi e innovativi. Il loro stile è ormai considerato piuttosto retrò, e queste prime unità sono più pesanti di quanto vorremmo. Ma per me rappresentano la fine di un'era per i nostri cantieri." Li guarda con nostalgia. "Probabile che lo Swan sia l'ultimo progetto che non produciamo come nave viva. Almeno, non completo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|	"They will be much more useful now than they would have been back then," intervenes Dusk, as the convoy reaches the closest pads of the starport.|3702|0
units.english: "They will be much more useful now than they would have been back then," intervenes Dusk, as the convoy reaches the closest pads of the starport.
units.italian: "Saranno molto più utili ora di quanto lo sarebbero stati allora," interviene Dusk, mentre il convoglio raggiunge le piazzole più vicine dello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|	"The role of these models will be flying around Postverta, going back and forth from the local gas giants to scoop deuterium for Ssil Vida. They are by, a good margin, the largest design we have produced for that purpose - though they cannot go as deep as a gaslining craft or a specialized vehicle. We want to give them some stress testing before we use them for more complex missions. They are in effect massive tankers, and not just of hyperspace fuel: their wings can fill with many tons of any liquid, from cryogenic hydrogen to the slime of a Void Sprite."|3703|0
units.english: "The role of these models will be flying around Postverta, going back and forth from the local gas giants to scoop deuterium for Ssil Vida. They are by, a good margin, the largest design we have produced for that purpose - though they cannot go as deep as a gaslining craft or a specialized vehicle. We want to give them some stress testing before we use them for more complex missions. They are in effect massive tankers, and not just of hyperspace fuel: their wings can fill with many tons of any liquid, from cryogenic hydrogen to the slime of a Void Sprite."
units.italian: "Il ruolo di questi modelli sarà volare attorno a Postverta, andando avanti e indietro dai giganti gassosi locali per raccogliere deuterio da dare a Ssil Vida. Sono, con un buon margine, il progetto più grande che abbiamo prodotto per quello scopo, anche se non possono scendere in profondità come una nave adatta all'atmosfera o un veicolo specializzato. Vogliamo sottoporli a qualche prova di stress prima di usarli per missioni più complesse. In effetti sono enormi navi cisterna, e non solo di carburante per iperguida: le loro ali possono riempirsi di molte tonnellate di qualsiasi liquido, dall'idrogeno criogenico alla melma di uno spettro del vuoto."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|	"Alright, I am ready."|3705|0
units.english: "Alright, I am ready."
units.italian: "Va bene, sono pronto."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|	"What about the next expedition?"|3706|0
units.english: "What about the next expedition?"
units.italian: "E la prossima spedizione?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|	"I am going to stay here to help the preparations for Patir," comments Dusk. "Our next trip, if the assigned prefects authorize it, will be both the first long endurance stay and the first complete expedition. Five of our crew in the laboratory will analyze the Builder settlement and their surroundings, and five in your ship will explore the space beyond Patir in-situ.|3707|0
units.english: "I am going to stay here to help the preparations for Patir," comments Dusk. "Our next trip, if the assigned prefects authorize it, will be both the first long endurance stay and the first complete expedition. Five of our crew in the laboratory will analyze the Builder settlement and their surroundings, and five in your ship will explore the space beyond Patir in-situ.
units.italian: "Resto qui ad aiutare con i preparativi per Patir," commenta Dusk. "Il nostro prossimo viaggio, se i prefetti assegnati lo autorizzeranno, sarà sia il primo soggiorno a resistenza lunga sia la prima spedizione completa. Cinque del nostro equipaggio nel laboratorio analizzeranno l'insediamento dei Costruttori e ciò che lo circonda, e cinque sulla tua nave esploreranno sul posto lo spazio oltre Patir.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|	"Still, we took the chance to repay you for your expenses, and to help you prepare for the future. You should find <payment> in your account shortly." You exchange bows, and he disappears in the crowd.|3708|0
units.english: "Still, we took the chance to repay you for your expenses, and to help you prepare for the future. You should find <payment> in your account shortly." You exchange bows, and he disappears in the crowd.
units.italian: "Tuttavia abbiamo colto l'occasione per rimborsarti le spese, e per aiutarti a preparare il futuro. Dovresti trovare <payment> sul tuo conto a breve." Vi scambiate inchini, e lui sparisce tra la folla.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|	"I will take his bunk on your ship, if it is alright with you," adds Taely. "Make sure to escort the Swans closely to <planet>: they may be armed, but this is still their first proper spaceflight."|3709|0
units.english: "I will take his bunk on your ship, if it is alright with you," adds Taely. "Make sure to escort the Swans closely to <planet>: they may be armed, but this is still their first proper spaceflight."
units.italian: "Prenderò io la sua cuccetta sulla tua nave, se per te va bene," aggiunge Taely. "Assicurati di scortare gli Swan da vicino fino a <planet>: potranno anche essere armati, ma questo è comunque il loro primo volo spaziale vero."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|dialog|3727|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that you left Taely on one of your escorts that hasn't entered the system. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto di aver lasciato Taely su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|As you make a hard-dock to <planet>, the three Swans go their own way toward the local gas giant. Taely explains that she will check on them from here on Ssil Vida, as the inhabitants have been kind enough to set up a console for the test. "This one will be more or less a rehearsal," she informs you. "Strange and hard to explain things happen around that world when Ssil Vida is engaged, and to avoid complications we intend to send the Swans to instead scoop from the nearby systems once operational."|3730|0
units.english: As you make a hard-dock to <planet>, the three Swans go their own way toward the local gas giant. Taely explains that she will check on them from here on Ssil Vida, as the inhabitants have been kind enough to set up a console for the test. "This one will be more or less a rehearsal," she informs you. "Strange and hard to explain things happen around that world when Ssil Vida is engaged, and to avoid complications we intend to send the Swans to instead scoop from the nearby systems once operational."
units.italian: Mentre ti agganci a <planet>, i tre Swan vanno per la loro strada verso il gigante gassoso locale. Taely spiega che da qui li controllerà da Ssil Vida, dato che gli abitanti sono stati così gentili da allestire una console per il test. "Questo sarà più o meno una prova generale," ti informa. "Attorno a quel mondo succedono cose strane e difficili da spiegare quando Ssil Vida è attivo, e per evitare complicazioni intendiamo mandare gli Swan a raccogliere dai sistemi vicini una volta operativi."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|	She looks at them with admiration. "The work on them has been remarkably smooth, but they spent so many years in my folders - it took so much of my time recently, that I cannot help but have mixed feelings watching them fly away."|3731|0
units.english: She looks at them with admiration. "The work on them has been remarkably smooth, but they spent so many years in my folders - it took so much of my time recently, that I cannot help but have mixed feelings watching them fly away."
units.italian: Li guarda con ammirazione. "Il lavoro su di loro è stato straordinariamente scorrevole, ma hanno passato tanti anni nelle mie cartelle; di recente mi hanno preso tantissimo tempo, e non posso fare a meno di provare sentimenti contrastanti nel vederli volare via."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|	"It is natural to feel that way."|3733|0
units.english: "It is natural to feel that way."
units.italian: "È naturale sentirsi così."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|	"What about the work on the Peregrine?"|3735|0
units.english: "What about the work on the Peregrine?"
units.italian: "E il lavoro sul Peregrine?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|	She smiles. "I sense a practical purpose behind your question. Unfortunately, progress has not been as fast as we hoped for. Liveships are still a very new concept for us, and to get production and training to the rates we wanted is proving complex. It will be at least a few months before you find them in our shipyards, I fear. Our security needs have to take precedence, but I will make sure to notify you as soon as they are available."|3736|0
units.english: She smiles. "I sense a practical purpose behind your question. Unfortunately, progress has not been as fast as we hoped for. Liveships are still a very new concept for us, and to get production and training to the rates we wanted is proving complex. It will be at least a few months before you find them in our shipyards, I fear. Our security needs have to take precedence, but I will make sure to notify you as soon as they are available."
units.italian: Sorride. "Intuisco uno scopo pratico dietro la tua domanda. Purtroppo i progressi non sono stati rapidi come speravamo. Le navi vive sono ancora un concetto molto nuovo per noi, e portare produzione e addestramento ai ritmi che volevamo si sta rivelando complesso. Temo che passeranno almeno qualche mese prima che tu le trovi nei nostri cantieri. Le nostre esigenze di sicurezza hanno la precedenza, ma mi assicurerò di avvisarti appena saranno disponibili."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 28|	By the time you have accompanied Taely to her workstation, the Swans are barely another point of light in the sky. "It will be just a matter of hours before the Swans are on their way back here. It should not be hard for us to meet up in the local starport hub once I am done - after all, it is still quite small."|3738|0
units.english: By the time you have accompanied Taely to her workstation, the Swans are barely another point of light in the sky. "It will be just a matter of hours before the Swans are on their way back here. It should not be hard for us to meet up in the local starport hub once I am done - after all, it is still quite small."
units.italian: Quando hai accompagnato Taely alla sua postazione, gli Swan sono ormai appena un altro punto di luce nel cielo. "Ci vorranno solo poche ore perché gli Swan siano di ritorno qui. Non dovrebbe essere difficile incontrarci nel nodo dello spazioporto locale quando avrò finito; dopo tutto è ancora piuttosto piccolo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 29|name|3742|0
units.english: Korath Beyond
units.italian: Korath oltre il confine

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 29|description|3743|0
units.english: Find and take care of the Korath ships in the Postverta cluster (with Ssil Vida active) so that they do not cause further damage.
units.italian: Trova e sistema le navi Korath nell'ammasso di Postverta (con Ssil Vida attivo) così che non causino altri danni.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 29|Taely comes looking for you shortly after the Swans have docked with Ssil Vida, with a fast step and crystal in her hand. "Captain, another task for you has just come up. I have been informed that the Korath we met on the way here have been raiding the system for a few days - in fact, since just before Ssil Vida activated. During the trouble of moving between the two realities, it appears that a ship in the attacking fleet was able to jump beyond Ssil Vida's range, and has remained inside that universe since. It is not acceptable to leave it there any longer."|3750|0
units.english: Taely comes looking for you shortly after the Swans have docked with Ssil Vida, with a fast step and crystal in her hand. "Captain, another task for you has just come up. I have been informed that the Korath we met on the way here have been raiding the system for a few days - in fact, since just before Ssil Vida activated. During the trouble of moving between the two realities, it appears that a ship in the attacking fleet was able to jump beyond Ssil Vida's range, and has remained inside that universe since. It is not acceptable to leave it there any longer."
units.italian: Taely viene a cercarti poco dopo che gli Swan si sono agganciati a Ssil Vida, con passo veloce e un cristallo in mano. "Capitano, è appena saltato fuori un altro compito per te. Mi è stato riferito che i Korath che abbiamo incontrato sulla via di qui stanno saccheggiando il sistema da qualche giorno, in effetti da poco prima che Ssil Vida si attivasse. Durante il trambusto dello spostamento tra le due realtà, sembra che una nave della flotta d'attacco sia riuscita a saltare oltre la portata di Ssil Vida, e da allora è rimasta dentro quell'universo. Non è accettabile lasciarla lì ancora."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 29|	A quiver down your spine suggests to you that Ssil Vida has activated again, filling Postverta with beings of all kinds. She hands you the crystal, small and sharp. "On this is the information we have on the ship, as well as a program to record what you see during your search. Given the location, we want to understand as much as we can about any damage they might have caused." She stops, as if preparing to leave; however, she changes her mind.|3751|0
units.english: A quiver down your spine suggests to you that Ssil Vida has activated again, filling Postverta with beings of all kinds. She hands you the crystal, small and sharp. "On this is the information we have on the ship, as well as a program to record what you see during your search. Given the location, we want to understand as much as we can about any damage they might have caused." She stops, as if preparing to leave; however, she changes her mind.
units.italian: Un brivido lungo la schiena ti suggerisce che Ssil Vida si è attivato di nuovo, riempiendo Postverta di esseri di ogni tipo. Ti consegna il cristallo, piccolo e appuntito. "Qui ci sono le informazioni che abbiamo sulla nave, oltre a un programma per registrare quello che vedrai durante la ricerca. Data la posizione, vogliamo capire il più possibile su eventuali danni che abbiano causato." Si ferma, come se si preparasse a partire; tuttavia cambia idea.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 29|	"Our Swans have not been designed for front line combat, but rather to fill a support role. Staying in Ssil Vida, however, will eventually subject them to direct attacks - be it from Korath, or perhaps worse. I would like to let one get some combat experience, if you can."|3752|0
units.english: "Our Swans have not been designed for front line combat, but rather to fill a support role. Staying in Ssil Vida, however, will eventually subject them to direct attacks - be it from Korath, or perhaps worse. I would like to let one get some combat experience, if you can."
units.italian: "I nostri Swan non sono progettati per il combattimento in prima linea, ma per un ruolo di supporto. Restare a Ssil Vida, però, li esporrà prima o poi ad attacchi diretti, da parte dei Korath o forse di peggio. Mi piacerebbe lasciarne uno fare un po' di esperienza di combattimento, se puoi."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 29|	"I would be happy to."|3754|0
units.english: "I would be happy to."
units.italian: "Ne sarei felice."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 29|	"They are large and unwieldy. I do not want them to get in the way."|3756|0
units.english: "They are large and unwieldy. I do not want them to get in the way."
units.italian: "Sono grandi e poco maneggevoli. Non voglio che si mettano in mezzo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 29|	She looks at you with some frustration. "Given their speed, it will not take much effort for you to overtake them to the target, if you wish to do so. I would rather let them get some combat experience."|3757|0
units.english: She looks at you with some frustration. "Given their speed, it will not take much effort for you to overtake them to the target, if you wish to do so. I would rather let them get some combat experience."
units.italian: Ti guarda con una certa frustrazione. "Data la loro velocità, non ti costerà molta fatica superarli verso l'obiettivo, se vuoi. Preferirei lasciare che facciano un po' di esperienza di combattimento."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 29|dialog|3774|0
units.english: The crew quarters lie in a disastrous state, ravaged by bite signs and bizarre slime. While the rest of the ship has held up together, there is no way to actually take control of it.
units.italian: Gli alloggi dell'equipaggio sono in uno stato disastroso, devastati da segni di morsi e da una melma bizzarra. Mentre il resto della nave ha tenuto, non c'è modo di prenderne davvero il controllo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 29|dialog|3781|0
units.english: A scan reveals that a series of increasingly large holes has replaced what used to be the crew quarters. Most of the personnel seem to have died days ago, and much of the remaining crew has locked themselves in the few still-airtight compartments.
units.italian: Una scansione rivela che una serie di fori sempre più grandi ha preso il posto di quelli che erano gli alloggi dell'equipaggio. La maggior parte del personale sembra morta da giorni, e buona parte dell'equipaggio rimasto si è chiusa nei pochi compartimenti ancora a tenuta stagna.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 29|The data Taely gave you included information on who to give the crystal to. Thanks to Ssil Vida's limited population, it only takes you a few minutes to identify her; based on your vague memories, she was likely one of the researchers you helped transport here.|3791|0
units.english: The data Taely gave you included information on who to give the crystal to. Thanks to Ssil Vida's limited population, it only takes you a few minutes to identify her; based on your vague memories, she was likely one of the researchers you helped transport here.
units.italian: I dati che Taely ti ha dato includevano informazioni su a chi consegnare il cristallo. Grazie alla popolazione limitata di Ssil Vida, ti servono solo pochi minuti per identificarla; in base ai tuoi vaghi ricordi, era probabilmente una delle ricercatrici che hai aiutato a trasportare qui.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 29|	"We appreciate your support, Captain. Postverta is for us like a window into this region of space before it turned into the Ember Waste; we must do everything we can to keep it as pristine as it is now." While she disappears into a hallway with the crystal, a notification appears on your communicator of a deposit of <payment> under the caption "Korath Bounty." With it, a message: Taely will meet you in the local spaceport.|3792|0
units.english: "We appreciate your support, Captain. Postverta is for us like a window into this region of space before it turned into the Ember Waste; we must do everything we can to keep it as pristine as it is now." While she disappears into a hallway with the crystal, a notification appears on your communicator of a deposit of <payment> under the caption "Korath Bounty." With it, a message: Taely will meet you in the local spaceport.
units.italian: "Apprezziamo il tuo supporto, capitano. Postverta è per noi come una finestra su questa regione di spazio prima che diventasse la Distesa di Braci; dobbiamo fare tutto il possibile per mantenerla incontaminata com'è ora." Mentre sparisce in un corridoio con il cristallo, sul tuo communicatore appare la notifica di un deposito di <payment> con la dicitura "Taglia Korath". Insieme, un messaggio: Taely ti incontrerà nello spazioporto locale.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 30|name|3806|0
units.english: Taely to <planet>
units.italian: Taely su <planet>

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 30|description|3807|0
units.english: Accompany Taely to <destination> so that she can return to her work.
units.italian: Accompagna Taely su <destination> così che possa tornare al suo lavoro.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 30|While trying to remember the appearance of this room, you notice that a large display has been installed by the Remnant recently. As far as you can tell, it shows a clock of some sort, but every number on the display is 'F'. "We have installed timers to mark the moment Patir disappears, and when it returns," explains Taely, noticing your gaze. "Given the gap between Ssil Vida's activation and the events taking place, it is easy to lose track of our current status and the actions to take. Of course, the timers have not yet started.|3815|0
units.english: While trying to remember the appearance of this room, you notice that a large display has been installed by the Remnant recently. As far as you can tell, it shows a clock of some sort, but every number on the display is 'F'. "We have installed timers to mark the moment Patir disappears, and when it returns," explains Taely, noticing your gaze. "Given the gap between Ssil Vida's activation and the events taking place, it is easy to lose track of our current status and the actions to take. Of course, the timers have not yet started.
units.italian: Mentre cerchi di ricordare l'aspetto di questa stanza, noti che di recente i Remnant hanno installato un grande display. Per quanto puoi dire, mostra una specie di orologio, ma ogni numero sul display è una 'F'. "Abbiamo installato dei timer per segnare il momento in cui Patir sparisce, e quello in cui torna," spiega Taely, accorgendosi del tuo sguardo. "Dato l'intervallo tra l'attivazione di Ssil Vida e gli eventi che accadono, è facile perdere traccia del nostro stato attuale e delle azioni da intraprendere. Naturalmente i timer non sono ancora partiti.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 30|	"But onto our mission, I can happily report that our Swans behaved as expected. This fleet, made of pre-production models - thus heavier and slightly less capable than the actual product - will stay here in Postverta to become its tanker flotilla. And on that topic, how would you say one fared in combat?"|3816|0
units.english: "But onto our mission, I can happily report that our Swans behaved as expected. This fleet, made of pre-production models - thus heavier and slightly less capable than the actual product - will stay here in Postverta to become its tanker flotilla. And on that topic, how would you say one fared in combat?"
units.italian: "Ma veniamo alla nostra missione: posso riferire con piacere che i nostri Swan si sono comportati come previsto. Questa flotta, fatta di modelli pre-produzione, quindi più pesanti e un po' meno capaci del prodotto vero, resterà qui a Postverta per diventarne la flottiglia cisterna. E a proposito, come diresti che se l'è cavata uno in combattimento?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 30|	"Acceptably."|3818|0
units.english: "Acceptably."
units.italian: "Accettabilmente."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 30|	"It was easily outmatched by the Tubfalet."|3819|0
units.english: "It was easily outmatched by the Tubfalet."
units.italian: "È stato facilmente sopraffatto dal Tubfalet."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 30|	"It did not really see much combat."|3820|0
units.english: "It did not really see much combat."
units.italian: "Non ha visto molto combattimento, in realtà."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 30|	"I will take note. You might have noticed they are armed with a turreted form of its Inhibitor Cannons, meant to support other ships in brawls and not face the enemy directly. A doctrine, I might add, similar to that of a number of Korath vessels. It should not be long before you see them appear on most of our aging Pelicans, so that they have better chances to escape the ever changing Korath ploys."|3821|0
units.english: "I will take note. You might have noticed they are armed with a turreted form of its Inhibitor Cannons, meant to support other ships in brawls and not face the enemy directly. A doctrine, I might add, similar to that of a number of Korath vessels. It should not be long before you see them appear on most of our aging Pelicans, so that they have better chances to escape the ever changing Korath ploys."
units.italian: "Ne prenderò nota. Forse avrai notato che sono armati con una forma in torretta dei suoi Cannoni Inibitori, pensata per supportare altre navi nelle mischie e non per affrontare il nemico direttamente. Una dottrina, aggiungo, simile a quella di diverse navi Korath. Non passerà molto prima che tu li veda comparire sulla maggior parte dei nostri vecchi Pelican, così che abbiano migliori possibilità di sfuggire ai sempre cangianti piani Korath."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 30|	"Will they ever become available for general purchase?"|3823|0
units.english: "Will they ever become available for general purchase?"
units.italian: "Diventeranno mai disponibili per l'acquisto generale?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 30|	"They are not a high priority project for us, otherwise, we would have developed them much earlier. Given our needs, several months before full production is expected. Although..." She stops to think for a moment. "Much of our understanding of Ssil Vida depends on the human technology you shared with us. As a gesture of gratitude, I might be able to give you access to the Inhibitor Turret sooner than that."|3824|0
units.english: "They are not a high priority project for us, otherwise, we would have developed them much earlier. Given our needs, several months before full production is expected. Although..." She stops to think for a moment. "Much of our understanding of Ssil Vida depends on the human technology you shared with us. As a gesture of gratitude, I might be able to give you access to the Inhibitor Turret sooner than that."
units.italian: "Non sono un progetto ad alta priorità per noi, altrimenti li avremmo sviluppati molto prima. Viste le nostre esigenze, si prevedono diversi mesi prima della produzione completa. Anche se..." Si ferma a pensare un momento. "Gran parte della nostra comprensione di Ssil Vida dipende dalla tecnologia umana che ci hai condiviso. Come gesto di gratitudine, potrei riuscire a darti accesso alla Torretta Inibitrice prima di allora."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 30|	"What do the human outfits have to do with Ssil Vida?"|3826|0
units.english: "What do the human outfits have to do with Ssil Vida?"
units.italian: "Che c'entrano gli equipaggiamenti umani con Ssil Vida?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 30|	"Thank you."|3827|0
units.english: "Thank you."
units.italian: "Grazie."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 30|	"We have had some issues understanding Ssil Vida's technology at first, at least beyond the most basic power distribution and control systems. However, some of us who worked on the human technology projects soon noticed the similarity in technology - studying the principles behind one improved our understanding of the other, despite not being exact matches in reality. When you brought us those outfits, you unknowingly saved us months or years of work; their technological level is really fairly similar."|3829|0
units.english: "We have had some issues understanding Ssil Vida's technology at first, at least beyond the most basic power distribution and control systems. However, some of us who worked on the human technology projects soon noticed the similarity in technology - studying the principles behind one improved our understanding of the other, despite not being exact matches in reality. When you brought us those outfits, you unknowingly saved us months or years of work; their technological level is really fairly similar."
units.italian: "All'inizio abbiamo avuto qualche difficoltà a capire la tecnologia di Ssil Vida, almeno oltre i sistemi più elementari di distribuzione e controllo dell'energia. Tuttavia alcuni di noi che hanno lavorato ai progetti sulla tecnologia umana hanno notato presto la somiglianza tra le due; studiare i principi di una ha migliorato la nostra comprensione dell'altra, anche se in realtà non coincidono esattamente. Quando ci hai portato quegli equipaggiamenti, ci hai risparmiato senza saperlo mesi o anni di lavoro; il loro livello tecnologico è davvero piuttosto simile."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 30|	"How could such a species build something like this station?" you ask in response.|3830|0
units.english: "How could such a species build something like this station?" you ask in response.
units.italian: "Come poteva una specie del genere costruire una stazione simile?" chiedi in risposta.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 30|	"If you want to know the specific mechanism, I have no way of knowing. But I can tell you that when a civilization is nearing its end, much of the logic you and I work with no longer applies: the strangest plans are put into motion, almost always with terrible results, but occasionally with more interesting endings.|3831|0
units.english: "If you want to know the specific mechanism, I have no way of knowing. But I can tell you that when a civilization is nearing its end, much of the logic you and I work with no longer applies: the strangest plans are put into motion, almost always with terrible results, but occasionally with more interesting endings.
units.italian: "Se vuoi conoscere il meccanismo specifico, non ho modo di saperlo. Ma posso dirti che quando una civiltà è vicina alla fine, gran parte della logica con cui lavoriamo tu e io non vale più: i piani più strani vengono messi in moto, quasi sempre con risultati terribili, ma ogni tanto con finali più interessanti.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 30|	"That being said, we should get going. The Swans may stay here, but I need a ride to <planet>'s shipyards to get back to my work."|3833|0
units.english: "That being said, we should get going. The Swans may stay here, but I need a ride to <planet>'s shipyards to get back to my work."
units.italian: "Detto questo, dovremmo andare. Gli Swan possono restare qui, ma a me serve un passaggio ai cantieri di <planet> per tornare al mio lavoro."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 31|name|3857|0
units.english: Patir preparations
units.italian: Preparativi per Patir

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 31|description|3858|0
units.english: Return to <destination> to meet up with Dusk in the local shipyard.
units.italian: Torna su <destination> per incontrare Dusk nel cantiere locale.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 31|Taely has been hard at work on your ship during the trip, assembling a contraption with a few spare parts roughly the size of a fist. At last, she connects it with your console, and a stone atop it lights up in a bright blue color. "Given your continued involvement in the exploration of Patir, I imagined it would be useful for you to know Patir's state whenever you need. Thanks to the stations mounted in Patir and the telemetry sent by Ssil Vida - both of which your ship already receives - all I needed to do was to put them together. This crystal will shine blue if Patir is stable in the Milky Way, yellow if it is about to leave it, and red if it is no longer here."|3866|0
units.english: Taely has been hard at work on your ship during the trip, assembling a contraption with a few spare parts roughly the size of a fist. At last, she connects it with your console, and a stone atop it lights up in a bright blue color. "Given your continued involvement in the exploration of Patir, I imagined it would be useful for you to know Patir's state whenever you need. Thanks to the stations mounted in Patir and the telemetry sent by Ssil Vida - both of which your ship already receives - all I needed to do was to put them together. This crystal will shine blue if Patir is stable in the Milky Way, yellow if it is about to leave it, and red if it is no longer here."
units.italian: Taely ha lavorato sodo sulla tua nave durante il viaggio, assemblando un congegno con qualche pezzo di ricambio grosso all'incirca come un pugno. Alla fine lo collega alla tua console, e una pietra sulla sua sommità si accende di un blu luminoso. "Visto il tuo coinvolgimento continuo nell'esplorazione di Patir, immaginavo ti sarebbe utile conoscere lo stato di Patir ogni volta che ti serve. Grazie alle stazioni montate su Patir e alla telemetria inviata da Ssil Vida, che la tua nave già riceve, dovevo solo metterle insieme. Questo cristallo brillerà di blu se Patir è stabile nella Via Lattea, di giallo se sta per lasciarla, e di rosso se non è più qui."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 31|	You thank her, and accompany her down the ramp. A group of Remnant is already waiting for her arrival. "Our outfitters are receiving a shipment of Inhibitor Turrets within a few days. I have arranged for you to have access to them once they arrive."|3867|0
units.english: You thank her, and accompany her down the ramp. A group of Remnant is already waiting for her arrival. "Our outfitters are receiving a shipment of Inhibitor Turrets within a few days. I have arranged for you to have access to them once they arrive."
units.italian: La ringrazi, e la accompagni giù per la rampa. Un gruppo di Remnant è già in attesa del suo arrivo. "I nostri fornitori di equipaggiamento riceveranno una spedizione di Torrette Inibitrici entro pochi giorni. Ho fatto in modo che tu possa accedervi quando arrivano."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 31|	Your communicator beeps: Dusk and his team will meet up with you for another expedition in the shipyard of <planet>. Seeing the message, she smirks. "I can give you a preview of your next mission, if you wish."|3868|0
units.english: Your communicator beeps: Dusk and his team will meet up with you for another expedition in the shipyard of <planet>. Seeing the message, she smirks. "I can give you a preview of your next mission, if you wish."
units.italian: Il tuo communicatore bippa: Dusk e la sua squadra ti incontreranno per un'altra spedizione nel cantiere di <planet>. Vedendo il messaggio, lei sorride. "Posso darti un'anteprima della tua prossima missione, se vuoi."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 31|	"How do you know about it?"|3870|0
units.english: "How do you know about it?"
units.italian: "Come fai a saperlo?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 31|	"Well, sure."|3872|0
units.english: "Well, sure."
units.italian: "Beh, certo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 31|	"I never liked spoilers much."|3874|0
units.english: "I never liked spoilers much."
units.italian: "Non mi sono mai piaciuti gli spoiler."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 31|	She laughs. "All right then. If you prefer it this way, I hope you will enjoy the surprise!" She disappears in the crowd of her colleagues, certainly already moving onto another project.|3875|0
units.english: She laughs. "All right then. If you prefer it this way, I hope you will enjoy the surprise!" She disappears in the crowd of her colleagues, certainly already moving onto another project.
units.italian: Ride. "Va bene allora. Se preferisci così, spero che ti godrai la sorpresa!" Sparisce nella folla dei suoi colleghi, di certo già passata a un altro progetto.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 31|	"We had to prepare a shipment of specialized Terns just a few weeks ago, the specifics of which were authorized by Dusk. Given that their destination was unmarked, I can tell you with near certainty that they have been destined to go to Patir. Especially because by this point, shipments to Ssil Vida come marked with their actual destination."|3878|0
units.english: "We had to prepare a shipment of specialized Terns just a few weeks ago, the specifics of which were authorized by Dusk. Given that their destination was unmarked, I can tell you with near certainty that they have been destined to go to Patir. Especially because by this point, shipments to Ssil Vida come marked with their actual destination."
units.italian: "Abbiamo dovuto preparare una spedizione di Tern specializzati solo poche settimane fa, e le specifiche sono state autorizzate da Dusk. Dato che la loro destinazione non era segnata, posso dirti con quasi certezza che erano destinati a Patir. Soprattutto perché, a questo punto, le spedizioni verso Ssil Vida arrivano con la destinazione reale indicata."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 31|	"What kind of specialization?" you ask.|3879|0
units.english: "What kind of specialization?" you ask.
units.italian: "Che tipo di specializzazione?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 31|	"We modified them to be easier to maintain, at the expense of some of their mass and structural integrity. I believe they are also going to be carrying some kind of outboard cargo, so that functionality was not affected by our changes. You will have to ask Dusk for something more specific than this, however."|3880|0
units.english: "We modified them to be easier to maintain, at the expense of some of their mass and structural integrity. I believe they are also going to be carrying some kind of outboard cargo, so that functionality was not affected by our changes. You will have to ask Dusk for something more specific than this, however."
units.italian: "Li abbiamo modificati per essere più facili da mantenere, a scapito di parte della massa e dell'integrità strutturale. Credo che porteranno anche una specie di carico esterno, quindi quella funzionalità non è stata toccata dalle nostre modifiche. Per qualcosa di più specifico dovrai però chiedere a Dusk."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 31|	"Good to know."|3882|0
units.english: "Good to know."
units.italian: "Buono a sapersi."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 31|	"What is the reason behind all this secrecy?"|3884|0
units.english: "What is the reason behind all this secrecy?"
units.italian: "Qual è il motivo di tutta questa segretezza?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 31|	"Oh, do not get the wrong idea," she scrambles to clarify. "If I had asked directly, they would have certainly told me what they were for. The confidentiality in these messages is as much directed toward us as it is toward anyone trying to intercept them. We do not want the Korath to get too much unintended information on our programs that show the most potential." After a brief goodbye, she disappears in the crowd of her colleagues, certainly already moving onto another project.|3885|0
units.english: "Oh, do not get the wrong idea," she scrambles to clarify. "If I had asked directly, they would have certainly told me what they were for. The confidentiality in these messages is as much directed toward us as it is toward anyone trying to intercept them. We do not want the Korath to get too much unintended information on our programs that show the most potential." After a brief goodbye, she disappears in the crowd of her colleagues, certainly already moving onto another project.
units.italian: "Oh, non fraintendere," si affretta a chiarire. "Se avessi chiesto direttamente, mi avrebbero di certo detto a cosa servivano. La riservatezza di questi messaggi è rivolta tanto a noi quanto a chiunque tenti di intercettarli. Non vogliamo che i Korath ottengano troppe informazioni non volute sui nostri programmi più promettenti." Dopo un breve saluto, sparisce nella folla dei suoi colleghi, di certo già passata a un altro progetto.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 31|After following Dusk through the busy starport, you reach a flock of Terns flying in circles at the outskirts of the landing zone. You count four of them, none of which seems to present any distinctive feature. "After we returned from the lifeboat test, we have started preparing this small fleet to join us around Patir. We think of them as fulfilling two functions: research, of course, and in case of emergency, distraction. They will do their best to act as decoys to allow the Petrel to escape safely into the depth of the gas giant. As you know, this will be our first - intentional - extended expedition into that region of space, as well as the first in which we leave a second team at the laboratory.|3890|0
units.english: After following Dusk through the busy starport, you reach a flock of Terns flying in circles at the outskirts of the landing zone. You count four of them, none of which seems to present any distinctive feature. "After we returned from the lifeboat test, we have started preparing this small fleet to join us around Patir. We think of them as fulfilling two functions: research, of course, and in case of emergency, distraction. They will do their best to act as decoys to allow the Petrel to escape safely into the depth of the gas giant. As you know, this will be our first - intentional - extended expedition into that region of space, as well as the first in which we leave a second team at the laboratory.
units.italian: Dopo aver seguito Dusk attraverso lo spazioporto affollato, raggiungi uno stormo di Tern che vola in cerchio ai margini della zona di atterraggio. Ne conti quattro, nessuno dei quali sembra presentare caratteristiche distintive. "Dopo il ritorno dal test della scialuppa, abbiamo iniziato a preparare questa piccola flotta per unirsi a noi attorno a Patir. Pensiamo che svolgano due funzioni: la ricerca, naturalmente, e in caso di emergenza, la distrazione. Faranno del loro meglio per fare da esche e permettere al Petrel di fuggire al sicuro nel profondo del gigante gassoso. Come sai, sarà la nostra prima spedizione prolungata, e intenzionale, in quella regione di spazio, nonché la prima in cui lasciamo una seconda squadra al laboratorio.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 31|	"What you do not know, however, is our objective. After our findings, the prefects have at last approved a direct exploration of the planetoid in Lathia - if it is indeed sapient, and if we succeed in communicating with it, this would be our first true contact with the asteroid-like species inhabiting that region.|3891|0
units.english: "What you do not know, however, is our objective. After our findings, the prefects have at last approved a direct exploration of the planetoid in Lathia - if it is indeed sapient, and if we succeed in communicating with it, this would be our first true contact with the asteroid-like species inhabiting that region.
units.italian: "Quello che però non sai è il nostro obiettivo. Dopo le nostre scoperte, i prefetti hanno finalmente approvato un'esplorazione diretta del planetoide di Lathia; se è davvero senziente, e se riusciamo a comunicare con esso, sarebbe il nostro primo vero contatto con la specie simile ad asteroide che abita quella regione.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 31|	"All of which means a very heavy payload, unfortunately." He scribbles something on his datapad, then reads from it. "Our expedition is going to need... at least 110 tons of equipment, including some allowance for samples of that planetoid. Along with this, the team in Patir will need another 105 tons of scientific payload, some of which to be mounted on the Builder settlement. To top it all, we need to carry our four Terns before we can begin. We will take care of the drones and the Patir-based machinery on one of our Swans, which leaves around 130 tons for you to take."|3892|0
units.english: "All of which means a very heavy payload, unfortunately." He scribbles something on his datapad, then reads from it. "Our expedition is going to need... at least 110 tons of equipment, including some allowance for samples of that planetoid. Along with this, the team in Patir will need another 105 tons of scientific payload, some of which to be mounted on the Builder settlement. To top it all, we need to carry our four Terns before we can begin. We will take care of the drones and the Patir-based machinery on one of our Swans, which leaves around 130 tons for you to take."
units.italian: "Il che significa un carico molto pesante, purtroppo." Scarabocchia qualcosa sul tablet, poi legge. "La nostra spedizione avrà bisogno di... almeno 110 tonnellate di equipaggiamento, compresa una certa tolleranza per i campioni di quel planetoide. Insieme a questo, la squadra a Patir avrà bisogno di altre 105 tonnellate di carico scientifico, parte del quale da montare sull'insediamento dei Costruttori. E per finire, dobbiamo portare i nostri quattro Tern prima di poter cominciare. Ci occuperemo dei droni e dei macchinari per Patir su uno dei nostri Swan, il che lascia circa 130 tonnellate da caricare su di te."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 31|	"Wait, a Swan is coming with us?"|3894|0
units.english: "Wait, a Swan is coming with us?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, uno Swan viene con noi?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 31|	"What does the exploration entail?"|3896|0
units.english: "What does the exploration entail?"
units.italian: "In che cosa consiste l'esplorazione?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 31|	"That is a lot of cargo."|3898|0
units.english: "That is a lot of cargo."
units.italian: "È un sacco di carico."
