units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 31|	"Look on the bright side: at least we do not need to carry it cloaked," he quips. "Yes, it certainly is. During that time, your ship is going to temporarily become one of our most capable research vehicles, at least on the side of planetary science." He hands you a credit chip. "We have decided to give you the payment before the mission, rather than after. It contains <payment>.|3899|0
units.english: "Look on the bright side: at least we do not need to carry it cloaked," he quips. "Yes, it certainly is. During that time, your ship is going to temporarily become one of our most capable research vehicles, at least on the side of planetary science." He hands you a credit chip. "We have decided to give you the payment before the mission, rather than after. It contains <payment>.
units.italian: "Guarda il lato positivo: almeno non dobbiamo portarlo occultati," scherza. "Sì, di certo. Durante quel periodo la tua nave diventerà temporaneamente uno dei nostri veicoli di ricerca più capaci, almeno sul fronte della scienza planetaria." Ti porge un chip di credito. "Abbiamo deciso di darti il pagamento prima della missione, invece che dopo. Contiene <payment>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 31|	"It was another special allocation to our project," he replies. "One that we have to return at the end of this mission, and which will not follow us beyond Patir. I imagine that fleet movements in the Milky Way are complicated enough as is." He hands you a credit chip. "Partly because of this, we have decided to give you the payment before the mission, rather than after. It contains <payment> credits.|3902|0
units.english: "It was another special allocation to our project," he replies. "One that we have to return at the end of this mission, and which will not follow us beyond Patir. I imagine that fleet movements in the Milky Way are complicated enough as is." He hands you a credit chip. "Partly because of this, we have decided to give you the payment before the mission, rather than after. It contains <payment> credits.
units.italian: "Era un'altra assegnazione speciale al nostro progetto," risponde. "Una che dobbiamo restituire alla fine di questa missione, e che non ci seguirà oltre Patir. Immagino che i movimenti di flotta nella Via Lattea siano già abbastanza complicati così." Ti porge un chip di credito. "In parte per questo, abbiamo deciso di darti il pagamento prima della missione, invece che dopo. Contiene <payment> crediti.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 31|	"It depends on what we see there," he replies stoically. "We are going to try to communicate through every medium we have available before approaching; if that fails, we may proceed with a brief EVA on the surface to find something to work on." He hands you a credit chip. "Partly because of this, we have decided to give you the payment before the mission, rather than after. It contains <payment> credits.|3905|0
units.english: "It depends on what we see there," he replies stoically. "We are going to try to communicate through every medium we have available before approaching; if that fails, we may proceed with a brief EVA on the surface to find something to work on." He hands you a credit chip. "Partly because of this, we have decided to give you the payment before the mission, rather than after. It contains <payment> credits.
units.italian: "Dipende da quello che vedremo là," risponde stoicamente. "Cercheremo di comunicare attraverso ogni mezzo a nostra disposizione prima di avvicinarci; se fallisce, potremmo procedere con una breve EVA sulla superficie per trovare qualcosa su cui lavorare." Ti porge un chip di credito. "In parte per questo, abbiamo deciso di darti il pagamento prima della missione, invece che dopo. Contiene <payment> crediti.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 31|	He glances toward the lower section of the starport, enclosed by a small rope. "Our policy is one of limiting our Jump Drive usage as much as possible - and when we do use them, our preference is to mount a large fleet so as to minimize risk. As you will have understood, this mission is complicated and important enough to warrant a breach of our protocols.|3907|0
units.english: He glances toward the lower section of the starport, enclosed by a small rope. "Our policy is one of limiting our Jump Drive usage as much as possible - and when we do use them, our preference is to mount a large fleet so as to minimize risk. As you will have understood, this mission is complicated and important enough to warrant a breach of our protocols.
units.italian: Dà un'occhiata verso la sezione inferiore dello spazioporto, delimitata da una piccola corda. "La nostra politica è limitare il più possibile l'uso dei motori di salto, e quando li usiamo preferiamo montare una flotta numerosa per ridurre al minimo il rischio. Come avrai capito, questa missione è abbastanza complicata e importante da giustificare una deroga ai nostri protocolli.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 31|	"We do not get a chance for a proper first contact often - most of our exploration of the galaxy has been strictly from orbit, far from any living being and safely hidden behind an active cloak. Given the circumstances, I was able to convince the Prefects of the tremendous potential such an encounter could have, if it were to go as we hope." He smiles. "And I trust that you are going to do everything in your power to make it so, just like us.|3908|0
units.english: "We do not get a chance for a proper first contact often - most of our exploration of the galaxy has been strictly from orbit, far from any living being and safely hidden behind an active cloak. Given the circumstances, I was able to convince the Prefects of the tremendous potential such an encounter could have, if it were to go as we hope." He smiles. "And I trust that you are going to do everything in your power to make it so, just like us.
units.italian: "Non ci capita spesso l'occasione di un vero primo contatto: gran parte della nostra esplorazione della galassia è stata rigorosamente dall'orbita, lontano da qualsiasi essere vivente e al sicuro dietro un occultamento attivo. Date le circostanze, sono riuscito a convincere i prefetti del potenziale immenso che un incontro del genere potrebbe avere, se andasse come speriamo." Sorride. "E confido che farai tutto ciò che è in tuo potere perché accada, proprio come faremo noi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 31|	"Give us a call when you are ready, Captain, and you will find us all here - a crew of 5 for the Lathia mission, and 5 more staying in Patir - together with the mission payload."|3909|0
units.english: "Give us a call when you are ready, Captain, and you will find us all here - a crew of 5 for the Lathia mission, and 5 more staying in Patir - together with the mission payload."
units.italian: "Chiamaci quando sei pronto, capitano, e ci troverai tutti qui: un equipaggio di 5 per la missione su Lathia e altri 5 che restano a Patir, insieme al carico della missione."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 32|name|3912|0
units.english: Logistics of a first contact
units.italian: Logistica di un primo contatto

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 32|description|3913|0
units.english: Accompany the Remnant team and their cargo to <system> exactly on <date>, making sure nobody is left behind on the jump in.
units.italian: Accompagna la squadra Remnant e il loro carico su <system> esattamente il <date>, assicurandoti che nessuno resti indietro al salto.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 32|blocked|3919|0
units.english: The cargo for the next expedition to Patir is ready, but you do not have enough free space. Come back when you have <tons> free.
units.italian: Il carico per la prossima spedizione a Patir è pronto, ma non hai abbastanza spazio libero. Torna quando avrai <tons> libere.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 32|Although standing in a rather isolated part of the starport, the mission personnel alone make a significant crowd. You count the ten people for your crew, plus at least two dozen more workers waiting for the order to load the payload.|3924|0
units.english: Although standing in a rather isolated part of the starport, the mission personnel alone make a significant crowd. You count the ten people for your crew, plus at least two dozen more workers waiting for the order to load the payload.
units.italian: Anche se si trova in una parte piuttosto isolata dello spazioporto, il solo personale della missione forma una folla notevole. Conti le dieci persone del tuo equipaggio, più almeno due dozzine di operai in attesa dell'ordine di caricare il carico.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 32|	When you approach them, Dusk makes a gesture and the crowd splits into smaller, selected groups, each busy with a specific function. Their coordinated movements almost remind you of a dance, like a well-oiled machine that just sprung into motion. You notice the researchers themselves assisting in the operations, making sure that each instrument is operational and correctly set up.|3925|0
units.english: When you approach them, Dusk makes a gesture and the crowd splits into smaller, selected groups, each busy with a specific function. Their coordinated movements almost remind you of a dance, like a well-oiled machine that just sprung into motion. You notice the researchers themselves assisting in the operations, making sure that each instrument is operational and correctly set up.
units.italian: Quando ti avvicini, Dusk fa un gesto e la folla si divide in gruppi più piccoli e selezionati, ognuno impegnato in una funzione specifica. I loro movimenti coordinati ti ricordano quasi una danza, come una macchina ben oliata appena messa in moto. Noti che i ricercatori stessi partecipano alle operazioni, assicurandosi che ogni strumento sia funzionante e montato correttamente.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 32|	Among them, some familiar faces make an appearance: while the Remnant that will accompany you to Lathia seem new, you notice some of the researchers from your original expedition among the group assigned to Patir. And near your payload bay, checking out one of the more voluminous machines, you are surprised to find Dawn.|3926|0
units.english: Among them, some familiar faces make an appearance: while the Remnant that will accompany you to Lathia seem new, you notice some of the researchers from your original expedition among the group assigned to Patir. And near your payload bay, checking out one of the more voluminous machines, you are surprised to find Dawn.
units.italian: Tra loro compaiono alcuni volti familiari: mentre i Remnant che ti accompagneranno su Lathia sembrano nuovi, riconosci alcuni dei ricercatori della tua spedizione originale tra il gruppo assegnato a Patir. E vicino alla tua stiva, intenta a controllare una delle macchine più voluminose, trovi con sorpresa Dawn.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 32|	"I am almost done here, <first>," she signs you when you come closer. "I want to run just a couple more integrated tests, and then I can trust it to work when it is meant to."|3927|0
units.english: "I am almost done here, <first>," she signs you when you come closer. "I want to run just a couple more integrated tests, and then I can trust it to work when it is meant to."
units.italian: "Ho quasi finito qui, <first>," ti accenna quando ti avvicini. "Voglio eseguire ancora un paio di test integrati, poi posso fidarmi che funzioni quando dovrà."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 32|	"I did not know you were part of the crew."|3929|0
units.english: "I did not know you were part of the crew."
units.italian: "Non sapevo che facessi parte dell'equipaggio."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 32|	"What is that?"|3930|0
units.english: "What is that?"
units.italian: "Che cos'è?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 32|	"You are coming with us too?"|3932|0
units.english: "You are coming with us too?"
units.italian: "Vieni anche tu con noi?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 32|	"I wish! Maybe when flights become more frequent, and more routine. No, I am part of the ground crew of one of the instruments you will add to our grid near the Builder settlement. Still, it is a serious responsibility - I have co-handled its definition a few months back, and I will also manage some of its data once we have the first light.|3933|0
units.english: "I wish! Maybe when flights become more frequent, and more routine. No, I am part of the ground crew of one of the instruments you will add to our grid near the Builder settlement. Still, it is a serious responsibility - I have co-handled its definition a few months back, and I will also manage some of its data once we have the first light.
units.italian: "Magari! Forse quando i voli diventeranno più frequenti, e più di routine. No, faccio parte della squadra a terra di uno degli strumenti che aggiungerai alla nostra rete vicino all'insediamento dei Costruttori. Comunque è una responsabilità seria: qualche mese fa ho contribuito a definirne le specifiche, e gestirò anche parte dei suoi dati quando avremo la prima luce.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 32|	"You see, this is a very-long-baseline interferometer: an antenna will be put atop our Patir outpost, and another on your ship. As you move further away their processor will compare the results of each to form an enormous, virtual telescope studying the space nearby. Nothing new, of course," she decides to clarify. "The main difference is the galaxy from where these observations are made."|3934|0
units.english: "You see, this is a very-long-baseline interferometer: an antenna will be put atop our Patir outpost, and another on your ship. As you move further away their processor will compare the results of each to form an enormous, virtual telescope studying the space nearby. Nothing new, of course," she decides to clarify. "The main difference is the galaxy from where these observations are made."
units.italian: "Vedi, questo è un interferometro a base molto lunga: un'antenna sarà posta in cima al nostro avamposto su Patir, e un'altra sulla tua nave. Man mano che ti allontani, il loro processore confronterà i risultati di ciascuna per formare un enorme telescopio virtuale che studia lo spazio vicino. Niente di nuovo, naturalmente," decide di chiarire. "La differenza principale è la galassia da cui vengono fatte queste osservazioni."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 32|	"What you see here is a very-long-baseline interferometer: an antenna will be put atop our Patir outpost, and another on your ship. As you move further away their processors will compare the results to form an enormous, virtual telescope studying the space nearby.|3937|0
units.english: "What you see here is a very-long-baseline interferometer: an antenna will be put atop our Patir outpost, and another on your ship. As you move further away their processors will compare the results to form an enormous, virtual telescope studying the space nearby.
units.italian: "Quello che vedi qui è un interferometro a base molto lunga: un'antenna sarà posta in cima al nostro avamposto su Patir, e un'altra sulla tua nave. Man mano che ti allontani, i loro processori confronteranno i risultati per formare un enorme telescopio virtuale che studia lo spazio vicino.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 32|	"Nothing new, of course," she decides to clarify. "The main difference is the galaxy from where these observations are made. Maybe I will come with you to see it with my own eyes at some point. For now, I am part of the ground crew here, managing its data once Patir is back and we have the first light."|3938|0
units.english: "Nothing new, of course," she decides to clarify. "The main difference is the galaxy from where these observations are made. Maybe I will come with you to see it with my own eyes at some point. For now, I am part of the ground crew here, managing its data once Patir is back and we have the first light."
units.italian: "Niente di nuovo, naturalmente," decide di chiarire. "La differenza principale è la galassia da cui vengono fatte queste osservazioni. Forse un giorno verrò con te a vederlo con i miei occhi. Per ora faccio parte della squadra a terra qui, e gestirò i suoi dati quando Patir sarà tornato e avremo la prima luce."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 32|	"I see."|3941|0
units.english: "I see."
units.italian: "Capisco."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 32|	"What are you hoping to find?"|3943|0
units.english: "What are you hoping to find?"
units.italian: "Che cosa sperate di trovare?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 32|	"Well, every stellar object there is interesting in its own way. My own study is on the largest singularity we have access to, Balnii. We believe it to be a merging of two or more supermassive black holes, but it is something impossible under our laws of physics. Once they reached a distance of one parsec, it would take far, far longer than the age of the universe for them to decay enough to merge.|3944|0
units.english: "Well, every stellar object there is interesting in its own way. My own study is on the largest singularity we have access to, Balnii. We believe it to be a merging of two or more supermassive black holes, but it is something impossible under our laws of physics. Once they reached a distance of one parsec, it would take far, far longer than the age of the universe for them to decay enough to merge.
units.italian: "Beh, ogni oggetto stellare è interessante a modo suo. Il mio studio riguarda la più grande singolarità a cui abbiamo accesso, Balnii. Crediamo sia la fusione di due o più buchi neri supermassicci, ma è qualcosa di impossibile secondo le nostre leggi della fisica. Una volta raggiunta la distanza di un parsec, impiegherebbero molto, molto più dell'età dell'universo per decadere abbastanza da fondersi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 32|	"Now, this is not exactly unique to that region of space. We have had some rare occurrences in our own Milky Way, which in the end were explained by another black hole entering the picture and pushing them together. It is possible this is true for Balnii as well, but we must know more in order to verify it."|3945|0
units.english: "Now, this is not exactly unique to that region of space. We have had some rare occurrences in our own Milky Way, which in the end were explained by another black hole entering the picture and pushing them together. It is possible this is true for Balnii as well, but we must know more in order to verify it."
units.italian: "Ora, questo non è esattamente unico di quella regione di spazio. Abbiamo avuto alcuni rari casi nella nostra Via Lattea, che alla fine si sono spiegati con l'ingresso in scena di un altro buco nero che li ha spinti insieme. È possibile che valga anche per Balnii, ma dobbiamo saperne di più per verificarlo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 32|	Soon enough, she shuts down her terminal and gives the okay to the rest of the team. She stands aside as the spaceport workers close out the payload bay once again, and the crew of ten climbs aboard into their own crew quarters. "You know, <first>," she signs at last, "How is it to stay in Patir when it moves between our galaxies?"|3947|0
units.english: Soon enough, she shuts down her terminal and gives the okay to the rest of the team. She stands aside as the spaceport workers close out the payload bay once again, and the crew of ten climbs aboard into their own crew quarters. "You know, <first>," she signs at last, "How is it to stay in Patir when it moves between our galaxies?"
units.italian: Presto spegne il terminale e dà il via libera al resto della squadra. Resta da parte mentre gli operai dello spazioporto richiudono la stiva, e l'equipaggio di dieci sale nei propri alloggi. "Sai, <first>," accenna infine, "com'è restare a Patir quando si sposta tra le nostre galassie?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 32|	"It makes for a nice light show."|3949|0
units.english: "It makes for a nice light show."
units.italian: "Fa un bel gioco di luci."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 32|	"It is like watching a strange dance, with each star knowing its exact role."|3950|0
units.english: "It is like watching a strange dance, with each star knowing its exact role."
units.italian: "È come guardare una danza strana, in cui ogni stella conosce il suo ruolo esatto."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 32|	"Not too unlike a hyperjump, I guess."|3951|0
units.english: "Not too unlike a hyperjump, I guess."
units.italian: "Non troppo diverso da un salto iperspaziale, immagino."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 32|	"When it happens, you cannot help but stare at it until it is over."|3952|0
units.english: "When it happens, you cannot help but stare at it until it is over."
units.italian: "Quando accade, non puoi fare a meno di fissarlo finché non è finito."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 32|	She smiles. "May the Embers bring you fortune, Captain."|3953|0
units.english: She smiles. "May the Embers bring you fortune, Captain."
units.italian: Sorride. "Che le Braci ti portino fortuna, capitano."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 32|	Once the Swan is ready for departure, you join the rest of the crew and prepare for liftoff. You glance over the cockpit board: as Taely promised, the crystal she gave you has turned into a dim yellow, eerily shining over the controls all around it.|3954|0
units.english: Once the Swan is ready for departure, you join the rest of the crew and prepare for liftoff. You glance over the cockpit board: as Taely promised, the crystal she gave you has turned into a dim yellow, eerily shining over the controls all around it.
units.italian: Quando lo Swan è pronto a partire, ti unisci al resto dell'equipaggio e ti prepari al decollo. Dài un'occhiata al pannello della cabina: come promise Taely, il cristallo che ti ha dato è diventato di un giallo tenue, che brilla inquietante sopra i comandi tutto intorno.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 32|dialog|3960|0
units.english: Your escort, your passengers or your cargo have been left behind in the Milky Way, and the mission is a failure. If you wish to continue Patir content, you may wish to reload.
units.italian: La tua scorta, i tuoi passeggeri o il tuo carico sono stati lasciati indietro nella Via Lattea, e la missione è fallita. Se vuoi continuare i contenuti di Patir, potresti voler ricaricare.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|name|4007|0
units.english: First contact
units.italian: Primo contatto

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|description|4008|0
units.english: Conduct a first contact with the largest asteroid in <system> by landing on its surface exactly on <date>.
units.italian: Conduci un primo contatto con l'asteroide più grande in <system> atterrando sulla sua superficie esattamente il <date>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|Once the Swan has closed out the landing, barely fitting within the makeshift pad next to the Remnant outpost, the Terns start to deploy. You watch them cheerfully separate from their carrier, with some leaping toward an unknown destination in a different direction - evidently, their mission has already begun. The researchers immediately begin unloading the surface payloads from your ship, using the help of the remaining Terns to carry the more massive loads.|4018|0
units.english: Once the Swan has closed out the landing, barely fitting within the makeshift pad next to the Remnant outpost, the Terns start to deploy. You watch them cheerfully separate from their carrier, with some leaping toward an unknown destination in a different direction - evidently, their mission has already begun. The researchers immediately begin unloading the surface payloads from your ship, using the help of the remaining Terns to carry the more massive loads.
units.italian: Una volta che lo Swan ha completato l'atterraggio, entrando a malapena nella piazzola improvvisata accanto all'avamposto dei Remnant, i Tern cominciano a schierarsi. Li guardi staccarsi allegramente dalla nave madre, con alcuni che saltano verso una destinazione sconosciuta in un'altra direzione: evidentemente la loro missione è già iniziata. I ricercatori cominciano subito a scaricare dalla nave i carichi di superficie, con l'aiuto dei Tern rimasti per trasportare i carichi più massicci.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	While the new members of the crew stand at the windows to watch the light show, you sit with Dusk at the table. "We have tested our equipment for the flight on the way here, and most of it worked perfectly. A couple instruments have proven strangely unresponsive, but it is all minor; if they start working again during the trip all the better, but we do not have time to repair, let alone replace them. That is to say," he concludes emphatically, "if you are ready to go, so are we."|4019|0
units.english: While the new members of the crew stand at the windows to watch the light show, you sit with Dusk at the table. "We have tested our equipment for the flight on the way here, and most of it worked perfectly. A couple instruments have proven strangely unresponsive, but it is all minor; if they start working again during the trip all the better, but we do not have time to repair, let alone replace them. That is to say," he concludes emphatically, "if you are ready to go, so are we."
units.italian: Mentre i nuovi membri dell'equipaggio restano ai finestrini a guardare lo spettacolo di luci, tu ti siedi al tavolo con Dusk. "Abbiamo testato la nostra attrezzatura per il volo durante il viaggio, e la maggior parte ha funzionato perfettamente. Un paio di strumenti si sono dimostrati stranamente insensibili, ma è roba da poco; se ricominciano a funzionare durante il viaggio tanto meglio, ma non abbiamo tempo per ripararli, figuriamoci sostituirli. Vale a dire," conclude con enfasi, "che se sei pronto a partire, lo siamo anche noi."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|It takes very little time for the Remnant to locate the target planetoid, standing out like a sore thumb among its species in the empty system. "Alright, <first>. If you feel ready to turn off your cloak, we have a procedure to follow for contacts of this kind."|4032|0
units.english: It takes very little time for the Remnant to locate the target planetoid, standing out like a sore thumb among its species in the empty system. "Alright, <first>. If you feel ready to turn off your cloak, we have a procedure to follow for contacts of this kind."
units.italian: Ai Remnant serve pochissimo tempo per localizzare il planetoide bersaglio, che spicca tra i suoi simili nel sistema vuoto. "Va bene, <first>. Se ti senti pronto a disattivare l'occultamento, abbiamo una procedura da seguire per contatti di questo tipo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"Okay, done."|4034|0
units.english: "Okay, done."
units.italian: "Va bene, fatto."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"My cloak is already off."|4036|0
units.english: "My cloak is already off."
units.italian: "Il mio occultamento è già spento."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"Actually, I do not have a cloak at all."|4037|0
units.english: "Actually, I do not have a cloak at all."
units.italian: "In realtà non ho affatto un occultamento."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"Oh!" He looks surprised. "Sorry, force of habit. We consider it best practice to keep the entire fleet cloaked when possible."|4038|0
units.english: "Oh!" He looks surprised. "Sorry, force of habit. We consider it best practice to keep the entire fleet cloaked when possible."
units.italian: "Oh!" Sembra sorpreso. "Scusa, forza dell'abitudine. Consideriamo una buona pratica tenere occultata l'intera flotta quando possibile."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	Tapping on his own console, he connects to your ship's devices and starts transmitting. Glancing over his screen, you see that he is trying to communicate a preloaded transmission through every frequency they have available, rapidly switching from one program to the next one. The sequence comes to an end, but no reply comes out of the asteroid.|4040|0
units.english: Tapping on his own console, he connects to your ship's devices and starts transmitting. Glancing over his screen, you see that he is trying to communicate a preloaded transmission through every frequency they have available, rapidly switching from one program to the next one. The sequence comes to an end, but no reply comes out of the asteroid.
units.italian: Digitando sulla sua console, si collega ai dispositivi della tua nave e comincia a trasmettere. Dando un'occhiata al suo schermo, vedi che sta cercando di trasmettere un messaggio predefinito su ogni frequenza disponibile, passando rapidamente da un programma al successivo. La sequenza termina, ma dall'asteroide non arriva alcuna risposta.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"<first>, we have another step we can try. It might look a bit crude, but it's worth an attempt." With his eyes locked on a clock atop his console, Dusk starts flicking on and off the lights inside and outside your ship at a precise cadence: 2 seconds, 3 seconds, 5 seconds, 7 seconds, 11 seconds...|4041|0
units.english: "<first>, we have another step we can try. It might look a bit crude, but it's worth an attempt." With his eyes locked on a clock atop his console, Dusk starts flicking on and off the lights inside and outside your ship at a precise cadence: 2 seconds, 3 seconds, 5 seconds, 7 seconds, 11 seconds...
units.italian: "<first>, abbiamo un altro passo che possiamo provare. Potrebbe sembrare un po' grezzo, ma vale un tentativo." Con gli occhi fissi su un orologio in cima alla console, Dusk comincia ad accendere e spegnere le luci dentro e fuori la nave con una cadenza precisa: 2 secondi, 3 secondi, 5 secondi, 7 secondi, 11 secondi...

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	Over the next five minutes, he completes a sequence of every prime number up to 47 with a good accuracy. He waits another minute or so, and then begins again, this time repeating some of the Fibonacci sequence. Yet still, the planetoid does not show any perceivable reaction. "Very well then, Captain. It is time to land on that asteroid."|4042|0
units.english: Over the next five minutes, he completes a sequence of every prime number up to 47 with a good accuracy. He waits another minute or so, and then begins again, this time repeating some of the Fibonacci sequence. Yet still, the planetoid does not show any perceivable reaction. "Very well then, Captain. It is time to land on that asteroid."
units.italian: Nei cinque minuti successivi completa una sequenza di tutti i numeri primi fino a 47 con buona precisione. Aspetta ancora un minuto circa, poi ricomincia, questa volta ripetendo parte della sequenza di Fibonacci. Eppure il planetoide non mostra alcuna reazione percepibile. "Molto bene allora, capitano. È ora di atterrare su quell'asteroide."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|Even from afar, the glow emitted from the asteroid has started to become apparent, tinting the entire cockpit purple. After you turn off your engines in an orbit tens of kilometers above the surface, you move to the living quarters to call the rest of the crew.|4047|0
units.english: Even from afar, the glow emitted from the asteroid has started to become apparent, tinting the entire cockpit purple. After you turn off your engines in an orbit tens of kilometers above the surface, you move to the living quarters to call the rest of the crew.
units.italian: Anche da lontano, il bagliore emesso dall'asteroide ha cominciato a farsi evidente, tingendo di viola l'intera cabina. Dopo aver spento i motori in un'orbita a decine di chilometri dalla superficie, ti sposti negli alloggi per chiamare il resto dell'equipaggio.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	All of them are already up and working, some of them preparing the EVA equipment and others reviewing their data pads. You make a quick gesture toward Dusk, who returns the greeting. "So the time has come, finally. Are you excited?"|4048|0
units.english: All of them are already up and working, some of them preparing the EVA equipment and others reviewing their data pads. You make a quick gesture toward Dusk, who returns the greeting. "So the time has come, finally. Are you excited?"
units.italian: Sono già tutti in piedi e al lavoro, alcuni preparano l'attrezzatura EVA e altri rivedono i loro tablet. Fai un rapido gesto verso Dusk, che ricambia il saluto. "E così è arrivato il momento, finalmente. Sei emozionato?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"Of course."|4050|0
units.english: "Of course."
units.italian: "Certo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"I prefer 'uneasy'."|4052|0
units.english: "I prefer 'uneasy'."
units.italian: "Preferisco 'inquieto'."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"Understandable. No matter how long one has been doing this job, some fear of the unknown is unavoidable; it helps one remain focused on the risk involved, and sometimes it can save your life.|4053|0
units.english: "Understandable. No matter how long one has been doing this job, some fear of the unknown is unavoidable; it helps one remain focused on the risk involved, and sometimes it can save your life.
units.italian: "Comprensibile. Non importa da quanto tempo uno faccia questo lavoro, un po' di paura dell'ignoto è inevitabile; aiuta a restare concentrati sul rischio, e a volte può salvarti la vita.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"We are going to do this in steps: first a close fly-around to decide on a landing site, followed by the landing phase and finally the surface expedition. If, and only if, no showstopper comes up, we will walk over the surface in our suits." Pointing toward the asteroid, he continues. "We have discovered that the object's gravity is unusually high for its size. There must be something very dense beneath all the regolith. For all intents and purposes, walking over its surface should be akin to walking on a large moon."|4055|0
units.english: "We are going to do this in steps: first a close fly-around to decide on a landing site, followed by the landing phase and finally the surface expedition. If, and only if, no showstopper comes up, we will walk over the surface in our suits." Pointing toward the asteroid, he continues. "We have discovered that the object's gravity is unusually high for its size. There must be something very dense beneath all the regolith. For all intents and purposes, walking over its surface should be akin to walking on a large moon."
units.italian: "Lo faremo per gradi: prima un giro ravvicinato per decidere un punto di atterraggio, poi la fase di atterraggio e infine la spedizione di superficie. Se, e solo se, non emerge nulla di bloccante, cammineremo sulla superficie con le nostre tute." Indicando l'asteroide, continua. "Abbiamo scoperto che la gravità dell'oggetto è insolitamente alta per le sue dimensioni. Deve esserci qualcosa di molto denso sotto tutta quella regolite. A tutti gli effetti, camminare sulla sua superficie dovrebbe essere come camminare su una grande luna."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	With a few instruments in his hands, Dusk follows you back to the cockpit to prepare for the flyby. Following a few short burns from the secondary propulsion system you start progressively lowering your orbit: first to ten kilometers, then to one, and finally passing less than two hundred meters over the surface. Next to you, Dusk points toward one of the rings that surround the planetoid. "Try to stay away from those, <first>. I am detecting high levels of beta radiation emanating from them - survivable, but it should be avoided if possible. Based on these readings, the surface seems to be safe at least."|4056|0
units.english: With a few instruments in his hands, Dusk follows you back to the cockpit to prepare for the flyby. Following a few short burns from the secondary propulsion system you start progressively lowering your orbit: first to ten kilometers, then to one, and finally passing less than two hundred meters over the surface. Next to you, Dusk points toward one of the rings that surround the planetoid. "Try to stay away from those, <first>. I am detecting high levels of beta radiation emanating from them - survivable, but it should be avoided if possible. Based on these readings, the surface seems to be safe at least."
units.italian: Con qualche strumento in mano, Dusk ti segue di nuovo in cabina per preparare il sorvolo. Dopo alcune brevi accensioni del sistema di propulsione secondario cominci ad abbassare progressivamente l'orbita: prima a dieci chilometri, poi a uno, e infine passando a meno di duecento metri dalla superficie. Accanto a te, Dusk indica uno degli anelli che circondano il planetoide. "Cerca di starne alla larga, <first>. Rilevo alti livelli di radiazione beta che emanano da essi: sopravvivibile, ma va evitata se possibile. In base a queste letture, la superficie sembra almeno sicura."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	While the terrain is fairly constant in height, the soil is interrupted by thin veins of a striking pink crystal that creates a labyrinth reaching over the whole asteroid. Over the night side, when the pink glow becomes the only source of light, the contrast between the two is harsh enough to force you to look away during the flight.|4057|0
units.english: While the terrain is fairly constant in height, the soil is interrupted by thin veins of a striking pink crystal that creates a labyrinth reaching over the whole asteroid. Over the night side, when the pink glow becomes the only source of light, the contrast between the two is harsh enough to force you to look away during the flight.
units.italian: Mentre il terreno è piuttosto costante in altezza, il suolo è interrotto da sottili vene di uno sgargiante cristallo rosa che creano un labirinto su tutto l'asteroide. Sul lato notturno, quando il bagliore rosa diventa l'unica fonte di luce, il contrasto tra i due è così forte da costringerti a distogliere lo sguardo durante il volo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	As the second loop around the asteroid comes to an end, a tap on your shoulder diverts you from your thoughts. "I believe this should have given us enough data for our purposes. We have passed over a number of acceptable landing sites by now, and the rest of the surface does not seem to have much of interest over the land we have already seen. If you are ready, so are we."|4058|0
units.english: As the second loop around the asteroid comes to an end, a tap on your shoulder diverts you from your thoughts. "I believe this should have given us enough data for our purposes. We have passed over a number of acceptable landing sites by now, and the rest of the surface does not seem to have much of interest over the land we have already seen. If you are ready, so are we."
units.italian: Mentre il secondo giro attorno all'asteroide volge al termine, un tocco sulla spalla ti distoglie dai pensieri. "Credo che questo ci abbia dato dati sufficienti per i nostri scopi. Abbiamo ormai sorvolato diversi punti di atterraggio accettabili, e il resto della superficie non sembra avere molto di interessante oltre al terreno che abbiamo già visto. Se sei pronto, lo siamo anche noi."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"Alright then, give me the coordinates."|4060|0
units.english: "Alright then, give me the coordinates."
units.italian: "Va bene allora, dammi le coordinate."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"I would rather fly over the whole surface before making a choice."|4062|0
units.english: "I would rather fly over the whole surface before making a choice."
units.italian: "Preferirei sorvolare tutta la superficie prima di scegliere."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	Dusk signs in acceptance and returns to his console. As time passes, you notice a few subtle changes in the terrain: in the valleys of the asteroid you see that the pink crystals become of a slightly redder tint, while the tone gets closer to purple in the few peaks you encounter during the flyby. Finally, Dusk informs you that they have selected the ideal landing site based on the new data you have gathered and that they are again ready for the next phase.|4063|0
units.english: Dusk signs in acceptance and returns to his console. As time passes, you notice a few subtle changes in the terrain: in the valleys of the asteroid you see that the pink crystals become of a slightly redder tint, while the tone gets closer to purple in the few peaks you encounter during the flyby. Finally, Dusk informs you that they have selected the ideal landing site based on the new data you have gathered and that they are again ready for the next phase.
units.italian: Dusk accenna in segno di assenso e torna alla sua console. Col passare del tempo noti qualche cambiamento sottile nel terreno: nelle valli dell'asteroide vedi che i cristalli rosa diventano di una tonalità leggermente più rossa, mentre il tono si avvicina al viola nelle poche cime che incontri durante il sorvolo. Alla fine Dusk ti informa che hanno scelto il punto di atterraggio ideale in base ai nuovi dati raccolti e che sono di nuovo pronti per la fase successiva.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	By the time you are halfway to the target coordinates, however, something catches your eye on the night side of the surface. The darkness makes it hard to distinguish anything, but something seems to be moving down there!|4064|0
units.english: By the time you are halfway to the target coordinates, however, something catches your eye on the night side of the surface. The darkness makes it hard to distinguish anything, but something seems to be moving down there!
units.italian: Quando sei a metà strada verso le coordinate bersaglio, però, qualcosa ti cattura l'occhio sul lato notturno della superficie. L'oscurità rende difficile distinguere qualsiasi cosa, ma qualcosa sembra muoversi laggiù!

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	(Continue the descent.)|4066|0
units.english: (Continue the descent.)
units.italian: (Continua la discesa.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	(Abort the landing.)|4068|0
units.english: (Abort the landing.)
units.italian: (Interrompi l'atterraggio.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"I think I saw something below us."|4070|0
units.english: "I think I saw something below us."
units.italian: "Credo di aver visto qualcosa sotto di noi."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	At Dusk's request, you cut the engines and shine the ship's lights toward the terrain under you. You spend a quarter of an hour trying to figure it out, comparing it with the scans taken previously, but nothing you find seems to be out of place. "Perhaps it was just a reflection," Dusk gestures, somewhat apprehensively, "or perhaps it was not. Either way, I doubt we will achieve much continuing to fly in circles. If you are sure of what you saw, returning to orbit would be most reasonable. What do you say?"|4071|0
units.english: At Dusk's request, you cut the engines and shine the ship's lights toward the terrain under you. You spend a quarter of an hour trying to figure it out, comparing it with the scans taken previously, but nothing you find seems to be out of place. "Perhaps it was just a reflection," Dusk gestures, somewhat apprehensively, "or perhaps it was not. Either way, I doubt we will achieve much continuing to fly in circles. If you are sure of what you saw, returning to orbit would be most reasonable. What do you say?"
units.italian: Su richiesta di Dusk, spegni i motori e dirigi le luci della nave verso il terreno sotto di te. Passi un quarto d'ora a cercare di capire, confrontandolo con le scansioni fatte prima, ma nulla di quello che trovi sembra fuori posto. "Forse era solo un riflesso," accenna Dusk, un po' apprensivo, "o forse no. In ogni caso dubito che continuare a volare in cerchio ci porterà lontano. Se sei sicuro di quello che hai visto, tornare in orbita sarebbe la cosa più ragionevole. Che ne dici?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"Let's continue."|4073|0
units.english: "Let's continue."
units.italian: "Continuiamo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"I am sure. Abort the descent."|4075|0
units.english: "I am sure. Abort the descent."
units.italian: "Sono sicuro. Interrompi la discesa."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	You begin your retreat immediately, a short burn from the thrusters pushing you toward an escape trajectory. But only a few seconds later, a large rippling wave passes through the surface in front of you, throwing dust in all directions. A second, third, and then more waves follow, growing in size and intensity. A quick evasive maneuver lets you avoid most of the debris, but the crests continue to grow faster than you can retreat. You make a final attempt to turn the ship around and fly away, but it's too late. The impact is strong enough to throw you to the floor, and now the entire ship is engulfed by the rock stream.|4077|0
units.english: You begin your retreat immediately, a short burn from the thrusters pushing you toward an escape trajectory. But only a few seconds later, a large rippling wave passes through the surface in front of you, throwing dust in all directions. A second, third, and then more waves follow, growing in size and intensity. A quick evasive maneuver lets you avoid most of the debris, but the crests continue to grow faster than you can retreat. You make a final attempt to turn the ship around and fly away, but it's too late. The impact is strong enough to throw you to the floor, and now the entire ship is engulfed by the rock stream.
units.italian: Cominci subito la ritirata, con una breve accensione dei propulsori che ti spinge su una traiettoria di fuga. Ma solo pochi secondi dopo, una grande onda increspata attraversa la superficie davanti a te, sollevando polvere in ogni direzione. Seguono una seconda, una terza e poi altre onde, sempre più grandi e intense. Una rapida manovra evasiva ti permette di evitare la maggior parte dei detriti, ma le creste continuano a crescere più in fretta di quanto tu riesca a ritirarti. Fai un ultimo tentativo di girare la nave e volare via, ma è troppo tardi. L'impatto è abbastanza forte da buttarti a terra, e ora l'intera nave è inghiottita dal flusso di roccia.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	As if under the control of an external force, the regolith cloud wraps around your ship and holds it firmly, exerting an extreme pressure against the hull. Based on the loud creaks coming from the whole vehicle, it will not take long for it to be crushed.|4078|0
units.english: As if under the control of an external force, the regolith cloud wraps around your ship and holds it firmly, exerting an extreme pressure against the hull. Based on the loud creaks coming from the whole vehicle, it will not take long for it to be crushed.
units.italian: Come se fosse sotto il controllo di una forza esterna, la nube di regolite avvolge la nave e la tiene ferma, esercitando una pressione estrema contro lo scafo. Dai forti scricchiolii che arrivano da tutto il veicolo, non ci vorrà molto perché venga schiacciata.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	(Take cover.)|4080|0
units.english: (Take cover.)
units.italian: (Mettiti al riparo.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	(Burn the engines at maximum power to try to break free.)|4082|0
units.english: (Burn the engines at maximum power to try to break free.)
units.italian: (Accendi i motori alla massima potenza per provare a liberarti.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	(Shoot with all your weapons.)|4083|0
units.english: (Shoot with all your weapons.)
units.italian: (Spara con tutte le tue armi.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	Not without great difficulty, you eventually overcome the vibrations enough to stand up and reach the top of the console. Turning up the throttle has no result, however. Within the chaos, you distinguish the words 'engines obstructed' just before another impact throws you back to the floor.|4087|0
units.english: Not without great difficulty, you eventually overcome the vibrations enough to stand up and reach the top of the console. Turning up the throttle has no result, however. Within the chaos, you distinguish the words 'engines obstructed' just before another impact throws you back to the floor.
units.italian: Non senza grande difficoltà, riesci infine a vincere le vibrazioni abbastanza da alzarti e raggiungere la parte alta della console. Aumentare la manetta non dà alcun risultato, però. Nel caos distingui le parole 'motori ostruiti' appena prima che un altro impatto ti ributti a terra.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	Not without great difficulty, you eventually overcome the vibrations enough to stand up and reach the top of the console. All for nothing, however. Within the chaos, you distinguish the words 'weapons disabled' before another impact throws you back to the floor.|4090|0
units.english: Not without great difficulty, you eventually overcome the vibrations enough to stand up and reach the top of the console. All for nothing, however. Within the chaos, you distinguish the words 'weapons disabled' before another impact throws you back to the floor.
units.italian: Non senza grande difficoltà, riesci infine a vincere le vibrazioni abbastanza da alzarti e raggiungere la parte alta della console. Tutto inutile, però. Nel caos distingui le parole 'armi neutralizzate' prima che un altro impatto ti ributti a terra.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	You quickly move under the console, crawling on the floor as fast as you can. Just as you close your helmet shut you hear the sirens: the hull has been breached. And then, a moment later, the vibrations stop in unison.|4092|0
units.english: You quickly move under the console, crawling on the floor as fast as you can. Just as you close your helmet shut you hear the sirens: the hull has been breached. And then, a moment later, the vibrations stop in unison.
units.italian: Ti sposti rapidamente sotto la console, strisciando sul pavimento il più in fretta che puoi. Proprio mentre chiudi il casco senti le sirene: lo scafo è stato perforato. E poi, un attimo dopo, le vibrazioni cessano all'unisono.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	You try to contact the rest of the crew, but the communicator stays silent. Dusk has donned his suit and taken cover on the other side of the cockpit. Between your ship's emergency lights, you notice a shade of red shining over the whole room from above the console. With a quick movement, you make a leap away from your cover and get up to look at the source. A cloud of tiny, incredibly bright red particles is floating in the middle of the cockpit, slowly drifting toward the two of you.|4093|0
units.english: You try to contact the rest of the crew, but the communicator stays silent. Dusk has donned his suit and taken cover on the other side of the cockpit. Between your ship's emergency lights, you notice a shade of red shining over the whole room from above the console. With a quick movement, you make a leap away from your cover and get up to look at the source. A cloud of tiny, incredibly bright red particles is floating in the middle of the cockpit, slowly drifting toward the two of you.
units.italian: Cerchi di contattare il resto dell'equipaggio, ma il comunicatore resta muto. Dusk ha indossato la tuta e si è messo al riparo dall'altra parte della cabina. Tra le luci di emergenza della nave, noti una tonalità di rosso che brilla su tutta la stanza da sopra la console. Con un movimento rapido, balzi fuori dal tuo riparo e ti alzi a guardare la fonte. Una nube di minuscole particelle rosse incredibilmente luminose fluttua al centro della cabina, alla deriva lenta verso di voi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	(Run out of the cockpit.)|4095|0
units.english: (Run out of the cockpit.)
units.italian: (Esci di corsa dalla cabina.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	(Remain still.)|4097|0
units.english: (Remain still.)
units.italian: (Resta immobile.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	(Try using your sidearm.)|4099|0
units.english: (Try using your sidearm.)
units.italian: (Prova a usare l'arma da fianco.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	Without taking your eyes off the dust you reach for your weapon, but to your surprise, your hand cannot find anything in the holster. In the chaos of the attack, it has fallen somewhere below the console, far beyond your grasp. As the cloud keeps moving closer, you find yourself back against the wall, with little options left for you to try.|4100|0
units.english: Without taking your eyes off the dust you reach for your weapon, but to your surprise, your hand cannot find anything in the holster. In the chaos of the attack, it has fallen somewhere below the console, far beyond your grasp. As the cloud keeps moving closer, you find yourself back against the wall, with little options left for you to try.
units.italian: Senza staccare gli occhi dalla polvere, cerchi l'arma, ma con tua sorpresa la mano non trova nulla nella fondina. Nel caos dell'attacco è caduta da qualche parte sotto la console, ben oltre la tua portata. Mentre la nube continua ad avvicinarsi, ti ritrovi con le spalle al muro, con poche opzioni da provare.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	(Run out of the cockpit.)|4102|0
units.english: (Run out of the cockpit.)
units.italian: (Esci di corsa dalla cabina.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	(Remain still.)|4103|0
units.english: (Remain still.)
units.italian: (Resta immobile.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	You rush to the cockpit door, but the handle won't turn; something on the other side must be blocking it. No matter how much force you push with, it remains completely stuck. As the dust gets closer and the red glow stronger behind your back, you make a last attempt at kicking down the door to force it open, to no avail. The door can't be opened.|4106|0
units.english: You rush to the cockpit door, but the handle won't turn; something on the other side must be blocking it. No matter how much force you push with, it remains completely stuck. As the dust gets closer and the red glow stronger behind your back, you make a last attempt at kicking down the door to force it open, to no avail. The door can't be opened.
units.italian: Ti precipiti verso la porta della cabina, ma la maniglia non gira; qualcosa dall'altra parte deve bloccarla. Non importa quanta forza tu applichi, resta completamente bloccata. Mentre la polvere si avvicina e il bagliore rosso si fa più forte alle tue spalle, fai un ultimo tentativo di abbattere la porta a calci per forzarla, invano. La porta non si apre.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	Dusk rushes toward the door, but it refuses to open; something on the other side must be blocking it. The glow emitted by the dust grows in strength as it gets closer to you, eventually forcing you to look away. As Dusk starts trying to kick down the door with little result, the red light is now barely a meter away.|4109|0
units.english: Dusk rushes toward the door, but it refuses to open; something on the other side must be blocking it. The glow emitted by the dust grows in strength as it gets closer to you, eventually forcing you to look away. As Dusk starts trying to kick down the door with little result, the red light is now barely a meter away.
units.italian: Dusk si precipita verso la porta, ma rifiuta di aprirsi; qualcosa dall'altra parte deve bloccarla. Il bagliore emesso dalla polvere cresce d'intensità avvicinandosi a voi, finché vi costringe a distogliere lo sguardo. Mentre Dusk comincia a provare ad abbattere la porta con scarsi risultati, la luce rossa è ormai a malapena un metro.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	The cloud reaches you and Dusk at the same time, clinging to the surface of your suit and forcing you back slightly. You try to brush it off, but you soon discover that it is blocking your joints, leaving you completely locked in place. A thump slams you below your neck as the dust tries to break into your suit; there is nothing you can do to stop it.|4111|0
units.english: The cloud reaches you and Dusk at the same time, clinging to the surface of your suit and forcing you back slightly. You try to brush it off, but you soon discover that it is blocking your joints, leaving you completely locked in place. A thump slams you below your neck as the dust tries to break into your suit; there is nothing you can do to stop it.
units.italian: La nube raggiunge te e Dusk nello stesso momento, attaccandosi alla superficie della tuta e spingendoti leggermente indietro. Cerchi di spazzarla via, ma scopri presto che blocca le articolazioni, lasciandoti completamente bloccato. Un tonfo ti colpisce sotto il collo mentre la polvere cerca di entrare nella tuta; non c'è nulla che tu possa fare per fermarla.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	Three more thumps follow; at the fourth you feel a strong impact hitting your torso, and a shiver spreads all over your body.|4112|0
units.english: Three more thumps follow; at the fourth you feel a strong impact hitting your torso, and a shiver spreads all over your body.
units.italian: Seguono altri tre tonfi; al quarto senti un forte impatto colpirti il busto, e un brivido si diffonde per tutto il corpo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	The suit breach alarm goes off, and everything goes black.|4113|0
units.english: The suit breach alarm goes off, and everything goes black.
units.italian: L'allarme di perforazione della tuta scatta, e tutto diventa nero.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	The chosen site isn't very far, and in a matter of minutes you are hovering around a hundred meters above the target. With the sun shining above your heads, choosing the right spot is very straightforward, though the shadows make gauging your altitude difficult. You land in a flat highland, surrounded by veins of the pink material you have observed earlier. The terrain seems very stable; once Dusk repeats the first contact communication procedure another time, again without reply, you turn off the repulsors.|4117|0
units.english: The chosen site isn't very far, and in a matter of minutes you are hovering around a hundred meters above the target. With the sun shining above your heads, choosing the right spot is very straightforward, though the shadows make gauging your altitude difficult. You land in a flat highland, surrounded by veins of the pink material you have observed earlier. The terrain seems very stable; once Dusk repeats the first contact communication procedure another time, again without reply, you turn off the repulsors.
units.italian: Il punto scelto non è molto lontano, e in pochi minuti sei sospeso a un centinaio di metri dal bersaglio. Con il sole che brilla sopra le vostre teste, scegliere il punto giusto è molto semplice, anche se le ombre rendono difficile valutare l'altitudine. Atterri su un altopiano pianeggiante, circondato dalle vene del materiale rosa che hai osservato prima. Il terreno sembra molto stabile; dopo che Dusk ripete un'altra volta la procedura di comunicazione del primo contatto, ancora senza risposta, spegni i repulsori.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	You accompany him down the aisle while the dust settles down. "A textbook landing, Captain. Especially given the circumstances."|4118|0
units.english: You accompany him down the aisle while the dust settles down. "A textbook landing, Captain. Especially given the circumstances."
units.italian: Lo accompagni lungo il corridoio mentre la polvere si deposita. "Un atterraggio da manuale, capitano. Soprattutto date le circostanze."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"She is a good ship."|4120|0
units.english: "She is a good ship."
units.italian: "È una buona nave."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"I have landed in worse places than this."|4121|0
units.english: "I have landed in worse places than this."
units.italian: "Sono atterrato in posti peggiori di questo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"What now?"|4122|0
units.english: "What now?"
units.italian: "E adesso?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"I bet," he smiles. "I cannot say that I have ever been particularly interested in starships, but the mystique of piloting has always had a certain appeal for me.|4124|0
units.english: "I bet," he smiles. "I cannot say that I have ever been particularly interested in starships, but the mystique of piloting has always had a certain appeal for me.
units.italian: "Ci scommetto," sorride. "Non posso dire di essermi mai interessato particolarmente alle navi spaziali, ma il fascino del pilotaggio ha sempre avuto una certa attrattiva per me.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"If everything goes according to the plan, this phase should be straightforward. We will deploy a surface experiment package under the <ship>, then gather a number of surface samples from this general area that seem interesting, and finally, if we do not find anything else, leave for Patir. The sampling will be nondestructive this time - no drills or perforations - given that we are unsure of what is alive and what is not."|4126|0
units.english: "If everything goes according to the plan, this phase should be straightforward. We will deploy a surface experiment package under the <ship>, then gather a number of surface samples from this general area that seem interesting, and finally, if we do not find anything else, leave for Patir. The sampling will be nondestructive this time - no drills or perforations - given that we are unsure of what is alive and what is not."
units.italian: "Se tutto va secondo i piani, questa fase dovrebbe essere semplice. Schiereremo un pacchetto di esperimenti di superficie sotto la <ship>, poi raccoglieremo una serie di campioni di superficie da questa zona che sembrano interessanti, e infine, se non troviamo altro, partiremo per Patir. Il campionamento questa volta sarà non distruttivo, niente trapani né perforazioni, dato che non siamo sicuri di cosa sia vivo e cosa no."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	Under the direction of the rest of the team, you pick up a few crates and bring them down the ramp. You place your boot on the surface, leaving a recognizable footprint below you, surely the first that anyone has ever left in this place. While you are busy looking down, the others swiftly walk around you, not giving it any attention. You follow them soon after.|4127|0
units.english: Under the direction of the rest of the team, you pick up a few crates and bring them down the ramp. You place your boot on the surface, leaving a recognizable footprint below you, surely the first that anyone has ever left in this place. While you are busy looking down, the others swiftly walk around you, not giving it any attention. You follow them soon after.
units.italian: Sotto la direzione del resto della squadra, prendi qualche cassa e le porti giù per la rampa. Appoggi lo stivale sulla superficie, lasciando sotto di te un'impronta riconoscibile, di certo la prima che qualcuno abbia mai lasciato in questo posto. Mentre sei impegnato a guardare in basso, gli altri ti passano accanto in fretta, senza dedicarle attenzione. Li segui poco dopo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	The experiments amount to a series of obscure surface stations of varying size - not too unlike the ones near the Remnant lab, except pointing down instead of up. Setting them up takes less than half an hour, and after a few more minutes to check the data they are transmitting, you can move on to sample gathering. The surface is made of a very fine sand, but the regolith below is solid and very compact. After picking a few pebbles scattered on the ground and filling a few vials with the dust, you try to break off a piece of a rock, to no avail. While searching for a more brittle rock nearby, however, your eye is caught by an opening in the ground, large enough for a person to pass through. A scarlet light is coming out of it.|4128|0
units.english: The experiments amount to a series of obscure surface stations of varying size - not too unlike the ones near the Remnant lab, except pointing down instead of up. Setting them up takes less than half an hour, and after a few more minutes to check the data they are transmitting, you can move on to sample gathering. The surface is made of a very fine sand, but the regolith below is solid and very compact. After picking a few pebbles scattered on the ground and filling a few vials with the dust, you try to break off a piece of a rock, to no avail. While searching for a more brittle rock nearby, however, your eye is caught by an opening in the ground, large enough for a person to pass through. A scarlet light is coming out of it.
units.italian: Gli esperimenti consistono in una serie di stazioni di superficie oscure di dimensioni varie, non troppo diverse da quelle vicino al laboratorio dei Remnant, tranne che puntate verso il basso invece che verso l'alto. Installarle richiede meno di mezz'ora, e dopo qualche altro minuto per controllare i dati che trasmettono puoi passare alla raccolta dei campioni. La superficie è fatta di sabbia molto fine, ma la regolite sotto è solida e molto compatta. Dopo aver raccolto qualche sassolino sparso a terra e riempito qualche fiala di polvere, provi a staccare un pezzo di roccia, invano. Mentre cerchi una roccia più friabile lì vicino, però, il tuo occhio è catturato da un'apertura nel terreno, abbastanza grande perché una persona ci passi. Da essa esce una luce scarlatta.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	(Show it to the others.)|4130|0
units.english: (Show it to the others.)
units.italian: (Mostrala agli altri.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	(Ignore it.)|4131|0
units.english: (Ignore it.)
units.italian: (Ignorala.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	Although it was well hidden, the entrance is at least two meters wide and the ground quite shallow; walking through it would take little effort. The team is unanimous in its decision to try to explore its interior, and perhaps find the source of said glow.|4133|0
units.english: Although it was well hidden, the entrance is at least two meters wide and the ground quite shallow; walking through it would take little effort. The team is unanimous in its decision to try to explore its interior, and perhaps find the source of said glow.
units.italian: Anche se era ben nascosto, l'ingresso è largo almeno due metri e il terreno è piuttosto superficiale; attraversarlo richiederebbe poca fatica. La squadra è unanime nel decidere di provare a esplorarne l'interno, e magari di trovare la fonte di quel bagliore.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	The floor and walls of the tunnel are scattered by small crystals growing between the rocks, all sharing the same color and shape. "These do not seem to be emitting light," one of the Remnant comments. "Perhaps they are still too young, or are made of another material." The tunnel opens into a small cave, not much wider than the passage you came from. At the opposite end, a heap of loose rocks blocks the way. As the four of you assess the barrier, one of the Remnant finally notices. "The red glow has disappeared!"|4134|0
units.english: The floor and walls of the tunnel are scattered by small crystals growing between the rocks, all sharing the same color and shape. "These do not seem to be emitting light," one of the Remnant comments. "Perhaps they are still too young, or are made of another material." The tunnel opens into a small cave, not much wider than the passage you came from. At the opposite end, a heap of loose rocks blocks the way. As the four of you assess the barrier, one of the Remnant finally notices. "The red glow has disappeared!"
units.italian: Il pavimento e le pareti del tunnel sono sparsi di piccoli cristalli che crescono tra le rocce, tutti dello stesso colore e della stessa forma. "Questi non sembrano emettere luce," commenta uno dei Remnant. "Forse sono ancora troppo giovani, o fatti di un altro materiale." Il tunnel si apre in una piccola caverna, non molto più larga del passaggio da cui venite. All'estremità opposta, un mucchio di rocce sciolte blocca la via. Mentre voi quattro valutate la barriera, uno dei Remnant infine se ne accorge. "Il bagliore rosso è sparito!"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	While the group is trying to mount a sensor on the wall, you take a few steps back with Dusk to try to assess the situation. "I am not comfortable with how things are turning out, <first>. Something is changing, or moving, somewhere down here. We have plenty of consumables still; perhaps we could continue the exploration on the surface. What do you think?"|4135|0
units.english: While the group is trying to mount a sensor on the wall, you take a few steps back with Dusk to try to assess the situation. "I am not comfortable with how things are turning out, <first>. Something is changing, or moving, somewhere down here. We have plenty of consumables still; perhaps we could continue the exploration on the surface. What do you think?"
units.italian: Mentre il gruppo cerca di montare un sensore sulla parete, fai qualche passo indietro con Dusk per valutare la situazione. "Non mi sento a mio agio con come stanno andando le cose, <first>. Qualcosa sta cambiando, o si muove, qui sotto. Abbiamo ancora molti consumabili; forse potremmo continuare l'esplorazione in superficie. Che ne pensi?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"I agree."|4137|0
units.english: "I agree."
units.italian: "Sono d'accordo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"I think it might be more wise to return to the ship and depart."|4139|0
units.english: "I think it might be more wise to return to the ship and depart."
units.italian: "Credo che sarebbe più saggio tornare alla nave e partire."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"We have gone this far already, we might as well get to the end of it."|4141|0
units.english: "We have gone this far already, we might as well get to the end of it."
units.italian: "Siamo arrivati fin qui, tanto vale andare fino in fondo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"Perhaps. But discoveries are meaningless if you do not live long enough to share them."|4142|0
units.english: "Perhaps. But discoveries are meaningless if you do not live long enough to share them."
units.italian: "Forse. Ma le scoperte non hanno senso se non vivi abbastanza a lungo per condividerle."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"Very well then. Once we have packed the samples in here we can move back to the surface."|4145|0
units.english: "Very well then. Once we have packed the samples in here we can move back to the surface."
units.italian: "Molto bene allora. Una volta imballati i campioni qui possiamo tornare in superficie."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	As soon as you turn around, however, it's clear something is wrong. A wall of rock has arose between you and the other Remnant, and your calls receive no reply. Aghast, Dusk rushes to his backpack to use one of his containers as a makeshift hammer against the wall. The first few hits shake it enough to move some dust, but soon after it doesn't appear to have any effect.|4147|0
units.english: As soon as you turn around, however, it's clear something is wrong. A wall of rock has arose between you and the other Remnant, and your calls receive no reply. Aghast, Dusk rushes to his backpack to use one of his containers as a makeshift hammer against the wall. The first few hits shake it enough to move some dust, but soon after it doesn't appear to have any effect.
units.italian: Appena ti volti, però, è chiaro che qualcosa non va. Un muro di roccia si è alzato tra te e gli altri Remnant, e le tue chiamate non ricevono risposta. Sgomento, Dusk si precipita allo zaino per usare uno dei suoi contenitori come martello improvvisato contro il muro. I primi colpi lo scuotono abbastanza da smuovere un po' di polvere, ma subito dopo non sembra avere alcun effetto.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	(Run away to the surface.)|4149|0
units.english: (Run away to the surface.)
units.italian: (Fuggi verso la superficie.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	(Try to help Dusk.)|4151|0
units.english: (Try to help Dusk.)
units.italian: (Prova ad aiutare Dusk.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	You pick up the heaviest tool in your backpack and start trying to make a hole in the wall. You hit, and hit, and hit against the rock with all your strength until the tool breaks apart. The wall, for its part, doesn't seem to be any different from when you started. As you desperately look for another tool to replace it, you hear Dusk's voice calling you in a distressed tone. His boot has been absorbed inside a mass of gray rock of some sort, slowly growing and moving up his suit.|4152|0
units.english: You pick up the heaviest tool in your backpack and start trying to make a hole in the wall. You hit, and hit, and hit against the rock with all your strength until the tool breaks apart. The wall, for its part, doesn't seem to be any different from when you started. As you desperately look for another tool to replace it, you hear Dusk's voice calling you in a distressed tone. His boot has been absorbed inside a mass of gray rock of some sort, slowly growing and moving up his suit.
units.italian: Prendi l'attrezzo più pesante dallo zaino e cominci a cercare di fare un buco nel muro. Colpisci, colpisci e colpisci la roccia con tutte le tue forze finché l'attrezzo si spezza. Il muro, da parte sua, non sembra diverso da quando hai iniziato. Mentre cerchi disperatamente un altro attrezzo con cui sostituirlo, senti la voce di Dusk che ti chiama con tono angosciato. Il suo stivale è stato assorbito dentro una massa di una specie di roccia grigia, che cresce lentamente e risale lungo la tuta.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	You start running back towards the tunnel you came from as fast as you can. After not even fifty meters, however, you meet another wall blocking your way, right where you had passed earlier. You try your best to make a hole in the barricade with the tools in your backpack, and eventually with your sidearm. But nothing works. A scream of help coming from the cave leads you to abandon your efforts and return to Dusk. When you find him, his boot has been absorbed inside a mass of gray rock of some sort, slowly growing and moving up his suit.|4155|0
units.english: You start running back towards the tunnel you came from as fast as you can. After not even fifty meters, however, you meet another wall blocking your way, right where you had passed earlier. You try your best to make a hole in the barricade with the tools in your backpack, and eventually with your sidearm. But nothing works. A scream of help coming from the cave leads you to abandon your efforts and return to Dusk. When you find him, his boot has been absorbed inside a mass of gray rock of some sort, slowly growing and moving up his suit.
units.italian: Cominci a correre indietro verso il tunnel da cui siete venuti il più in fretta possibile. Dopo nemmeno cinquanta metri, però, incontri un altro muro che blocca la via, proprio dove eri passato prima. Fai del tuo meglio per aprire un buco nella barricata con gli attrezzi nello zaino, e alla fine con l'arma da fianco. Ma niente funziona. Un grido d'aiuto dalla caverna ti porta ad abbandonare i tuoi sforzi e a tornare da Dusk. Quando lo trovi, il suo stivale è stato assorbito dentro una massa di una specie di roccia grigia, che cresce lentamente e risale lungo la tuta.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	You try with all your strength to bring him out of it, but its grip is too tight. The stone quickly reaches the torso, and then the arms. You watch helpless as his whole body gets absorbed by the newly formed wall. You are now stuck in a hole barely larger than you are.|4157|0
units.english: You try with all your strength to bring him out of it, but its grip is too tight. The stone quickly reaches the torso, and then the arms. You watch helpless as his whole body gets absorbed by the newly formed wall. You are now stuck in a hole barely larger than you are.
units.italian: Provi con tutte le tue forze a tirarlo fuori, ma la presa è troppo stretta. La pietra raggiunge rapidamente il busto, e poi le braccia. Guardi impotente mentre tutto il suo corpo viene assorbito dal muro appena formato. Ora sei bloccato in un buco a malapena più grande di te.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	It doesn't take long for the rock to start growing on you as well. You try your best to calm down and slow your oxygen consumption as your helmet, torso and legs get covered in stone. Creaks and vibrations start spreading along the suit; it is pushing, and you know it will not take long for it to burst.|4158|0
units.english: It doesn't take long for the rock to start growing on you as well. You try your best to calm down and slow your oxygen consumption as your helmet, torso and legs get covered in stone. Creaks and vibrations start spreading along the suit; it is pushing, and you know it will not take long for it to burst.
units.italian: Non ci vuole molto perché la roccia cominci a crescere anche su di te. Cerchi di calmarti e di rallentare il consumo di ossigeno mentre il casco, il busto e le gambe vengono coperti di pietra. Scricchiolii e vibrazioni cominciano a diffondersi lungo la tuta; sta spingendo, e sai che non ci vorrà molto perché si squarci.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	Minutes pass with the suit on the point of breaking, unable to do anything except to wait for the inevitable. Finally, you feel a strong impact hitting your torso, and a shiver spreads all over your body.|4159|0
units.english: Minutes pass with the suit on the point of breaking, unable to do anything except to wait for the inevitable. Finally, you feel a strong impact hitting your torso, and a shiver spreads all over your body.
units.italian: Passano i minuti con la tuta sul punto di cedere, incapace di fare altro che aspettare l'inevitabile. Alla fine senti un forte impatto colpirti il busto, e un brivido si diffonde per tutto il corpo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	The suit breach alarm goes off, and everything goes black.|4160|0
units.english: The suit breach alarm goes off, and everything goes black.
units.italian: L'allarme di perforazione della tuta scatta, e tutto diventa nero.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	The sample gathering continues for more than an hour, spanning from the base of the <ship> to the deposits of crystals surrounding the landing zone. With the backpack packed full of rocks and minerals of all sizes, you join the rest of group at the top of a small cliff.|4164|0
units.english: The sample gathering continues for more than an hour, spanning from the base of the <ship> to the deposits of crystals surrounding the landing zone. With the backpack packed full of rocks and minerals of all sizes, you join the rest of group at the top of a small cliff.
