units.italian: La raccolta di campioni continua per più di un'ora, dalla base della <ship> ai depositi di cristalli che circondano la zona di atterraggio. Con lo zaino pieno di rocce e minerali di ogni dimensione, ti unisci al resto del gruppo in cima a una piccola scogliera.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"We have hours of life support still available, and none of the activities up to this point were very tiring. We were discussing about emptying our bags in the cargo bay and move a bit further out next with the remaining tools. What do you think?"|4165|0
units.english: "We have hours of life support still available, and none of the activities up to this point were very tiring. We were discussing about emptying our bags in the cargo bay and move a bit further out next with the remaining tools. What do you think?"
units.italian: "Abbiamo ancora ore di supporto vitale disponibile, e nessuna delle attività fatte finora è stata molto stancante. Stavamo discutendo di svuotare le borse nella stiva e spostarci un po' più in là con gli attrezzi rimasti. Che ne pensi?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"Alright."|4167|0
units.english: "Alright."
units.italian: "Va bene."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"We have spent enough time in this place. We should leave."|4168|0
units.english: "We have spent enough time in this place. We should leave."
units.italian: "Abbiamo passato abbastanza tempo in questo posto. Dovremmo andarcene."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	(Tell them about the tunnel.)|4169|0
units.english: (Tell them about the tunnel.)
units.italian: (Parla loro del tunnel.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	Suddenly, the terrain starts to shake violently beneath your feet. The quake is strong enough to throw all of you to the ground, and cracks begin showing up all around you. Soon, the surface starts to crumble under your feet, and you fall into the darkness.|4170|0
units.english: Suddenly, the terrain starts to shake violently beneath your feet. The quake is strong enough to throw all of you to the ground, and cracks begin showing up all around you. Soon, the surface starts to crumble under your feet, and you fall into the darkness.
units.italian: All'improvviso il terreno comincia a tremare violentemente sotto i tuoi piedi. Il terremoto è abbastanza forte da buttare tutti a terra, e cominciano ad aprirsi crepe tutto intorno. Presto la superficie comincia a sgretolarsi sotto i piedi, e cadi nel buio.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	You end up into an unknown cave, quite thin but at least twenty meters long. The natural light of the asteroid here is too low to see; you light up your suit's flashlights, and the others do the same. Around you, vast veins of tiny crystals cover most of the cave, similar in appearance to the ones on the surface.|4171|0
units.english: You end up into an unknown cave, quite thin but at least twenty meters long. The natural light of the asteroid here is too low to see; you light up your suit's flashlights, and the others do the same. Around you, vast veins of tiny crystals cover most of the cave, similar in appearance to the ones on the surface.
units.italian: Finisci in una caverna sconosciuta, piuttosto stretta ma lunga almeno venti metri. La luce naturale dell'asteroide qui è troppo debole per vedere; accendi le torce della tuta, e gli altri fanno lo stesso. Attorno a te, vaste vene di minuscoli cristalli coprono gran parte della caverna, simili nell'aspetto a quelli in superficie.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"Is everyone alright?" Dusk asks, and you reply with a cautious nod. Despite the chaos, none of you seem to have been hurt much, certainly thanks to the reduced gravity. The walls around you are very steep, but perhaps bumpy enough to be climbed on.|4172|0
units.english: "Is everyone alright?" Dusk asks, and you reply with a cautious nod. Despite the chaos, none of you seem to have been hurt much, certainly thanks to the reduced gravity. The walls around you are very steep, but perhaps bumpy enough to be climbed on.
units.italian: "State tutti bene?" chiede Dusk, e tu rispondi con un cenno cauto. Nonostante il caos, nessuno di voi sembra essersi fatto molto male, di certo grazie alla gravità ridotta. Le pareti attorno a voi sono molto ripide, ma forse abbastanza irregolari per essere scalate.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"What do we do now?"|4174|0
units.english: "What do we do now?"
units.italian: "Che cosa facciamo adesso?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	(Try to climb back to the surface.)|4176|0
units.english: (Try to climb back to the surface.)
units.italian: (Prova a risalire in superficie.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	You can't even make it a couple meters up before the regolith crumbles under your hands, throwing you back to the ground. Before you can try to do it again, Dusk gestures you to wait. "We have a better way to handle scenarios like this."|4177|0
units.english: You can't even make it a couple meters up before the regolith crumbles under your hands, throwing you back to the ground. Before you can try to do it again, Dusk gestures you to wait. "We have a better way to handle scenarios like this."
units.italian: Non riesci nemmeno a salire un paio di metri prima che la regolite ceda sotto le tue mani, ributtandoti a terra. Prima che tu possa riprovare, Dusk ti fa cenno di aspettare. "Abbiamo un modo migliore per gestire scenari come questo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	"We have some contingencies for scenarios like this one," he replies, unable to completely hide some apprehension in his gestures.|4180|0
units.english: "We have some contingencies for scenarios like this one," he replies, unable to completely hide some apprehension in his gestures.
units.italian: "Abbiamo alcune contromisure per scenari come questo," risponde, incapace di nascondere del tutto una certa apprensione nei suoi gesti.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	He takes out a rope from his backpack, with a mechanical hook attached on one end. After shooting it over the edge he shows you briefly how to use it, and gestures you to follow him. The climb is very slow, as you are careful not to damage your suit further against the walls of the cave. Suddenly, you feel a strong vibration coming from above. The hole is closing!|4182|0
units.english: He takes out a rope from his backpack, with a mechanical hook attached on one end. After shooting it over the edge he shows you briefly how to use it, and gestures you to follow him. The climb is very slow, as you are careful not to damage your suit further against the walls of the cave. Suddenly, you feel a strong vibration coming from above. The hole is closing!
units.italian: Tira fuori dallo zaino una corda, con un gancio meccanico fissato a un'estremità. Dopo averlo lanciato oltre il bordo ti mostra brevemente come si usa, e ti fa cenno di seguirlo. La salita è molto lenta, perché state attenti a non danneggiare ulteriormente le tute contro le pareti della caverna. All'improvviso senti una forte vibrazione provenire dall'alto. Il foro si sta chiudendo!

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	The rope snaps, throwing you back to the ground and breaking your helmet's lamps. You try to stand up, but you feel something holding your leg; the complete darkness prevents you from seeing, but it feels like a rocky material. You try to call the other Remnant, but there is no reply. You aren't sure whether the radio broke as well, or if something worse happened.|4183|0
units.english: The rope snaps, throwing you back to the ground and breaking your helmet's lamps. You try to stand up, but you feel something holding your leg; the complete darkness prevents you from seeing, but it feels like a rocky material. You try to call the other Remnant, but there is no reply. You aren't sure whether the radio broke as well, or if something worse happened.
units.italian: La corda si spezza, ributtandoti a terra e rompendo le lampade del casco. Cerchi di alzarti, ma senti qualcosa che ti tiene la gamba; il buio completo ti impedisce di vedere, ma sembra un materiale roccioso. Cerchi di chiamare gli altri Remnant, ma non c'è risposta. Non sei sicuro se si sia rotta anche la radio, o se sia successo qualcosa di peggio.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	(Try to make a breach in the rock growth.)|4185|0
units.english: (Try to make a breach in the rock growth.)
units.italian: (Prova ad aprire una breccia nella crescita di roccia.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	(Stand still and save your oxygen.)|4186|0
units.english: (Stand still and save your oxygen.)
units.italian: (Resta fermo e risparmia l'ossigeno.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	You try your best to free your leg using the tools in your backpack, with little result. Left with no other options, you even take out your sidearm and fire into the dark all the shots you can. But nothing works.|4188|0
units.english: You try your best to free your leg using the tools in your backpack, with little result. Left with no other options, you even take out your sidearm and fire into the dark all the shots you can. But nothing works.
units.italian: Fai del tuo meglio per liberare la gamba con gli attrezzi dello zaino, con scarsi risultati. Senza altre opzioni, tiri fuori persino l'arma da fianco e spari nel buio tutti i colpi che puoi. Ma niente funziona.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	The mass on your leg grows, wrapping more and more of your suit. You try your best to calm down and slow your oxygen consumption as your helmet, torso and legs get covered. Creaks and vibrations start spreading along the suit; you know it will not take long for it to burst.|4190|0
units.english: The mass on your leg grows, wrapping more and more of your suit. You try your best to calm down and slow your oxygen consumption as your helmet, torso and legs get covered. Creaks and vibrations start spreading along the suit; you know it will not take long for it to burst.
units.italian: La massa sulla gamba cresce, avvolgendo sempre più la tuta. Cerchi di calmarti e di rallentare il consumo di ossigeno mentre il casco, il busto e le gambe vengono coperti. Scricchiolii e vibrazioni cominciano a diffondersi lungo la tuta; sai che non ci vorrà molto perché si squarci.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	Minutes pass with the suit on the point of breaking, and you are unable to do anything except to wait for the inevitable. Finally, you feel a strong impact hitting your torso, and a shiver spreads all over your body.|4191|0
units.english: Minutes pass with the suit on the point of breaking, and you are unable to do anything except to wait for the inevitable. Finally, you feel a strong impact hitting your torso, and a shiver spreads all over your body.
units.italian: Passano i minuti con la tuta sul punto di cedere, e non puoi fare altro che aspettare l'inevitabile. Alla fine senti un forte impatto colpirti il busto, e un brivido si diffonde per tutto il corpo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 33|	The suit breach alarm goes off, and everything goes black.|4192|0
units.english: The suit breach alarm goes off, and everything goes black.
units.italian: L'allarme di perforazione della tuta scatta, e tutto diventa nero.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|name|4197|0
units.english: Bad contact
units.italian: Contatto sbagliato

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|description|4198|0
units.english: Return to <system> with the Remnant team exactly on <date>.
units.italian: Torna su <system> con la squadra Remnant esattamente il <date>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|You wake up lying on the floor with a blinking light pointed in your eyes. Trying to cover it with your hand, the Remnant above you gestures to stay quiet. As he helps you stand up, you realize you are inside the payload bay of your own ship - around you is the rest of the crew, and standing in a circle in their undersuit garments. You try to take a step, but you almost fall, realizing then that your spacesuit is too ruined to use. You tiredly take it off.|4208|0
units.english: You wake up lying on the floor with a blinking light pointed in your eyes. Trying to cover it with your hand, the Remnant above you gestures to stay quiet. As he helps you stand up, you realize you are inside the payload bay of your own ship - around you is the rest of the crew, and standing in a circle in their undersuit garments. You try to take a step, but you almost fall, realizing then that your spacesuit is too ruined to use. You tiredly take it off.
units.italian: Ti svegli sdraiato sul pavimento con una luce lampeggiante puntata negli occhi. Cercando di coprirla con la mano, il Remnant sopra di te ti fa cenno di stare zitto. Mentre ti aiuta ad alzarti, ti rendi conto di essere nella stiva della tua nave: attorno a te c'è il resto dell'equipaggio, in cerchio con la tuta interna. Provi a fare un passo, ma quasi cadi, capendo allora che la tua tuta spaziale è troppo rovinata per essere usata. Te la togli, stanco.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	"We have all woken up here," Dusk signs in the complete silence. His sleeves are slightly lacerated, and atop his shoulders you notice his own symbiont peeking through. "There was a meter-sized breach in the hull, but we have patched it up just now. Going by our clocks, we have been unconscious for no more than 20 minutes." He points his hand toward the open hatch that separates the cargo bay from the rest of the ship. "None of us has ventured beyond that door yet. Presuming our scanners are correct, there is still a presence inside this ship."|4209|0
units.english: "We have all woken up here," Dusk signs in the complete silence. His sleeves are slightly lacerated, and atop his shoulders you notice his own symbiont peeking through. "There was a meter-sized breach in the hull, but we have patched it up just now. Going by our clocks, we have been unconscious for no more than 20 minutes." He points his hand toward the open hatch that separates the cargo bay from the rest of the ship. "None of us has ventured beyond that door yet. Presuming our scanners are correct, there is still a presence inside this ship."
units.italian: "Ci siamo svegliati tutti qui," accenna Dusk nel silenzio completo. Le sue maniche sono leggermente lacerate, e sulle spalle noti che il suo simbionte fa capolino. "C'era una breccia grande un metro nello scafo, ma l'abbiamo appena riparata. A giudicare dai nostri orologi, siamo stati privi di sensi per non più di 20 minuti." Indica con la mano il portello aperto che separa la stiva dal resto della nave. "Nessuno di noi si è ancora avventurato oltre quella porta. Se i nostri scanner sono corretti, c'è ancora una presenza dentro questa nave."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	"Is the rest of the ship pressurized?"|4211|0
units.english: "Is the rest of the ship pressurized?"
units.italian: "Il resto della nave è pressurizzato?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	"Why are we alive?"|4213|0
units.english: "Why are we alive?"
units.italian: "Perché siamo vivi?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	"I am going."|4214|0
units.english: "I am going."
units.italian: "Vado io."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	"Reasonably, because it chose to keep us alive. But to be honest, I have no intention to speculate on the reasons for this, until we are back somewhere safer - and that requires getting you back to the cockpit to fly us out of here." You sign in agreement. "If you are feeling okay, we are ready."|4216|0
units.english: "Reasonably, because it chose to keep us alive. But to be honest, I have no intention to speculate on the reasons for this, until we are back somewhere safer - and that requires getting you back to the cockpit to fly us out of here." You sign in agreement. "If you are feeling okay, we are ready."
units.italian: "Ragionevolmente, perché ha scelto di lasciarci vivi. Ma a essere onesti, non ho intenzione di fare supposizioni sui motivi finché non saremo in un posto più sicuro, e per questo devi tornare in cabina e portarci fuori di qui." Accenni in segno d'accordo. "Se ti senti bene, siamo pronti."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	"As far as we can tell, yes, this was the only breach. I have taken some respirators with us in case of emergency, given the state of our suits. If you are feeling okay, we are ready."|4219|0
units.english: "As far as we can tell, yes, this was the only breach. I have taken some respirators with us in case of emergency, given the state of our suits. If you are feeling okay, we are ready."
units.italian: "Per quanto possiamo dire, sì, era l'unica breccia. Ho portato qualche respiratore con noi in caso di emergenza, visto lo stato delle nostre tute. Se ti senti bene, siamo pronti."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	Before you enter the hatch, you make sure you grab your pistol from the remains of your spacesuit. You take the lead into the empty anteroom and then inside a corridor, gesturing with the other Remnant to coordinate your movements. Room after room, everything looks the same as you left it, and eventually you clear every part of the <ship> but the cockpit. An ominous red light now shines through the gap below the door, and you hear a continuous clicking sound. With your sidearm raised, you push the door open as slowly as you can.|4221|0
units.english: Before you enter the hatch, you make sure you grab your pistol from the remains of your spacesuit. You take the lead into the empty anteroom and then inside a corridor, gesturing with the other Remnant to coordinate your movements. Room after room, everything looks the same as you left it, and eventually you clear every part of the <ship> but the cockpit. An ominous red light now shines through the gap below the door, and you hear a continuous clicking sound. With your sidearm raised, you push the door open as slowly as you can.
units.italian: Prima di entrare nel portello, ti assicuri di prendere la pistola dai resti della tuta spaziale. Guidi il gruppo nell'anticamera vuota e poi in un corridoio, accennando con gli altri Remnant per coordinare i movimenti. Stanza dopo stanza, tutto sembra come l'hai lasciato, e alla fine ripulite ogni parte della <ship> tranne la cabina. Una luce rossa sinistra brilla ora attraverso la fessura sotto la porta, e senti un suono continuo di clic. Con l'arma da fianco alzata, spingi la porta aperta il più lentamente possibile.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	A bright red light is floating still in the middle of the room. In front of it, a whirlwind of dust is throwing itself over and over on the cockpit controls, pressing every button and flipping every switch. Dusk gestures you to wait, while the red light continues its activities unfazed.|4222|0
units.english: A bright red light is floating still in the middle of the room. In front of it, a whirlwind of dust is throwing itself over and over on the cockpit controls, pressing every button and flipping every switch. Dusk gestures you to wait, while the red light continues its activities unfazed.
units.italian: Una luce rossa intensa fluttua immobile al centro della stanza. Davanti a essa, un turbine di polvere si getta più e più volte sui comandi della cabina, premendo ogni pulsante e azionando ogni interruttore. Dusk ti fa cenno di aspettare, mentre la luce rossa continua le sue attività imperturbata.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	(Stand still.)|4224|0
units.english: (Stand still.)
units.italian: (Resta fermo.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	(Shoot up to catch its attention.)|4226|0
units.english: (Shoot up to catch its attention.)
units.italian: (Spara in alto per attirare la sua attenzione.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	(Shoot toward the red light.)|4227|0
units.english: (Shoot toward the red light.)
units.italian: (Spara verso la luce rossa.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	(Run toward the controls and push the engines to maximum power.)|4228|0
units.english: (Run toward the controls and push the engines to maximum power.)
units.italian: (Corri verso i comandi e porta i motori alla massima potenza.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	You fire three shots and wait for a reaction, but the living dust does not change its pace.|4230|0
units.english: You fire three shots and wait for a reaction, but the living dust does not change its pace.
units.italian: Sparo tre colpi e aspetti una reazione, ma la polvere viva non cambia ritmo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	Around the console, the sand is continuously opening and closing shelves, drawers and everything that moves, as if trying to do something it does not understand. Dusk comes closer to the red light, carefully moving around the edges of the room. But for a while, neither of you do anything.|4232|0
units.english: Around the console, the sand is continuously opening and closing shelves, drawers and everything that moves, as if trying to do something it does not understand. Dusk comes closer to the red light, carefully moving around the edges of the room. But for a while, neither of you do anything.
units.italian: Attorno alla console, la sabbia apre e chiude continuamente ripiani, cassetti e tutto ciò che si muove, come se cercasse di fare qualcosa che non capisce. Dusk si avvicina alla luce rossa, muovendosi con cautela lungo i bordi della stanza. Ma per un po' nessuno dei due fa nulla.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	Eventually, he stands up and carefully walks to the console. He puts his hand over the controls, and the rocks carefully move around it. He flicks three switches: the propellant flow, the engine start, and the autopilot. The engines roar to life, and the dust stops mid-air.|4233|0
units.english: Eventually, he stands up and carefully walks to the console. He puts his hand over the controls, and the rocks carefully move around it. He flicks three switches: the propellant flow, the engine start, and the autopilot. The engines roar to life, and the dust stops mid-air.
units.italian: Alla fine si alza e cammina con cautela verso la console. Mette la mano sopra i comandi, e le rocce si spostano con cura attorno a essa. Aziona tre interruttori: il flusso di propellente, l'avvio dei motori e il pilota automatico. I motori ruggiscono, e la polvere si ferma a mezz'aria.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	You put away your sidearm and make a leap toward the console. Before the rocks can react, you have already flicked three switches: the propellant flow, the engine start, and the autopilot. The engines roar to life, and the dust stops mid-air.|4236|0
units.english: You put away your sidearm and make a leap toward the console. Before the rocks can react, you have already flicked three switches: the propellant flow, the engine start, and the autopilot. The engines roar to life, and the dust stops mid-air.
units.italian: Rimetti via l'arma da fianco e balzi verso la console. Prima che le rocce possano reagire, hai già azionato tre interruttori: il flusso di propellente, l'avvio dei motori e il pilota automatico. I motori ruggiscono, e la polvere si ferma a mezz'aria.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	The rocks slowly retract into a ball in the middle of the room, surrounding the red light completely. You watch the mass grow, and the hue turns into a pink tint by the time it is done. The minuscule asteroid stands still in the middle of the room, and you cannot help but stare at it.|4238|0
units.english: The rocks slowly retract into a ball in the middle of the room, surrounding the red light completely. You watch the mass grow, and the hue turns into a pink tint by the time it is done. The minuscule asteroid stands still in the middle of the room, and you cannot help but stare at it.
units.italian: Le rocce si ritirano lentamente in una palla al centro della stanza, circondando del tutto la luce rossa. Guardi la massa crescere, e la tonalità diventa rosa quando ha finito. Il minuscolo asteroide resta immobile al centro della stanza, e non puoi fare a meno di fissarlo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	(Wait and see.)|4240|0
units.english: (Wait and see.)
units.italian: (Aspetta e vedi.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	(Sit in the pilot's seat and fly away.)|4241|0
units.english: (Sit in the pilot's seat and fly away.)
units.italian: (Siediti al posto di pilotaggio e vola via.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	(Show it my hand, like in that video I saw once.)|4242|0
units.english: (Show it my hand, like in that video I saw once.)
units.italian: (Mostragli la mia mano, come in quel video che ho visto una volta.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	In an instant, the asteroid sprints out of the room. You follow it on your console: it breaches through an emergency vent to launch out of your ship, and automated systems seal it off immediately. With the engines still firing, you take back control of your ship and leave the sphere of influence of the planetoid...|4243|0
units.english: In an instant, the asteroid sprints out of the room. You follow it on your console: it breaches through an emergency vent to launch out of your ship, and automated systems seal it off immediately. With the engines still firing, you take back control of your ship and leave the sphere of influence of the planetoid...
units.italian: In un istante, l'asteroide schizza fuori dalla stanza. Lo segui sulla console: sfonda una valvola di emergenza per lanciarsi fuori dalla nave, e i sistemi automatici la sigillano subito. Con i motori ancora accesi, riprendi il controllo della nave e lasci la sfera di influenza del planetoide...

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|Although the days of travel gave you plenty of time to think about what happened, you can't help but feel some whiplash at the scene waiting for you in Patir. The Terns are cheerfully flying around the system, each carrying a slightly different instrument on their belly. On the surface of the asteroid, a few Remnant are busy swapping the payloads of one with another set of experiments.|4249|0
units.english: Although the days of travel gave you plenty of time to think about what happened, you can't help but feel some whiplash at the scene waiting for you in Patir. The Terns are cheerfully flying around the system, each carrying a slightly different instrument on their belly. On the surface of the asteroid, a few Remnant are busy swapping the payloads of one with another set of experiments.
units.italian: Anche se i giorni di viaggio ti hanno dato molto tempo per pensare a quello che è successo, non puoi fare a meno di sentirti frastornato dalla scena che ti aspetta a Patir. I Tern volano allegramente attorno al sistema, ognuno con uno strumento leggermente diverso sulla pancia. Sulla superficie dell'asteroide, alcuni Remnant sono impegnati a scambiare il carico di uno con un altro set di esperimenti.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	You use your ship's communicator to warn the ground team that your spacesuits have been damaged, and join the Remnant in the crew quarters to wait for them to bring new ones. "We want to leave some for you as well, <first>. We have plenty of spares in the outpost," Dusk reassures you.|4250|0
units.english: You use your ship's communicator to warn the ground team that your spacesuits have been damaged, and join the Remnant in the crew quarters to wait for them to bring new ones. "We want to leave some for you as well, <first>. We have plenty of spares in the outpost," Dusk reassures you.
units.italian: Usi il comunicatore della nave per avvisare la squadra a terra che le vostre tute spaziali sono danneggiate, e ti unisci ai Remnant negli alloggi ad aspettare che ne portino di nuove. "Vogliamo lasciarne alcune anche per te, <first>. Abbiamo molti ricambi nell'avamposto," ti rassicura Dusk.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	"I cannot make sense of what happened."|4252|0
units.english: "I cannot make sense of what happened."
units.italian: "Non riesco a dare un senso a quello che è successo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	"How long will it be until Patir moves?"|4254|0
units.english: "How long will it be until Patir moves?"
units.italian: "Quanto manca perché Patir si sposti?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	"What was the point of all that?"|4255|0
units.english: "What was the point of all that?"
units.italian: "Qual era il senso di tutto questo?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	He glances at the clock. "A couple hours. We must have been very efficient this time." His half smile fades away almost instantly, and silence falls again over the room. At last, one of the Remnant speaks up. "I have a theory on what that creature was trying to say.|4257|0
units.english: He glances at the clock. "A couple hours. We must have been very efficient this time." His half smile fades away almost instantly, and silence falls again over the room. At last, one of the Remnant speaks up. "I have a theory on what that creature was trying to say.
units.italian: Dà un'occhiata all'orologio. "Un paio d'ore. Questa volta dobbiamo essere stati molto efficienti." Il suo mezzo sorriso svanisce quasi subito, e il silenzio cala di nuovo sulla stanza. Alla fine uno dei Remnant prende la parola. "Ho una teoria su cosa quella creatura cercasse di dire.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	"To me, the only thing that makes sense is that it wanted to keep us away," states the Remnant furthest away from you. "To scare us, or to threaten us, but with the final objective of making us leave as quickly as possible."|4259|0
units.english: "To me, the only thing that makes sense is that it wanted to keep us away," states the Remnant furthest away from you. "To scare us, or to threaten us, but with the final objective of making us leave as quickly as possible."
units.italian: "A me l'unica cosa che ha senso è che volesse tenerci lontani," afferma il Remnant più lontano da te. "Spaventarci, o minacciarci, ma con l'obiettivo finale di farci andare via il più in fretta possibile."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	"We saw it trying to start the <ship>," intervenes Dusk, "and it left once we did it in its place, without bothering us further. Certainly, it looked dexterous enough to create something like Chanai. But why have such a disproportionate reaction to our approach?"|4260|0
units.english: "We saw it trying to start the <ship>," intervenes Dusk, "and it left once we did it in its place, without bothering us further. Certainly, it looked dexterous enough to create something like Chanai. But why have such a disproportionate reaction to our approach?"
units.italian: "L'abbiamo vista cercare di avviare la <ship>," interviene Dusk, "e se n'è andata quando l'abbiamo fatto noi al suo posto, senza darci altri fastidi. Di certo sembrava abbastanza abile da creare qualcosa come Chanai. Ma perché una reazione così sproporzionata al nostro avvicinamento?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	"Maybe it behaves like a territorial animal."|4262|0
units.english: "Maybe it behaves like a territorial animal."
units.italian: "Forse si comporta come un animale territoriale."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	"It might seem a disproportionate reaction to something of that size."|4264|0
units.english: "It might seem a disproportionate reaction to something of that size."
units.italian: "Potrebbe sembrare una reazione sproporzionata a qualcosa di quella dimensione."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	"Perhaps we were simply bothering it."|4266|0
units.english: "Perhaps we were simply bothering it."
units.italian: "Forse la stavamo semplicemente infastidendo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	"I feel like the why's matter little in a situation like this."|4268|0
units.english: "I feel like the why's matter little in a situation like this."
units.italian: "Mi sembra che i perché contino poco in una situazione del genere."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	"I cannot agree, <first>. Much of the point of scientific research is understanding the context: to repeat it, to avoid it, or even just to make sense of your own memories. Perhaps we will never understand the psychology of something so incredibly different to us, but it is simply human nature to try." He stops, thoughtful. "Maybe it was just annoyed by our presence, from all we can tell."|4269|0
units.english: "I cannot agree, <first>. Much of the point of scientific research is understanding the context: to repeat it, to avoid it, or even just to make sense of your own memories. Perhaps we will never understand the psychology of something so incredibly different to us, but it is simply human nature to try." He stops, thoughtful. "Maybe it was just annoyed by our presence, from all we can tell."
units.italian: "Non posso essere d'accordo, <first>. Gran parte del senso della ricerca scientifica è capire il contesto: per ripeterlo, per evitarlo, o anche solo per dare un senso ai propri ricordi. Forse non capiremo mai la psicologia di qualcosa di così incredibilmente diverso da noi, ma tentare è semplicemente natura umana." Si ferma, pensieroso. "Forse la nostra presenza dava semplicemente fastidio, da quello che possiamo dire."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	"Maybe. I find the thought interesting: that something so large, so old, and so inscrutable would be annoyed by our simple presence. It is such a foreign psychology to us, and so peculiar."|4272|0
units.english: "Maybe. I find the thought interesting: that something so large, so old, and so inscrutable would be annoyed by our simple presence. It is such a foreign psychology to us, and so peculiar."
units.italian: "Forse. Trovo interessante il pensiero: che qualcosa di così grande, così antico e così imperscrutabile provasse fastidio per la nostra semplice presenza. È una psicologia così estranea a noi, e così peculiare."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	"Maybe. Or maybe it was simply annoyed by our presence, from all we can tell. I find the thought interesting: that something so large, so old, and so inscrutable would put such an effort into making us leave, essentially unharmed. It is such a foreign psychology to us, and so peculiar."|4275|0
units.english: "Maybe. Or maybe it was simply annoyed by our presence, from all we can tell. I find the thought interesting: that something so large, so old, and so inscrutable would put such an effort into making us leave, essentially unharmed. It is such a foreign psychology to us, and so peculiar."
units.italian: "Forse. O forse la nostra presenza dava semplicemente fastidio, da quello che possiamo dire. Trovo interessante il pensiero: che qualcosa di così grande, così antico e così imperscrutabile si impegnasse tanto per farci andare via, sostanzialmente incolumi. È una psicologia così estranea a noi, e così peculiare."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 34|	Minutes later, the other Remnant arrive with the replacement suits. The group eventually leaves your ship all together, still discussing the events that just unfolded.|4277|0
units.english: Minutes later, the other Remnant arrive with the replacement suits. The group eventually leaves your ship all together, still discussing the events that just unfolded.
units.italian: Pochi minuti dopo, gli altri Remnant arrivano con le tute di ricambio. Alla fine il gruppo lascia la nave tutto insieme, ancora a discutere degli eventi appena accaduti.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 35|name|4280|0
units.english: End of the voyage
units.italian: Fine del viaggio

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 35|description|4281|0
units.english: Return to <destination> with the Remnant and their scientific payload.
units.italian: Torna su <destination> con i Remnant e il loro carico scientifico.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 35|The pilgrimage of the Remnant and their payloads toward your ship takes the better part of an hour, again helped by the Tern flock. "We are a fair bit lighter than we thought we would be, given that we have next to no sample from the planetoid." Dusk has taken seat in the cockpit, watching out of the window as the last few payloads climb atop the ramp. In the horizon, the sea of iridium shines at just the right angle to hit your eyes.|4290|0
units.english: The pilgrimage of the Remnant and their payloads toward your ship takes the better part of an hour, again helped by the Tern flock. "We are a fair bit lighter than we thought we would be, given that we have next to no sample from the planetoid." Dusk has taken seat in the cockpit, watching out of the window as the last few payloads climb atop the ramp. In the horizon, the sea of iridium shines at just the right angle to hit your eyes.
units.italian: Il pellegrinaggio dei Remnant e dei loro carichi verso la tua nave richiede buona parte di un'ora, ancora una volta con l'aiuto dello stormo di Tern. "Siamo un bel po' più leggeri di quanto pensassimo, visto che non abbiamo quasi nessun campione del planetoide." Dusk si è seduto in cabina, guardando fuori dal finestrino mentre gli ultimi carichi salgono sulla rampa. All'orizzonte, il mare di iridio brilla con l'angolazione giusta per colpirti gli occhi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 35|	"One of those creatures was in Patir again when it moved. Again it turned motionless, and it was orbiting over us when a Ka'sei located right next to it blew it up. It is a great shame that we could not get to it in time: the next time Patir returns, whenever that may be, we need to be prepared better to board it and plunder its content."|4291|0
units.english: "One of those creatures was in Patir again when it moved. Again it turned motionless, and it was orbiting over us when a Ka'sei located right next to it blew it up. It is a great shame that we could not get to it in time: the next time Patir returns, whenever that may be, we need to be prepared better to board it and plunder its content."
units.italian: "Una di quelle creature era di nuovo a Patir quando si è spostato. Di nuovo è diventata immobile, e stava orbitando sopra di noi quando un Ka'sei situato proprio accanto l'ha fatta saltare in aria. È un gran peccato che non siamo arrivati in tempo: la prossima volta che Patir torna, quando che sia, dovremo prepararci meglio ad abbordarla e saccheggiarne il contenuto."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 35|	"Is it not a sapient being?"|4293|0
units.english: "Is it not a sapient being?"
units.italian: "Non è un essere senziente?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 35|	"I do not think I want to harvest the organs of a living creature, if that is what they are."|4294|0
units.english: "I do not think I want to harvest the organs of a living creature, if that is what they are."
units.italian: "Non credo di voler raccogliere gli organi di una creatura viva, se è questo che sono."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 35|	"It will not be a problem."|4296|0
units.english: "It will not be a problem."
units.italian: "Non sarà un problema."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 35|	"Maybe. There was certainly some reason behind its actions, but not that much. When we were in the cockpit, it was clearly clueless as to what to do with it. I would go as far as saying that it did not understand the difference between a switch and a counter, given how it was continuously flipping them open and closed." He looks inquisitive. "They are fascinating creatures, but why the question?"|4298|0
units.english: "Maybe. There was certainly some reason behind its actions, but not that much. When we were in the cockpit, it was clearly clueless as to what to do with it. I would go as far as saying that it did not understand the difference between a switch and a counter, given how it was continuously flipping them open and closed." He looks inquisitive. "They are fascinating creatures, but why the question?"
units.italian: "Forse. C'era di certo un motivo dietro le sue azioni, ma non così tanto. Quando eravamo in cabina, era chiaramente incapace di capire cosa farne. Arriverei a dire che non capiva la differenza tra un interruttore e un contatore, visto come li apriva e chiudeva di continuo." Ti guarda incuriosito. "Sono creature affascinanti, ma perché la domanda?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 35|	"There is a difference between plundering a ship and someone's body."|4300|0
units.english: "There is a difference between plundering a ship and someone's body."
units.italian: "C'è differenza tra saccheggiare una nave e il corpo di qualcuno."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 35|	"I do not want to repeat the same mistakes the Remnant had made with the Void Sprites."|4301|0
units.english: "I do not want to repeat the same mistakes the Remnant had made with the Void Sprites."
units.italian: "Non voglio ripetere gli stessi errori che i Remnant hanno fatto con gli spettri del vuoto."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 35|	"I was just curious, we can depart."|4303|0
units.english: "I was just curious, we can depart."
units.italian: "Ero solo curioso, possiamo partire."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 35|	"We are not grave robbers, though the lines can get blurred sometimes. However, recovering more of that technology could tremendously help our understanding of it. We cannot say for certain that it was dead, for that matter - perhaps it was simply in some sort of hibernation."|4305|0
units.english: "We are not grave robbers, though the lines can get blurred sometimes. However, recovering more of that technology could tremendously help our understanding of it. We cannot say for certain that it was dead, for that matter - perhaps it was simply in some sort of hibernation."
units.italian: "Non siamo tombaroli, anche se a volte le linee possono confondersi. Tuttavia recuperare altra di quella tecnologia potrebbe aiutare enormemente la nostra comprensione. Non possiamo dire con certezza che fosse morta, peraltro: forse era semplicemente in una sorta di ibernazione."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 35|	Realizing how his words sound, he changes his argument. "Think of it this way: if we leave them there, the Ka'sei will 'mine' them and harvest their pieces. In the end, the only difference is that we do not get the data on it."|4307|0
units.english: Realizing how his words sound, he changes his argument. "Think of it this way: if we leave them there, the Ka'sei will 'mine' them and harvest their pieces. In the end, the only difference is that we do not get the data on it."
units.italian: Rendendosi conto di come suonano le sue parole, cambia argomento. "Pensala così: se le lasciamo lì, i Ka'sei le 'estrarranno' e ne raccoglieranno i pezzi. Alla fine l'unica differenza è che noi non otteniamo i dati."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 35|	"I would rather not do something of this sort. At least, until we understand it better."|4309|0
units.english: "I would rather not do something of this sort. At least, until we understand it better."
units.italian: "Preferirei non fare una cosa del genere. Almeno finché non la capiamo meglio."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 35|	"Alright then."|4310|0
units.english: "Alright then."
units.italian: "Va bene allora."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 35|	He looks at you with interest. "You are the captain here. If that is your final position, I understand." He looks back, and sees the rest of the team has taken their seat. "We can go to <destination> now."|4312|0
units.english: He looks at you with interest. "You are the captain here. If that is your final position, I understand." He looks back, and sees the rest of the team has taken their seat. "We can go to <destination> now."
units.italian: Ti guarda con interesse. "Qui il capitano sei tu. Se questa è la tua posizione finale, capisco." Si volta, e vede che il resto della squadra si è sistemato. "Possiamo andare su <destination> adesso."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 35|	"I am not sure if what we can harvest is part of their own body, or rather if there is a clear separation between themselves and their 'systems'. For that matter, it is one of the things that we will try to find out when studying its technology. Right now, we cannot even say for certain that it was dead - perhaps it was simply in some sort of hibernation."|4316|0
units.english: "I am not sure if what we can harvest is part of their own body, or rather if there is a clear separation between themselves and their 'systems'. For that matter, it is one of the things that we will try to find out when studying its technology. Right now, we cannot even say for certain that it was dead - perhaps it was simply in some sort of hibernation."
units.italian: "Non sono sicuro che quello che possiamo raccogliere faccia parte del loro corpo, o piuttosto che ci sia una chiara separazione tra loro e i loro 'sistemi'. Peraltro è una delle cose che cercheremo di scoprire studiando la loro tecnologia. Al momento non possiamo nemmeno dire con certezza che fosse morta: forse era semplicemente in una sorta di ibernazione."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 35|log|4326|0
units.english: Visited the space beyond Patir a few times with the Remnant. They are now going to let me go in and out of it on my own.
units.italian: Ho visitato più volte lo spazio oltre Patir con i Remnant. Ora mi lasceranno entrare e uscire da solo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 35|log|4327|0
units.english: It is not clear what the creatures in that space are, what their purpose is, or how intelligent they are.
units.italian: Non è chiaro cosa siano le creature di quello spazio, quale sia il loro scopo, o quanto siano intelligenti.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 35|You don't have time to say goodbye to the crew before a couple Remnant take you into another part of the starport, barely a meter below the ground. You spend the next hours recounting to your best abilities everything you have seen, pausing only for a few bathroom breaks and a quick meal. As time goes on, you notice they seem displeased with the lack of details you are able to give; when they eventually let you out, you can't help but feel they are not satisfied by your testimony.|4329|0
units.english: You don't have time to say goodbye to the crew before a couple Remnant take you into another part of the starport, barely a meter below the ground. You spend the next hours recounting to your best abilities everything you have seen, pausing only for a few bathroom breaks and a quick meal. As time goes on, you notice they seem displeased with the lack of details you are able to give; when they eventually let you out, you can't help but feel they are not satisfied by your testimony.
units.italian: Non hai tempo di salutare l'equipaggio prima che un paio di Remnant ti portino in un'altra parte dello spazioporto, appena un metro sotto terra. Passi le ore successive a raccontare come meglio puoi tutto quello che hai visto, fermandoti solo per qualche pausa in bagno e un pasto veloce. Col passare del tempo noti che sembrano scontenti della mancanza di dettagli che riesci a dare; quando infine ti lasciano uscire, non puoi fare a meno di sentire che la tua testimonianza non li soddisfa.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 35|	By the time you return, the team has disappeared again, only Dusk having stayed. "I just wanted to say goodbye, <first>. Despite the hiccups along the way - and, in a way, thanks to them - we now have a safe outpost to house our crews, as well as our own instruments. Soon, all kinds of people are going to want to use it for their purposes, and they deserve to do so; from here on, my own research is going to compete with them all for time in the laboratory."|4330|0
units.english: By the time you return, the team has disappeared again, only Dusk having stayed. "I just wanted to say goodbye, <first>. Despite the hiccups along the way - and, in a way, thanks to them - we now have a safe outpost to house our crews, as well as our own instruments. Soon, all kinds of people are going to want to use it for their purposes, and they deserve to do so; from here on, my own research is going to compete with them all for time in the laboratory."
units.italian: Al tuo ritorno, la squadra è sparita di nuovo, è rimasto solo Dusk. "Volevo solo salutarti, <first>. Nonostante gli intoppi lungo la strada, e in un certo senso grazie a essi, ora abbiamo un avamposto sicuro dove ospitare i nostri equipaggi, oltre ai nostri strumenti. Presto ogni tipo di persona vorrà usarlo per i propri scopi, e se lo merita; da qui in avanti la mia ricerca dovrà competere con tutte le altre per il tempo nel laboratorio."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 35|	He taps on one of your ship's screens that displays the nearby job board. "When you are here on <planet>, you will be able to connect directly with Ssil Vida to control Patir's state. As usual, the timing is going to be predefined, and if you miss your return window they will do their best to send it back as soon as possible. After our last trip, I suggest you to keep your cloak active at all times, especially if you have to pass through Lathia."|4331|0
units.english: He taps on one of your ship's screens that displays the nearby job board. "When you are here on <planet>, you will be able to connect directly with Ssil Vida to control Patir's state. As usual, the timing is going to be predefined, and if you miss your return window they will do their best to send it back as soon as possible. After our last trip, I suggest you to keep your cloak active at all times, especially if you have to pass through Lathia."
units.italian: Tocca uno degli schermi della tua nave che mostra la bacheca degli incarichi vicina. "Quando sei qui su <planet>, potrai collegarti direttamente a Ssil Vida per controllare lo stato di Patir. Come al solito, i tempi saranno predefiniti, e se perdi la finestra di ritorno faranno del loro meglio per rimandarlo indietro il prima possibile. Dopo il nostro ultimo viaggio, ti suggerisco di tenere l'occultamento attivo in ogni momento, soprattutto se devi passare per Lathia."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 35|	"Thank you."|4333|0
units.english: "Thank you."
units.italian: "Grazie."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 35|	"What are you going to do now?"|4334|0
units.english: "What are you going to do now?"
units.italian: "Che cosa farai adesso?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery 35|	"I want to get back up to date with the Builder research, at least while I see how things trend with Patir. In the meanwhile, keep your eyes open for anyone who needs a ride there - I have no doubt that as long as you keep helping our efforts, our roads will cross again. Embers bless your path, <first>!" You copy his bow in farewell.|4335|0
units.english: "I want to get back up to date with the Builder research, at least while I see how things trend with Patir. In the meanwhile, keep your eyes open for anyone who needs a ride there - I have no doubt that as long as you keep helping our efforts, our roads will cross again. Embers bless your path, <first>!" You copy his bow in farewell.
units.italian: "Voglio rimettermi al passo con la ricerca sui Costruttori, almeno finché osservo come va con Patir. Nel frattempo, tieni gli occhi aperti per chiunque abbia bisogno di un passaggio laggiù; non ho dubbi che, finché continuerai ad aiutarci, le nostre strade si incroceranno di nuovo. Che le Braci benedicano il tuo cammino, <first>!" Ricambi il suo inchino in segno di saluto.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery Safety Net Early|The unthinkable has happened: Patir has moved back, but without you! Trying to keep your calm, you check out the flight plans. It seems that for cases like this, Ssil Vida will send Patir back here for a 3-day stay as soon as they see you are not there, eventually returning to the Milky Way on <date>.|4412|0

units.italian: È successo l'impensabile: Patir è tornato indietro, ma senza di te! Cercando di mantenere la calma, controlli i piani di volo. Sembra che, in casi come questo, Ssil Vida rimanderà Patir qui per un soggiorno di 3 giorni appena vedrà che non ci sei, per poi tornare nella Via Lattea il <date>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery Safety Net Early|	Though you should be able to return, you have failed an essential Remnant mission. If you wish to continue Patir content, you may wish to reload.|4413|0

units.italian: Dovresti riuscire a tornare, ma hai fallito una missione essenziale dei Remnant. Se vuoi continuare i contenuti di Patir, potresti voler ricaricare.

units.english: New Expedition to <waypoints>
units.italian: Nuova spedizione su <waypoints>

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery Crew job|description|4472|0
units.english: Travel to <waypoints> with a crew of <bunks> and <tons> of instruments to collect data, then return to <destination>.
units.italian: Viaggia fino a <waypoints> con un equipaggio di <bunks> e <tons> di strumenti per raccogliere dati, poi torna su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery Crew job|dialog|4488|0
units.english: Strange sets of instruments extend once again from your payload bay, scanning the system in an engaging rhythm. You see a number of Snipes jump in and out of your own ship; after some discussions, the Remnant decide that they are satisfied enough with this amount of data.
units.italian: Strane serie di strumenti si estendono di nuovo dalla tua stiva, scansionando il sistema con un ritmo coinvolgente. Vedi numerosi Snipes entrare e uscire dalla tua nave; dopo qualche discussione, i Remnant decidono di essere abbastanza soddisfatti di questa quantità di dati.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Patir Mystery Crew job|dialog|4492|0
units.english: The arrays of instruments are soon unloaded from your ship, and the researchers disembark excitedly. Before leaving, they make sure to hand you a chip with <payment>.
units.italian: Le serie di strumenti vengono presto scaricate dalla nave, e i ricercatori sbarcano eccitati. Prima di partire, si assicurano di consegnarti un chip con <payment>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 0|You make a close pass above this lifeless satellite, abandoned in a graveyard orbit for who knows how long. All of a sudden, your commlink emits a weak, garbled, whistle-like sound, as if receiving a communication from the Builder spacecraft. While you can't understand it, it might be worth paying another visit to the Remnant.|4527|0
units.english: You make a close pass above this lifeless satellite, abandoned in a graveyard orbit for who knows how long. All of a sudden, your commlink emits a weak, garbled, whistle-like sound, as if receiving a communication from the Builder spacecraft. While you can't understand it, it might be worth paying another visit to the Remnant.
units.italian: Passi radente sopra questo satellite senza vita, abbandonato in un'orbita cimitero da chissà quanto tempo. All'improvviso il tuo communicatore emette un suono debole e distorto, simile a un fischio, come se ricevesse una comunicazione dalla nave spaziale dei Costruttori. Anche se non riesci a capirla, potrebbe valere la pena di fare un'altra visita ai Remnant.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 0|A glance at the radar screen reveals that the nearby Builder satellite exploded, presumably due to the damage incurred. A wasted opportunity.|4531|0
units.english: A glance at the radar screen reveals that the nearby Builder satellite exploded, presumably due to the damage incurred. A wasted opportunity.
units.italian: Un'occhiata allo schermo radar rivela che il satellite dei Costruttori vicino è esploso, presumibilmente per i danni subiti. Un'occasione sprecata.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|name|4560|0
units.english: Builder signal
units.italian: Segnale dei Costruttori

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|description|4561|0
units.english: Look for Gavriil aboard <destination> to ask them about the Builder satellite.
units.italian: Cerca Gavriil a bordo di <destination> per chiedere del satellite dei Costruttori.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|Do you want to ask the Remnant about the Builder satellite you encountered in Fereti?|4570|0
units.english: Do you want to ask the Remnant about the Builder satellite you encountered in Fereti?
units.italian: Vuoi chiedere ai Remnant del satellite dei Costruttori che hai incontrato a Fereti?

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	(Yes.)|4572|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	(Not now.)|4573|0
units.english: (Not now.)
units.italian: (Non adesso.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	You spend at least half an hour looking for someone in the spaceport, but you can't seem to find anyone familiar. Just as you're starting to lose hope, you notice a flurry of movement in the direction of one of the scientific laboratories.|4575|0
units.english: You spend at least half an hour looking for someone in the spaceport, but you can't seem to find anyone familiar. Just as you're starting to lose hope, you notice a flurry of movement in the direction of one of the scientific laboratories.
units.italian: Passi almeno mezz'ora a cercare qualcuno nello spazioporto, ma non sembri trovare nessuno di familiare. Proprio quando cominci a perdere la speranza, noti un gran movimento in direzione di uno dei laboratori scientifici.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	Moving closer, you notice the crowd moving away to leave space for a convoy of heavy machinery to pass through. Though you can't seem to identify their function, you do recognize the person in front of the camels that head the vehicles: it's Plume, the scientist leading the Void Sprite Research program.|4576|0
units.english: Moving closer, you notice the crowd moving away to leave space for a convoy of heavy machinery to pass through. Though you can't seem to identify their function, you do recognize the person in front of the camels that head the vehicles: it's Plume, the scientist leading the Void Sprite Research program.
units.italian: Avvicinandoti, noti che la folla si sposta per lasciare spazio a un convoglio di macchinari pesanti. Anche se non riesci a identificarne la funzione, riconosci la persona davanti ai cammelli che guidano i veicoli: è Plume, lo scienziato che dirige il programma di ricerca sugli spettri del vuoto.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	You wave your arm to try to catch his attention as you slowly squeeze through the crowd until he notices you. "Captain <first>! I did not expect to see you here. You were part of the fleet as well?" he signs, excitedly gesturing toward the cargo being transported.|4577|0
units.english: You wave your arm to try to catch his attention as you slowly squeeze through the crowd until he notices you. "Captain <first>! I did not expect to see you here. You were part of the fleet as well?" he signs, excitedly gesturing toward the cargo being transported.
units.italian: Agiti il braccio per cercare di attirare la sua attenzione mentre ti fai lentamente largo tra la folla, finché non ti nota. "Capitano <first>! Non mi aspettavo di vederti qui. Facevi parte anche tu della flotta?" accenna, gesticolando eccitato verso il carico in trasporto.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	Seeing your confused expression, he understands his mistake. "I have been spending some long days in the laboratory recently. It is good that we have such an abundance of data, of course, but the preparations for this expedition have been exhausting."|4578|0
units.english: Seeing your confused expression, he understands his mistake. "I have been spending some long days in the laboratory recently. It is good that we have such an abundance of data, of course, but the preparations for this expedition have been exhausting."
units.italian: Vedendo la tua espressione confusa, capisce il suo errore. "Ultimamente ho passato giornate lunghe in laboratorio. È bello avere tanta abbondanza di dati, naturalmente, ma i preparativi per questa spedizione sono stati estenuanti."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	"What are you transporting?"|4580|0
units.english: "What are you transporting?"
units.italian: "Che cosa trasporti?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	"I found something interesting in Fereti."|4581|0
units.english: "I found something interesting in Fereti."
units.italian: "Ho trovato qualcosa di interessante a Fereti."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	"Cryogenic vats, full of Void Sprite material. All the work done in Esquiline is finally bearing fruits, and this is the more noticeable result. It did not take long after we left them to roam in Pantica that we started to realize that their close passes to the station left visible traces of secretion all over it. All we had to do was place detachable panels over its hull to begin gathering and analyzing those samples.|4583|0
units.english: "Cryogenic vats, full of Void Sprite material. All the work done in Esquiline is finally bearing fruits, and this is the more noticeable result. It did not take long after we left them to roam in Pantica that we started to realize that their close passes to the station left visible traces of secretion all over it. All we had to do was place detachable panels over its hull to begin gathering and analyzing those samples.
units.italian: "Vasche criogeniche, piene di materiale di spettri del vuoto. Tutto il lavoro fatto a Esquiline sta finalmente dando frutti, e questo è il risultato più visibile. Non è passato molto da quando li abbiamo lasciati vagare a Pantica che abbiamo iniziato a renderci conto che i loro passaggi ravvicinati alla stazione lasciavano tracce visibili di secrezione su tutta la superficie. Dovevamo solo mettere dei pannelli staccabili sullo scafo per iniziare a raccogliere e analizzare quei campioni.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	"Of course, most of this machinery is dedicated to keeping the material at the right conditions of pressure, temperature and composition. Each vat contains just a few kilograms of samples at most. Still, it is hard to overstate the impact such a continuous and harmless source of Void Sprite samples could have on genetic research over time.|4584|0
units.english: "Of course, most of this machinery is dedicated to keeping the material at the right conditions of pressure, temperature and composition. Each vat contains just a few kilograms of samples at most. Still, it is hard to overstate the impact such a continuous and harmless source of Void Sprite samples could have on genetic research over time.
units.italian: "Naturalmente, gran parte di questi macchinari serve a mantenere il materiale nelle giuste condizioni di pressione, temperatura e composizione. Ogni vasca contiene al massimo qualche chilogrammo di campioni. Tuttavia è difficile esagerare l'impatto che una fonte così continua e innocua di campioni di spettri del vuoto potrebbe avere sulla ricerca genetica nel tempo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	"What about you?"|4585|0
units.english: "What about you?"
units.italian: "E tu, invece?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	You explain your encounter with the Builder satellite and the signal it sent you to Plume. By the end of your story, however, he still seems quite confused. "I was hoping there would be Void Sprites involved," he jokes, "but it was an interesting story nonetheless.|4587|0
units.english: You explain your encounter with the Builder satellite and the signal it sent you to Plume. By the end of your story, however, he still seems quite confused. "I was hoping there would be Void Sprites involved," he jokes, "but it was an interesting story nonetheless.
units.italian: Spieghi a Plume il tuo incontro con il satellite dei Costruttori e il segnale che ti ha inviato. Alla fine del racconto, però, sembra ancora piuttosto confuso. "Speravo ci fossero di mezzo gli spettri del vuoto," scherza, "ma è stata comunque una storia interessante.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	"I am not quite sure how to help you this time, though - none of this is really within my expertise."|4588|0
units.english: "I am not quite sure how to help you this time, though - none of this is really within my expertise."
units.italian: "Non sono però sicuro di come aiutarti questa volta: niente di tutto questo rientra davvero nelle mie competenze."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	"Who should I ask then?"|4590|0
units.english: "Who should I ask then?"
units.italian: "A chi dovrei chiedere, allora?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	"That is a shame."|4591|0
units.english: "That is a shame."
units.italian: "È un peccato."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	Plume leaves to oversee a group of technicians unloading the contents of the first vehicle, gesturing for you to wait for him. He comes back to you a few minutes later. "I have an idea. Follow me.|4592|0
units.english: Plume leaves to oversee a group of technicians unloading the contents of the first vehicle, gesturing for you to wait for him. He comes back to you a few minutes later. "I have an idea. Follow me.
units.italian: Plume si allontana per sovrintendere a un gruppo di tecnici che scaricano il contenuto del primo veicolo, facendoti cenno di aspettarlo. Torna da te qualche minuto dopo. "Ho un'idea. Seguimi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	"Here," he signs after a short walk, gesturing toward a wall-mounted terminal. "I may not have enough engineering experience to help you directly, but if there is a place where that information might be, it is here." He shows you to a data pad, grabbing your hand and passing it below a scanner before continuing.|4593|0
units.english: "Here," he signs after a short walk, gesturing toward a wall-mounted terminal. "I may not have enough engineering experience to help you directly, but if there is a place where that information might be, it is here." He shows you to a data pad, grabbing your hand and passing it below a scanner before continuing.
units.italian: "Ecco," accenna dopo una breve camminata, indicando un terminale a parete. "Forse non ho abbastanza esperienza ingegneristica per aiutarti direttamente, ma se c'è un posto dove quell'informazione potrebbe essere, è qui." Ti mostra un tablet, prendendoti la mano e passandola sotto uno scanner prima di continuare.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	"This pad contains the extracts of all our published engineering papers - the publicly available ones, at least. If what you have encountered has been studied previously, it should be here somewhere." Plume returns to his job after showing you the basics, signing to give him a call if you need more help.|4594|0
units.english: "This pad contains the extracts of all our published engineering papers - the publicly available ones, at least. If what you have encountered has been studied previously, it should be here somewhere." Plume returns to his job after showing you the basics, signing to give him a call if you need more help.
units.italian: "Questo tablet contiene gli estratti di tutti i nostri articoli di ingegneria pubblicati, almeno quelli disponibili pubblicamente. Se quello che hai incontrato è già stato studiato, dovrebbe essere qui da qualche parte." Plume torna al suo lavoro dopo averti mostrato le basi, accennandoti di chiamarlo se ti serve altro aiuto.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	Left by yourself, you grab a nearby seat and start making some searches inside the terminal. The first half hour does not return any useful result: there are millions of papers to choose from, and the initial queries you come up with find either thousands of possible matches, or none at all.|4595|0
units.english: Left by yourself, you grab a nearby seat and start making some searches inside the terminal. The first half hour does not return any useful result: there are millions of papers to choose from, and the initial queries you come up with find either thousands of possible matches, or none at all.
units.italian: Lasciato solo, prendi una sedia lì vicino e cominci a fare qualche ricerca nel terminale. La prima mezz'ora non dà risultati utili: ci sono milioni di articoli tra cui scegliere, e le prime query che ti vengono in mente trovano o migliaia di corrispondenze possibili, o nessuna.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	Eventually, however, you start getting the hang of it. You find one paper that describes the phenomena you observed, then another, then even more. By the end of the hour, you've saved at least a dozen relevant papers.|4596|0
units.english: Eventually, however, you start getting the hang of it. You find one paper that describes the phenomena you observed, then another, then even more. By the end of the hour, you've saved at least a dozen relevant papers.
units.italian: Alla fine, però, cominci a prenderci la mano. Trovi un articolo che descrive i fenomeni che hai osservato, poi un altro, poi altri ancora. Alla fine dell'ora hai salvato almeno una dozzina di articoli pertinenti.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	Though you can't understand any of them in depth, a detail catches your eye: three of those papers were authored by Gavriil, the engineer you last left in <system>. If there's anyone who can get you to the end of this, it has to be them.|4597|0
units.english: Though you can't understand any of them in depth, a detail catches your eye: three of those papers were authored by Gavriil, the engineer you last left in <system>. If there's anyone who can get you to the end of this, it has to be them.
units.italian: Anche se non riesci a capirne nessuno in profondità, un dettaglio ti colpisce: tre di quegli articoli sono firmati da Gavriil, l'ingegnere che hai lasciato l'ultima volta su <system>. Se c'è qualcuno che può portarti in fondo a questa storia, deve essere per forza quella persona.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	You wave goodbye to Plume, still busy transferring the delicate cargo to the safety of the laboratory, and climb aboard your ship. Next stop: <planet>.|4598|0
units.english: You wave goodbye to Plume, still busy transferring the delicate cargo to the safety of the laboratory, and climb aboard your ship. Next stop: <planet>.
units.italian: Saluti con la mano Plume, ancora impegnato a trasferire il carico delicato al sicuro nel laboratorio, e sali sulla nave. Prossima tappa: <planet>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|The more time passes, the more Ssil Vida resembles a Remnant outpost. The local spaceport has followed a transformation similar to Esquiline on a grander scale, with walls covered by mazes of piping and dozens of active work stations expanding the already operational outfitter. There is no need to wander around, however: Gavriil is waiting for you right beside the landing pad.|4602|0
units.english: The more time passes, the more Ssil Vida resembles a Remnant outpost. The local spaceport has followed a transformation similar to Esquiline on a grander scale, with walls covered by mazes of piping and dozens of active work stations expanding the already operational outfitter. There is no need to wander around, however: Gavriil is waiting for you right beside the landing pad.
units.italian: Col passare del tempo, Ssil Vida assomiglia sempre più a un avamposto Remnant. Lo spazioporto locale ha seguito una trasformazione simile a quella di Esquiline su scala più grande, con pareti coperte da labirinti di tubature e dozzine di postazioni di lavoro attive che ampliano il fornitore di equipaggiamento già operativo. Non serve però girare a vuoto: Gavriil ti aspetta proprio accanto alla piazzola di atterraggio.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	"Nice to see you again," they gestures warmly. "I hope the Embers blessed your journey."|4603|0
units.english: "Nice to see you again," they gestures warmly. "I hope the Embers blessed your journey."
units.italian: "Bello rivederti," gesticola con calore. "Spero che le Braci abbiano benedetto il tuo viaggio."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	"They did."|4605|0
units.english: "They did."
units.italian: "L'hanno fatto."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	(Tell them about the encounter.)|4606|0
units.english: (Tell them about the encounter.)
units.italian: (Racconta loro dell'incontro.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	You take them aside to again explain your encounter with the Builder satellite, but they stop you before you can begin. "Plume told me everything a few days ago. It is always delightful to see something one has theorized about become reality," they continue proudly. "What you have observed is usually called a 'zombie satellite.' Not too technical of an expression, maybe, but certainly meaningful.|4607|0
units.english: You take them aside to again explain your encounter with the Builder satellite, but they stop you before you can begin. "Plume told me everything a few days ago. It is always delightful to see something one has theorized about become reality," they continue proudly. "What you have observed is usually called a 'zombie satellite.' Not too technical of an expression, maybe, but certainly meaningful.
units.italian: La prendi da parte per spiegare di nuovo il tuo incontro con il satellite dei Costruttori, ma ti ferma prima che tu possa iniziare. "Plume mi ha raccontato tutto qualche giorno fa. È sempre delizioso vedere qualcosa che avevi teorizzato diventare realtà," continua con orgoglio. "Quello che hai osservato si chiama di solito 'satellite zombi'. Un'espressione non troppo tecnica, forse, ma di certo significativa.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	"There are many ways a spacecraft can die, some less violent than others. And there are times, years after the supposed end of operations, when the spacecraft spontaneously comes back to life and communicates again with the ground. It is not a predictable event, nor does it happen only to specific designs; it simply happens, no matter whether the satellite was built on Aventine, Hai-home, or Valhalla.|4608|0
units.english: "There are many ways a spacecraft can die, some less violent than others. And there are times, years after the supposed end of operations, when the spacecraft spontaneously comes back to life and communicates again with the ground. It is not a predictable event, nor does it happen only to specific designs; it simply happens, no matter whether the satellite was built on Aventine, Hai-home, or Valhalla.
units.italian: "Ci sono molti modi in cui un veicolo spaziale può morire, alcuni meno violenti di altri. E ci sono volte, anni dopo la presunta fine delle operazioni, in cui il veicolo torna spontaneamente in vita e comunica di nuovo con la base. Non è un evento prevedibile, né accade solo a progetti specifici; accade e basta, che il satellite sia stato costruito su Aventine, su Hai-home o su Valhalla.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	"What makes it special in this case is the sheer length of time that has passed between the 'death' of the satellite and now. This spacecraft was silent the last time we explored Fereti, which either means it survived for tens of thousands of years and died a few hundred years ago, or that it died at the time of the Builders and only came back to life after millennia - both very fascinating possibilities in their own right.|4609|0
units.english: "What makes it special in this case is the sheer length of time that has passed between the 'death' of the satellite and now. This spacecraft was silent the last time we explored Fereti, which either means it survived for tens of thousands of years and died a few hundred years ago, or that it died at the time of the Builders and only came back to life after millennia - both very fascinating possibilities in their own right.
units.italian: "Ciò che lo rende speciale in questo caso è la quantità enorme di tempo passata tra la 'morte' del satellite e oggi. Questo veicolo era silenzioso l'ultima volta che abbiamo esplorato Fereti, il che significa o che è sopravvissuto per decine di migliaia di anni ed è morto qualche centinaio di anni fa, o che è morto all'epoca dei Costruttori ed è tornato in vita solo dopo millenni: entrambe possibilità molto affascinanti di per sé.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	"This would be the first active Builder satellite we have identified, which is not surprising given these conditions. If your report is accurate, we need to go study it as soon as possible."|4610|0
units.english: "This would be the first active Builder satellite we have identified, which is not surprising given these conditions. If your report is accurate, we need to go study it as soon as possible."
units.italian: "Questo sarebbe il primo satellite attivo dei Costruttori che abbiamo identificato, il che non sorprende viste queste condizioni. Se il tuo rapporto è accurato, dobbiamo andare a studiarlo il prima possibile."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	"How did it come back to life?"|4612|0
units.english: "How did it come back to life?"
units.italian: "Come è tornato in vita?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	"Can you take a look at the signal it sent?"|4613|0
units.english: "Can you take a look at the signal it sent?"
units.italian: "Puoi dare un'occhiata al segnale che ha inviato?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	"I have a few ideas, but there is no way to be sure. One of the most frequent causes is the software successfully rebooting after a memory failure, practically resetting it to the factory setup, but without more information this is at best a guess on my part."|4615|0
units.english: "I have a few ideas, but there is no way to be sure. One of the most frequent causes is the software successfully rebooting after a memory failure, practically resetting it to the factory setup, but without more information this is at best a guess on my part."
units.italian: "Ho qualche idea, ma non c'è modo di esserne certo. Una delle cause più frequenti è il software che riesce a riavviarsi dopo un guasto della memoria, riportandolo praticamente alle impostazioni di fabbrica, ma senza altre informazioni questa è al massimo una mia supposizione."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	You hand them a data chip with the communication you received from the satellite, which they quickly put into their pocket. "I will try to take a few hours off to give it a first pass with the instruments we have here. While they are not the best suited for this sort of analysis, I remember a few tricks that might get something usable out of it.|4617|0
units.english: You hand them a data chip with the communication you received from the satellite, which they quickly put into their pocket. "I will try to take a few hours off to give it a first pass with the instruments we have here. While they are not the best suited for this sort of analysis, I remember a few tricks that might get something usable out of it.
units.italian: Gli consegni un chip dati con la comunicazione che hai ricevuto dal satellite, che infila subito in tasca. "Cercherò di prendermi qualche ora libera per darci una prima occhiata con gli strumenti che abbiamo qui.
