Anche se non sono i più adatti a questo tipo di analisi, ricordo qualche trucco che potrebbe tirarne fuori qualcosa di utilizzabile.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1|	"In the meantime, feel free to take a look at the changes we have been making here. I will give you a call from the spaceport when I have something to show."|4618|0
units.english: "In the meantime, feel free to take a look at the changes we have been making here. I will give you a call from the spaceport when I have something to show."
units.italian: "Nel frattempo, sentiti libero di dare un'occhiata ai cambiamenti che abbiamo fatto qui. Ti chiamerò dallo spazioporto quando avrò qualcosa da mostrarti."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1B|Do you want to ask the Remnant about the communication received from the Builder satellite?|4628|0
units.english: Do you want to ask the Remnant about the communication received from the Builder satellite?
units.italian: Vuoi chiedere ai Remnant della comunicazione ricevuta dal satellite dei Costruttori?

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1B|	(Yes.)|4630|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1B|	(Not now.)|4631|0
units.english: (Not now.)
units.italian: (Non adesso.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 1B|With the ongoing construction preventing you from reaching most of the station, you try to look around near the landing pad. It takes almost half an hour before you give up; there's too many people to try to find someone who knows you, and everyone else seems far too busy to stop and listen to your story. Perhaps you will have better luck in the spaceport of a major planet.|4633|0
units.english: With the ongoing construction preventing you from reaching most of the station, you try to look around near the landing pad. It takes almost half an hour before you give up; there's too many people to try to find someone who knows you, and everyone else seems far too busy to stop and listen to your story. Perhaps you will have better luck in the spaceport of a major planet.
units.italian: Con la costruzione in corso che ti impedisce di raggiungere gran parte della stazione, provi a guardarti intorno vicino alla piazzola di atterraggio. Passa quasi mezz'ora prima che tu ti arrenda; ci sono troppe persone per cercare qualcuno che ti conosca, e tutti gli altri sembrano troppo impegnati per fermarsi ad ascoltare la tua storia. Forse avrai più fortuna nello spazioporto di un pianeta importante.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 2|name|4637|0
units.english: Outpost on Kumkapi
units.italian: Avamposto su Kumkapi

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 2|description|4638|0
units.english: Bring Gavriil to <destination> to prepare for the capture of the Builder satellite.
units.italian: Porta Gavriil su <destination> per preparare la cattura del satellite dei Costruttori.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 2|blocked|4639|0
units.english: This mission requires one empty bunk to carry Gavriil with you.
units.italian: Questa missione richiede una cuccetta libera per trasportare Gavriil con te.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 2|Ssil Vida's outfitter was built atop the original storage platforms of the station, far too large for the Remnant's logistics system. While it does not seem to be particularly well equipped, what they were able to set up on completely alien infrastructure since the first time you came here is still impressive.|4648|0
units.english: Ssil Vida's outfitter was built atop the original storage platforms of the station, far too large for the Remnant's logistics system. While it does not seem to be particularly well equipped, what they were able to set up on completely alien infrastructure since the first time you came here is still impressive.
units.italian: Il fornitore di equipaggiamento di Ssil Vida è stato costruito sopra le piattaforme di stoccaggio originali della stazione, troppo grandi per il sistema logistico dei Remnant. Anche se non sembra particolarmente ben attrezzato, quello che sono riusciti a montare su un'infrastruttura completamente aliena dal primo momento in cui sei venuto qui è comunque impressionante.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 2|	Your walk comes to an end when Gavriil's name appears on your communicator. You turn around and stride back to the spaceport, where you find them waiting at a table.|4649|0
units.english: Your walk comes to an end when Gavriil's name appears on your communicator. You turn around and stride back to the spaceport, where you find them waiting at a table.
units.italian: La tua passeggiata finisce quando il nome di Gavriil appare sul tuo communicatore. Ti volti e torni a passo svelto verso lo spazioporto, dove lo trovi in attesa a un tavolo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 2|	"I have good news and bad news," they sign with a slight frown. "How much do you know about the history of our exploration of the Graveyard?"|4650|0
units.english: "I have good news and bad news," they sign with a slight frown. "How much do you know about the history of our exploration of the Graveyard?"
units.italian: "Ho buone e cattive notizie," accenna con una leggera smorfia. "Quanto sai della storia della nostra esplorazione del Cimitero?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 2|	"Not much. Can you summarize it?"|4652|0
units.english: "Not much. Can you summarize it?"
units.italian: "Non molto. Puoi riassumerla?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 2|	"Enough."|4653|0
units.english: "Enough."
units.italian: "A sufficienza."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 2|	"After the loss of a number of vehicles to what we now know to be the Ka'het, our ancestors developed and adopted new standards to reduce the risk of such expeditions into the depth of the Ember Waste. Cloaks were to be kept active at all times while inside the Graveyard, limiting the range of our archeological missions to the ever-increasing capacity of our fuel tanks.|4655|0
units.english: "After the loss of a number of vehicles to what we now know to be the Ka'het, our ancestors developed and adopted new standards to reduce the risk of such expeditions into the depth of the Ember Waste. Cloaks were to be kept active at all times while inside the Graveyard, limiting the range of our archeological missions to the ever-increasing capacity of our fuel tanks.
units.italian: "Dopo la perdita di numerosi veicoli a causa di quelli che ora sappiamo essere i Ka'het, i nostri antenati svilupparono e adottarono nuovi standard per ridurre il rischio di tali spedizioni nel profondo della Distesa di Braci. Gli occultamenti dovevano restare attivi in ogni momento dentro il Cimitero, limitando la portata delle nostre missioni archeologiche alla capacità sempre crescente dei nostri serbatoi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 2|	"Despite limiting most expeditions to the northern systems, these guidelines still led to the golden age of Builder archeology, giving us incredible insights into the history of this region and its inhabitants. The culmination of this effort was the partial translation of their written language, as well as the decoding of some of their programming. The problem, however, is that this did not extend to their spoken language.|4656|0
units.english: "Despite limiting most expeditions to the northern systems, these guidelines still led to the golden age of Builder archeology, giving us incredible insights into the history of this region and its inhabitants. The culmination of this effort was the partial translation of their written language, as well as the decoding of some of their programming. The problem, however, is that this did not extend to their spoken language.
units.italian: "Nonostante abbiano limitato la maggior parte delle spedizioni ai sistemi settentrionali, queste linee guida portarono comunque all'età d'oro dell'archeologia dei Costruttori, dandoci intuizioni incredibili sulla storia di questa regione e dei suoi abitanti. Il culmine di questo sforzo fu la traduzione parziale della loro lingua scritta, oltre alla decodifica di parte della loro programmazione. Il problema, però, è che questo non si estese alla loro lingua parlata.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 2|	He looks amused. "I will try to keep things short then. During our archeological effort, we were able to translate most of the written Builder language and decode some of their programming. The problem, however, is that this did not extend to their spoken language.|4659|0
units.english: He looks amused. "I will try to keep things short then. During our archeological effort, we were able to translate most of the written Builder language and decode some of their programming. The problem, however, is that this did not extend to their spoken language.
units.italian: Sembra divertito. "Cercherò di essere breve, allora. Durante il nostro sforzo archeologico siamo riusciti a tradurre gran parte della lingua scritta dei Costruttori e a decodificare parte della loro programmazione. Il problema, però, è che questo non si estese alla loro lingua parlata.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 2|	"What we have discovered in the analysis is that the communication you received contains some kind of audio recording, the meaning of which remains a mystery. I have transmitted it to Aventine so that xenolinguists will be able to archive it for further study, but the purpose of this signal, and consequently of the satellite, will remain unknown."|4661|0
units.english: "What we have discovered in the analysis is that the communication you received contains some kind of audio recording, the meaning of which remains a mystery. I have transmitted it to Aventine so that xenolinguists will be able to archive it for further study, but the purpose of this signal, and consequently of the satellite, will remain unknown."
units.italian: "Quello che abbiamo scoperto nell'analisi è che la comunicazione che hai ricevuto contiene una specie di registrazione audio, il cui significato resta un mistero. L'ho trasmessa ad Aventine così che i xenolinguisti possano archiviarla per studi futuri, ma lo scopo di questo segnale, e di conseguenza del satellite, resterà sconosciuto."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 2|	He pauses for a few seconds, thoughtful. "The data we have gathered shows that the satellite is not too large, nor particularly heavy. A way to circumvent these issues could be to capture the Builder spacecraft and bring it to one of our laboratories - if it is still alive it should be possible to extract its data mostly, if not fully intact.|4662|0
units.english: He pauses for a few seconds, thoughtful. "The data we have gathered shows that the satellite is not too large, nor particularly heavy. A way to circumvent these issues could be to capture the Builder spacecraft and bring it to one of our laboratories - if it is still alive it should be possible to extract its data mostly, if not fully intact.
units.italian: Si ferma qualche secondo, pensieroso. "I dati che abbiamo raccolto mostrano che il satellite non è troppo grande, né particolarmente pesante. Un modo per aggirare questi problemi potrebbe essere catturare il veicolo dei Costruttori e portarlo in uno dei nostri laboratori; se è ancora vivo, dovrebbe essere possibile estrarne i dati in gran parte, se non del tutto intatti.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 2|	"Have you ever been on <planet>?" they ask, without waiting for an answer. "It is a small semi-abandoned colony in <system>, orbiting right above Viminal. I used to know some people there who should have just the equipment a project like this would need."|4663|0
units.english: "Have you ever been on <planet>?" they ask, without waiting for an answer. "It is a small semi-abandoned colony in <system>, orbiting right above Viminal. I used to know some people there who should have just the equipment a project like this would need."
units.italian: "Sei mai stato su <planet>?" chiede, senza aspettare risposta. "È una piccola colonia semiabbandonata in <system>, in orbita proprio sopra Viminal. Conoscevo alcune persone lì che dovrebbero avere proprio l'attrezzatura necessaria a un progetto del genere."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 2|	"Alright, let's do this."|4665|0
units.english: "Alright, let's do this."
units.italian: "Va bene, facciamolo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 2|	"Will you come with me?"|4666|0
units.english: "Will you come with me?"
units.italian: "Verrai con me?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 2|	You make a gesture toward your ship, to which they reply with an undecided expression. "Our backlog here has been growing considerably, and leaving for another adventure right now would not make it shorter." They stop for a few seconds, then continue.|4667|0
units.english: You make a gesture toward your ship, to which they reply with an undecided expression. "Our backlog here has been growing considerably, and leaving for another adventure right now would not make it shorter." They stop for a few seconds, then continue.
units.italian: Fai un gesto verso la tua nave, e risponde con un'espressione indecisa. "Il nostro arretrato qui è cresciuto parecchio, e partire per un'altra avventura proprio ora non lo renderebbe più piccolo." Si ferma qualche secondo, poi continua.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 2|	"On the other hand, we have also been completing milestones ahead of schedule lately, and there are plenty of experienced people here who could take over for some time. I can afford to leave the reins to someone else for a few days.|4668|0
units.english: "On the other hand, we have also been completing milestones ahead of schedule lately, and there are plenty of experienced people here who could take over for some time. I can afford to leave the reins to someone else for a few days.
units.italian: "D'altra parte, ultimamente stiamo completando le tappe anche in anticipo, e qui ci sono molte persone esperte che potrebbero prendere in mano la situazione per un po'. Posso permettermi di lasciare le redini a qualcun altro per qualche giorno.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 2|	"Plus," they conclude with a smile, "it will be an opportunity to see some faces I have not seen in years, and to reminisce about the past for a bit. I should have done this a while ago."|4669|0
units.english: "Plus," they conclude with a smile, "it will be an opportunity to see some faces I have not seen in years, and to reminisce about the past for a bit. I should have done this a while ago."
units.italian: "Inoltre," conclude con un sorriso, "sarà l'occasione per rivedere qualche viso che non vedo da anni, e per ricordare un po' il passato. Avrei dovuto farlo tempo fa."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 3|name|4677|0
units.english: Builder satellite
units.italian: Satellite dei Costruttori

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 3|description|4678|0
units.english: Capture the Builder satellite in <waypoints> and bring it to <destination>.
units.italian: Cattura il satellite dei Costruttori in <waypoints> e portalo su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 3|blocked|4679|0
units.english: The cargo is ready to load, but you do not have enough free space. Come back when you have <tons> free.
units.italian: Il carico è pronto da caricare, ma non hai abbastanza spazio libero. Torna quando avrai <tons> libere.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 3|The gradual descent toward the landing site is quite slow. Dozens of mining outposts are scattered over the surface, some of which are quite big, but none of them give the impression of being in active use. Even the landing pads, almost all empty, have started to show a thin layer of dust and regolith.|4688|0
units.english: The gradual descent toward the landing site is quite slow. Dozens of mining outposts are scattered over the surface, some of which are quite big, but none of them give the impression of being in active use. Even the landing pads, almost all empty, have started to show a thin layer of dust and regolith.
units.italian: La discesa graduale verso il punto di atterraggio è piuttosto lenta. Dozzine di avamposti minerari sono sparsi sulla superficie, alcuni piuttosto grandi, ma nessuno dà l'impressione di essere in uso attivo. Persino le piazzole di atterraggio, quasi tutte vuote, hanno cominciato a mostrare uno strato sottile di polvere e regolite.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 3|	"Just a few decades ago, these buildings were sprawling with activity," Gavriil explains, keeping their eyes on the horizon. "Everyone was on the hunt for Key Stone veins outside of Viminal, and planetary systems tend to have similar characteristics between each other. I will spare you the details, but this turned out not to be the case with <planet>, and most of the infrastructure that had built up here was left without a clear purpose."|4689|0
units.english: "Just a few decades ago, these buildings were sprawling with activity," Gavriil explains, keeping their eyes on the horizon. "Everyone was on the hunt for Key Stone veins outside of Viminal, and planetary systems tend to have similar characteristics between each other. I will spare you the details, but this turned out not to be the case with <planet>, and most of the infrastructure that had built up here was left without a clear purpose."
units.italian: "Solo qualche decennio fa questi edifici brulicavano di attività," spiega Gavriil, tenendo gli occhi sull'orizzonte. "Tutti erano a caccia di vene di Pietra Chiave fuori da Viminal, e i sistemi planetari tendono ad avere caratteristiche simili tra loro. Ti risparmio i dettagli, ma con <planet> non fu così, e gran parte dell'infrastruttura costruita qui rimase senza uno scopo chiaro."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 3|	Following the landing trajectory, you steer left after passing over a canyon and prepare for the final approach. You notice their eyes light up when the target outpost comes into view, just for an instant. "So as not to leave it to rot, a few projects to reuse the abandoned facilities were given the go ahead. The one we are going to visit today has become a major testing facility for advanced technologies, whether built by us or recovered from other sources."|4690|0
units.english: Following the landing trajectory, you steer left after passing over a canyon and prepare for the final approach. You notice their eyes light up when the target outpost comes into view, just for an instant. "So as not to leave it to rot, a few projects to reuse the abandoned facilities were given the go ahead. The one we are going to visit today has become a major testing facility for advanced technologies, whether built by us or recovered from other sources."
units.italian: Seguendo la traiettoria di atterraggio, sterzi a sinistra dopo aver superato un canyon e ti prepari all'avvicinamento finale. Noti che i suoi occhi si illuminano quando l'avamposto bersaglio entra nel campo visivo, solo per un istante. "Per non lasciarlo marcire, sono stati autorizzati alcuni progetti per riutilizzare le strutture abbandonate. Quella che visitiamo oggi è diventata un importante centro di collaudo per tecnologie avanzate, costruite da noi o recuperate da altre fonti."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 3|	"I see."|4692|0
units.english: "I see."
units.italian: "Capisco."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 3|	"Is this testing dangerous?"|4694|0
units.english: "Is this testing dangerous?"
units.italian: "Questo collaudo è pericoloso?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 3|	"Was the Key Stone search successful?"|4696|0
units.english: "Was the Key Stone search successful?"
units.italian: "La ricerca delle Pietre Chiave ha avuto successo?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 3|	"Not as much as we were hoping. The only other place to turn a positive result was Eavine, a gas giant's moon located right in the middle of Ka'het-controlled space. It was a scientifically interesting finding, but not one that we could make use of in the near future."|4697|0
units.english: "Not as much as we were hoping. The only other place to turn a positive result was Eavine, a gas giant's moon located right in the middle of Ka'het-controlled space. It was a scientifically interesting finding, but not one that we could make use of in the near future."
units.italian: "Non quanto speravamo. L'unico altro posto con un risultato positivo è stato Eavine, una luna di un gigante gassoso situata proprio in mezzo allo spazio controllato dai Ka'het. È stata una scoperta scientificamente interessante, ma non una che potessimo sfruttare nel prossimo futuro."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 3|	"It can be. Many weapons have been tested here over the years, and even projects that had more peaceful purposes occasionally had some rather explosive results. Mind you, this is no matter to be taken lightly."|4700|0
units.english: "It can be. Many weapons have been tested here over the years, and even projects that had more peaceful purposes occasionally had some rather explosive results. Mind you, this is no matter to be taken lightly."
units.italian: "Può esserlo. Negli anni qui sono state testate molte armi, e persino progetti con scopi più pacifici hanno a volte avuto risultati piuttosto esplosivi. Attenzione, non è una cosa da prendere alla leggera."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 3|	By the time you complete the post-landing checklist, Gavriil has already left the ship to meet up with the people on the ground. The crowd that has been gathering around the pad gives them a warm welcome, to which they reply cheerfully. They must have spent a lot of time on this moon when they were younger.|4702|0
units.english: By the time you complete the post-landing checklist, Gavriil has already left the ship to meet up with the people on the ground. The crowd that has been gathering around the pad gives them a warm welcome, to which they reply cheerfully. They must have spent a lot of time on this moon when they were younger.
units.italian: Quando completi la lista di controllo post-atterraggio, Gavriil ha già lasciato la nave per incontrare le persone a terra. La folla radunata attorno alla piazzola gli dà un benvenuto caloroso, a cui risponde allegramente. Devono aver passato molto tempo su questa luna da giovani.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 3|	After some brief introductions, you follow the group as it moves down a few ramps of stairs and inside some well-lit tunnels right below the outpost. At the end of them lies a large hangar, wide in both directions but with a rather low ceiling. "We have a few rigs we used to capture test satellites in the past," one of the technicians explains. "They were Remnant spacecraft in those cases, but there is nothing fundamentally preventing their use in your mission.|4703|0
units.english: After some brief introductions, you follow the group as it moves down a few ramps of stairs and inside some well-lit tunnels right below the outpost. At the end of them lies a large hangar, wide in both directions but with a rather low ceiling. "We have a few rigs we used to capture test satellites in the past," one of the technicians explains. "They were Remnant spacecraft in those cases, but there is nothing fundamentally preventing their use in your mission.
units.italian: Dopo qualche presentazione, segui il gruppo che scende un paio di rampe di scale ed entra in alcuni tunnel ben illuminati proprio sotto l'avamposto. In fondo c'è un grande hangar, ampio in entrambe le direzioni ma con un soffitto piuttosto basso. "Abbiamo un paio di impianti che usavamo per catturare satelliti di prova in passato," spiega uno dei tecnici. "In quei casi erano veicoli Remnant, ma nulla impedisce fondamentalmente di usarli nella tua missione.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 3|	"Connecting with the spacecraft after you carry it here is going to be a bit more complicated. We have the machines necessary to keep it stored, but I had to order some special devices from Aventine to download its data after all is said and done. Either way, a fleet will have brought it here before you are back, so it should not pose a problem."|4704|0
units.english: "Connecting with the spacecraft after you carry it here is going to be a bit more complicated. We have the machines necessary to keep it stored, but I had to order some special devices from Aventine to download its data after all is said and done. Either way, a fleet will have brought it here before you are back, so it should not pose a problem."
units.italian: "Collegarsi al veicolo dopo che l'avrai portato qui sarà un po' più complicato. Abbiamo le macchine necessarie a tenerlo in deposito, ma ho dovuto ordinare da Aventine alcuni dispositivi speciali per scaricarne i dati alla fine. In ogni caso, una flotta lo avrà portato qui prima del tuo ritorno, quindi non dovrebbe essere un problema."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 3|	You help them load the satellite capture equipment in your ship, and make sure to leave enough space for the spacecraft itself. "I will stay here to help them prepare for the satellite," Gavriil signs, "and hopefully remain updated with Ssil Vida on the progress made in my absence. See you in a month or two."|4705|0
units.english: You help them load the satellite capture equipment in your ship, and make sure to leave enough space for the spacecraft itself. "I will stay here to help them prepare for the satellite," Gavriil signs, "and hopefully remain updated with Ssil Vida on the progress made in my absence. See you in a month or two."
units.italian: Li aiuti a caricare sulla nave l'attrezzatura per la cattura del satellite, e ti assicuri di lasciare spazio sufficiente per il veicolo stesso. "Resto qui ad aiutarli a prepararsi per il satellite," accenna Gavriil, "e spero di restare aggiornato con Ssil Vida sui progressi fatti in mia assenza. Ci vediamo tra un mese o due."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 3|You approach the spacecraft, and activate the equipment the Remnant gave you. Slowly, a large robotic claw, padded with a thick gray insulation, emerges out of your cargo hold. It takes a few tries, but you're finally able to put the satellite into your cargo bay and prepare the fittings to keep it in place.|4713|0
units.english: You approach the spacecraft, and activate the equipment the Remnant gave you. Slowly, a large robotic claw, padded with a thick gray insulation, emerges out of your cargo hold. It takes a few tries, but you're finally able to put the satellite into your cargo bay and prepare the fittings to keep it in place.
units.italian: Ti avvicini al veicolo e attivi l'attrezzatura che i Remnant ti hanno dato. Lentamente, dalla stiva emerge un grande artiglio robotico, rivestito di uno spesso isolante grigio. Ci vogliono alcuni tentativi, ma alla fine riesci a mettere il satellite nella stiva e a preparare i fissaggi per tenerlo fermo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 4|name|4718|0
units.english: Return Gavriil
units.italian: Riporta Gavriil

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 4|description|4719|0
units.english: Bring Gavriil back to <destination>.
units.italian: Riporta Gavriil su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 4|A few pad workers guide you to the designated landing site, where a large harness is waiting for your special payload to arrive. Once the satellite's container has been safely berthed to its transporter, you follow the convoy as it slowly descends down a wide ramp and into the same hangar you had been shown earlier.|4726|0
units.english: A few pad workers guide you to the designated landing site, where a large harness is waiting for your special payload to arrive. Once the satellite's container has been safely berthed to its transporter, you follow the convoy as it slowly descends down a wide ramp and into the same hangar you had been shown earlier.
units.italian: Alcuni operai della piazzola ti guidano al punto di atterraggio designato, dove un grande supporto attende l'arrivo del tuo carico speciale. Una volta che il contenitore del satellite è stato agganciato in sicurezza al suo trasportatore, segui il convoglio che scende lentamente lungo un'ampia rampa ed entra nello stesso hangar che ti era stato mostrato prima.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 4|	Gavriil seems enthusiastic. "Fantastic. We have already prepared the machinery delivered from Aventine, so we should be able to start the transfer right now," they sign, gesturing toward four contraptions - each about as large as a closet. "I hope your journey went well."|4727|0
units.english: Gavriil seems enthusiastic. "Fantastic. We have already prepared the machinery delivered from Aventine, so we should be able to start the transfer right now," they sign, gesturing toward four contraptions - each about as large as a closet. "I hope your journey went well."
units.italian: Gavriil sembra entusiasta. "Fantastico. Abbiamo già preparato i macchinari arrivati da Aventine, quindi dovremmo poter iniziare il trasferimento subito," accenna, gesticolando verso quattro congegni, ognuno grosso all'incirca come un armadio. "Spero che il viaggio sia andato bene."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 4|	"About as well as a mission in the middle of the Graveyard can go."|4729|0
units.english: "About as well as a mission in the middle of the Graveyard can go."
units.italian: "Il meglio che una missione in mezzo al Cimitero possa andare."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 4|	"It could have gone better."|4730|0
units.english: "It could have gone better."
units.italian: "Poteva andare meglio."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 4|	"I will make sure to reward you appropriately once this is said and done," they reply. Behind them, two technicians climb atop a scaffolding and take a closer look at the satellite you brought with you. "One of the challenges with these kinds of artifacts is not only their alien origins, but also the era in which they were designed.|4731|0
units.english: "I will make sure to reward you appropriately once this is said and done," they reply. Behind them, two technicians climb atop a scaffolding and take a closer look at the satellite you brought with you. "One of the challenges with these kinds of artifacts is not only their alien origins, but also the era in which they were designed.
units.italian: "Mi assicurerò di ricompensarti adeguatamente quando tutto sarà finito," risponde. Dietro di lui, due tecnici salgono su un'impalcatura e danno un'occhiata più da vicino al satellite che hai portato. "Una delle difficoltà con questi manufatti non è solo la loro origine aliena, ma anche l'epoca in cui sono stati progettati.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 4|	"The Builder empire lasted for tens of millennia; their technological level varied wildly during this time, and the remains of one era are often incompatible with the remains of previous eras. We have done our best to date this spacecraft, so this is the moment of truth."|4732|0
units.english: "The Builder empire lasted for tens of millennia; their technological level varied wildly during this time, and the remains of one era are often incompatible with the remains of previous eras. We have done our best to date this spacecraft, so this is the moment of truth."
units.italian: "L'impero dei Costruttori è durato decine di millenni; il loro livello tecnologico è variato enormemente nel tempo, e i resti di un'epoca sono spesso incompatibili con quelli delle epoche precedenti. Abbiamo fatto del nostro meglio per datare questo veicolo, quindi questo è il momento della verità."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 4|	A technician carefully hands a wide cable to the two atop the platform, who move toward the captured satellite and try to insert the cord into an opening on its back.|4733|0
units.english: A technician carefully hands a wide cable to the two atop the platform, who move toward the captured satellite and try to insert the cord into an opening on its back.
units.italian: Un tecnico porge con cura un largo cavo ai due sull'impalcatura, che si avvicinano al satellite catturato e cercano di inserirlo in un'apertura sul retro.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 4|	It takes a few attempts, but at last they succeed. While you can't quite see what one technician is signing from the control console, it must be great news, judging from the cheer that erupts soon after. "The transfer has started!" Gavriil gestures in celebration. They rush toward the terminals at the back of the hangar, almost in disbelief.|4734|0
units.english: It takes a few attempts, but at last they succeed. While you can't quite see what one technician is signing from the control console, it must be great news, judging from the cheer that erupts soon after. "The transfer has started!" Gavriil gestures in celebration. They rush toward the terminals at the back of the hangar, almost in disbelief.
units.italian: Ci vogliono alcuni tentativi, ma alla fine ci riescono. Anche se non riesci a vedere bene cosa stia accennando un tecnico dalla console di controllo, devono essere ottime notizie, a giudicare dall'esultanza che scoppia poco dopo. "Il trasferimento è iniziato!" gesticola Gavriil in festa. Si precipita verso i terminali in fondo all'hangar, quasi incredulo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 4|	The excitement only slightly wears off as the hours pass, the sheer amount of data taken from the spacecraft boosting it again and again. Finally, Gavriil comes back to you with anticipation. "The transfer is mostly complete by now, and the analysis will soon begin. If you are ready, this would be a good time to return to Ssil Vida - it will take days before any result is ready."|4735|0
units.english: The excitement only slightly wears off as the hours pass, the sheer amount of data taken from the spacecraft boosting it again and again. Finally, Gavriil comes back to you with anticipation. "The transfer is mostly complete by now, and the analysis will soon begin. If you are ready, this would be a good time to return to Ssil Vida - it will take days before any result is ready."
units.italian: L'eccitazione cala solo leggermente col passare delle ore, e la quantità enorme di dati presi dal veicolo la ravviva più e più volte. Alla fine, Gavriil torna da te con trepidazione. "Il trasferimento è ormai in gran parte completo, e l'analisi inizierà presto. Se sei pronto, questo sarebbe un buon momento per tornare a Ssil Vida; passeranno giorni prima che qualche risultato sia pronto."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|name|4740|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Torna su <planet>

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|description|4741|0
units.english: Return to <destination> to get some new equipment.
units.italian: Torna su <destination> per procurarti un nuovo equipaggiamento.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|log|4747|0
units.english: Captured an active Builder satellite. It was a warning beacon orbiting the moon Alix, which appears to have been used as a quarantine site to defend against an alien plague.
units.italian: Ho catturato un satellite attivo dei Costruttori. Era un faro di avvertimento in orbita attorno alla luna Alix, che sembra essere stata usata come sito di quarantena per difendersi da una peste aliena.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|During the trip, Gavriil has received a constant stream of communications, either from Kumkapi or Ssil Vida. They walk alongside you out of the airlock and down the ramp, silent but clearly thoughtful.|4750|0
units.english: During the trip, Gavriil has received a constant stream of communications, either from Kumkapi or Ssil Vida. They walk alongside you out of the airlock and down the ramp, silent but clearly thoughtful.
units.italian: Durante il viaggio, Gavriil ha ricevuto un flusso continuo di comunicazioni, da Kumkapi o da Ssil Vida. Cammina accanto a te fuori dalla camera di equilibrio e giù per la rampa, silenzioso ma chiaramente pensieroso.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|	"Thank you for this, Captain - not just for ferrying me back, but also for making this little adventure possible in the first place. There is still much to discover about the Builders and their civilization, and I am happy to have contributed to this puzzle at least a tiny bit.|4751|0
units.english: "Thank you for this, Captain - not just for ferrying me back, but also for making this little adventure possible in the first place. There is still much to discover about the Builders and their civilization, and I am happy to have contributed to this puzzle at least a tiny bit.
units.italian: "Grazie per questo, capitano, non solo per avermi riportato, ma anche per aver reso possibile questa piccola avventura. C'è ancora molto da scoprire sui Costruttori e sulla loro civiltà, e sono felice di aver contribuito almeno un pochino a questo puzzle.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|	"One of the key events in order to understand their history is the first contacts they had with what for them would be alien species. As it often happens, the first one was with the peaceful Quarg, but there is at least another encounter we know of that did not go nearly as well.|4752|0
units.english: "One of the key events in order to understand their history is the first contacts they had with what for them would be alien species. As it often happens, the first one was with the peaceful Quarg, but there is at least another encounter we know of that did not go nearly as well.
units.italian: "Uno degli eventi chiave per capire la loro storia sono i primi contatti che ebbero con quelle che per loro erano specie aliene. Come spesso accade, il primo fu con i pacifici Quarg, ma c'è almeno un altro incontro che conosciamo e che non andò affatto bene.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|	"We do not know whether it was an actual invasion attempt or just an explorer that did not react well under pressure, but the two species fought, and the Builders only won after multiple days of fighting. The militarization of Builder society started at the same time."|4753|0
units.english: "We do not know whether it was an actual invasion attempt or just an explorer that did not react well under pressure, but the two species fought, and the Builders only won after multiple days of fighting. The militarization of Builder society started at the same time."
units.italian: "Non sappiamo se fu un vero tentativo di invasione o solo un esploratore che reagì male sotto pressione, ma le due specie combatterono, e i Costruttori vinsero solo dopo giorni di scontri. La militarizzazione della società dei Costruttori iniziò nello stesso periodo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|	"What species were they attacked by?" you ask.|4754|0
units.english: "What species were they attacked by?" you ask.
units.italian: "Da quali specie furono attaccati?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|	"We cannot say for certain. From what I understand, no alien remains were found during the past Graveyard expeditions - other than Builder ones, naturally. However, an interstellar species does not just disappear without leaving any trace, and there are only a small number of candidates who fit the bill."|4755|0
units.english: "We cannot say for certain. From what I understand, no alien remains were found during the past Graveyard expeditions - other than Builder ones, naturally. However, an interstellar species does not just disappear without leaving any trace, and there are only a small number of candidates who fit the bill."
units.italian: "Non possiamo dirlo con certezza. Da quello che ho capito, nessun resto alieno è stato trovato durante le spedizioni passate nel Cimitero, a parte quelli dei Costruttori, naturalmente. Tuttavia una specie interstellare non sparisce senza lasciare traccia, e i candidati che corrispondono sono pochi."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|	"The Korath?"|4757|0
units.english: "The Korath?"
units.italian: "I Korath?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|	"The Hai?"|4759|0
units.english: "The Hai?"
units.italian: "Gli Hai?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|	"The Pug?"|4760|0
units.english: "The Pug?"
units.italian: "I Pug?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|	"The Sheragi?"|4764|0
units.english: "The Sheragi?"
units.italian: "Gli Sheragi?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|	"A good guess. Both the Hai and the Sheragi would make sense - the timeline fits well enough, they were known to be quite belligerent, and their potential reach was large enough to include the Graveyard. I heard there are great debates about the two species going on to this day, especially after the discoveries in Ssil Vida, but I am not the person to ask about them.|4767|0
units.english: "A good guess. Both the Hai and the Sheragi would make sense - the timeline fits well enough, they were known to be quite belligerent, and their potential reach was large enough to include the Graveyard. I heard there are great debates about the two species going on to this day, especially after the discoveries in Ssil Vida, but I am not the person to ask about them.
units.italian: "Buona ipotesi. Sia gli Hai sia gli Sheragi avrebbero senso: la cronologia torna abbastanza, erano noti per essere piuttosto bellicosi, e la loro portata potenziale era abbastanza ampia da includere il Cimitero. Ho sentito che su queste due specie ci sono grandi dibattiti ancora oggi, soprattutto dopo le scoperte a Ssil Vida, ma non sono la persona giusta a cui chiedere.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|	"Interesting guess. We do know that they used to have a presence in this area at some point, but there is no use in speculating about their purposes with so little information, especially when there are more likely candidates. Either the Hai or the Sheragi would make more sense - the timeline fits well enough, they were known to be quite belligerent, and their potential reach was large enough to include the Graveyard.|4770|0
units.english: "Interesting guess. We do know that they used to have a presence in this area at some point, but there is no use in speculating about their purposes with so little information, especially when there are more likely candidates. Either the Hai or the Sheragi would make more sense - the timeline fits well enough, they were known to be quite belligerent, and their potential reach was large enough to include the Graveyard.
units.italian: "Ipotesi interessante. Sappiamo che un tempo avevano una presenza in questa zona, ma non serve speculare sui loro scopi con così poche informazioni, soprattutto quando ci sono candidati più probabili. Sia gli Hai sia gli Sheragi avrebbero più senso: la cronologia torna abbastanza, erano noti per essere piuttosto bellicosi, e la loro portata potenziale era abbastanza ampia da includere il Cimitero.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|	"Not this time," they sign, amused. "More time has passed between the end of the Builders and the Korath's discovery of spaceflight than it has between the latter and now. Keep it in mind that we are talking about something that happened perhaps a hundred thousand years ago. In this context, either the Hai or the Sheragi would make more sense - the timeline fits well enough, they were known to be quite belligerent, and their potential reach was large enough to include the Graveyard.|4773|0
units.english: "Not this time," they sign, amused. "More time has passed between the end of the Builders and the Korath's discovery of spaceflight than it has between the latter and now. Keep it in mind that we are talking about something that happened perhaps a hundred thousand years ago. In this context, either the Hai or the Sheragi would make more sense - the timeline fits well enough, they were known to be quite belligerent, and their potential reach was large enough to include the Graveyard.
units.italian: "Non questa volta," accenna divertito. "Tra la fine dei Costruttori e la scoperta del volo spaziale da parte dei Korath è passato più tempo di quanto ne sia passato tra quest'ultima e oggi. Tieni presente che stiamo parlando di qualcosa accaduto forse centomila anni fa. In questo contesto, sia gli Hai sia gli Sheragi avrebbero più senso: la cronologia torna abbastanza, erano noti per essere piuttosto bellicosi, e la loro portata potenziale era abbastanza ampia da includere il Cimitero.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|	"Whatever happened, the scars left by this short encounter were not merely psychological. What this satellite shows is that some kind of virus or bacteria started spreading soon after the first contact, possibly of alien origin. We do not know the impact it had on their civilization, but it must have been quite severe: Alix appears to have been used as a quarantine facility at the time, and satellites like this had the sole function of warning incoming ships of the danger.|4775|0
units.english: "Whatever happened, the scars left by this short encounter were not merely psychological. What this satellite shows is that some kind of virus or bacteria started spreading soon after the first contact, possibly of alien origin. We do not know the impact it had on their civilization, but it must have been quite severe: Alix appears to have been used as a quarantine facility at the time, and satellites like this had the sole function of warning incoming ships of the danger.
units.italian: "Qualunque cosa sia successa, le cicatrici lasciate da questo breve incontro non furono solo psicologiche. Quello che questo satellite mostra è che qualche virus o batterio cominciò a diffondersi poco dopo il primo contatto, probabilmente di origine aliena. Non sappiamo l'impatto che ebbe sulla loro civiltà, ma deve essere stato piuttosto grave: Alix sembra essere stata usata come struttura di quarantena in quel periodo, e satelliti come questo avevano l'unica funzione di avvertire le navi in arrivo del pericolo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|	"If you find anything else, do not hesitate to tell us. The analysis is still ongoing, but I have been able to spare 300,000 credits to deposit on your account to show our gratitude."|4776|0
units.english: "If you find anything else, do not hesitate to tell us. The analysis is still ongoing, but I have been able to spare 300,000 credits to deposit on your account to show our gratitude."
units.italian: "Se trovi qualcos'altro, non esitare a dircelo. L'analisi è ancora in corso, ma sono riuscito a mettere da parte 300.000 crediti da depositare sul tuo conto per mostrarti la nostra gratitudine."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|	"You can keep the money. I would rather continue exploring further."|4778|0
units.english: "You can keep the money. I would rather continue exploring further."
units.italian: "Puoi tenerti i soldi. Preferirei continuare a esplorare."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|	"Who are the Sheragi?"|4780|0
units.english: "Who are the Sheragi?"
units.italian: "Chi sono gli Sheragi?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|	"Thank you."|4783|0
units.english: "Thank you."
units.italian: "Grazie."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|	"You might not have heard the name, but you have certainly been into their territory. They are a long extinct species, once inhabiting what has become the Rim and the South of human space. The same area where, not too long ago, you got the material we are currently using to power Ssil Vida," they reply, making a gesture in the direction of the station's reactor.|4787|0
units.english: "You might not have heard the name, but you have certainly been into their territory. They are a long extinct species, once inhabiting what has become the Rim and the South of human space. The same area where, not too long ago, you got the material we are currently using to power Ssil Vida," they reply, making a gesture in the direction of the station's reactor.
units.italian: "Forse non ne avrai sentito il nome, ma di certo sei stato nel loro territorio. Sono una specie estinta da molto tempo, che un tempo abitava quella che è diventata la fascia del Bordo e il Sud dello spazio umano. La stessa zona dove, non molto tempo fa, hai preso il materiale che stiamo usando per alimentare Ssil Vida," risponde, con un gesto verso il reattore della stazione.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|	"I can tell you that, as far as we know, they were roughly concurrent with the Builders; but this is the wealth of information I learnt during the work in Postverta. It is a continuously evolving field, and I have not been able to follow it closely beyond the engineering research on this station."|4788|0
units.english: "I can tell you that, as far as we know, they were roughly concurrent with the Builders; but this is the wealth of information I learnt during the work in Postverta. It is a continuously evolving field, and I have not been able to follow it closely beyond the engineering research on this station."
units.italian: "Posso dirti che, per quanto ne sappiamo, erano grosso modo contemporanei dei Costruttori; ma questa è la ricchezza di informazioni che ho imparato durante il lavoro a Postverta. È un campo in continua evoluzione, e non sono riuscito a seguirlo da vicino oltre la ricerca ingegneristica su questa stazione."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|	"You can keep the money. I would rather continue exploring further."|4790|0
units.english: "You can keep the money. I would rather continue exploring further."
units.italian: "Puoi tenerti i soldi. Preferirei continuare a esplorare."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|	"Thank you."|4791|0
units.english: "Thank you."
units.italian: "Grazie."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|	"Oh. Fascinating." They seem quite pleased by your reply. "Well, in that case, I could try calling Kumkapi again to see if they have something you could help them with. I have a lot to catch up with, but I will try to get back to you as soon as I hear from them."|4794|0
units.english: "Oh. Fascinating." They seem quite pleased by your reply. "Well, in that case, I could try calling Kumkapi again to see if they have something you could help them with. I have a lot to catch up with, but I will try to get back to you as soon as I hear from them."
units.italian: "Oh. Affascinante." Sembra molto soddisfatto della tua risposta. "Beh, in tal caso potrei provare a chiamare di nuovo Kumkapi per vedere se hanno qualcosa in cui potresti aiutarli. Ho molto da recuperare, ma cercherò di ricontattarti appena avrò loro notizie."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|	You wait for Gavriil for nearly an hour, but they don't show up again. Just before leaving, you notice they sent you a communication on your datapad. "<first>," it reads, "I won't be able to meet up with you again today. I apologize for the impoliteness, but there is just too much I need to catch up with in order to keep the project on target.|4795|0
units.english: You wait for Gavriil for nearly an hour, but they don't show up again. Just before leaving, you notice they sent you a communication on your datapad. "<first>," it reads, "I won't be able to meet up with you again today. I apologize for the impoliteness, but there is just too much I need to catch up with in order to keep the project on target.
units.italian: Aspetti Gavriil per quasi un'ora, ma non si fa più vedere. Poco prima di partire, noti che ti ha inviato una comunicazione sul tablet. "<first>," si legge, "non riuscirò a incontrarti di nuovo oggi. Mi scuso per la scortesia, ma ho davvero troppo da recuperare per tenere il progetto in linea.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|	"Nevertheless, I was able to get in contact with the test range, and they seemed happy to get more help. I won't be able to come with you this time, but if you follow the same indications I gave you last time you should have no problems finding them.|4796|0
units.english: "Nevertheless, I was able to get in contact with the test range, and they seemed happy to get more help. I won't be able to come with you this time, but if you follow the same indications I gave you last time you should have no problems finding them.
units.italian: "Tuttavia sono riuscito a mettermi in contatto con il poligono di prova, e sembravano felici di avere altro aiuto. Questa volta non potrò venire con te, ma se segui le stesse indicazioni che ti ho dato l'ultima volta non dovresti avere problemi a trovarli.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|	"Farewell, Captain, and may the Embers guide you back soon."|4797|0
units.english: "Farewell, Captain, and may the Embers guide you back soon."
units.italian: "Addio, capitano, e che le Braci ti guidino presto al ritorno."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 5|	"Farewell, Captain, and may the Embers guide you back soon," they gesture with a short bow.|4803|0
units.english: "Farewell, Captain, and may the Embers guide you back soon," they gesture with a short bow.
units.italian: "Addio, capitano, e che le Braci ti guidino presto al ritorno," gesticola con un breve inchino.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|name|4808|0
units.english: Explore <stopovers>
units.italian: Esplora <stopovers>

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|description|4809|0
units.english: Visit <stopovers> to search for the remains of the quarantine facility.
units.italian: Visita <stopovers> per cercare i resti della struttura di quarantena.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|blocked|4810|0
units.english: The cargo is ready to load, but you do not have enough free space. Come back when you have <tons> of empty cargo space.
units.italian: Il carico è pronto da caricare, ma non hai abbastanza spazio libero. Torna quando avrai <tons> di spazio libero nella stiva.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|<planet> looks far more active than it was just a few days ago. There is a Remnant ship on almost every landing pad close to the outpost, and there are even a couple Albatrosses in the middle of the sitting fleet. Luckily, you find a pad reserved for your arrival next to the main entrance.|4818|0
units.english: <planet> looks far more active than it was just a few days ago. There is a Remnant ship on almost every landing pad close to the outpost, and there are even a couple Albatrosses in the middle of the sitting fleet. Luckily, you find a pad reserved for your arrival next to the main entrance.
units.italian: <planet> sembra molto più attivo di appena qualche giorno fa. C'è un veicolo Remnant su quasi ogni piazzola vicino all'avamposto, e ci sono persino un paio di Albatross in mezzo alla flotta ferma. Per fortuna trovi una piazzola riservata al tuo arrivo accanto all'ingresso principale.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	Before you have even reached the bottom of your ship's stairway, a group of locals has gathered below your ship with anticipation. You attempt to salute them, but they seem to be more interested in your ship: a few of them pry open a panel near your cargo bay, trying to connect with the payload controls.|4819|0
units.english: Before you have even reached the bottom of your ship's stairway, a group of locals has gathered below your ship with anticipation. You attempt to salute them, but they seem to be more interested in your ship: a few of them pry open a panel near your cargo bay, trying to connect with the payload controls.
units.italian: Prima ancora che tu abbia raggiunto il fondo della scaletta della nave, un gruppo di locali si è radunato sotto la nave con aspettativa. Cerchi di salutarli, ma sembrano più interessati alla tua nave: alcuni aprono con forza un pannello vicino alla stiva, cercando di collegarsi ai comandi del carico.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	You try to ask for explanations, but they direct you toward the pad manager. Finally, after spending what feels like an hour trying to make your way through the crowd, you find her handling the loading operations at the back of a Merganser.|4820|0
units.english: You try to ask for explanations, but they direct you toward the pad manager. Finally, after spending what feels like an hour trying to make your way through the crowd, you find her handling the loading operations at the back of a Merganser.
units.italian: Cerchi di chiedere spiegazioni, ma ti indirizzano verso la responsabile della piazzola. Alla fine, dopo aver passato quella che sembra un'ora a farti largo tra la folla, la trovi che gestisce le operazioni di carico sul retro di un Merganser.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	(Ask her about my mission.)|4822|0
units.english: (Ask her about my mission.)
units.italian: (Chiedile della mia missione.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	"What are they doing with my ship?"|4823|0
units.english: "What are they doing with my ship?"
units.italian: "Che cosa stanno facendo alla mia nave?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	"It seems there must have been some miscommunications along the way," she signs in reply to your queries. "Sorry, but we have not had anything close to this amount of traffic for at least the past thirty years. We cannot afford to waste even a single minute right now.|4824|0
units.english: "It seems there must have been some miscommunications along the way," she signs in reply to your queries. "Sorry, but we have not had anything close to this amount of traffic for at least the past thirty years. We cannot afford to waste even a single minute right now.
units.italian: "Deve esserci stato qualche fraintendimento lungo la strada," accenna in risposta alle tue domande. "Scusa, ma non abbiamo avuto nulla di neanche lontanamente simile a questo traffico negli ultimi trent'anni. Al momento non possiamo permetterci di perdere nemmeno un minuto.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	"Ever since someone brought us that satellite a few days ago," she continues, seemingly oblivious about who you are, "there have been a constant stream of captains wanting to take a look at it and do all kinds of analysis. We are not staffed for this kind of traffic, not even close."|4825|0
units.english: "Ever since someone brought us that satellite a few days ago," she continues, seemingly oblivious about who you are, "there have been a constant stream of captains wanting to take a look at it and do all kinds of analysis. We are not staffed for this kind of traffic, not even close."
units.italian: "Da quando qualcuno ci ha portato quel satellite qualche giorno fa," continua, apparentemente ignara di chi tu sia, "c'è stato un flusso continuo di capitani che vogliono dargli un'occhiata e fare ogni tipo di analisi. Non abbiamo personale per questo tipo di traffico, nemmeno lontanamente."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	You try to inquire further about your mission, but she does not seem to know any more than you do. She redirects you again to the pad, pointing toward the bill of landing attached to the cargo they are mounting on your ship.|4826|0
units.english: You try to inquire further about your mission, but she does not seem to know any more than you do. She redirects you again to the pad, pointing toward the bill of landing attached to the cargo they are mounting on your ship.
units.italian: Cerchi di informarti meglio sulla tua missione, ma lei non sembra saperne più di te. Ti rimanda di nuovo alla piazzola, indicando la bolla di carico allegata al carico che stanno montando sulla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	At last, you find in there the information you needed: your payload is a large penetrating scanner, and your task is to use it just above the surface of <stopovers> in a specified location near the south pole of that moon to try to locate the quarantine facility.|4827|0
units.english: At last, you find in there the information you needed: your payload is a large penetrating scanner, and your task is to use it just above the surface of <stopovers> in a specified location near the south pole of that moon to try to locate the quarantine facility.
units.italian: Alla fine ci trovi le informazioni che ti servivano: il tuo carico è un grande scanner penetrante, e il tuo compito è usarlo appena sopra la superficie di <stopovers>, in un punto specifico vicino al polo sud di quella luna, per cercare di localizzare la struttura di quarantena.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|Unlike many of the moons you have visited in the Ember Waste, nothing about Alix stands out as particularly unique. It is a small, rocky moon orbiting close above the Pathera gas giant, nearly atmosphereless and showing an appropriately low gravity. Its surface is punctuated by millions of small meteoroid impacts, certainly attracted by Pathera's deep gravity well. Even <home planet> had a couple of gas giants with moons in every way similar to this one.|4836|0
units.english: Unlike many of the moons you have visited in the Ember Waste, nothing about Alix stands out as particularly unique. It is a small, rocky moon orbiting close above the Pathera gas giant, nearly atmosphereless and showing an appropriately low gravity. Its surface is punctuated by millions of small meteoroid impacts, certainly attracted by Pathera's deep gravity well. Even <home planet> had a couple of gas giants with moons in every way similar to this one.
units.italian: A differenza di molte lune che hai visitato nella Distesa di Braci, nulla di Alix spicca come particolarmente unico. È una piccola luna rocciosa che orbita vicino sopra il gigante gassoso Pathera, quasi priva di atmosfera e con una gravità adeguatamente bassa. La sua superficie è punteggiata da milioni di piccoli impatti di meteoroidi, di certo attratti dal profondo pozzo gravitazionale di Pathera. Persino <home planet> aveva un paio di giganti gassosi con lune del tutto simili a questa.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	The Builders seem to have found some interesting uses for it, however. Among the destroyed settlements all around Alix, vast mining facilities not only survived the attacks, but still see a constant stream of Ka'mar vehicles coming to gather their mineral cargo and deliver it to the imposing Ka'het station orbiting the same star.|4837|0
units.english: The Builders seem to have found some interesting uses for it, however. Among the destroyed settlements all around Alix, vast mining facilities not only survived the attacks, but still see a constant stream of Ka'mar vehicles coming to gather their mineral cargo and deliver it to the imposing Ka'het station orbiting the same star.
units.italian: I Costruttori sembrano però averne trovato qualche uso interessante. Tra gli insediamenti distrutti attorno ad Alix, vaste strutture minerarie non solo sono sopravvissute agli attacchi, ma vedono ancora un flusso continuo di veicoli Ka'mar che vengono a raccogliere il loro carico minerale e a consegnarlo all'imponente stazione Ka'het in orbita attorno alla stessa stella.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	Strangely enough, this moon does not show any sign of strip mining, or in fact any digging at all. After operating mining facilities for a hundred thousand years, the surface should show clearly visible signs of such an intensive operation, but there seem to be none.|4838|0
units.english: Strangely enough, this moon does not show any sign of strip mining, or in fact any digging at all. After operating mining facilities for a hundred thousand years, the surface should show clearly visible signs of such an intensive operation, but there seem to be none.
units.italian: Stranamente, questa luna non mostra alcun segno di estrazione a cielo aperto, né in realtà di alcuno scavo. Dopo aver gestito strutture minerarie per centomila anni, la superficie dovrebbe mostrare segni chiaramente visibili di un'attività così intensa, ma non sembra essercene alcuno.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	(Fly closer to the mining outposts to investigate.)|4840|0
units.english: (Fly closer to the mining outposts to investigate.)
units.italian: (Volare più vicino agli avamposti minerari per indagare.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	(Move to the target location the Remnant gave me.)|4841|0
units.english: (Move to the target location the Remnant gave me.)
units.italian: (Spostati verso la posizione bersaglio che mi hanno dato i Remnant.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	You pitch down your ship and steer toward the nearest outpost: a long series of short buildings with angled roofs, reminiscent of a solar field in your ship's screen. After coming closer, however, you realize your initial guess was wrong - these are not akin to roofs, but to sails, composed of a pale white textile. A thin layer of dust covers their surface, mostly gathered toward the bottom.|4843|0
units.english: You pitch down your ship and steer toward the nearest outpost: a long series of short buildings with angled roofs, reminiscent of a solar field in your ship's screen. After coming closer, however, you realize your initial guess was wrong - these are not akin to roofs, but to sails, composed of a pale white textile. A thin layer of dust covers their surface, mostly gathered toward the bottom.
units.italian: Inclini la nave verso il basso e sterzi verso l'avamposto più vicino: una lunga serie di edifici bassi con tetti inclinati, che sullo schermo della nave ricordano un campo solare. Avvicinandoti, però, capisci che la tua prima ipotesi era sbagliata: non sono tetti, ma vele, fatte di un tessuto bianco pallido. Uno strato sottile di polvere ne copre la superficie, raccolto soprattutto verso il basso.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	You try to come closer, but the compass on your ship suddenly starts spinning randomly! Alarmed, you swiftly reverse course to move away from the facility, and the instrumentation soon returns to normal again after a reboot. The automated outpost is clearly emitting a strong magnetic field, but the connection among all this isn't immediately obvious.|4844|0
units.english: You try to come closer, but the compass on your ship suddenly starts spinning randomly! Alarmed, you swiftly reverse course to move away from the facility, and the instrumentation soon returns to normal again after a reboot. The automated outpost is clearly emitting a strong magnetic field, but the connection among all this isn't immediately obvious.
units.italian: Cerchi di avvicinarti, ma la bussola della nave comincia all'improvviso a girare a caso! Allarmato, inverti rapidamente la rotta per allontanarti dalla struttura, e la strumentazione torna alla normalità dopo un riavvio. L'avamposto automatizzato emette chiaramente un forte campo magnetico, ma il legame tra tutte queste cose non è immediatamente ovvio.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	(Do a close flyby, even if the compass goes haywire.)|4846|0
units.english: (Do a close flyby, even if the compass goes haywire.)
units.italian: (Fai un sorvolo ravvicinato, anche se la bussola impazzisce.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	(Try to search around the facility, keeping a safe distance.)|4847|0
units.english: (Try to search around the facility, keeping a safe distance.)
units.italian: (Cerca nei dintorni della struttura, mantenendo una distanza di sicurezza.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	(Give up and move to the original target.)|4849|0
units.english: (Give up and move to the original target.)
units.italian: (Rinuncia e vai al bersaglio originale.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	A brief exploration doesn't turn up anything you hadn't already seen earlier, and all you can do is watch as the mesmerizing flow of Faes'mar in and out of the facility continues undisturbed below you.|4851|0
units.english: A brief exploration doesn't turn up anything you hadn't already seen earlier, and all you can do is watch as the mesmerizing flow of Faes'mar in and out of the facility continues undisturbed below you.
units.italian: Una breve esplorazione non rivela nulla che tu non avessi già visto prima, e non puoi fare altro che guardare il flusso ipnotico di Faes'mar che entra ed esce dalla struttura, continuando indisturbato sotto di te.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	Just as you're starting to feel that this mystery will remain unsolved, you have a stroke of luck: a small meteorite hits the surface a few kilometers away from you, throwing a cloud of debris in every direction. You check the composition of the nearly imperceptible atmosphere near the surface, and find it composed almost entirely of precious metal particles.|4853|0
units.english: Just as you're starting to feel that this mystery will remain unsolved, you have a stroke of luck: a small meteorite hits the surface a few kilometers away from you, throwing a cloud of debris in every direction. You check the composition of the nearly imperceptible atmosphere near the surface, and find it composed almost entirely of precious metal particles.
units.italian: Proprio quando cominci a sentire che questo mistero resterà irrisolto, hai un colpo di fortuna: un piccolo meteorite colpisce la superficie a qualche chilometro da te, sollevando una nube di detriti in ogni direzione. Controlli la composizione dell'atmosfera quasi impercettibile vicino alla superficie, e la trovi composta quasi interamente di particelle di metallo prezioso.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	The overall picture has become clearer: the frequent asteroid impacts on a moon like this raise enough meteorite dust to effectively shroud the planet in an extremely sparse atmosphere, which the Builder machines attract and gather so that they can be transported off-planet afterwards. It's a slow and cumbersome process, but it's also one that was able to work for tens of thousands of years without maintenance.|4854|0
units.english: The overall picture has become clearer: the frequent asteroid impacts on a moon like this raise enough meteorite dust to effectively shroud the planet in an extremely sparse atmosphere, which the Builder machines attract and gather so that they can be transported off-planet afterwards. It's a slow and cumbersome process, but it's also one that was able to work for tens of thousands of years without maintenance.
units.italian: Il quadro complessivo si è fatto più chiaro: i frequenti impatti di asteroidi su una luna come questa sollevano abbastanza polvere di meteoriti da avvolgere di fatto il pianeta in un'atmosfera estremamente rarefatta, che le macchine dei Costruttori attirano e raccolgono per poi trasportarla fuori dal pianeta. È un processo lento e macchinoso, ma è anche uno che ha potuto funzionare per decine di migliaia di anni senza manutenzione.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	You record a brief log of your thoughts, and move on to the target location. The mining facilities you see become progressively smaller and more sporadic, until they disappear completely. Flying just above a series of increasingly featureless highlands, you eventually reach your destination: an unremarkable plateau extending for kilometers in every direction.|4856|0
units.english: You record a brief log of your thoughts, and move on to the target location. The mining facilities you see become progressively smaller and more sporadic, until they disappear completely. Flying just above a series of increasingly featureless highlands, you eventually reach your destination: an unremarkable plateau extending for kilometers in every direction.
units.italian: Registri un breve appunto dei tuoi pensieri, e passi alla posizione bersaglio. Le strutture minerarie che vedi diventano progressivamente più piccole e sporadiche, finché non spariscono del tutto. Volando appena sopra una serie di altopiani sempre più privi di tratti distintivi, raggiungi infine la destinazione: un altopiano anonimo che si estende per chilometri in ogni direzione.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	You pitch down and lower your altitude to look for debris, but you're not able to find anything useful. There were many ruins on the way here that could have certainly been a quarantine site at some point, but there's absolutely nothing here, as if it was never even inhabited in the first place.|4857|0
units.english: You pitch down and lower your altitude to look for debris, but you're not able to find anything useful. There were many ruins on the way here that could have certainly been a quarantine site at some point, but there's absolutely nothing here, as if it was never even inhabited in the first place.
units.italian: Inclini la nave e abbassi l'altitudine per cercare detriti, ma non riesci a trovare nulla di utile. C'erano molte rovine sulla via di qui che avrebbero potuto essere un sito di quarantena, ma qui non c'è assolutamente nulla, come se non fosse mai stato abitato.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	Perplexed, you turn your ship around and activate the high-power scanners the Remnant gave you. The task is very tedious: you have to pass over every bit of terrain going at just the right speed, careful not to skew the data with any abrupt movements, so that the instruments can function correctly.|4858|0
units.english: Perplexed, you turn your ship around and activate the high-power scanners the Remnant gave you. The task is very tedious: you have to pass over every bit of terrain going at just the right speed, careful not to skew the data with any abrupt movements, so that the instruments can function correctly.
units.italian: Perplesso, giri la nave e attivi gli scanner ad alta potenza che ti hanno dato i Remnant. Il compito è molto noioso: devi passare sopra ogni pezzo di terreno a una velocità precisa, attento a non falsare i dati con movimenti bruschi, così che gli strumenti possano funzionare correttamente.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	It takes an hour, but a familiar beep from the cockpit panel finally signals you can come back to <destination> to deliver the data.|4859|0
units.english: It takes an hour, but a familiar beep from the cockpit panel finally signals you can come back to <destination> to deliver the data.
units.italian: Ci vuole un'ora, ma alla fine un beep familiare dal pannello della cabina ti segnala che puoi tornare su <destination> per consegnare i dati.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|Unlike your last visit, the testing range on <planet> has become eerily empty once again. Gone are the hectic crowds and the massive fleets occupying every parking spot: the few ships that are still here are rarely bigger than a Petrel. Enticed, you set sight on a random pad in the vicinity of the facility and touch down softly.|4863|0
units.english: Unlike your last visit, the testing range on <planet> has become eerily empty once again. Gone are the hectic crowds and the massive fleets occupying every parking spot: the few ships that are still here are rarely bigger than a Petrel. Enticed, you set sight on a random pad in the vicinity of the facility and touch down softly.
units.italian: A differenza della tua ultima visita, il poligono di prova su <planet> è tornato inquietantemente vuoto. Non ci sono più le folle caotiche e le flotte enormi che occupavano ogni posto di parcheggio: i pochi veicoli ancora presenti sono raramente più grandi di un Petrel. Invogliato, punti una piazzola a caso vicino alla struttura e atterri delicatamente.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	With a datapad in your hand and the pad workers unloading your used mission equipment, you start looking around for someone to deliver the data to. The only people you can find nearby are the ones working on your ship, as well as the pad manager you had met earlier.|4864|0
units.english: With a datapad in your hand and the pad workers unloading your used mission equipment, you start looking around for someone to deliver the data to. The only people you can find nearby are the ones working on your ship, as well as the pad manager you had met earlier.
units.italian: Con un tablet in mano e gli operai della piazzola che scaricano la tua attrezzatura di missione usata, cominci a guardarti intorno in cerca di qualcuno a cui consegnare i dati. Le uniche persone che riesci a trovare nei paraggi sono quelle che lavorano sulla tua nave, oltre alla responsabile della piazzola che avevi incontrato prima.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	"They relented!" she signs excitedly after noticing you. "It took a few days, but they finally accepted that we do not have the facilities nor the personnel to handle such traffic, and moved the satellite to a more appropriate laboratory. Somewhere on Aventine, I believe."|4865|0
units.english: "They relented!" she signs excitedly after noticing you. "It took a few days, but they finally accepted that we do not have the facilities nor the personnel to handle such traffic, and moved the satellite to a more appropriate laboratory. Somewhere on Aventine, I believe."
units.italian: "Hanno ceduto!" accenna eccitata notandoti. "Ci sono voluti qualche giorno, ma alla fine hanno accettato che non abbiamo le strutture né il personale per gestire un traffico del genere, e hanno spostato il satellite in un laboratorio più adatto. Da qualche parte su Aventine, credo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	"Is there someone I can give this data to?"|4867|0
units.english: "Is there someone I can give this data to?"
units.italian: "C'è qualcuno a cui posso dare questi dati?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	"The location you gave me did not seem to have been inhabited."|4868|0
units.english: "The location you gave me did not seem to have been inhabited."
units.italian: "Il luogo che mi hai indicato non sembrava abitato."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	You give her a brief summary of your mission, and of your findings. "I am afraid the people you were supposed to deliver this data to have left together with the satellite," she replies, perplexed. "It has been busy for all of us recently, and some steps were skipped to accelerate the process.|4869|0
units.english: You give her a brief summary of your mission, and of your findings. "I am afraid the people you were supposed to deliver this data to have left together with the satellite," she replies, perplexed. "It has been busy for all of us recently, and some steps were skipped to accelerate the process.
units.italian: Le fai un breve riassunto della tua missione e delle tue scoperte. "Temo che le persone a cui dovevi consegnare questi dati siano partite insieme al satellite," risponde, perplessa. "È stato un periodo intenso per tutti noi di recente, e alcuni passaggi sono stati saltati per accelerare la procedura.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Voice From The Past 6|	"If you leave the datapad here, I promise I will make sure it gets into the right hands.
