I am sure they will contact you themselves after things have calmed down a bit." You hand her the tablet with the info you recorded, hopeful it will reach its destination.|4870|0
units.english: "If you leave the datapad here, I promise I will make sure it gets into the right hands. I am sure they will contact you themselves after things have calmed down a bit." You hand her the tablet with the info you recorded, hopeful it will reach its destination.
units.italian: "Se lasci il tablet qui, prometto che mi assicurerò che arrivi nelle mani giuste. Sono certa che ti contatteranno loro stessi quando le cose si saranno calmate un po'." Le consegni il tablet con le informazioni che hai registrato, sperando che arrivi a destinazione.

units.id: event:ka'het: alix discoveries|add|4876|0
units.english: Long before becoming an automated mining outpost, this moon was designated as a Builder quarantine site.
units.italian: Molto prima di diventare un avamposto minerario automatizzato, questa luna era designata come sito di quarantena dei Costruttori.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 1|name|4882|0
units.english: In the Depths
units.italian: Nelle profondità

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 1|description|4883|0
units.english: Escort a Swan with four modified Terns through a number of gas giants, starting with <destination>.
units.italian: Scorta uno Swan con quattro Tern modificati attraverso diversi giganti gassosi, a cominciare da <destination>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 1|Glancing around the landing zone, you spot two Remnant walking at a fast pace toward your ship; eventually, you recognize them as Taely, still wearing her flight helmet, and Torza. "We have been looking for you, Captain," he begins. He gestures toward the ship they arrived from: a Swan, carrying four Terns below its massive wings. "Have you been in the Graveyard recently?"|4893|0
units.english: Glancing around the landing zone, you spot two Remnant walking at a fast pace toward your ship; eventually, you recognize them as Taely, still wearing her flight helmet, and Torza. "We have been looking for you, Captain," he begins. He gestures toward the ship they arrived from: a Swan, carrying four Terns below its massive wings. "Have you been in the Graveyard recently?"
units.italian: Guardandoti intorno nella zona di atterraggio, scorgi due Remnant che camminano a passo svelto verso la tua nave; alla fine riconosci in loro Taely, ancora con il casco da volo, e Torza. "Ti stavamo cercando, capitano," esordisce lui. Fa un gesto verso la nave da cui sono arrivati: uno Swan, con quattro Tern sotto le sue ali enormi. "Sei stato nel Cimitero di recente?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 1|	The three of you take a seat on a starport bench. Torza seems to be concerned about the amount of data that they possess on the inhabitants in the Graveyard. "Our current surveillance methods are limited," he continues, "especially around the Ka'het. One must stay cloaked at all times in order to survive." Taely intervenes with some technical details - of the compromises between ramscoop requirements and designing for optimal cloaking, and how running them continuously will inevitably clog them over time. While you do not recognize every sign she makes, the exploding motion she makes with her hands makes the consequences clear.|4894|0
units.english: The three of you take a seat on a starport bench. Torza seems to be concerned about the amount of data that they possess on the inhabitants in the Graveyard. "Our current surveillance methods are limited," he continues, "especially around the Ka'het. One must stay cloaked at all times in order to survive." Taely intervenes with some technical details - of the compromises between ramscoop requirements and designing for optimal cloaking, and how running them continuously will inevitably clog them over time. While you do not recognize every sign she makes, the exploding motion she makes with her hands makes the consequences clear.
units.italian: Voi tre vi sedete su una panchina dello spazioporto. Torza sembra preoccupato per la quantità di dati che possiedono sugli abitanti del Cimitero. "I nostri attuali metodi di sorveglianza sono limitati," continua, "soprattutto attorno ai Ka'het. Bisogna restare occultati in ogni momento per sopravvivere." Taely interviene con qualche dettaglio tecnico: dei compromessi tra le esigenze dei ramscoop e la progettazione per un occultamento ottimale, e di come usarli in continuazione finirà inevitabilmente per intasarli col tempo. Anche se non riconosci tutti i suoi segni, il movimento esplosivo che fa con le mani rende chiare le conseguenze.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 1|	"But if we cannot make them undetectable, perhaps we can make them unreachable. We have recently learned how to replicate extremely precise trackers," she states, "enough to record orbital vehicles from deep inside an atmosphere. The idea was raised to take a Tern, mount these optics inside of it, and leave it permanently inside a Graveyard gas giant." Torza indicates again, one by one, the four drones clamped beneath the Swan.|4895|0
units.english: "But if we cannot make them undetectable, perhaps we can make them unreachable. We have recently learned how to replicate extremely precise trackers," she states, "enough to record orbital vehicles from deep inside an atmosphere. The idea was raised to take a Tern, mount these optics inside of it, and leave it permanently inside a Graveyard gas giant." Torza indicates again, one by one, the four drones clamped beneath the Swan.
units.italian: "Ma se non possiamo renderli non rilevabili, forse possiamo renderli irraggiungibili. Di recente abbiamo imparato a replicare localizzatori estremamente precisi," afferma, "abbastanza da registrare veicoli orbitali dal profondo di un'atmosfera. È stata avanzata l'idea di prendere un Tern, montare queste ottiche al suo interno e lasciarlo permanentemente dentro un gigante gassoso del Cimitero." Torza indica di nuovo, uno per uno, i quattro droni agganciati sotto lo Swan.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 1|	"Will that hide them from the Ka'het?"|4897|0
units.english: "Will that hide them from the Ka'het?"
units.italian: "Questo li nasconderà ai Ka'het?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 1|	"Why was that not a concern previously?"|4898|0
units.english: "Why was that not a concern previously?"
units.italian: "Perché non era una preoccupazione prima?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 1|	"Why the Swan? I could carry them on my own."|4900|0
units.english: "Why the Swan? I could carry them on my own."
units.italian: "Perché lo Swan? Potrei portarli io."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 1|	"In our experience, it will not," Torza replies, sharing a somber glance with the other prefect. "But the Ka'het cannot visit gas planets, as far as we can tell. If they study them, they will learn of the Terns, but the ships should be far beyond their reach."|4902|0
units.english: "In our experience, it will not," Torza replies, sharing a somber glance with the other prefect. "But the Ka'het cannot visit gas planets, as far as we can tell. If they study them, they will learn of the Terns, but the ships should be far beyond their reach."
units.italian: "Secondo la nostra esperienza, no," risponde Torza, scambiando uno sguardo cupo con l'altra prefetta. "Ma i Ka'het non possono visitare i pianeti gassosi, per quanto possiamo dire. Se li studieranno, verranno a conoscenza dei Tern, ma i veicoli dovrebbero essere ben oltre la loro portata."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 1|	"It has been a point of concern for decades now." Torza looks slightly miffed by your question. "If this information gap is still unresolved, it is only because our attempts at filling it have failed."|4905|0
units.english: "It has been a point of concern for decades now." Torza looks slightly miffed by your question. "If this information gap is still unresolved, it is only because our attempts at filling it have failed."
units.italian: "È un punto di preoccupazione da decenni ormai." Torza sembra leggermente infastidito dalla tua domanda. "Se questa lacuna informativa è ancora aperta, è solo perché i nostri tentativi di colmarla sono falliti."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 1|	Taely continues the conversation. "We could call it a trial-by-fire, I guess. You might have noticed that neither of our carriers are capable of cloaking. Even if filled with propellant, an Ibis would have to stop, vulnerable, to refuel in the middle of the Graveyard; the Swan is inherently capable of doing the round trip without a ramscoop, using a Scram drive and leaving some fuel for an escort. Which would be you, in this case."|4907|0
units.english: Taely continues the conversation. "We could call it a trial-by-fire, I guess. You might have noticed that neither of our carriers are capable of cloaking. Even if filled with propellant, an Ibis would have to stop, vulnerable, to refuel in the middle of the Graveyard; the Swan is inherently capable of doing the round trip without a ramscoop, using a Scram drive and leaving some fuel for an escort. Which would be you, in this case."
units.italian: Taely riprende la conversazione. "Potremmo chiamarla una prova del fuoco, immagino. Forse avrai notato che nessuno dei nostri vettori è in grado di occultarsi. Anche pieno di propellente, un Ibis dovrebbe fermarsi, vulnerabile, a rifornirsi nel mezzo del Cimitero; lo Swan è per natura in grado di fare andata e ritorno senza ramscoop, usando un motore Scram e lasciando un po' di carburante per una scorta. Che in questo caso saresti tu."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 1|	"I would be happy to."|4909|0
units.english: "I would be happy to."
units.italian: "Ne sarei felice."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 1|	"Sorry, but I am too busy right now."|4910|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I am too busy right now."
units.italian: "Scusa, ma al momento sono troppo impegnata."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 1|	"Make sure to use a gaslined ship," she reminds you. "Your first target will be in <system>, on the opposite edge of the Ember Waste. The Graveyard is host to gas giants strangely different from the ones here; only <planet> is similar enough for us to trial it before entering the battlefield."|4912|0
units.english: "Make sure to use a gaslined ship," she reminds you. "Your first target will be in <system>, on the opposite edge of the Ember Waste. The Graveyard is host to gas giants strangely different from the ones here; only <planet> is similar enough for us to trial it before entering the battlefield."
units.italian: "Assicurati di usare una nave adatta all'atmosfera," ti ricorda. "Il tuo primo bersaglio sarà in <system>, sul bordo opposto della Distesa di Braci. Il Cimitero ospita giganti gassosi stranamente diversi da quelli di qui; solo <planet> è abbastanza simile da permetterci di provarlo prima di entrare nel campo di battaglia."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 1|	"Be careful with our Swan," adds Torza. "It is meant to support a fleet in combat, not win a one-on-one fight. If you encounter trouble, better use some of its fuel reserves to jump somewhere else."|4913|0
units.english: "Be careful with our Swan," adds Torza. "It is meant to support a fleet in combat, not win a one-on-one fight. If you encounter trouble, better use some of its fuel reserves to jump somewhere else."
units.italian: "Stai attento al nostro Swan," aggiunge Torza. "È pensato per supportare una flotta in combattimento, non per vincere uno scontro uno contro uno. Se incontri guai, meglio usare parte delle sue riserve di carburante per saltare altrove."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 1|dialog|4924|0
units.english: Once the Swan reaches the outskirts of the atmosphere, a Tern drops from its wing and plunges into the depth of the gas giant. The captain of the Swan shares updates through the radio, and once it reaches an equilibrium, your map updates with your next stop. It is time to enter the Graveyard: the destination is Antamesa in the Polerius system.
units.italian: Una volta che lo Swan raggiunge i margini dell'atmosfera, un Tern cade dalla sua ala e si tuffa nel profondo del gigante gassoso. Il capitano dello Swan condivide aggiornamenti alla radio, e quando raggiunge un equilibrio la tua mappa si aggiorna con la prossima tappa. È ora di entrare nel Cimitero: la destinazione è Antamesa nel sistema Polerius.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 2|name|4928|0
units.english: In the deep
units.italian: Nel profondo

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 2|description|4929|0
units.english: Enter the Graveyard to leave a second Tern in <destination>.
units.italian: Entra nel Cimitero per lasciare un secondo Tern in <destination>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 2|dialog|4942|0
units.english: The second Tern detaches from the Swan. You follow it as it falls: slowly, you see it turn upside down as a number of barrel-shaped instruments emerge from its belly. Once a set of what you presume to be antennae pop out of its aft, the map places the next target on Baliesa in the Gerenus system.
units.italian: Il secondo Tern si stacca dallo Swan. Lo segui mentre cade: lentamente, lo vedi capovolgersi mentre una serie di strumenti a forma di botte emerge dalla sua pancia. Quando un gruppo di quelli che supponi essere antenne esce dalla parte posteriore, la mappa segna il prossimo bersaglio su Baliesa, nel sistema Gerenus.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 3|name|4946|0
units.english: In the deep
units.italian: Nel profondo

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 3|description|4947|0
units.english: Reach <destination> with the Swan to deploy the third Tern.
units.italian: Raggiungi <destination> con lo Swan per schierare il terzo Tern.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 3|dialog|4967|0
units.english: Another Tern drops from its mothership, falling through the bright clouds. Some of the orbiting debris enters the atmosphere around the same time, leaving streaks of plasma around the trail of the Tern. While you gaze at the spectacle, the map signals you the next stop - Meligara, part of the Ritilas system.
units.italian: Un altro Tern cade dalla nave madre, precipitando tra le nuvole luminose. Parte dei detriti in orbita entra nell'atmosfera nello stesso momento, lasciando strisce di plasma attorno alla scia del Tern. Mentre guardi lo spettacolo, la mappa ti segnala la prossima tappa: Meligara, nel sistema Ritilas.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 4|name|4971|0
units.english: In the deep
units.italian: Nel profondo

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 4|description|4972|0
units.english: Bring the Swan with the final Tern to <destination>.
units.italian: Porta lo Swan con l'ultimo Tern su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 4|dialog|4983|0
units.english: While the final Tern disappears beyond your sight, you receive a message from the Swan captain. With this task complete, she asks you to escort them to Seraglio - a small planet of the Arculus system - before you part ways. When you inquire further, she simply states that they have been assigned there next.
units.italian: Mentre l'ultimo Tern sparisce oltre la tua vista, ricevi un messaggio dal capitano dello Swan. Completato questo compito, ti chiede di scortarli fino a Seraglio, un piccolo pianeta del sistema Arculus, prima di separarvi. Quando chiedi di più, dice semplicemente che sono stati assegnati lì come prossima tappa.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 5|name|4987|0
units.english: In the deep
units.italian: Nel profondo

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 5|description|4988|0
units.english: Escort the Swan and its crew to <destination> to conclude the mission.
units.italian: Scorta lo Swan e il suo equipaggio fino a <destination> per concludere la missione.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 5|Despite having entered the relative safety of the Remnant cluster, the now-empty Swan silently stays on your wing during the descent. As you fly in the direction of the equator, the ice fields below you leave space for some patches of peculiar, deep red terrain. Occasionally, a dark Remnant outpost adorns the scene, surrounded by a perfect circle of melted ice. Far too small, and moving far too fast below you, to make out any detail.|5001|0
units.english: Despite having entered the relative safety of the Remnant cluster, the now-empty Swan silently stays on your wing during the descent. As you fly in the direction of the equator, the ice fields below you leave space for some patches of peculiar, deep red terrain. Occasionally, a dark Remnant outpost adorns the scene, surrounded by a perfect circle of melted ice. Far too small, and moving far too fast below you, to make out any detail.
units.italian: Nonostante sia entrato nella relativa sicurezza dell'ammasso dei Remnant, lo Swan ormai vuoto resta silenziosamente sulla tua ala durante la discesa. Mentre voli in direzione dell'equatore, i campi di ghiaccio sotto di te lasciano spazio a qualche chiazza di terreno peculiare, di un rosso profondo. Ogni tanto un avamposto Remnant scuro adorna la scena, circondato da un cerchio perfetto di ghiaccio sciolto. Troppo piccolo, e troppo veloce sotto di te, per distinguerne alcun dettaglio.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 5|	You start to decelerate near your destination, but the Swan passes in front of you without appearing to slow down. Only when it is right above the target - another outpost, seemingly identical to every other one around here - it finally pitches up its nose, flexing its wings to maintain the balance and rotating its nose at the same time. If it is really less "alive" than other recent Remnant vehicles, you are having a hard time finding differences.|5002|0
units.english: You start to decelerate near your destination, but the Swan passes in front of you without appearing to slow down. Only when it is right above the target - another outpost, seemingly identical to every other one around here - it finally pitches up its nose, flexing its wings to maintain the balance and rotating its nose at the same time. If it is really less "alive" than other recent Remnant vehicles, you are having a hard time finding differences.
units.italian: Cominci a decelerare vicino alla destinazione, ma lo Swan ti passa davanti senza sembrare rallentare. Solo quando è proprio sopra il bersaglio, un altro avamposto apparentemente identico a tutti gli altri qui intorno, alza finalmente il muso, flette le ali per mantenere l'equilibrio e ruota il muso nello stesso momento. Se è davvero meno 'vivo' degli altri veicoli recenti dei Remnant, fai fatica a trovare le differenze.""

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 5|	"Thanks for the company, Captain," buzzes your radio. "We can handle this from here; logistics should authorize a payment shortly. May the Embers guide your efforts."|5003|0
units.english: "Thanks for the company, Captain," buzzes your radio. "We can handle this from here; logistics should authorize a payment shortly. May the Embers guide your efforts."
units.italian: "Grazie per la compagnia, capitano," ronza la radio. "Da qui possiamo gestire noi; la logistica dovrebbe autorizzare un pagamento a breve. Che le Braci guidino i tuoi sforzi."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 5|	"What is your mission here?"|5005|0
units.english: "What is your mission here?"
units.italian: "Qual è la vostra missione qui?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 5|	(Return the farewell.)|5007|0
units.english: (Return the farewell.)
units.italian: (Ricambia il saluto.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 5|	"What should I do now?"|5009|0
units.english: "What should I do now?"
units.italian: "Che cosa dovrei fare adesso?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 5|	A cheerful chant comes out of your radio. It speaks of the unpredictability of life, of the endless paths one may find, and of a hidden purpose unknown to us all. At least three or four voices complement each other, increasing further when the subject changes to the need to take action and not let life slide off you.|5010|0
units.english: A cheerful chant comes out of your radio. It speaks of the unpredictability of life, of the endless paths one may find, and of a hidden purpose unknown to us all. At least three or four voices complement each other, increasing further when the subject changes to the need to take action and not let life slide off you.
units.italian: Dalla radio esce un canto allegro. Parla dell'imprevedibilità della vita, degli infiniti sentieri che si possono trovare, e di uno scopo nascosto ignoto a tutti noi. Almeno tre o quattro voci si completano a vicenda, crescendo ancora quando il tema passa alla necessità di agire e di non lasciarsi scivolare via la vita.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 5|	After a few minutes, you infer that they do not know about your mission, and you go your own way. Soon enough, the screen informs you of a transfer of <payment> from Remnant Logistics coupled with a short message of appreciation.|5011|0
units.english: After a few minutes, you infer that they do not know about your mission, and you go your own way. Soon enough, the screen informs you of a transfer of <payment> from Remnant Logistics coupled with a short message of appreciation.
units.italian: Dopo qualche minuto deduci che non conoscono la tua missione, e vai per la tua strada. Presto lo schermo ti informa di un trasferimento di <payment> dalla Logistica Remnant, accompagnato da un breve messaggio di ringraziamento.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 5|	You are surprised to hear a loud, triumphant chant come out of your radio. It describes the bliss of finding life in unexpected places, beyond what one would consider possible. While the chorus has a very pleasing rhythm, you are oblivious to most of the events described in the song, excluding the discovery of past life in the Sol system.|5014|0
units.english: You are surprised to hear a loud, triumphant chant come out of your radio. It describes the bliss of finding life in unexpected places, beyond what one would consider possible. While the chorus has a very pleasing rhythm, you are oblivious to most of the events described in the song, excluding the discovery of past life in the Sol system.
units.italian: Resti sorpreso nel sentire un canto forte e trionfale uscire dalla radio. Descrive la gioia di trovare vita in luoghi inattesi, oltre ciò che si riterrebbe possibile. Anche se il coro ha un ritmo molto piacevole, gran parte degli eventi descritti nella canzone ti sfugge, esclusa la scoperta di vita passata nel sistema Sol.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Cloud Probe 5|	By the time the song comes to an end, the Swan has completed the landing, and a flexible, puffy-looking tube is injecting a colorless liquid into its wings. You bid the crew farewell and go your own way. Soon enough, the screen in front of you informs you of the transfer of <payment> from Remnant Logistics, coupled with a short message of appreciation.|5015|0
units.english: By the time the song comes to an end, the Swan has completed the landing, and a flexible, puffy-looking tube is injecting a colorless liquid into its wings. You bid the crew farewell and go your own way. Soon enough, the screen in front of you informs you of the transfer of <payment> from Remnant Logistics, coupled with a short message of appreciation.
units.italian: Quando la canzone finisce, lo Swan ha completato l'atterraggio, e un tubo flessibile dall'aspetto gonfio inietta un liquido incolore nelle sue ali. Saluti l'equipaggio e vai per la tua strada. Presto lo schermo davanti a te ti informa del trasferimento di <payment> dalla Logistica Remnant, accompagnato da un breve messaggio di ringraziamento.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 1|name|5022|0
units.english: Hear from Taely on <planet>
units.italian: Ascolta Taely su <planet>

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 1|description|5023|0
units.english: Taely has asked you to meet with her on <destination>. There appears to be some trouble with their gaslining probes.
units.italian: Taely ti ha chiesto di incontrarla su <destination>. Sembra ci siano problemi con le loro sonde per l'atmosfera.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 1|dialog|5032|0
units.english: To your surprise, you hear your commlink chirping once again. It is a message from Taely, asking you to meet up with her in <planet>'s starport as soon as you can. Though she does not specify the reason, the subject of the communication reads "Gas probe trouble."
units.italian: Con tua sorpresa, senti il communicatore cinguettare di nuovo. È un messaggio di Taely, che ti chiede di incontrarla nello spazioporto di <planet> il prima possibile. Anche se non specifica il motivo, l'oggetto della comunicazione recita "Problemi con la sonda atmosferica."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 1|"We have made a grave mistake," Taely begins, stepping into the <ship>'s hatch. When she turns around, you notice a large, swollen leathery mass peeking from behind her neck, almost like an unworn hood. You realize that her movements are slightly jittery, though barely enough to be perceivable. "I am glad you were in this region already, <first>, because we need to act. Evidently, somewhere in our construction process - or even in the design - something slipped beyond our watch."|5035|0
units.english: "We have made a grave mistake," Taely begins, stepping into the <ship>'s hatch. When she turns around, you notice a large, swollen leathery mass peeking from behind her neck, almost like an unworn hood. You realize that her movements are slightly jittery, though barely enough to be perceivable. "I am glad you were in this region already, <first>, because we need to act. Evidently, somewhere in our construction process - or even in the design - something slipped beyond our watch."
units.italian: "Abbiamo fatto un grave errore," esordisce Taely, entrando nel portello della <ship>. Quando si volta, noti una grande massa carnosa e gonfia che fa capolino dietro il suo collo, quasi come un cappuccio non indossato. Ti accorgi che i suoi movimenti sono leggermente a scatti, anche se a malapena percettibile. "Sono contenta che fossi già in questa regione, <first>, perché dobbiamo agire. Evidentemente, da qualche parte nel nostro processo di costruzione, o persino nel progetto, qualcosa è sfuggito alla nostra sorveglianza."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 1|	"What do you mean?"|5037|0
units.english: "What do you mean?"
units.italian: "Che cosa intendi dire?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 1|	"Did the Ka'het notice the Tern probes?"|5039|0
units.english: "Did the Ka'het notice the Tern probes?"
units.italian: "I Ka'het hanno notato le sonde Tern?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 1|	"Are you okay?"|5040|0
units.english: "Are you okay?"
units.italian: "Stai bene?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 1|	"If they have, it is not a problem right now. I fear the only damage our vessels have incurred was caused by us, rather than the Ka'het."|5042|0
units.english: "If they have, it is not a problem right now. I fear the only damage our vessels have incurred was caused by us, rather than the Ka'het."
units.italian: "Se lo hanno fatto, non è un problema adesso. Temo che l'unico danno subito dai nostri veicoli sia stato causato da noi, non dai Ka'het."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 1|	"Ah, fairly well," she replies with a hint of perplexity. "Given the issues with the mission, we are all making best use of our flexible hours. More than usual, I admit, but it is a necessity right now."|5045|0
units.english: "Ah, fairly well," she replies with a hint of perplexity. "Given the issues with the mission, we are all making best use of our flexible hours. More than usual, I admit, but it is a necessity right now."
units.italian: "Ah, abbastanza bene," risponde con un pizzico di perplessità. "Visti i problemi con la missione, stiamo tutti sfruttando al meglio le nostre ore flessibili. Più del solito, ammetto, ma al momento è una necessità."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 1|	"What do you mean by flexible hours?" you ask.|5046|0
units.english: "What do you mean by flexible hours?" you ask.
units.italian: "Che cosa intendi con ore flessibili?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 1|	"Sleeping hours." She puts her hand on the back of her head, almost instinctively, before explaining. "One of the more common benefits of our symbionts is the capacity to control better our sleep cycle. Once one stays awake for longer than expected by the circadian rhythm, their body starts having an excess of a number of chemicals, and a deficit of others. Our symbionts are capable of storing the former and administering the latter, at least for a time; then, at the right moment, the process is reversed and we go through the entire sleep we had put off for the previous days.|5047|0
units.english: "Sleeping hours." She puts her hand on the back of her head, almost instinctively, before explaining. "One of the more common benefits of our symbionts is the capacity to control better our sleep cycle. Once one stays awake for longer than expected by the circadian rhythm, their body starts having an excess of a number of chemicals, and a deficit of others. Our symbionts are capable of storing the former and administering the latter, at least for a time; then, at the right moment, the process is reversed and we go through the entire sleep we had put off for the previous days.
units.italian: "Le ore di sonno." Si mette la mano dietro la testa, quasi istintivamente, prima di spiegare. "Uno dei benefici più comuni dei nostri simbionti è la capacità di controllare meglio il ciclo del sonno. Quando si resta svegli più a lungo di quanto il ritmo circadiano preveda, il corpo comincia ad avere un eccesso di alcune sostanze chimiche e una carenza di altre. I nostri simbionti sono in grado di immagazzinare le prime e somministrare le seconde, almeno per un po'; poi, al momento giusto, il processo si inverte e recuperiamo tutto il sonno che avevamo rimandato nei giorni precedenti.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 1|	"This has multiple uses. As in this case, we can stay awake for as long as it takes for an emergency to get under control without excess fatigue. Alternatively, we can use it to adapt to different planets, where the length of the day-night cycle is sometimes wildly different. I recall from your records that there are medicines used for similar purpose, but we prefer this approach. Though," she smiles, "I have been told that it can give a tendency to digress."|5048|0
units.english: "This has multiple uses. As in this case, we can stay awake for as long as it takes for an emergency to get under control without excess fatigue. Alternatively, we can use it to adapt to different planets, where the length of the day-night cycle is sometimes wildly different. I recall from your records that there are medicines used for similar purpose, but we prefer this approach. Though," she smiles, "I have been told that it can give a tendency to digress."
units.italian: "Questo ha molti usi. Come in questo caso, possiamo restare svegli per tutto il tempo necessario a mettere sotto controllo un'emergenza senza stanchezza eccessiva. In alternativa, possiamo usarlo per adattarci a pianeti diversi, dove talvolta la durata del ciclo giorno-notte è molto diversa. Ricordo dai vostri archivi che ci sono medicine usate per scopi simili, ma noi preferiamo questo approccio. Anche se," sorride, "mi hanno detto che può dare una tendenza a divagare."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 1|	Taely walks toward one of your screens, eventually making it show the data of one of the Terns you recently deployed. "Ever since the first ion storm, the probe stationed in Meligara has become useless. Every tracker returns vast amounts of noise, so much that it is impossible to distinguish a Ka'het in that mess. If, as we suspect, there is a gap in its ion shielding, it is only a matter of time until we lose it. Today marks the fifth day we have spent trying to identify the issue."|5050|0
units.english: Taely walks toward one of your screens, eventually making it show the data of one of the Terns you recently deployed. "Ever since the first ion storm, the probe stationed in Meligara has become useless. Every tracker returns vast amounts of noise, so much that it is impossible to distinguish a Ka'het in that mess. If, as we suspect, there is a gap in its ion shielding, it is only a matter of time until we lose it. Today marks the fifth day we have spent trying to identify the issue."
units.italian: Taely cammina verso uno dei tuoi schermi, finendo per mostrare i dati di uno dei Tern che hai schierato di recente. "Dalla prima tempesta ionica, la sonda di stanza a Meligara è diventata inutile. Ogni localizzatore restituisce enormi quantità di rumore, tanto che è impossibile distinguere un Ka'het in quel caos. Se, come sospettiamo, c'è una falla nella sua schermatura ionica, è solo questione di tempo prima di perderlo. Oggi è il quinto giorno che passiamo cercando di identificare il problema."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 1|	She starts tracing lines by hand around a few sections of the Tern. "Each of these areas could be the cause of the problem. If you dissect these parts with your equipment, we should, at least, prevent the other probes from falling to the same issue."|5051|0
units.english: She starts tracing lines by hand around a few sections of the Tern. "Each of these areas could be the cause of the problem. If you dissect these parts with your equipment, we should, at least, prevent the other probes from falling to the same issue."
units.italian: Comincia a tracciare linee a mano attorno ad alcune sezioni del Tern. "Ognuna di queste aree potrebbe essere la causa del problema. Se sezioni queste parti con la tua attrezzatura, dovremmo almeno impedire che le altre sonde cadano nello stesso problema."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 1|	"Is there any chance of saving this Tern?"|5053|0
units.english: "Is there any chance of saving this Tern?"
units.italian: "C'è qualche possibilità di salvare questo Tern?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 1|	"How do I do that?"|5054|0
units.english: "How do I do that?"
units.italian: "Come faccio?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 1|	"Maybe. If it is still able to float in the atmosphere after you are done with it, it might be able to survive through a few more storms before its avionics arc and short-circuit."|5056|0
units.english: "Maybe. If it is still able to float in the atmosphere after you are done with it, it might be able to survive through a few more storms before its avionics arc and short-circuit."
units.italian: "Forse. Se dopo che avrai finito è ancora in grado di galleggiare nell'atmosfera, potrebbe sopravvivere a qualche altra tempesta prima che l'elettronica si bruci e vada in cortocircuito."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 1|	She hands you a checklist. "I have written down a simple enough sampling procedure for the ion shielding. Still, you will have to send it a command to climb once you are in the system - at the altitude it is staying now, the winds would leave you no chance of rendezvous. And be quick: we cannot know for how long that poor Tern can keep it together in this state."|5058|0
units.english: She hands you a checklist. "I have written down a simple enough sampling procedure for the ion shielding. Still, you will have to send it a command to climb once you are in the system - at the altitude it is staying now, the winds would leave you no chance of rendezvous. And be quick: we cannot know for how long that poor Tern can keep it together in this state."
units.italian: Ti consegna una lista di controllo. "Ho scritto una procedura di campionamento abbastanza semplice per la schermatura ionica. Tuttavia dovrai inviargli un comando per farlo salire una volta nel sistema: all'altitudine a cui si trova ora, i venti non ti lascerebbero alcuna possibilità di incontrarlo. E sbrigati: non possiamo sapere per quanto tempo quel povero Tern riuscirà a reggere in questo stato."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 2|name|5062|0
units.english: Check out the probe in <system>
units.italian: Controlla la sonda in <system>

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 2|description|5063|0
units.english: Return to <destination> to take samples from the Tern stationed there.
units.italian: Torna su <destination> per prendere campioni dal Tern di stanza lì.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 2|Sitting atop the cloud layer, it takes you a dozen attempts before your signal finally reaches the Tern through the chaotic atmosphere. Far above, the violet swirl of the wormhole peeks just above the horizon. You wait for the probe to rise through the darkness.|5078|0
units.english: Sitting atop the cloud layer, it takes you a dozen attempts before your signal finally reaches the Tern through the chaotic atmosphere. Far above, the violet swirl of the wormhole peeks just above the horizon. You wait for the probe to rise through the darkness.
units.italian: Seduto sopra lo strato di nuvole, ti servono una dozzina di tentativi prima che il tuo segnale raggiunga finalmente il Tern attraverso l'atmosfera caotica. Molto più in alto, il vortice viola del cunicolo fa capolino appena sopra l'orizzonte. Aspetti che la sonda risalga attraverso l'oscurità.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 2|	The vehicle appears upside down, its barrels independently pointing somewhere in the sky. Just as you try an approach, an impressive gust nearly smashes you against the Tern. At the last second its systems take over, swooshing it away from the impact trajectory. Eventually, you can start going through the tasks Taely gave you.|5079|0
units.english: The vehicle appears upside down, its barrels independently pointing somewhere in the sky. Just as you try an approach, an impressive gust nearly smashes you against the Tern. At the last second its systems take over, swooshing it away from the impact trajectory. Eventually, you can start going through the tasks Taely gave you.
units.italian: Il veicolo appare capovolto, con le sue botti che puntano indipendentemente verso un punto qualsiasi del cielo. Proprio mentre provi un avvicinamento, una raffica impressionante ti sbatte quasi contro il Tern. All'ultimo secondo i suoi sistemi prendono il controllo, sospingendolo via dalla traiettoria d'impatto. Alla fine puoi cominciare i compiti che Taely ti ha dato.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 2|	(Use the opportunity to take a closer look at its sensor array.)|5081|0
units.english: (Use the opportunity to take a closer look at its sensor array.)
units.italian: (Cogli l'occasione per dare un'occhiata più da vicino al suo array di sensori.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 2|	(Go through the checklist and leave.)|5082|0
units.english: (Go through the checklist and leave.)
units.italian: (Segui la lista di controllo e vai.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 2|	The belly of the Tern is adorned with hundreds of small electronic boxes, slightly different from one another but all showing a clear Remnant origin. The dozen or so larger instruments are more interesting. It takes you a while to find an appropriate descriptor of their design language; eventually, you have to settle on "suspiciously Korath-like."|5084|0
units.english: The belly of the Tern is adorned with hundreds of small electronic boxes, slightly different from one another but all showing a clear Remnant origin. The dozen or so larger instruments are more interesting. It takes you a while to find an appropriate descriptor of their design language; eventually, you have to settle on "suspiciously Korath-like."
units.italian: La pancia del Tern è adornata con centinaia di piccole scatole elettroniche, leggermente diverse l'una dall'altra ma tutte di chiara origine Remnant. La dozzina circa di strumenti più grandi è più interessante. Ti serve un po' per trovare una descrizione adeguata del loro linguaggio progettuale; alla fine devi accontentarti di "sospettosamente simile ai Korath".

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 2|	Though Taely's handwriting turns out to be uniquely hard to understand, you make it to the end, eventually. A cracking sound from the hull signals to you that an ion storm is starting. After a brief moment, you decide to leave the Tern to its fate and watch what happens. You spot tiny blue sparkles all around the atmosphere, briefly illuminating the dark scene. Deep below you, far brighter bolts are barely visible through the clouds. Among them a dark, solid outline suddenly becomes visible.|5086|0
units.english: Though Taely's handwriting turns out to be uniquely hard to understand, you make it to the end, eventually. A cracking sound from the hull signals to you that an ion storm is starting. After a brief moment, you decide to leave the Tern to its fate and watch what happens. You spot tiny blue sparkles all around the atmosphere, briefly illuminating the dark scene. Deep below you, far brighter bolts are barely visible through the clouds. Among them a dark, solid outline suddenly becomes visible.
units.italian: Anche se la calligrafia di Taely si rivela particolarmente difficile da capire, alla fine arrivi in fondo. Un suono di crepitio dallo scafo ti segnala che sta iniziando una tempesta ionica. Dopo un breve momento, decidi di lasciare il Tern al suo destino e guardare cosa succede. Scorgi minuscole scintille blu attorno all'atmosfera, che illuminano brevemente la scena buia. Molto sotto di te, fulmini assai più luminosi sono a malapena visibili tra le nuvole. Tra essi appare all'improvviso un contorno scuro e solido.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 2|	Your ship's tracker starts whining a desperate whistle. Thousands of signals appear in a matter of seconds, beyond the range of your radar. Their communication is garbled, but your ship tentatively classifies it as "Builder." As the storm rages on, you notice on one of your screens the tracking data from the Tern: the pattern of what the Remnant classified as noise is remarkably similar to that of the signals now reaching you.|5087|0
units.english: Your ship's tracker starts whining a desperate whistle. Thousands of signals appear in a matter of seconds, beyond the range of your radar. Their communication is garbled, but your ship tentatively classifies it as "Builder." As the storm rages on, you notice on one of your screens the tracking data from the Tern: the pattern of what the Remnant classified as noise is remarkably similar to that of the signals now reaching you.
units.italian: Il localizzatore della nave comincia a emettere un fischio disperato. Migliaia di segnali appaiono in pochi secondi, oltre la portata del tuo radar. La loro comunicazione è distorta, ma la nave la classifica prudentemente come "Costruttori". Mentre la tempesta infuria, noti su uno dei tuoi schermi i dati di tracciamento del Tern: lo schema di quello che i Remnant hanno classificato come rumore è notevolmente simile a quello dei segnali che ti arrivano ora.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 2|	(Staying was a bad idea. Move out and return to Remnant space.)|5089|0
units.english: (Staying was a bad idea. Move out and return to Remnant space.)
units.italian: (Restare è stata una cattiva idea. Muoviti e torna nello spazio dei Remnant.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 2|	(Wait for the storm to end, then leave.)|5091|0
units.english: (Wait for the storm to end, then leave.)
units.italian: (Aspetta che la tempesta finisca, poi parti.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 2|	(Investigate further.)|5093|0
units.english: (Investigate further.)
units.italian: (Indaga più a fondo.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 2|	A chaotic mix of winds hits the <ship> on the way down, forcing continuous corrections to the descent trajectory. You count three distinct lightning bolts hitting you during these maneuvers, seemingly without ill effects. By the time you are within visual range of one of the mysterious craft, the air is changing so rapidly that the maneuvering engines are essentially always active.|5094|0
units.english: A chaotic mix of winds hits the <ship> on the way down, forcing continuous corrections to the descent trajectory. You count three distinct lightning bolts hitting you during these maneuvers, seemingly without ill effects. By the time you are within visual range of one of the mysterious craft, the air is changing so rapidly that the maneuvering engines are essentially always active.
units.italian: Una miscela caotica di venti colpisce la <ship> durante la discesa, costringendo a correzioni continue della traiettoria. Conti tre fulmini distinti che ti colpiscono durante queste manovre, apparentemente senza effetti negativi. Quando sei a portata visiva di uno dei misteriosi veicoli, l'aria cambia così rapidamente che i motori di manovra sono praticamente sempre attivi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 2|	The incessant lightning flashes allow you to snap a few low-quality pictures of the strange machine. What appears to be a large balloon sits at the top, its surface often broken up by smaller spikes. A number of tethers hang below it, each holding up machinery of unclear design.|5095|0
units.english: The incessant lightning flashes allow you to snap a few low-quality pictures of the strange machine. What appears to be a large balloon sits at the top, its surface often broken up by smaller spikes. A number of tethers hang below it, each holding up machinery of unclear design.
units.italian: I lampi incessanti ti permettono di scattare qualche foto di bassa qualità della strana macchina. Quella che sembra una grande mongolfiera sta in cima, con la superficie spesso interrotta da punte più piccole. Sotto di essa pendono numerosi cavi, ognuno dei quali regge macchinari dal design poco chiaro.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 2|	(Wait for the storm to end, then leave.)|5097|0
units.english: (Wait for the storm to end, then leave.)
units.italian: (Aspetta che la tempesta finisca, poi parti.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 2|	(Try to snatch some parts of it.)|5099|0
units.english: (Try to snatch some parts of it.)
units.italian: (Prova a strapparne qualche pezzo.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 2|	Tremendous gusts move you and your target in every direction, more than once almost sending you into a spin. The first time you get close to it, another current arrives to split you apart. The same happens a second, and a third time. At last, on the fourth attempted approach, the air throws the vessel right into the nose of your ship, crashing before you get the chance to react. Instantly, the balloon pops, and what is left of the machine plunges into the depths of the gas giant.|5100|0
units.english: Tremendous gusts move you and your target in every direction, more than once almost sending you into a spin. The first time you get close to it, another current arrives to split you apart. The same happens a second, and a third time. At last, on the fourth attempted approach, the air throws the vessel right into the nose of your ship, crashing before you get the chance to react. Instantly, the balloon pops, and what is left of the machine plunges into the depths of the gas giant.
units.italian: Raffiche tremende spostano te e il tuo bersaglio in ogni direzione, più di una volta quasi mandandoti in vite. La prima volta che ti avvicini, un'altra corrente arriva a separarvi. Lo stesso accade una seconda e una terza volta. Alla fine, al quarto tentativo di avvicinamento, l'aria scaglia il veicolo proprio contro il muso della tua nave, che si schianta prima che tu possa reagire. All'istante la mongolfiera scoppia, e quello che resta della macchina precipita nelle profondità del gigante gassoso.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 2|	While your ship climbs back toward orbit, you detect a Ka'het attempting to make some runs into the high atmosphere of the gas giant. Though it never descends below the upper layers, it seems to be trying to find a way to reach the Tern.|5102|0
units.english: While your ship climbs back toward orbit, you detect a Ka'het attempting to make some runs into the high atmosphere of the gas giant. Though it never descends below the upper layers, it seems to be trying to find a way to reach the Tern.
units.italian: Mentre la nave risale verso l'orbita, rilevi un Ka'het che tenta qualche incursione nell'alta atmosfera del gigante gassoso. Anche se non scende mai sotto gli strati superiori, sembra cercare un modo per raggiungere il Tern.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 3|name|5106|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Torna su <planet>

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 3|description|5107|0
units.english: Bring your discoveries back to the Remnant on <destination>.
units.italian: Riporta le tue scoperte ai Remnant su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 3|Just as you begin to go through the post-landing checks, a light on the console informs you that Taely has already climbed into the cargo bay. Another light soon indicates that she has opened the mission storage; she seems to have finished going through what you have gathered by the time you reach her.|5114|0
units.english: Just as you begin to go through the post-landing checks, a light on the console informs you that Taely has already climbed into the cargo bay. Another light soon indicates that she has opened the mission storage; she seems to have finished going through what you have gathered by the time you reach her.
units.italian: Proprio mentre cominci i controlli post-atterraggio, una spia sulla console ti informa che Taely è già salita nella stiva. Un'altra spia indica presto che ha aperto il deposito della missione; quando la raggiungi, sembra aver già finito di esaminare quello che hai raccolto.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 3|	"This is odd," she signs. "We were sure one or more of these samples would show signs of damage, but, as far as I can tell, the shielding is applied correctly enough. Right now, I have a hard time theorizing what is actually happening."|5115|0
units.english: "This is odd," she signs. "We were sure one or more of these samples would show signs of damage, but, as far as I can tell, the shielding is applied correctly enough. Right now, I have a hard time theorizing what is actually happening."
units.italian: "Questo è strano," accenna. "Eravamo certi che uno o più di questi campioni mostrassero segni di danneggiamento, ma per quanto posso dire la schermatura è applicata in modo abbastanza corretto. Al momento faccio fatica a teorizzare cosa stia succedendo davvero."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 3|	(Tell her about your encounter.)|5117|0
units.english: (Tell her about your encounter.)
units.italian: (Racconta loro del tuo incontro.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 3|	As you go on recounting your mission, she looks happy to learn that there is nothing wrong with the probes themselves. Once your tale is almost over, however, her eyes light up. "Are you sure that these vehicles only showed up in the tracker during the ion storm? No sign at all of their presence before then?" You nod, after thinking for a couple seconds. "Very curious."|5118|0
units.english: As you go on recounting your mission, she looks happy to learn that there is nothing wrong with the probes themselves. Once your tale is almost over, however, her eyes light up. "Are you sure that these vehicles only showed up in the tracker during the ion storm? No sign at all of their presence before then?" You nod, after thinking for a couple seconds. "Very curious."
units.italian: Mentre continui a raccontare la missione, sembra felice di sapere che le sonde non hanno nulla che non va. Quando il racconto è quasi finito, però, i suoi occhi si illuminano. "Sei sicuro che questi veicoli siano comparsi sul localizzatore solo durante la tempesta ionica? Nessun segno della loro presenza prima?" Annuisci, dopo aver riflettuto un paio di secondi. "Molto curioso."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 3|	She takes out her commlink to type something down. "I am going to need the tracking data your ship recorded in Meligara, <first>. Perhaps your flight logs, too."|5119|0
units.english: She takes out her commlink to type something down. "I am going to need the tracking data your ship recorded in Meligara, <first>. Perhaps your flight logs, too."
units.italian: Tira fuori il communicatore per annotare qualcosa. "Mi serviranno i dati di tracciamento registrati dalla tua nave a Meligara, <first>. Forse anche i registri di volo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 3|	"What is so special about appearing during the ion storm?"|5121|0
units.english: "What is so special about appearing during the ion storm?"
units.italian: "Che cosa c'è di speciale nel comparire durante la tempesta ionica?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 3|	"What are you planning?"|5122|0
units.english: "What are you planning?"
units.italian: "Che cosa hai in mente?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 3|	"There are two reasons I can think of that would make a probe start talking during a storm," she replies. "One is that it is about to run out of energy and wants to call home, which is possible. But there is also a particular piece of technology which could cause this - a generator that captures useful energy from the ion storm. We believe the Builders possessed it, though we have found no hard evidence yet." She steps down into the spaceport, seemingly looking for someone.|5123|0
units.english: "There are two reasons I can think of that would make a probe start talking during a storm," she replies. "One is that it is about to run out of energy and wants to call home, which is possible. But there is also a particular piece of technology which could cause this - a generator that captures useful energy from the ion storm. We believe the Builders possessed it, though we have found no hard evidence yet." She steps down into the spaceport, seemingly looking for someone.
units.italian: "Ci sono due motivi che mi vengono in mente per cui una sonda comincia a parlare durante una tempesta," risponde. "Uno è che stia per esaurire l'energia e voglia chiamare casa, il che è possibile. Ma c'è anche una particolare tecnologia che potrebbe causarlo: un generatore che cattura energia utile dalla tempesta ionica. Crediamo che i Costruttori la possedessero, anche se non ne abbiamo ancora prove concrete." Scende nello spazioporto, apparentemente in cerca di qualcuno.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 3|	"Why do you believe that?" you ask, following her.|5124|0
units.english: "Why do you believe that?" you ask, following her.
units.italian: "Perché lo credete?" chiedi, seguendola.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 3|	"Hundreds of sizable military hold points were once stationed in every Builder system. Though they have long become worthless debris, if that, we found and translated some of their inventory. Understanding an extinct, alien language is only reliable up to a point, of course. All the more reason to capture one of those Builder crafts."|5125|0
units.english: "Hundreds of sizable military hold points were once stationed in every Builder system. Though they have long become worthless debris, if that, we found and translated some of their inventory. Understanding an extinct, alien language is only reliable up to a point, of course. All the more reason to capture one of those Builder crafts."
units.italian: "Centinaia di consistenti punti di appoggio militare erano un tempo di stanza in ogni sistema dei Costruttori. Anche se sono diventati da tempo detriti senza valore, se non peggio, abbiamo trovato e tradotto parte del loro inventario. Capire una lingua aliena estinta è affidabile solo fino a un certo punto, naturalmente. Motivo in più per catturare uno di quei veicoli dei Costruttori."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 3|	She calls the attention of a spaceport worker to ask for a list of expected traffic. She quickly scrolls through the datapad, then turns to you again. "I can ready two Peregrines in the spaceport in a few hours with a soft capture kit. Offhand, I do not believe we can outfit them with quite enough propellant for a round trip to Meligara - at least, not without stopping to ramscoop in the Graveyard. A Swan tanker should solve this, however." After some more napkin math, she signs that she has to go now to be ready in time.|5126|0
units.english: She calls the attention of a spaceport worker to ask for a list of expected traffic. She quickly scrolls through the datapad, then turns to you again. "I can ready two Peregrines in the spaceport in a few hours with a soft capture kit. Offhand, I do not believe we can outfit them with quite enough propellant for a round trip to Meligara - at least, not without stopping to ramscoop in the Graveyard. A Swan tanker should solve this, however." After some more napkin math, she signs that she has to go now to be ready in time.
units.italian: Attira l'attenzione di un operaio dello spazioporto per chiedere una lista del traffico previsto. Scorre rapidamente il tablet, poi si volta di nuovo verso di te. "Posso preparare due Peregrine nello spazioporto in qualche ora con un kit di cattura morbida. A naso, non credo che possiamo equipaggiarle con abbastanza propellente per un viaggio di andata e ritorno fino a Meligara, almeno non senza fermarsi a raccogliere con i ramscoop nel Cimitero. Una cisterna Swan dovrebbe risolvere il problema, però." Dopo qualche altro calcolo a mente, accenna che deve andare ora per essere pronta in tempo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 3|	"See you in a few hours then."|5128|0
units.english: "See you in a few hours then."
units.italian: "Allora ci vediamo tra qualche ora."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 3|	"What about your own probes?"|5130|0
units.english: "What about your own probes?"
units.italian: "E le vostre sonde?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 3|	"Well," she replies with some trepidation, "they seem to be fine, after all. If nothing new comes up, we can just leave them be on their own mission."|5131|0
units.english: "Well," she replies with some trepidation, "they seem to be fine, after all. If nothing new comes up, we can just leave them be on their own mission."
units.italian: "Beh," risponde con una certa trepidazione, "a quanto pare stanno bene, dopotutto. Se non emerge nulla di nuovo, possiamo semplicemente lasciarle alla loro missione."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 4A|name|5134|0
units.english: Builder balloon
units.italian: Mongolfiera dei Costruttori

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 4A|description|5135|0
units.english: Escort the Remnant to <destination> to try to capture at least one of the Builder probes deep inside the gas giant.
units.italian: Scorta i Remnant fino a <destination> per provare a catturare almeno una delle sonde dei Costruttori nel profondo del gigante gassoso.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 4A|At the time you arrive, the fleet appears to be made only of two ships - a Peregrine, the back of which is encased in a confusingly high amount of scaffolding, and a Swan. You are almost hit by a Remnant descending on a rope; once you take a few steps back and glance around, you notice the temporary structure has an extensive pulley system, letting them move easily between different floors. You find Taely busy managing the rest of the Peregrine team.|5143|0
units.english: At the time you arrive, the fleet appears to be made only of two ships - a Peregrine, the back of which is encased in a confusingly high amount of scaffolding, and a Swan. You are almost hit by a Remnant descending on a rope; once you take a few steps back and glance around, you notice the temporary structure has an extensive pulley system, letting them move easily between different floors. You find Taely busy managing the rest of the Peregrine team.
units.italian: Quando arrivi, la flotta sembra composta solo da due navi: un Peregrine, il cui retro è rivestito di un'impalcatura confusamente alta, e uno Swan. Vieni quasi colpito da un Remnant che scende con una corda; dopo esserti fatto un paio di passi indietro e aver guardato intorno, noti che la struttura temporanea ha un ampio sistema di pulegge, che permette loro di muoversi facilmente tra i vari piani. Trovi Taely impegnata a gestire il resto della squadra del Peregrine.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 4A|	"<first>, we are almost ready to go," she signs at last. "After searching through the thousands of Builder probes in your data, we found a few which have drifted into a calmer part of <planet>'s atmosphere. 'Calmer' is relative, but it should be enough for our tools to capture it." Another Remnant calls for her attention, and you gather she has to return to the preparations. "The other Peregrine will return from her previous mission in a matter of seconds now, already equipped for the job. Are you ready, <first>?"|5144|0
units.english: "<first>, we are almost ready to go," she signs at last. "After searching through the thousands of Builder probes in your data, we found a few which have drifted into a calmer part of <planet>'s atmosphere. 'Calmer' is relative, but it should be enough for our tools to capture it." Another Remnant calls for her attention, and you gather she has to return to the preparations. "The other Peregrine will return from her previous mission in a matter of seconds now, already equipped for the job. Are you ready, <first>?"
units.italian: "<first>, siamo quasi pronti a partire," accenna infine. "Dopo aver cercato tra le migliaia di sonde dei Costruttori nei tuoi dati, ne abbiamo trovate alcune che sono andate alla deriva in una parte più calma dell'atmosfera di <planet>. 'Calma' è un termine relativo, ma dovrebbe bastare perché i nostri strumenti la catturino." Un altro Remnant la chiama, e capisci che deve tornare ai preparativi. "L'altro Peregrine tornerà dalla sua missione precedente in pochi secondi, già equipaggiato per il lavoro. Sei pronto, <first>?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 4A|	"Of course."|5146|0
units.english: "Of course."
units.italian: "Certo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 4A|	"What kind of job was the Peregrine on to require such equipment?"|5148|0
units.english: "What kind of job was the Peregrine on to require such equipment?"
units.italian: "Che tipo di missione richiedeva un equipaggiamento del genere al Peregrine?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 4A|	"Just some scouting in a few nearby systems," she replies, appearing a bit amused. "Best to focus on our own mission for now. Give us just a few more minutes, and then we can begin."|5149|0
units.english: "Just some scouting in a few nearby systems," she replies, appearing a bit amused. "Best to focus on our own mission for now. Give us just a few more minutes, and then we can begin."
units.italian: "Solo un po' di ricognizione in alcuni sistemi vicini," risponde, sembrando un po' divertita. "Meglio concentrarci sulla nostra missione, per ora. Dacci solo qualche altro minuto, e poi possiamo cominciare."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|name|5186|0
units.english: Builder technology to <planet>
units.italian: Tecnologia dei Costruttori su <planet>

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|description|5187|0
units.english: Escort the Remnant ships back to <destination> with the hardware taken from the Builder gas probe.
units.italian: Scorta le navi dei Remnant fino a <destination> con l'hardware prelevato dalla sonda atmosferica dei Costruttori.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|The fleet's descent into the upper atmosphere of Meligara is accompanied at a short distance by a raging Ka'het. The pressure eventually forces it to abandon the pursuit, as expected, and the Swan follows suit shortly after.|5202|0
units.english: The fleet's descent into the upper atmosphere of Meligara is accompanied at a short distance by a raging Ka'het. The pressure eventually forces it to abandon the pursuit, as expected, and the Swan follows suit shortly after.
units.italian: La discesa della flotta nell'alta atmosfera di Meligara è accompagnata a breve distanza da un Ka'het furioso. La pressione alla fine lo costringe ad abbandonare l'inseguimento, come previsto, e lo Swan fa lo stesso poco dopo.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|	Gusts only somewhat less violent than the ones you encountered previously surround the Builder vehicle. You notice that the chosen probe is still in the same area as the Tern, though higher in the atmosphere.|5203|0
units.english: Gusts only somewhat less violent than the ones you encountered previously surround the Builder vehicle. You notice that the chosen probe is still in the same area as the Tern, though higher in the atmosphere.
units.italian: Raffiche solo un po' meno violente di quelle che hai incontrato prima circondano il veicolo dei Costruttori. Noti che la sonda scelta è ancora nella stessa area del Tern, anche se più in alto nell'atmosfera.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|	Before the capture can begin, however, your attention is caught by a dot on your radar screen. A new object is falling at high speed through the atmosphere, showing a cross section far smaller than that of a spacecraft. It appears to be steering roughly in the direction of the Tern.|5205|0
units.english: Before the capture can begin, however, your attention is caught by a dot on your radar screen. A new object is falling at high speed through the atmosphere, showing a cross section far smaller than that of a spacecraft. It appears to be steering roughly in the direction of the Tern.
units.italian: Prima che la cattura possa iniziare, però, la tua attenzione viene catturata da un punto sullo schermo radar. Un nuovo oggetto sta cadendo ad alta velocità attraverso l'atmosfera, con una sezione trasversale molto più piccola di quella di un veicolo spaziale. Sembra dirigersi grosso modo verso il Tern.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|	"Is that one of yours?"|5207|0
units.english: "Is that one of yours?"
units.italian: "È uno dei vostri?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|	(Warm up my weapons.)|5208|0
units.english: (Warm up my weapons.)
units.italian: (Scalda le mie armi.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|	Right as the object disappears, a three-letter message finally reaches you through the radio: "EMP"|5209|0
units.english: Right as the object disappears, a three-letter message finally reaches you through the radio: "EMP"
units.italian: Proprio mentre l'oggetto sparisce, un messaggio di tre lettere ti raggiunge finalmente via radio: "EMP"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|	The electric burst hits you a few seconds later; it seems to have dissipated somewhat, but it is enough to temporarily garble your communicator. A check of the tracking screen shows the Tern unscathed by the strike, but the aft of the Builder probe is now showing a worrying red glow.|5210|0
units.english: The electric burst hits you a few seconds later; it seems to have dissipated somewhat, but it is enough to temporarily garble your communicator. A check of the tracking screen shows the Tern unscathed by the strike, but the aft of the Builder probe is now showing a worrying red glow.
units.italian: La scarica elettrica ti colpisce pochi secondi dopo; sembra essersi un po' dissipata, ma basta a disturbare temporaneamente il comunicatore. Un controllo dello schermo di tracciamento mostra che il Tern è rimasto illeso dal colpo, ma il retro della sonda dei Costruttori mostra ora un preoccupante bagliore rosso.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|	You try to contact the Remnant, but the arrival of another EMP prevents you from doing so. For their part, one of the Peregrines has taken the initiative to approach the alien spacecraft.|5211|0
units.english: You try to contact the Remnant, but the arrival of another EMP prevents you from doing so. For their part, one of the Peregrines has taken the initiative to approach the alien spacecraft.
units.italian: Cerchi di contattare i Remnant, ma l'arrivo di un altro EMP te lo impedisce. Da parte loro, uno dei Peregrine ha preso l'iniziativa di avvicinarsi al veicolo alieno.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|	(Return to orbit to fight the Ka'het.)|5213|0
units.english: (Return to orbit to fight the Ka'het.)
units.italian: (Torna in orbita per combattere il Ka'het.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|	(Keep trying to speak with the Remnant.)|5215|0
units.english: (Keep trying to speak with the Remnant.)
units.italian: (Continua a cercare di parlare con i Remnant.)

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|	The Peregrine pitches up to reveal two enormous claws mounted beneath its body. It closes the distance with the target bit by bit, then makes a swift movement to catch its prey before the wind changes. It succeeds, despite the continuous lightning that now surrounds you.|5218|0
units.english: The Peregrine pitches up to reveal two enormous claws mounted beneath its body. It closes the distance with the target bit by bit, then makes a swift movement to catch its prey before the wind changes. It succeeds, despite the continuous lightning that now surrounds you.
units.italian: Il Peregrine alza il muso per rivelare due enormi artigli montati sotto il corpo. Chiude la distanza dal bersaglio poco a poco, poi fa un movimento rapido per catturare la preda prima che il vento cambi. Ci riesce, nonostante i fulmini continui che ora vi circondano.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|	Once the second Peregrine repeats the movement, a group of Remnant in extravehicular suits come out of their payload bays. Half of them work on securing the lower section of the craft, most of which is now a bright yellow hue; at the same time, you see the other few distribute along the balloon's various tethers. You see a flash. The balloon soars upward while its payload remains in the clamps of the Peregrine.|5219|0
units.english: Once the second Peregrine repeats the movement, a group of Remnant in extravehicular suits come out of their payload bays. Half of them work on securing the lower section of the craft, most of which is now a bright yellow hue; at the same time, you see the other few distribute along the balloon's various tethers. You see a flash. The balloon soars upward while its payload remains in the clamps of the Peregrine.
units.italian: Quando il secondo Peregrine ripete il movimento, un gruppo di Remnant in tute extraveicolari esce dalle stive. Metà di loro lavora a fissare la sezione inferiore del veicolo, che ora è in gran parte di un giallo brillante; allo stesso tempo, vedi gli altri pochi distribuirsi lungo i vari cavi della mongolfiera. Vedi un lampo. La mongolfiera si libra verso l'alto mentre il suo carico resta negli artigli del Peregrine.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|	"Are you there, <first>?" The radio is working again: you realize the rain of EMPs has ceased. You reply affirmatively to Taely's call. "We have what we needed. The Ka'het seems to have succeeded in bringing our Tern down, but we can worry about that from a safer place."|5220|0
units.english: "Are you there, <first>?" The radio is working again: you realize the rain of EMPs has ceased. You reply affirmatively to Taely's call. "We have what we needed. The Ka'het seems to have succeeded in bringing our Tern down, but we can worry about that from a safer place."
units.italian: "Ci sei, <first>?" La radio funziona di nuovo: capisci che la pioggia di EMP è cessata. Rispondi affermativamente alla chiamata di Taely. "Abbiamo quello che ci serviva. Sembra che i Ka'het siano riusciti ad abbattere il nostro Tern, ma possiamo preoccuparcene da un posto più sicuro."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|	While you prepare to leave, you give a final look to the tracking screen. At the top, the Ka'het is about to go out of your instruments' range. At the bottom, two sets of debris are falling through the atmosphere: one from the burst balloon, and the other from the Tern.|5221|0
units.english: While you prepare to leave, you give a final look to the tracking screen. At the top, the Ka'het is about to go out of your instruments' range. At the bottom, two sets of debris are falling through the atmosphere: one from the burst balloon, and the other from the Tern.
units.italian: Mentre ti prepari a partire, dài un ultimo sguardo allo schermo di tracciamento. In alto, il Ka'het sta per uscire dalla portata dei tuoi strumenti. In basso, due serie di detriti cadono attraverso l'atmosfera: una dalla mongolfiera scoppiata, l'altra dal Tern.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|label|5224|0
units.english: ka'het killed for the cloud probe
units.italian: ka'het killed for the cloud probe

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|Like two enormous birds of prey, the Peregrines have captured the Builder probe with a set of claws mounted beneath their bodies. You receive the communications of a group of Remnant in the middle of an extravehicular activity. Half of them work on securing the lower section of the craft, seemingly having cooled down; at the same time, you see the other few distribute along the balloon's various tethers. You see a flash. The balloon soars upward while its payload remains in the clamps of the Peregrine.|5225|0
units.english: Like two enormous birds of prey, the Peregrines have captured the Builder probe with a set of claws mounted beneath their bodies. You receive the communications of a group of Remnant in the middle of an extravehicular activity. Half of them work on securing the lower section of the craft, seemingly having cooled down; at the same time, you see the other few distribute along the balloon's various tethers. You see a flash. The balloon soars upward while its payload remains in the clamps of the Peregrine.
units.italian: Come due enormi uccelli rapaci, i Peregrine hanno catturato la sonda dei Costruttori con una serie di artigli montati sotto il corpo. Ricevi le comunicazioni di un gruppo di Remnant impegnati in un'attività extraveicolare. Metà di loro lavora a fissare la sezione inferiore del veicolo, che sembra essersi raffreddata; allo stesso tempo, vedi gli altri pochi distribuirsi lungo i vari cavi della mongolfiera. Vedi un lampo. La mongolfiera si libra verso l'alto mentre il suo carico resta negli artigli del Peregrine.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|	"Thank you for getting them off our tail, <first>," Taely radios. "We have what we needed. Plus, while I don't know how long our Tern will keep together, it seems to have survived." The Swan makes a reappearance in your tracking screen, holding well above you in the atmosphere.|5226|0
units.english: "Thank you for getting them off our tail, <first>," Taely radios. "We have what we needed. Plus, while I don't know how long our Tern will keep together, it seems to have survived." The Swan makes a reappearance in your tracking screen, holding well above you in the atmosphere.
units.italian: "Grazie per averceli tolti di dosso, <first>," dice Taely alla radio. "Abbiamo quello che ci serviva. In più, anche se non so per quanto tempo il nostro Tern reggerà, sembra essere sopravvissuto." Lo Swan riappare sullo schermo di tracciamento, ben sopra di te nell'atmosfera.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|	"Oddly enough, we have just recorded the Builder balloon imploding, rather than bursting, once it was free. We were able to catch a few fragments for later study before it fell too deeply into the atmosphere." Soon, the Peregrines signal that they are ready to leave for <planet>.|5227|0
units.english: "Oddly enough, we have just recorded the Builder balloon imploding, rather than bursting, once it was free. We were able to catch a few fragments for later study before it fell too deeply into the atmosphere." Soon, the Peregrines signal that they are ready to leave for <planet>.
units.italian: "Stranamente, abbiamo appena registrato la mongolfiera dei Costruttori implodere, invece che scoppiare, una volta liberata. Siamo riusciti a recuperare qualche frammento per studiarlo più tardi prima che cadesse troppo in profondità nell'atmosfera." Presto i Peregrine segnalano di essere pronti a partire per <planet>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|label|5230|0
units.english: ka'het killed early
units.italian: ka'het killed early

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|Gusts only somewhat less violent than the ones you encountered previously surround the Builder vehicle. You notice that the chosen Builder probe is still in the same area as the Remnant one, though higher in the atmosphere.|5231|0
units.english: Gusts only somewhat less violent than the ones you encountered previously surround the Builder vehicle. You notice that the chosen Builder probe is still in the same area as the Remnant one, though higher in the atmosphere.
units.italian: Raffiche solo un po' meno violente di quelle che hai incontrato prima circondano il veicolo dei Costruttori. Noti che la sonda dei Costruttori scelta è ancora nella stessa area di quella dei Remnant, anche se più in alto nell'atmosfera.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|	Soon enough one of the Peregrines takes the initiative to approach the alien spacecraft. It pitches up to reveal two enormous claws mounted beneath its body. It closes the distance with the target bit by bit, then makes a swift movement to catch its prey before the wind changes. It succeeds.|5233|0
units.english: Soon enough one of the Peregrines takes the initiative to approach the alien spacecraft. It pitches up to reveal two enormous claws mounted beneath its body. It closes the distance with the target bit by bit, then makes a swift movement to catch its prey before the wind changes. It succeeds.
units.italian: Presto uno dei Peregrine prende l'iniziativa di avvicinarsi al veicolo alieno. Alza il muso per rivelare due enormi artigli montati sotto il corpo. Chiude la distanza dal bersaglio poco a poco, poi fa un movimento rapido per catturare la preda prima che il vento cambi. Ci riesce.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|	You receive the communications of a group of Remnant in the middle of an extravehicular activity. Half of them work on securing the lower section of the craft, it seemingly having cooled down; at the same time, you see the other few distribute along the balloon's various tethers. You see a flash: the balloon flies away free, while the payload stays in the clamps of the Peregrines.|5234|0
units.english: You receive the communications of a group of Remnant in the middle of an extravehicular activity.
