Half of them work on securing the lower section of the craft, it seemingly having cooled down; at the same time, you see the other few distribute along the balloon's various tethers. You see a flash: the balloon flies away free, while the payload stays in the clamps of the Peregrines.
units.italian: Ricevi le comunicazioni di un gruppo di Remnant impegnati in un'attività extraveicolare. Metà di loro lavora a fissare la sezione inferiore del veicolo, che sembra essersi raffreddata; allo stesso tempo, vedi gli altri pochi distribuirsi lungo i vari cavi della mongolfiera. Vedi un lampo: la mongolfiera vola via libera, mentre il carico resta negli artigli del Peregrine.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|	"We have what we needed, <first>," Taely states through the ship's radio. "Oddly enough, we have just recorded the Builder balloon imploding, rather than bursting, once it was free. We were able to catch a few fragments for later study before it fell too deeply into the atmosphere." Soon, the Peregrines signal that they are ready to leave for <planet>.|5235|0
units.english: "We have what we needed, <first>," Taely states through the ship's radio. "Oddly enough, we have just recorded the Builder balloon imploding, rather than bursting, once it was free. We were able to catch a few fragments for later study before it fell too deeply into the atmosphere." Soon, the Peregrines signal that they are ready to leave for <planet>.
units.italian: "Abbiamo quello che ci serviva, <first>," afferma Taely alla radio della nave. "Stranamente, abbiamo appena registrato la mongolfiera dei Costruttori implodere, invece che scoppiare, una volta liberata. Siamo riusciti a recuperare qualche frammento per studiarlo più tardi prima che cadesse troppo in profondità nell'atmosfera." Presto i Peregrine segnalano di essere pronti a partire per <planet>.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|Two pairs of camels come out of the Peregrine's payload bay, pulling well-wrapped sections of the Builder craft. Taely and her team follow ceremoniously, staying at the sides of the convoy for the duration of the walk. For its part, the Swan has already taken flight for a new destination.|5252|0
units.english: Two pairs of camels come out of the Peregrine's payload bay, pulling well-wrapped sections of the Builder craft. Taely and her team follow ceremoniously, staying at the sides of the convoy for the duration of the walk. For its part, the Swan has already taken flight for a new destination.
units.italian: Due coppie di cammelli escono dalla stiva del Peregrine, trainando sezioni ben avvolte del veicolo dei Costruttori. Taely e la sua squadra seguono con solennità, restando ai lati del convoglio per tutta la durata della camminata. Da parte sua, lo Swan ha già preso il volo verso una nuova destinazione.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|	"I think we can classify this as an overall success." Based on the strange devices in her tool belt, Taely looks ready to start working on the alien vehicle. "I have received communication that all Terns are under attack by Ka'het EMPs, and most have already faltered. Though the project was not able to complete its original objective, one might say that this discovery is interesting enough to make up for it."|5253|0
units.english: "I think we can classify this as an overall success." Based on the strange devices in her tool belt, Taely looks ready to start working on the alien vehicle. "I have received communication that all Terns are under attack by Ka'het EMPs, and most have already faltered. Though the project was not able to complete its original objective, one might say that this discovery is interesting enough to make up for it."
units.italian: "Direi che possiamo classificarla come un successo complessivo." A giudicare dagli strani dispositivi nella sua cintura portautensili, Taely sembra pronta a iniziare a lavorare sul veicolo alieno. "Ho ricevuto comunicazione che tutti i Tern sono sotto attacco degli EMP dei Ka'het, e la maggior parte ha già ceduto. Anche se il progetto non è riuscito a completare il suo obiettivo originale, si potrebbe dire che questa scoperta sia abbastanza interessante da compensare."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|	"I can agree with that."|5255|0
units.english: "I can agree with that."
units.italian: "Posso essere d'accordo."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|	"Depends on what you can get out of this, I guess."|5257|0
units.english: "Depends on what you can get out of this, I guess."
units.italian: "Dipende da cosa riuscite a ricavarne, immagino."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|	"What is going to happen with the program?"|5259|0
units.english: "What is going to happen with the program?"
units.italian: "Che ne sarà del programma?"

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|	"Evidently, our original premise - that the Ka'het would not be able to reach a gaslining probe - was flawed from the start. If there is one field where the Ka'het show a modicum of inventiveness, it is direct combat. Arming one of these vehicles with a point defense system would have limited benefits, especially compared to starting over with a new idea."|5260|0
units.english: "Evidently, our original premise - that the Ka'het would not be able to reach a gaslining probe - was flawed from the start. If there is one field where the Ka'het show a modicum of inventiveness, it is direct combat. Arming one of these vehicles with a point defense system would have limited benefits, especially compared to starting over with a new idea."
units.italian: "Evidentemente la nostra premessa originale, che i Ka'het non sarebbero riusciti a raggiungere una sonda adatta all'atmosfera, era difettosa fin dall'inizio. Se c'è un campo in cui i Ka'het mostrano un minimo di inventiva, è il combattimento diretto. Armare uno di questi veicoli con un sistema di difesa di punto avrebbe benefici limitati, soprattutto rispetto a ricominciare con una nuova idea."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|	"What kind of idea?" you ask.|5261|0
units.english: "What kind of idea?" you ask.
units.italian: "Che tipo di idea?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|	She stops for a bit, then shakes her head. "We will inform you when we get a good one.|5262|0
units.english: She stops for a bit, then shakes her head. "We will inform you when we get a good one.
units.italian: Si ferma un momento, poi scuote la testa. "Vi informeremo quando ne avremo una buona.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|	"For now, I can tell you that our hopes for this Builder vehicle look promising. We have found minor signs of damage in some of its avionics, but not from discharge: rather, the electronics appear to have been overcharged in the recent past."|5268|0
units.english: "For now, I can tell you that our hopes for this Builder vehicle look promising. We have found minor signs of damage in some of its avionics, but not from discharge: rather, the electronics appear to have been overcharged in the recent past."
units.italian: "Per ora posso dirti che le nostre speranze per questo veicolo dei Costruttori sembrano promettenti. Abbiamo trovato lievi segni di danni in parte della sua avionica, ma non da scarica: l'elettronica sembra piuttosto essere stata sovraccaricata in un passato recente."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|label|5270|0
units.english: burnt electronics
units.italian: burnt electronics

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|	"For now, I can tell you that our hopes for this Builder vehicle look promising. Though most of its avionics show extensive damage, it was not caused by discharge: rather, the electronics appear to have been overcharged in the recent past."|5271|0
units.english: "For now, I can tell you that our hopes for this Builder vehicle look promising. Though most of its avionics show extensive damage, it was not caused by discharge: rather, the electronics appear to have been overcharged in the recent past."
units.italian: "Per ora posso dirti che le nostre speranze per questo veicolo dei Costruttori sembrano promettenti. Anche se gran parte della sua avionica mostra danni estesi, non sono stati causati da una scarica: l'elettronica sembra piuttosto essere stata sovraccaricata in un passato recente."

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle 5|	Soon enough, the transport stops and Taely's personnel begin unwrapping the cargo. "If you find yourself in the southern Graveyard," she says, taking a few steps toward the rest of the team, "I suggest that you keep your eyes open for anything of interest. Our short-lived project could only afford to reach the northern half, after all!" After a farewell, a promise to keep you updated, and the handover of a credit chip, she returns to her own work once again.|5273|0
units.english: Soon enough, the transport stops and Taely's personnel begin unwrapping the cargo. "If you find yourself in the southern Graveyard," she says, taking a few steps toward the rest of the team, "I suggest that you keep your eyes open for anything of interest. Our short-lived project could only afford to reach the northern half, after all!" After a farewell, a promise to keep you updated, and the handover of a credit chip, she returns to her own work once again.
units.italian: Presto il trasporto si ferma e il personale di Taely comincia a scartare il carico. "Se ti trovi nel Cimitero meridionale," dice, facendo qualche passo verso il resto della squadra, "ti suggerisco di tenere gli occhi aperti per qualsiasi cosa interessante. Il nostro progetto di breve durata poteva permettersi di raggiungere solo la metà settentrionale, dopo tutto!" Dopo un saluto, la promessa di tenerti aggiornato e la consegna di un chip di credito, torna di nuovo al suo lavoro.

units.id: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle Epilogue 2|A message from Taely appears on your commlink. "Captain," it begins, "we have successfully identified the mechanisms capable of generating energy from ion storms in both the cloud probe and the Builder satellite you helped recover, and we have since recovered more examples of this technology. In order to thank you for your efforts, we want to gift you the outfit that was once used by the Fereti warning satellite." A few minutes later, a hurried Tern unloads a compact, spiky-looking device and bolts away.|5297|0
units.context: mission:Ka'het: Lightning in a Bottle Epilogue 2
units.english: A message from Taely appears on your commlink. "Captain," it begins, "we have successfully identified the mechanisms capable of generating energy from ion storms in both the cloud probe and the Builder satellite you helped recover, and we have since recovered more examples of this technology. In order to thank you for your efforts, we want to gift you the outfit that was once used by the Fereti warning satellite." A few minutes later, a hurried Tern unloads a compact, spiky-looking device and bolts away.
units.italian: Sul tuo communicatore appare un messaggio di Taely. "Capitano," esordisce, "abbiamo identificato con successo i meccanismi capaci di generare energia dalle tempeste ioniche sia nella sonda atmosferica sia nel satellite dei Costruttori che ci hai aiutato a recuperare, e da allora abbiamo recuperato altri esempi di questa tecnologia. Per ringraziarti dei tuoi sforzi, vogliamo regalarti l'equipaggiamento che un tempo era usato dal satellite di avvertimento di Fereti." Pochi minuti dopo, un Tern frettoloso scarica un dispositivo compatto dall'aspetto appuntito e schizza via.
